H769.d: or אַרְנֹןlemma אַרְנן missing vowel, corrected to אַרְנֹן; from רָנַן; a brawling stream; the Arnon, a river east of the Jordan, also its territory; Arnon.

H770.d: probably from the same as אַרְנוֹן; noisy; Arnan, an Israelite; Arnan.

H771.d: probably from אֹרֶן; strong; Ornan, a Jebusite; Ornan. See אֲרַוְנָה.

H772.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to אֶרֶץ; the earth; by implication (figuratively) low; earth, interior.

H773.d: (Aramaic) feminine of אֲרַע; the bottom; bottom.

H774.d: from רָפַד; spread out; Arpad, a place in Syria; Arpad, Arphad.

H775.d: probably of foreign origin; Arpakshad, a son of Noah; also the region settled by him; Arphaxad.

H776.d: from an unused root probably meaning to be firm; the earth (at large, or partitively a land); [idiom] common, country, earth, field, ground, land, [idiom] natins, way, [phrase] wilderness, world.

H777.d: from אֶרֶץ; earthiness; Artsa, an Israelite; Arza.

H778.d: (Aramaic) by transmutation for אֲרַע; the earth; earth.

H779.d: a primitive root; to execrate; [idiom] bitterly curse.

H780.d: of foreign origin; Ararat (or rather Armenia); Ararat, Armenia.

H781.d: a primitive root; to engage for matrimony; betroth, espouse.

H782.d: from אָרַשׂ (in the sense of desiring to possess); a longing for; request.

H783.d: or אַרְתַּחְשַׁשְׁתְּא; or by permutation אַרְתַּחְשַׁסְתְּא; of foreign origin; Artachshasta (or Artaxerxes), a title (rather than name) of several Persian kings; Artaxerxes.

H784.d: a primitive word; fire (literally or figuratively); burning, fiery, fire, flaming, hot.

H785.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to אֵשׁ; {fire (literally or figuratively)}; flame.

H786.d: identical (in origin and formation) with אֵשׁ; entity, used only adverbially, there is or are; are there, none can. Compare יֵשׁ.

H787.d: (Aramaic) corresponding (by transposition and abbreviation) to אֲשׁוּיָה; a foundation; foundation.

H788.d: probably from the same as שֹׁבֶל; flowing; Ashbel, an Israelite; Ashbel.

H789.d: patronymic from אַשְׁבֵּל; an Ashbelite (collectively) or descendant of Ashbel; Ashbelites.

H790.d: lemma אֶשְּׁבָּן extra dagesh, corrected to אֶשְׁבָּן; probably from the same as שֶׁבְנָא; vigorous; Eshban, an Idumaean; Eshban.

H791.d: from שָׁבַע; adjurer; Asbea, an Israelite; Ashbea.

H792.d: from אִישׁ and בַּעַל; man of Baal; Eshbaal (or Ishbosheth), a son of Saul; Eshbaal.

H793.d: from an unused root meaning to pour; an outpouring; stream.

H794.d: feminine of אֶשֶׁד; a ravine; springs.

H795.d: from שָׁדַד; ravager; Ashdod, a place in Palestine; Ahdod.

H796.d: patrial from אַשְׁדּוֹד; an Ashdodite (often collectively) or inhabitant of Asdod; Ashdodites, of Ashdod.

H797.d: feminine of אַשְׁדּוֹדִי; (only adverb) in the language of Ashdod; in the speech of Ashdod.

H798.d: from the plural of אֲשֵׁדָה and פִּסְגָּה with the article interposed; ravines of the Pisgah; Ashdoth-Pisgah, a place east of the Jordan; Ashdoth-pisgah.

H799.d: from אֵשׁ and דָּת; a fire-law; fiery law.

H801.d: the same as אֶשָּׁה, but used in a liturgical sense; properly, a burnt-offering; but occasionally of any sacrifice; (offering, sacrifice), (made) by fire.

H802.d: feminine of אִישׁ or אֱנוֹשׁ; irregular plural, נָשִׁים;(used in the same wide sense as אֱנוֹשׁ); a woman; (adulter) ess, each, every, female, [idiom] many, [phrase] none, one, [phrase] together, wife, woman. Often unexpressed in English.

H803.d: feminine passive participle from an unused root meaning to found; foundation; foundation.

H804.d: or אַשֻּׁר; apparently from אָשַׁר (in the sense of successful); Ashshur, the second son of Shem; also his descendants and the country occupied by them (i.e. Assyria), its region and its empire; Asshur, Assur, Assyria, Assyrians. See אָשֻׁר.

H805.d: or אַשּׁוּרִי; from a patrial word of the same form as אַשּׁוּר; an Ashurite (collectively) or inhabitant of Ashur, a district in Palestine; Asshurim, Ashurites.

H806.d: probably from שָׁחַר; black; Ashchur, an Israelite; Ashur.

H807.d: of foreign origin; Ashima, a deity of Hamath; Ashima.

H808.d: from the same as אֵשׁ (in the sense of pressing down firmly; compare אֲשׁוּיָה); a (ruined) foundation; foundation.

H809.d: feminine of אָשִׁישׁ; something closely pressed together, i.e. a cake of raisins or other comfits; flagon.

H810.d: from an unused root (probably meaning to bunch together); a testicle (as a lump); stone.

H811.d: or אֶשְׁכֹּל; probably prolonged from אֶשֶׁךְ; a bunch of grapes or other fruit; cluster (of grapes).

H812.d: the same as אֶשְׁכּוֹל; Eshcol, the name of an Amorite, also of a valley in Palestine; Eshcol.

H813.d: of foreign origin; Ashkenaz, a Japhethite, also his descendants; Ashkenaz.

H814.d: for שָׂכָר; a gratuity; gift, present.

H815.d: from a root of uncertain signification; a tamarisk tree; by extension, a grove of any kind; grove, tree.

H816.d: or אָשֵׁם; a primitive root; to be guilty; by implication to be punished or perish; [idiom] certainly, be(-come, made) desolate, destroy, [idiom] greatly, be(-come, found, hold) guilty, offend (acknowledge offence), trespass.

H817.d: from אָשַׁם; guilt; by implication, a fault; also a sin-offering; guiltiness, (offering for) sin, trespass (offering).

H818.d: from אָשַׁם; guilty; hence, presenting asin-offering; one which is faulty, guilty.

H819.d: feminine of אָשָׁם; guiltiness, a fault, the presentation of asin-offering; offend, sin, (cause of) trespass(-ing, offering).

H820.d: probably from שֶׁמֶן; a fat-field; desolate place.

H821.d: or אַשׁמוּרָה; or אַשׁמֹרֶת; (feminine) from שָׁמַר; a night watch; watch.

H822.d: apparently from an unused root (probably meaning to leave interstices); a latticed window; casement, lattice.

H823.d: probably a variation for יְשָׁנָה; Ashnah, the name of two places in Palestine; Ashnah.

H824.d: from שָׁעַן; support; Eshan, a place in Palestine; Eshean.

H825.d: from an unused root (probably meaning to lisp, i.e. practice enchantment); a conjurer; astrologer.

H827.d: perhaps (feminine) from the same as אַשָּׁף (in the sense of covering); a quiver or arrow-case; quiver.

H828.d: of foreign origin; Ashpenaz, a Babylonian eunuch; Ashpenaz.

H829.d: of uncertain derivation; a measured portion; good piece (of flesh).

H830.d: or אַשְׁפּוֹת; or שְׁפֹת; (contraction) plural of a noun of the same form as אַשְׁפָּה, from שָׁפָה (in the sense of scraping); a heap of rubbish or filth; dung (hill).

H831.d: probably from שָׁקַל in the sense of weighing-place (i.e. mart); Ashkelon, a place in Palestine; Ashkelon, Askalon.

H832.d: patrial from אַשְׁקְלוֹן; Ashkelonite (collectively) or inhabitant of Ashkelon; Eshkalonites.

H833.d: or אָשֵׁר; a primitive root; to be straight (used in the widest sense, especially to be level, right, happy); figuratively, to go forward, be honest, proper; (call, be) bless(-ed, happy), go, guide, lead, relieve.

H834.d: a primitive relative pronoun (of every gender and number); who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.; [idiom] after, [idiom] alike, as (soon as), because, [idiom] every, for, [phrase] forasmuch, [phrase] from whence, [phrase] how(-soever), [idiom] if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), [idiom] though, [phrase] until, [phrase] whatsoever, when, where ([phrase] -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, [phrase] whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.

H835.d: from אָשַׁר; happiness; only in masculine plural construction as interjection, how happy!; blessed, happy.

H836.d: from אָשַׁר,; happy; Asher, a son of Jacob, and the tribe descended from him, with its territory; also a place in Palestine; Asher

H838.d: or אַשֻּׁר; from אָשַׁר in the sense of going; a step; going, step.

H839.d: contracted for תְּאַשּׁוּר; the cedar tree or some other light elastic wood; Ashurite.

H840.d: by orthographical variation from אָשַׁר and אֵל; right of God; Asarel, an Israelite; Asareel.

H841.d: from the same as אֲשַׂרְאֵל; right toward God; Asarelah, an Israelite; Asarelah. Compare יְשַׂרְאֵלָה.

H842.d: or אֲשֵׁירָה; from אָשַׁר; happy; Asherah (or Astarte) a Phoenician goddess; also an image of the same; grove. Compare עַשְׁתֹּרֶת.

H843.d: patronymic from אָשֵׁר; an Asherite (collectively) or descendant of Asher; Asherites.

H844.d: an orthographical variation for אֲשַׂרְאֵל; Asriel, the name of two Israelites; Ashriel, Asriel.

H845.d: patronymic from אַשְׂרִיאֵל; an Asrielite (collectively) or descendant of Asriel; Asrielites.

H846.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to אָשַׁר; a wall (from its uprightness); wall.

H847.d: or אֶשְׁתָּאוֹל; probably from שָׁאַל; intreaty; Eshtaol, a place in Palestine; Eshtaol.

H848.d: patrial from אֶשְׁתָּאֹל; an Eshtaolite (collectively) or inhabitant of Eshtaol; Eshtaulites.

H849.d: (Aramaic) from שְׁדַר (in a bad sense); rebellion; sedition.

H850.d: probably from the same as שׁוּנִי; restful; Eshton, an Israelite; Eshton.

H851.d: or אֶשְׁתְּמוֹעַ; or אֶשְׁתְּמֹה; from שָׁמַע (in the sense of obedience); Eshtemoa or Eshtemoh, a place in Palestine; Eshtemoa, Eshtemoh.

H852.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to אוֹת; a portent; sign.

H853.d: apparent contracted from אוֹת in the demonstrative sense of entity; properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely); (as such unrepresented in English).

H854.d: probably from אָנָה; properly, nearness (used only as a preposition or an adverb), near; hence, generally, with, by, at, among, etc.; against, among, before, by, for, from, in(-to), (out) of, with. Often with another prepositional prefix.

H855.d: of uncertain derivation; a hoe or other digging implement; coulter, plowshare.

H856.d: from אֵת and בַּעַל; with Baal; Ethbaal, a Phoenician king; Ethbaal.

H857.d: or אָתָא; a primitive root (collateral to אוּת contraction); to arrive; (be-, things to) come (upon), bring.

H858.d: (Aramaic) or אָתָא; (Aramaic), corresponding to אָתָה; {to arrive}; (be-) come, bring.

H859.d: or (shortened); אַתָּ; or אַת; feminine (irregular) sometimes אַתִּי; plural masculine אַתֶּם; feminine אַתֶּן; or אַתֵּנָהlemma אתֵּנָה missing vowel, corrected to אַתֵּנָה; or אַתֵּנָּה; a primitive pronoun of the second person; thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you; thee, thou, ye, you.

H860.d: probably from the same as אֵיתָן (in the sense of patience); a female donkey (from its docility); (she) ass.

H861.d: (Aramaic) probably from the corresponding to אֵשׁ; probably a fire-place, i.e. furnace; furnace.

H862.d: or אַתִּיק; from נָתַק in the sense of decreasing; a ledge or offset in abuilding; gallery.

H863.d: or אִיתַי; from אֵת; near; Ittai or Ithai, the name of a Gittite and of an Israelite; Ithai, Ittai.

H864.d: of Egyptian derivation; Etham, a place in the Desert; Etham.

H865.d: or אִתְמוֹל; or אֶתְמוּל; probably from אֵת or אֵת and מוּל; heretofore; definitely yesterday; [phrase] before (that) time, [phrase] heretofore, of late (old), [phrase] times past, yester(day).

H866.d: from תָּנָה; a present (as the price of harlotry); reward.

H867.d: perhaps from אֶתְנָה; munificence; Ethni, an Israelite; Ethni.

H868.d: the same as אֶתְנָה; a gift (as the price of harlotry or idolatry); hire, reward.

H869.d: the same as אֶתְנַן in the sense of אֶתְנִי; Ethnan, an Israelite; Ethnan.

H870.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to that of אֲתָרִים; a place; (adverb) after; after, place.

H871.d: plural from an unused root (probably meaning to step); places; Atharim, a place near Palestine; spies. b

H872.d: from בּוֹא; an entrance to a building; entry.

H874.d: a primitive root; to dig; by analogy, to engrave; figuratively, to explain; declare, (make) plain(-ly).

H875.d: from בָּאַר; a pit; especially a well; pit, well.

H876.d: the same as בְּאֵר; Beer, a place in the Desert, also one in Palestine; Beer.

H878.d: from בְּאֵר; a well; Beera, an Israelite; Beera.

H879.d: from בְּאֵר and the plural of אֵל; well of heroes; Beer-Elim, a place in the Desert; Beer-elim.

H880.d: the same as בְּאֵרָא; Beerah, an Israelite; Beerah.

H881.d: feminine plural of בְּאֵר; wells; Beeroth, a place in Palestine; Beeroth.

H882.d: from בְּאֵר; fountained; Beeri, the name of a Hittite and of an Israelite; Beeri.

H883.d: from בְּאֵר and חַי (with prefix) and רֹאֶה; well of a living (One) my Seer; Beer-Lachai-Roi, a place in the Desert; Beer-lahai-roi.

H884.d: from בְּאֵר and שֶׁבַע (in the sense of שָׁבַע); well of an oath; Beer-Sheba, a place in Palestine; Beer-shebah.

H885.d: xlit Bᵉêrôth corrected to Bᵉʼêrôth; from the feminine plural of בְּאֵר, and the plural contraction of בֵּן, and יַעֲקָן; wells of (the) sons of Jaakan; Beeroth-Bene-Jaakan, a place in the Desert; Beeroth of the children of Jaakan.

H886.d: patrial from בְּאֵרוֹת; a Beerothite or inhabitant of Beeroth; Beerothite.

H887.d: a primitive root; to smell bad; figuratively, to be offensive morally; (make to) be abhorred (had in abomination, loathsome, odious), (cause a, make to) stink(-ing savour), [idiom] utterly.

H888.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to בָּאַשׁ; {to smell bad; figuratively, to be offensive morally}; displease.

H890.d: feminine of בְּאֹשׁ; stink-weed or any other noxious or useless plant; cockle.

H891.d: plural of בְּאֹשׁ; poison-berries; wild grapes.

H892.d: feminine active participle of an unused root meaning to hollow out; something hollowed (as a gate), i.e. pupil of the eye; apple (of the eye).

H893.d: probably of foreign origin; Bebai, an Israelite; Bebai.

H894.d: from בָּלַל; confusion; Babel (i.e. Babylon), including Babylonia and the Babylonian empire; Babel, Babylon.

H895.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to בָּבֶל; {Babel (i.e. Babylon), including Babylonia and the Babylonian empire}; Babylon.

H896.d: (Aramaic) patrial from בַּבֶל; a Babylonian; Babylonia.

H897.d: a Persian word; food; spoil (from the margin for בַּז.)

H898.d: a primitive root; to cover (with a garment); figuratively, to act covertly; by implication, to pillage; deal deceitfully (treacherously, unfaithfully), offend, transgress(-or), (depart), treacherous (dealer, -ly, man), unfaithful(-ly, man), [idiom] very.

H899.d: from בָּגַד; a covering, i.e. clothing; also treachery or pillage; apparel, cloth(-es, ing), garment, lap, rag, raiment, robe, [idiom] very (treacherously), vesture, wardrobe.

H900.d: feminine plural active participle of בָּגַד; treacheries; treacherous.

H902.d: probably of foreign origin; Bigvai, an Israelite; Bigvai.

H903.d: of Persian derivation; Bigtha, a eunuch of Xerxes; Bigtha.

H904.d: or בִּגְתָנָא; of similar derivation to בִּגְתָא; Bigthan or Bigthana, a eunuch of Xerxes; Bigthan, Bigthana.

H905.d: from בָּדַד; properly, separation; by implication, a part of the body, branch of atree, bar forcarrying; figuratively, chief of a city; especially (with prepositional prefix) as an adverb, apart, only, besides; alone, apart, bar, besides, branch, by self, of each alike, except, only, part, staff, strength.

H906.d: perhaps from בָּדַד (in the sense of divided fibres); flaxen thread or yarn; hence, a linen garment; linen.

H907.d: from בָּדָא; a brag or lie; also a liar; liar, lie.

H908.d: a primitive root; (figuratively) to invent; devise, feign.

H909.d: a primitive root; to divide, i.e. (reflex.) be solitary; alone.

H910.d: from בָּדַד; separate; adverb, separately; alone, desolate, only, solitary.

H911.d: from בָּדַד; separation; Bedad, an Edomite; Bedad.

H912.d: probably a shortened form עֹבַדְיָה; servant of Jehovah; Bedejah, an Israelite; Bedeiah.

H913.d: from בָּדַל; alloy (because removed by smelting); by analogy, tin; [phrase] plummet, tin.

H914.d: a primitive root; to divide (in variation senses literally or figuratively, separate, distinguish, differ, select, etc.); (make, put) difference, divide (asunder), (make) separate (self, -ation), sever (out), [idiom] utterly.

H916.d: probably from בָּדַל; something in pieces, i.e. bdellium, a (fragrant) gum (perhaps amber); others a pearl; bdellium.

H917.d: probably shortened for עַבְדוֹן; servile; Bedan, the name of two Israelites; Bedan.

H918.d: a primitive root; to gap open; used only as a denominative from בֶּדֶק; to mend a breach; repair.

H919.d: from בָּדַק; a gap or leak (in a building or a ship); breach, [phrase] calker.

H920.d: probably from דָּקַר with a prepositional prefix; by stabbing, i.e. assassin; Bidkar, an Israelite; Bidkar.

H921.d: (Aramaic) corresponding (by transposition) to פָּרַד; to scatter; scatter.

H922.d: from an unused root (meaning to be empty); a vacuity, i.e. (superficially) an undistinguishable ruin; emptiness, void.

H923.d: from an unused root (probably meaning to glisten); white marble or perhaps alabaster; red (marble).

H924.d: (Aramaic) from בְּהַל; a hurry; only adverb, hastily; in haste.

H925.d: from an unused root (meaning to be bright); shining; bright.

H926.d: a primitive root; to tremble inwardly (or palpitate), i.e. (figuratively) be (causative, make) (suddenly) alarmed or agitated; by implication to hasten anxiously; be (make) affrighted (afraid, amazed, dismayed, rash), (be, get, make) haste(-n, -y, -ily), (give) speedy(-ily), thrust out, trouble, vex.

H927.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to בָּהַל; to terrify, hasten; in haste, trouble.

H928.d: from בָּהַל; panic, destruction; terror, trouble.

H929.d: from an unused root (probably meaning to be mute); properly, a dumb beast; especially any large quadruped or animal (often collective); beast, cattle.

H930.d: in form a plural or בְּהֵמָה, but really a singular of Egyptian derivation; a water-ox, i.e. the hippopotamus or Nile-horse; Behemoth.

H931.d: from an unused root apparently meaning to be thick; the thumb of the hand or great toe of the foot; thumb, great toe.

H932.d: an orthographical variation of בֹּהֶן; thumb, Bohan, an Israelite; Bohan.

H933.d: from an unused root meaning to be pale; white scurf; freckled spot.

H934.d: feminine active participle of the same as בָּהִיר; a whitish spot on the skin; bright spot.

H935.d: a primitive root; to go or come (in a wide variety of applications); abide, apply, attain, [idiom] be, befall, [phrase] besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call, carry, [idiom] certainly, (cause, let, thing for) to come (against, in, out, upon, to pass), depart, [idiom] doubtless again, [phrase] eat, [phrase] employ, (cause to) enter (in, into, -tering, -trance, -try), be fallen, fetch, [phrase] follow, get, give, go (down, in, to war), grant, [phrase] have, [idiom] indeed, (in-) vade, lead, lift (up), mention, pull in, put, resort, run (down), send, set, [idiom] (well) stricken (in age), [idiom] surely, take (in), way.

H936.d: a primitive root; to disrespect; contemn, despise, [idiom] utterly.

H937.d: from בּוּז; disrespect; contempt(-uously), despised, shamed.

H938.d: the same as בּוּז; Buz, the name of a son of Nahor, and of an Israelite; Buz.

H939.d: feminine passive participle of בּוּז; something scorned; an object of contempt; despised.

H940.d: patronymic from בּוּז; a Buzite or descendant of Buz; Buzite.

H941.d: the same as בּוּזִי; Buzi, an Israelite; Buzi.

H942.d: probably of Persian origin; Bavvai, an Israelite; Bavai.

H943.d: a primitive root; to involve (literally or figuratively); be entangled, (perplexed).

H944.d: for יְבוּל; produce (of the earth, etc.); food, stock.

H945.d: the same as בּוּל (in the sense of rain); Bul, the eighth Hebrew month; Bul.

H946.d: from בִּין; discretion; Bunah, an Israelite; Bunah.

H947.d: a primitive root; to trample (literally or figuratively); loath, tread (down, under (foot)), be polluted.

H948.d: from an unused root (of the same form) meaning to bleach, i.e. (intransitive) be white; probably cotton (of some sort); fine (white) linen.

H949.d: from the same as בּוּץ; shining; Botsets, a rock near Michmash; Bozez.

H950.d: feminine passive participle of an unused root (meaning to be hollow); emptiness (as adjective); empty.

H951.d: lemma בּוֹקִר second vowel, corrected to בּוֹקֵר; xlit bôwkêr corrected to bôwqêr; properly, active participle from בָּקַר as denominative from בָּקָר; a cattle-tender; herdman.

H952.d: a primitive root; to bore, i.e. (figuratively) examine; declare.

H953.d: from בּוּר (in the sense of בֹּאר); a pit hole (especially one used as a cistern or a prison); cistern, dungeon, fountain, pit, well.

H954.d: a primitive root; properly, to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed; also (by implication) to be disappointed or delayed; (be, make, bring to, cause, put to, with, a-) shamed(-d), be (put to) confounded(-fusion), become dry, delay, be long.

H955.d: feminine participle passive of בּוּשׁ; shame; shame.

H956.d: (Aramaic) apparent denominative from בַּיִת; to lodge over night; pass the night.

H957.d: from בָּזַז; plunder; booty, prey, spoil(-ed).

H958.d: a primitive root; probably to cleave; spoil.

H959.d: a primitive root; to disesteem; despise, disdain, contemn(-ptible), [phrase] think to scorn, vile person.

H961.d: feminine of בַּז; booty; prey, spoil.

H962.d: a primitive root; to plunder; catch, gather, (take) for a prey, rob(-ber), spoil, take (away, spoil), [idiom] utterly.

H964.d: from בָּזָה and יָהּ; contempts of Jah; Bizjothjah, a place in Palestine; Bizjothjah.

H965.d: from an unused root meaning to lighten; a flash of lightning; flash of lightning.

H966.d: from בָּזָק; lightning; Bezek, a place in Palestine; Bezek.

H967.d: a primitive root; to disperse; scatter.

H968.d: of Persian origin; Biztha, a eunuch of Xerxes; Biztha.

H969.d: xlit bâchôwnʼ corrected to bâchôwn; from בָּחַן; an assayer or metals; tower.

H970.d: or בָּחֻר; participle passive of בָּחַר; properly, selected, i.e. a youth (often collective); (choice) young (man), chosen, [idiom] hole.

H971.d: another form of בַּחַן; a watch-tower of besiegers; tower.

H972.d: from בָּחַר; select; choose, chosen one, elect.

H973.d: a primitive root; to loath; abhor, get hastily (from the margin for בָּהַל).

H974.d: a primitive root; to test (especially metals); generally and figuratively, to investigate; examine, prove, tempt, try (trial).

H975.d: from בָּחַן (in the sense of keeping a look-out); a watch-tower; tower.

H977.d: a primitive root; properly, to try, i.e. (by implication) select; acceptable, appoint, choose (choice), excellent, join, be rather, require.

H978.d: patrial from בַּחֻרִים (by transposition); a Bacharumite or inhabitant of Bachurim; Baharumite.

H979.d: or בְּחוּרוֹת; feminine plural of בָּחוּר; also (masculine plural) בְּחֻרִים; youth (collectively and abstractly); young men, youth.

H980.d: or בַּחוּרִים; masculine plural of בָּחוּר; young men; Bachurim, a place in Palestine; Bahurim.

H981.d: or בָּטָה; a primitive root; to babble; hence, to vociferate angrily; pronounce, speak (unadvisedly).

H982.d: a primitive root; properly, to hide for refuge (but not so precipitately as חָסָה); figuratively, to trust, be confident or sure; be bold (confident, secure, sure), careless (one, woman), put confidence, (make to) hope, (put, make to) trust.

H983.d: from בָּטַח; properly, a place of refuge; abstract, safety, both the fact (security) and the feeling (trust); often (adverb with or without preposition) safely; assurance, boldly, (without) care(-less), confidence, hope, safe(-ly, -ty), secure, surely.

H984.d: the same as בֶּטַח; Betach, a place in Syria; Betah.

H987.d: feminine plural from בָּטַח; security; secure.

H988.d: a primitive root; to desist from labor; cease.

H989.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to בָּטֵל; to stop; (cause, make to), cease, hinder.

H990.d: from an unused root probably meaning to be hollow; the belly, especially the womb; also the bosom or body of anything; belly, body, [phrase] as they be born, [phrase] within, womb.

H991.d: the same as בֶּטֶן; Beten. a place in Palestine; Beten.

H992.d: from בֶּטֶן; (only in plural) a pistachio-nut (from its form); nut.

H993.d: probably plural from בֹּטֶן; hollows; Betonim, a place in Palestine; Betonim.

H994.d: perhaps from בָּעָה (in the sense of asking); properly, a request; used only adverbially (always with 'my Lord'); oh that!; with leave, or if it please; alas, O, oh.

H995.d: a primitive root; to separate mentally (or distinguish), i.e.(generally) understand; attend, consider, be cunning, diligently, direct, discern, eloquent, feel, inform, instruct, have intelligence, know, look well to, mark, perceive, be prudent, regard, (can) skill(-full), teach, think, (cause, make to, get, give, have) understand(-ing), view, (deal) wise(-ly, man).

H996.d: (sometimes in the plural masculine or feminine); properly, the constructive form of an otherwise unused noun from בִּין; a distinction; but used only as a preposition,; between (repeated before each noun, often with other particles); also as a conjunction, either...or; among, asunder, at, between (-twixt...and), [phrase] from (the widest), [idiom] in, out of, whether (it be...or), within.

H997.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to בֵּין; {between (repeated before each noun, often with other particles); also as a conjunction, either...or}; among, between.

H998.d: from בִּין; understanding; knowledge, meaning, [idiom] perfectly, understanding, wisdom.

H1000.d: from the same as בּוּץ; an egg (from its whiteness); egg.

H1001.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to בִּירָה; a palace; palace.

H1002.d: of foreign origin; a castle or palace; palace.

H1004.d: probably from בָּנָה abbreviated; a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.); court, daughter, door, [phrase] dungeon, family, [phrase] forth of, [idiom] great as would contain, hangings, home(born), (winter) house(-hold), inside(-ward), palace, place, [phrase] prison, [phrase] steward, [phrase] tablet, temple, web, [phrase] within(-out).

H1005.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to בַּיִת; {a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)}; house.

H1006.d: the same as בַּיִת; Bajith, a place in Palestine; Bajith.

H1007.d: from בַּיִת and אָוֶן; house of vanity; Beth-Aven, a place in Palestine; Beth-aven.

H1008.d: from בַּיִת and אֵל; house of God; Beth-El, a place in Palestine; Beth-el.

H1009.d: from בַּיִת and אֶרֶב and אֵל; house of God's ambush; Beth-Arbel, a place in Palestine; Beth-Arbel.

H1010.d: from בַּיִת and בַּעַל and מָעוֹן; house of Baal of (the) habitation of (apparently by transposition); or (shorter) בֵּית מְעוֹןlemma בֵּית מעוֹן missing vowel, corrected to בֵּית מְעוֹן; house of habitation of (Baal); Beth-Baal-Meon, a place in Palestine; Beth-baal-meon. Compare בַּעַל מְעוֹן and בְּעֹן.

H1011.d: xlit Birʻîy corrected to Birʼîy; from בַּיִת and בָּרָא; house of a creative one; Beth-Biri, a place in Palestine; Bethbirei.

H1012.d: probably from בַּיִת and עֲבָרָה; house of (the) ford; Beth-Barah, a place in Palestine; Beth-barah.

H1013.d: from בַּיִת and גָּדֵר; house of (the) wall; Beth-Gader, a place in Palestine; Beth-gader.

H1014.d: from בַּיִת and the passive participle of גְּמוּל; house of (the) weaned; Beth-Gamul, a place East of the Jordan; Beth-gamul.

H1015.d: from בַּיִת and the dual of דְּבֵלָה; house of (the) two figcakes; Beth-Diblathajim, a place East of the Jordan; Beth-diblathaim.

H1016.d: from בַּיִת and דָּגוֹן; house of Dagon; Beth-Dagon, the name of two places in Palestine; Beth-dagon.

H1017.d: patrial from בֵּית־אֵל with the article interposed; a Beth-elite, or inhabitant of Bethel; Bethelite.

H1018.d: from בַּיִת and אֵצֶל with the article interposed; house of the side; Beth-ha-Etsel, a place in Palestine; Beth-ezel.

H1019.d: from בַּיִת and גִּלְגָּל with the article interposed; house of Gilgal (or rolling); Beth-hag-Gilgal, a place in Palestine; Beth-gilgal.

H1020.d: from בַּיִת and the plural of יְשִׁימַה with the article interposed; house of the deserts; Beth-ha-Jeshimoth, a town East of the Jordan; Beth-jeshimoth.

H1021.d: from בַּיִת and כֶּרֶם with the article interposed; house of the vineyard; Beth-hak-Kerem, a place in Palestine; Beth-haccerem.

H1022.d: patrial from בֵּית לֶחֶם with the article inserted; a Beth-lechemite, or native of Bethlechem; Bethlehemite.

H1023.d: from בַּיִת and מֶרְחָק with the article interposed; house of the breadth; Beth-ham-Merchak, a place in Palestine; place that was far off.

H1024.d: or (shortened) בֵּית מַרְכָּבוֹת; from בַּיִת and the plural of מֶרְכָּבָה (with or without the article interposed); place of (the) chariots; Beth-ham-Markaboth or Beth-Markaboth, a place in Palestine; Bethmarcaboth.

H1025.d: from בַּיִת and עֵמֶק with the article interposed; house of the valley; Beth-ha-Emek, a place in Palestine; Beth-emek.

H1026.d: from בַּיִת and עֲרָבָה with the article interposed; house of the Desert; Beth-ha-Arabah, a place in Palestine; Beth-arabah.

H1027.d: from בַּיִת and רוּם with the article interposed; house of the height; Beth-ha-Ram, a place East of the Jordan; Beth-aram.

H1028.d: probably for בֵּית הָרָם; Beth-ha-Ram, a place East of the Jordan; Beth-haran.

H1029.d: from בַּיִת and שִׁטָּה with the article interposed; house of the acacia; Beth-hash-Shittah, a place in Palestine; Beth-shittah.

H1030.d: patrial from בֵּית שֶׁמֶשׁ with the article inserted; a Beth-shimshite, or inhabitant of Bethshemesh; Bethshemite.

H1031.d: from בַּיִת and the same as חׇגְלָה; house of a partridge; Beth-Choglah, a place in Palestine; Beth-hoglah.

H1032.d: from בַּיִת and חוֹר; house of hollowness; Beth-Choron, the name of two adjoining places in Palestine; Beth-horon.

H1033.d: from בַּיִת and כַּר; house of pasture; Beth-Car, a place in Palestine; Beth-car.

H1034.d: from בַּיִת and the plural of לָבִיא; house of lionesses; Beth-Lebaoth, a place in Palestine; Beth-lebaoth. Compare לְבָאוֹת.

H1035.d: from בַּיִת and לֶחֶם; house of bread; Beth-Lechem, a place in Palestine; Bethlehem.

H1036.d: from בַּיִת and the feminine of עָפָר (with preposition interposed); house to (i.e. of) dust; Beth-le-Aphrah, a place in Palestine; house of Aphrah.

H1037.d: or בֵּית מִלֹּא; from בַּיִת and מִלּוֹא; house of (the) rampart; Beth-Millo, the name of two citadels; house of Millo.

H1038.d: from בַּיִת and מַעֲכָה; house of Maakah; Beth-Maakah, a place in Palestine; Beth-maachah.

H1039.d: from בַּיִת and the feminine of נָמֵר; house of (the) leopard; Beth-Nimrah, a place east of the Jordan; Beth-Nimrah. Compare נִמְרָה.

H1040.d: from בַּיִת and עֵדֶן; house of pleasure; Beth-Eden, a place in Syria; Beth-eden.

H1041.d: from בַּיִת and עַזְמָוֶת; house of Azmaveth, a place in Palestine; Bethaz-maveth. Compare עַזְמָוֶת.

H1042.d: from בַּיִת and a plural from עָנָה; house of replies; Beth-Anoth, a place in Palestine; Beth-anoth.

H1043.d: an orthographical variation for בֵּית עֲנוֹת; Beth-Anath, a place in Palestine; Beth-anath.

H1044.d: from בַּיִת and a derivative of עָקַד; house of (the) binding (for sheep-shearing); Beth-Eked, a place in Palestine; shearing house.

H1045.d: ; from בַּיִת and עַשְׁתָּרוֹת; house of Ashtoreths; Beth-Ashtaroth, a place in Palestine; house of Ashtaroth. Compare בְּעֶשְׁתְּרָה, עַשְׁתָּרוֹת.

H1046.d: from בַּיִת and פָּלִיט; house of escape; Beth-Palet, a place in Palestine; Beth-palet.

H1047.d: from בַּיִת and פְּעוֹר; house of Peor; Beth-Peor, a place East of the Jordan; Bethpeor.

H1048.d: from בַּיִת and a derivative from פּוּץ; house of dispersion; Beth-Patstsets, a place in Palestine; Beth-pazzez.

H1049.d: from בַּיִת and צוּר; house of (the) rock; Beth-Tsur, a place in Palestine; Beth-zur.

H1050.d: from בַּיִת and רְחֹב; house of (the) street; Beth-Rechob, a place in Palestine; Beth-rehob.

H1051.d: from בַּיִת and רָפָא; house of (the) giant; Beth-Rapha, an Israelite; Beth-rapha.

H1052.d: or בֵּית שָׁן; from בַּיִת and שָׁאַן; house of ease; Beth-Shean or Beth-Shan, a place in Palestine; Beth-shean, Beth-Shan.

H1053.d: from בַּיִת and שֶׁמֶשׁ; house of (the) sun; Beth-Shemesh, a place in Palestine; Beth-shemesh.

H1054.d: from בַּיִת and תַּפּוּחַ; house of (the) apple; Beth-Tappuach, a place in Palestine; Beth-tappuah.

H1055.d: probably from בַּיִת; a palace (i.e. large house); palace.

H1056.d: from בָּכָה, weeping; Baca, a valley in Palestine; Baca.

H1057.d: the same as בָּכָא; the weeping tree (some gum-distilling tree, perhaps the balsam); mulberry tree.

H1058.d: a primitive root; to weep; generally to bemoan; [idiom] at all, bewail, complain, make lamentation, [idiom] more, mourn, [idiom] sore, [idiom] with tears, weep.

H1060.d: from בָּכַר; firstborn; hence, chief; eldest (son), firstborn(-ling).

H1061.d: from בָּכַר; the first-fruits of the crop; first fruit (-ripe (figuratively)), hasty fruit.

H1062.d: or (short) בְּכֹרָה; feminine of בְּכוֹר; the firstling of man or beast; abstractly primogeniture; birthright, firstborn(-ling).

H1063.d: feminine of בִּכּוּר; the early fig; firstripe (fruit).

H1064.d: feminine of בְּכוֹרָה; primogeniture; Bekorath, an Israelite; Bechorath.

H1065.d: from בָּכָה; a weeping; by analogy, a dripping; overflowing, [idiom] sore, (continual) weeping, wept.

H1066.d: plural active participle of בָּכָה; (with the article) the weepers; Bo-kim, a place in Palestine; Bochim.

H1067.d: xlit bekîyrâh corrected to bᵉkîyrâh; feminine from בָּכַר; the eldest daughter; firstborn.

H1069.d: a primitive root; properly, to burst the womb, i.e. (causatively) bear or make early fruit (of woman or tree); also (as denominative from בִּכּוּר); to give the birthright; make firstborn, be firstling, bring forth first child (new fruit).

H1070.d: from בָּכַר (in the sense of youth); a young camel; dromedary.

H1071.d: the same as בֶּכֶר; Beker, the name of two Israelites; Becher.

H1072.d: feminine of בֶּכֶר; a young she-camel; dromedary.

H1073.d: by orthographical variation for בִּכּוּרָה; a first-ripe fig; firstripe.

H1074.d: from בָּכַר; first-born; Bokeru, an Israelite; Bocheru.

H1075.d: from בָּכַר; youth-ful; Bikri, an Israelite; Bichri.

H1076.d: patronymically from בֶכֶר; a Bakrite (collectively) or descendants of Beker; Bachrites.

H1077.d: from בָּלָה; properly, a failure; by implication nothing; usually (adverb) not at all; also lest; lest, neither, no, none (that...), not (any), nothing.

H1078.d: by contraction for בַּעַל; Bel, the Baal of the Babylonians; Bel.

H1079.d: (Aramaic) from בְּלָא; properly, anxiety, i.e. (by implication) the heart (as its seat); heart.

H1080.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to בָּלָה (but used only in a mental sense); to afflict; wear out.

H1081.d: from בֵּל and אָדוֹן (contracted); Bel (is his) lord; Baladan, the name of a Babylonian prince; Baladan.

H1082.d: a primitive root; to break off or loose (in a favorable or unfavorable sense), i.e. desist (from grief) or invade (with destruction); comfort, (recover) strength(-en).

H1083.d: from בָּלַג; desistance; Bilgah, the name of two Israelites; Bilgah.

H1084.d: from בָּלַג; desistant; Bilgai, an Israelite; Bilgai.

H1085.d: of uncertain derivation; Bildad, one of Job's friends; Bildad.

H1086.d: a primitive root; to fail; by implication to wear out, decay (causatively, consume, spend); consume, enjoy long, become (make, wax) old, spend, waste.

H1088.d: feminine of בָּלֶה; failure; Balah, a place in Palestine; Balah.

H1089.d: a primitive root (rather by transposition for בָּהַל); to palpitate; hence, (causatively) to terrify; trouble.

H1090.d: from בָּלַהּ; timid; Bilhah, the name of one of Jacob's concubines; also of a place in Palestine; Bilhah.

H1091.d: from בָּלַהּ; alarm; hence, destruction; terror, trouble.

H1092.d: from בָּלַהּ; timid; Bilhan, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite; Bilhan.

H1093.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to בָּלָה; excise (on articles consumed); tribute.

H1094.d: or (fully) בְּלוֹי; from בָּלָה; (only in plural construction) rags; old.

H1095.d: of foreign derivation; Belteshatstsar, the Babylonian name of Daniel; Belteshazzar.

H1096.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּר; {Belteshatstsar, the Babylonian name of Daniel}; Belteshazzar.

H1097.d: from בָּלָה; properly, failure, i.e. nothing or destruction; usually (with preposition) without, not yet, because not, as long as, etc.; corruption, ig(norantly), for lack of, where no...is, so that no, none, not, un(awares), without.

H1098.d: from בָּלַל; mixed, i.e. (specifically) feed (for cattle); corn, fodder, provender.

H1099.d: from בְּלִי and מָה; (as indefinitely) nothing whatever; nothing.

H1100.d: from בְּלִי and יַעַל;(often in connection with אִישׁ, אִשָּׁה, בֵּן, etc.); without profit, worthlessness; by extension, destruction, wickedness; Belial, evil, naughty, ungodly (men), wicked.

H1101.d: a primitive root; (also  denominatively from בְּלִיל) to fodder; to overflow (specifically with oil.); by implication, to mix; to fodder; anoint, confound, [idiom] fade, mingle, mix (self), give provender, temper.

H1102.d: a primitive root; to muzzle; be held in.

H1103.d: a primitive root; to pinch sycamore figs (a process necessary to ripen them); gatherer.

H1104.d: a primitive root; to make away with (specifically by swallowing); generally, to destroy; cover, destroy, devour, eat up, be at end, spend up, swallow down (up).

H1105.d: from בָּלַע; a gulp; figuratively, destruction; devouring, that which he hath swallowed up.

H1106.d: the same as בֶּלַע; Bela, the name of a place, also of an Edomite and of two Israelites; Bela.

H1107.d: or בַּלְעֲדֵי; constructive plural from בַּל and עַד, not till, i.e. (as preposition or adverb); except, without, besides; beside, not (in), save, without.

H1108.d: patronymically from בֶּלַע; a Belaite (collectively) or descendants of Bela; Belaites.

H1109.d: probably from בַּל and עַם; not (of the) people, i.e. foreigner; Bilam, a Mesopotamian prophet; also a place in Palestine; Balaam, Bileam.

H1110.d: a primitive root; to annihilate; (make) waste.

H1111.d: from בָּלַק; waster; Balak, a Moabitish king; Balak.

H1112.d: or בֵּלְאשַׁצַּרlemma בֵּלְאשַׁצּר missing vowel, corrected to בֵּלְאשַׁצַּר; of foreign origin (compare בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּר); Belshatstsar, a Babylonian king; Belshazzar.

H1113.d: lemma בֵּלְשַׁאצּר missing vowel, corrected to בֵּלְשַׁאצַּר; (Aramaic) corresponding to בֵּלְשַׁאצַּר; {Belshatstsar, a Babylonian king}; Belshazzar.

H1114.d: of uncertain derivation; Bilshan, an Israelite; Bilshan.

H1115.d: constructive feminine of בָּלָה (equivalent to בְּלִי); properly, a failure of, i.e. (used only as a negative particle, usually with a prepositional prefix) not, except, without, unless, besides, because not, until, etc.; because un(satiable), beside, but, [phrase] continual, except, from, lest, neither, no more, none, not, nothing, save, that no, without.

H1116.d: from an unused root (meaning to be high); an elevation; height, high place, wave.

H1117.d: the same as בָּמָה; Bamah, a place in Palestine; Bamah. See also בָּמוֹת.

H1118.d: probably from מָהַל with prepositional prefix; with pruning; Bimhal, an Israelite; Bimhal.

H1119.d: prolongation for prepositional prefix; in, with, by, etc.; for, in into, through.

H1120.d: plural of בָּמָה; heights; or (fully) בָּמוֹת בַּעַל; from the same and בַּעַל; heights of Baal; Bamoth or Bamoth-Baal, a place East of the Jordan; Bamoth, Bamoth-baal.

H1121.d: from בָּנָה; a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.); [phrase] afflicted, age, (Ahoh-) (Ammon-) (Hachmon-) (Lev-) ite, (anoint-) ed one, appointed to, ([phrase]) arrow, (Assyr-) (Babylon-) (Egypt-) (Grec-) ian, one born, bough, branch, breed, [phrase] (young) bullock, [phrase] (young) calf, [idiom] came up in, child, colt, [idiom] common, [idiom] corn, daughter, [idiom] of first, [phrase] firstborn, foal, [phrase] very fruitful, [phrase] postage, [idiom] in, [phrase] kid, [phrase] lamb, ([phrase]) man, meet, [phrase] mighty, [phrase] nephew, old, ([phrase]) people, [phrase] rebel, [phrase] robber, [idiom] servant born, [idiom] soldier, son, [phrase] spark, [phrase] steward, [phrase] stranger, [idiom] surely, them of, [phrase] tumultuous one, [phrase] valiant(-est), whelp, worthy, young (one), youth.

H1122.d: the same as בֵּן; Ben, an Israelite; Ben.

H1123.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to בֵּן; {a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense}; child, son, young.

H1124.d: (Aramaic) or בְּנָה; (Aramaic), corresponding to בָּנָה; to build; build, make.

H1125.d: from בֵּן and אֲבִימֶלֶךְ; (the) son of Abinadab; Ben-Abinadab, an Israelite; the son of Abinadab.

H1126.d: from בֵּן and אָוֶן; son of my sorrow; Ben-Oni, the original name of Benjamin; Ben-oni.

H1127.d: from בֵּן and גֶּבֶר; son of (the) hero; Ben-Geber, an Israelite; the son of Geber.

H1128.d: from בֵּן and a derivative of דָּקַר; son of piercing (or of a lance); Ben-Deker, an Israelite; the son of Dekar.

H1129.d: a primitive root; to build (literally and figuratively); (begin to) build(-er), obtain children, make, repair, set (up), [idiom] surely.

H1130.d: from בֵּן and הֲדַד; son of Hadad; Ben-Hadad, the name of several Syrian kings; Benhadad.

H1131.d: from בָּנָה; built up; Binnui, an Israelite; Binnui.

H1132.d: from בֵּן and זוֹחֵת; son of Zocheth; Ben-Zocheth, an Israelite; Ben-zoketh.

H1133.d: from בֵּן and חוּר; son of Chur; Ben-Chur, an Israelite; the son of Hur.

H1134.d: from בֵּן and חַיִל; son of might; Ben-Chail, an Israelite; Ben-hail.

H1135.d: from בֵּן and חָנָן; son of Chanan; Ben-Chanan, an Israelite; Ben-hanan.

H1136.d: from בֵּן and חֵסֵד; son of kindness; Ben-Chesed, an Israelite; the son of Hesed.

H1137.d: from בָּנָה; built; Bani, the name of five Israelites; Bani.

H1138.d: or (fuller) בּוּנִי; from בָּנָה; built; Bunni or Buni, an Israelite; Bunni.

H1139.d: from the plural construction of בֵּן and בָּרָק; sons of lightning, Bene-berak, a place in Palestine; Bene-barak.

H1140.d: feminine from בָּנָה; a structure; building.

H1141.d: or בּנָיָהוּ; (prolonged) from בָּנָה and יָהּ; Jah has built; Benajah, the name of twelve Israelites; Benaiah.

H1143.d: dual of בֵּין; a double interval, i.e. the space between two armies; [phrase] champion.

H1144.d: from בֵּן and יָמִין; son of (the) right hand; Binjamin, youngest son of Jacob; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory; Benjamin.

H1145.d: sometimes (with the article inserted) בֵּן־הַיּמִינִי; with אִישׁ inserted (1 Samuel 9:1) בֶּן־אִישׁ ימִינִי; son of a man of Jemini; or shortened אִישׁ יְמִינִי; (1 Samuel 9:4; Esther 2:5) a man of Jemini, or (1 Samuel 20:1) simply יְמִינִיxlit Yᵉmînîy corrected to Yᵉmîynîy; a Jeminite; (plural) בְּנֵי יְמִינִיxlit Bᵉnîy corrected to Bᵉnêy; patron from בִּנְיָמִין; a Benjaminite, or descendent of Benjamin; Benjamite, of Benjamin.

H1148.d: probably from בֵּן with pron. suff.; our son; Beninu, an Israelite; Beninu.

H1149.d: (Aramaic) of uncertain affinity; to be enraged; be angry.

H1150.d: or בִּנְעָה; of uncertain derivation; Bina or Binah, an Israelite; Binea, Bineah.

H1151.d: from בֵּן and עַם with pronomial suffix; son of my people; Ben-Ammi, a son of Lot; Ben-ammi.

H1152.d: from סוֹד and יָהּ with prepositional prefix; in (the) counsel of Jehovah; Besodejah, an Israelite; Besodeiah.

H1153.d: from בּוּס; domineering; Besai, one of the Nethinim; Besai.

H1154.d: from an unused root meaning to be sour; an immature grape; unripe grape.

H1155.d: from the same as בֶּסֶר; {an immature grape}; sour grape.

H1156.d: (Aramaic) or בְּעָה; (Aramaic), corresponding to בָּעָה; to seek or ask; ask, desire, make (petition), pray, request, seek.

H1157.d: from עַד with prepositional prefix; in up to or over against; generally at, beside, among, behind, for, etc.; about, at by (means of), for, over, through, up (-on), within.

H1158.d: a primitive root; to gush over, i.e. to swell; (figuratively) to desire earnestly; by implication to ask; cause, inquire, seek up, swell out.

H1160.d: from בָּעַר (in the sense of burning); a lamp; Beor, the name of the father of an Edomitish king; also of that of Balaam; Beor.

H1161.d: masculine plural from בָּעַת; alarms; terrors.

H1162.d: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Boaz, the ancestor of David; also the name of a pillar in front of the temple; Boaz.

H1163.d: a primitive root; to trample down, i.e. (figuratively) despise; kick.

H1165.d: from בָּעַר (in the sense of eating); cattle; beast, cattle.

H1166.d: a primitive root; also as denominative from בַּעַל; to be master; hence, to marry; have dominion (over), be husband, marry(-ried, [idiom] wife).

H1167.d: from בָּעַל; a master; hence, a husband, or (figuratively) owner (often used with another noun in modifications of this latter sense); [phrase] archer, [phrase] babbler, [phrase] bird, captain, chief man, [phrase] confederate, [phrase] have to do, [phrase] dreamer, those to whom it is due, [phrase] furious, those that are given to it, great, [phrase] hairy, he that hath it, have, [phrase] horseman, husband, lord, man, [phrase] married, master, person, [phrase] sworn, they of.

H1168.d: the same as בַּעַל; Baal, a Phoenician deity; Baal, (plural) Baalim.

H1169.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to בַּעַל; {a master; hence, a husband,}; [phrase] chancellor.

H1170.d: from בַּעַל and בְּרִית; Baal of (the) covenant; Baal-Berith, a special deity of the Shechemites; Baal-berith.

H1171.d: from בַּעַל and גָּד; Baal of Fortune; Baal-Gad, a place in Syria; Baal-gad.

H1172.d: feminine of בַּעַל; a mistress; that hath, mistress.

H1173.d: the same as בַּעֲלָה; Baalah, the name of three places in Palestine; Baalah.

H1174.d: from בַּעַל and הָמוֹן; possessor of a multitude; Baal-Hamon, a place in Palestine; Baal-hamon.

H1175.d: plural of בַּעֲלָה; mistresses; Bealoth, a place in Palestine; Bealoth, in Aloth (by mistake for a plural from עָלָה with prepositional prefix).

H1176.d: from בַּעַל and זְבוּב; Baal of (the) Fly; Baal-Zebub, a special deity of the Ekronites; Baal-zebub.

H1177.d: from בַּעַל and חָנַן; possessor of grace; Baal-Chanan, the name of an Edomite, also of an Israelite; Baal-hanan.

H1178.d: from בַּעַל and a modification of חָצֵר; possessor of a village; Baal-Chatsor, a place in Palestine; Baal-hazor.

H1179.d: from בַּעַל and חֶרְמוֹן; possessor of Hermon; Baal-Chermon, a place in Palestine; Baal-hermon.

H1180.d: from בַּעַל with pron. suff.; my master; Baali, a symbolical name for Jehovah; Baali.

H1181.d: from the plural of בַּעַל and the plural of בָּמָה; Baals of (the) heights; Baale-Bamoth, a place East of the Jordan; lords of the high places.

H1182.d: from בַּעַל and יָדַע; Baal has known; Beeljada, an Israelite; Beeliada.

H1183.d: from בַּעַל and יָהּ; Jah (is) master; Bealjah, an Israelite; Bealiah.

H1184.d: from the plural of בַּעַל and יְהוּדָה; masters of Judah; Baale-Jehudah, a place in Palestine; Baale of Judah.

H1185.d: xlit Baʻălîç corrected to Baʻălîyç; probably from a derivative of עָלַס with prepositional prefix; in exultation; Baalis, an Ammonitish king; Baalis.

H1186.d: from בַּעַל and מָעוֹן; Baal of (the) habitation (of) (compare בֵּית בַּעַל מְעוֹן); Baal-Meon, a place East of the Jordan; Baal-meon.

H1187.d: from בַּעַל and פְּעוֹר; Baal of Peor; Baal-Peor, a Moabitish deity; Baal-peor.

H1188.d: from בַּעַל and the plural of פֶּרֶץ; possessor of breaches; Baal-Peratsim, a place in Palestine; Baal-perazim.

H1190.d: from בַּעַל and שָׁלִשָׁה; Baal of Shalishah, Baal-Shalishah, a place in Palestine; Baal-shalisha.

H1191.d: a modification of בַּעֲלָה; mistressship; Baalath, a place in Palestine; Baalath.

H1192.d: xlit Bᵉʻêr corrected to Bᵉʼêr; from בַּעֲלָה and בְּאֵר; mistress of a well; Baalath-Beer, a place in Palestine; Baalath-beer.

H1193.d: from בַּעַל and תָּמָר; possessor of (the) palm-tree; Baal-Tamar, a place in Palestine; Baal-tamar.

H1194.d: probably a contraction of בֵּית בַּעַל מְעוֹן; Beon, a place East of the Jordan; Beon.

H1195.d: the same as בַּעֲנָה; Banana, the name of four Israelite; Baana, Baanah.

H1196.d: from a derivative of עָנָה with prepositional prefix; in affliction; Baanah, the name of four Israelites; Baanah.

H1197.d: a primitive root; also as denominative from בַּעַר; to kindle, i.e. consume (by fire or by eating);  to be(-come) brutish; be brutish, bring (put, take) away, burn, (cause to) eat (up), feed, heat, kindle, set (on fire), waste.

H1198.d: from בָּעַר; properly, foot (as consumed); i.e. (by exten.) of cattle brutishness; (concretely) stupid; brutish (person), foolish.

H1199.d: from בַּעַר; brutish; Baara, an Israelitish woman; Baara.

H1201.d: from an unused root meaning to stink; offensiveness; Basha, a king of Israel; Baasha.

H1202.d: from עָשָׂה and יָהּ with a prepositional prefix; in (the) work of Jah; Baasejah, an Israelite; Baaseiah.

H1203.d: from עַשְׁתְּרָה (as singular of עַשְׁתָּרוֹת) with a prepositional prefix; with Ashtoreth; Beeshterah, a place East of the Jordan; Beeshterah.

H1204.d: a primitive root; to fear; affright, be (make) afraid, terrify, trouble.

H1206.d: probably the same as בּוּץ; mud (as whitish clay); mire.

H1207.d: intensive from בֹץ; a swamp; fen, mire(-ry place).

H1208.d: from בָּצַר; inaccessible, i.e. lofty; vintage (by confusion with בָּצִיר).

H1209.d: perhaps the same as בְּסַי; Betsai, the name of two Israelites; Bezai.

H1210.d: from בָּצַר; clipped, i.e. the grape crop; vintage.

H1211.d: xlit bᵉtsel corrected to betsel; from an unused root apparently meaning to peel; an onion; onion.

H1216.d: a primitive root; perhaps to swell up, i.e. blister; swell.

H1217.d: from בָּצֵק; dough (as swelling by fermentation); dough, flour.

H1218.d: from בָּצֵק; a swell of ground; Botscath, a place in Palestine; Bozcath, Boskath.

H1219.d: a primitive root; to clip off; specifically (as denominative from בָּצִיר); to gather grapes; also to be isolated (i.e. inaccessible by height or fortification); cut off, (de-) fenced, fortify, (grape) gather(-er), mighty things, restrain, strong, wall (up), withhold.

H1220.d: from בָּצַר; strictly a clipping, i.e. gold (as dug out); gold defence.

H1221.d: the same as בֶּצֶר, an inaccessible spot; Betser, a place in Palestine; also an Israelite; Bezer.

H1222.d: another form for בֶּצֶר; gold; gold.

H1223.d: feminine from בָּצַר; an enclosure, i.e. sheep fold; Bozrah.

H1224.d: the same as בׇּצְרָה; Botsrah, a place in Edom; Bozrah.

H1226.d: feminine intensive from בָּצַר; restraint (of rain), i.e. drought; dearth, drought.

H1231.d: from בָּקַק; wasteful; Bukki, the name of two Israelites; Bukki.

H1232.d: from בָּקַק and יָהּ; wasting of Jah; Bukkijah, an Israelite; Bukkiah.

H1233.d: from בָּקַע; a fissure; breach, cleft.

H1236.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to בִּקְעָה; {properly, a split, i.e. a wide level valley between mountains}; plain.

H1237.d: from בָּקַע; properly, a split, i.e. a wide level valley between mountains; plain, valley.

H1238.d: a primitive root; to pour out, i.e. to empty, figuratively, to depopulate; by analogy, to spread out (as a fruitful vine); (make) empty (out), fail, [idiom] utterly, make void.

H1239.d: a primitive root; properly, to plough, or (generally) break forth, i.e. (figuratively) to inspect, admire, care for, consider; (make) inquire (-ry), (make) search, seek out.

H1240.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to בָּקַר; {properly, to plough, or (generally) break forth, i.e. (figuratively) to inspect, admire, care for, consider}; inquire, make search.

H1241.d: from בָּקַר; beef cattle or an animal of the ox family of either gender (as used for plowing); collectively, a herd; beeve, bull ([phrase] -ock), [phrase] calf, [phrase] cow, great (cattle), [phrase] heifer, herd, kine, ox.

H1242.d: from בָּקַר; properly, dawn (as the break of day); generally, morning; ([phrase]) day, early, morning, morrow.

H1243.d: intensive from בָּקַר; a looking after; seek out.

H1244.d: from בָּקַר; properly, examination, i.e. (by implication) punishment; scourged.

H1247.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to בֵּן; a son, grandson, etc.; [idiom] old, son.

H1248.d: borrowed (as a title) from בַּר; the heir (apparent to the throne); son.

H1249.d: from בָּרַר (in its various senses); beloved; also pure, empty; choice, clean, clear, pure.

H1250.d: or בַּר; from בָּרַר (in the sense of winnowing); grain of any kind (even while standing in the field); by extension the open country; corn, wheat.

H1251.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to בָּר; a field; field.

H1253.d: the same as בֹּר; vegetable lye (from its cleansing); used as a soap forwashing, or a flux formetals; [idiom] never so, purely.

H1254.d: a primitive root; (absolutely) to create; (qualified) to cut down (a wood), select, feed (as formative processes); choose, create (creator), cut down, dispatch, do, make (fat).

H1255.d: a variation of מְרֹאדַךְ בַּלְאָדָן; Berodak-Baladan, a Babylonian king; Berodach-baladan.Birliy.

H1256.d: from בָּרָא and שְׁמוּאֵל; Jah has created; Berajah, an Israelite; Beraiah.

H1257.d: by reduplication from בָּר; a fowl (as fattened on grain); fowl.

H1258.d: a primitive root,; to hail; hail.

H1260.d: from בָּרַד; hail; Bered, the name of a place south of Palestine, also of an Israelite; Bered.

H1261.d: from בָּרַד; spotted (as if with hail); grisled.

H1262.d: a primitive root; to select; also (as denominative from בָּר) to feed; also (as equivalent to בָּרַר) to render clear (Ecclesiastes 3:18); to select; to feed; to render clear; choose, (cause to) eat, manifest, (give) meat.

H1263.d: passive participle from בָרַךְ; blessed; Baruk, the name of three Israelites; Baruch.

H1264.d: probably of foreign origin; damask (stuff of variegated thread); rich apparel.

H1265.d: of uncertain derivation; a cypress (?) tree; hence, a lance or a musical instrument (as made of that wood); fir (tree).

H1266.d: lemma בֻּרוֹת first vowel, corrected to בְּרוֹת; a variation of בְּרוֹשׁ; the cypress (or some elastic tree); fir.

H1270.d: perhaps from the root of בִּרְזוֹת; iron (as cutting); by extension, an iron implement; (ax) head, iron.

H1271.d: from בַּרְזֶל; iron-hearted; Barzillai, the name of three Israelites; Barzillai.

H1272.d: a primitive root; to bolt, i.e. figuratively, to flee suddenly; chase (away); drive away, fain, flee (away), put to flight, make haste, reach, run away, shoot.

H1273.d: by transposition for בַּחֲרוּמִי; a Barchumite, or native of Bachurim; Barhumite.

H1275.d: probably by contraction from בְּאֵרִי; Beri, an Israelite; Beri.

H1276.d: of uncertain derivation; (only in the plural and with the article) the Berites, a place in Palestine; Berites.

H1277.d: from בָּרָא (in the sense of בָּרָה); fatted or plump; fat ((fleshed), -ter), fed, firm, plenteous, rank.

H1278.d: feminine from בָּרָא; a creation, i.e. a novelty; new thing.

H1280.d: from בָּרַח; a bolt; bar, fugitive.

H1281.d: or בָּרִחַ; (shortened) from בָּרַח; a fugitive, i.e. the serpent (as fleeing), and the constellation by that name; crooked, noble, piercing.

H1282.d: the same as בָּרִיחַ; Bariach, an Israelite; Bariah.

H1283.d: apparently from the feminine of רַע with a prepositional prefix; in trouble; Beriah, the name of four Israelites; Beriah.

H1284.d: patronymically from בְּרִיעָה; a Beriite (collectively) or descendants of Beriah; Beerites.

H1285.d: from בָּרָה (in the sense of cutting (like בָּרָא)); a compact (because made by passing between pieces of flesh); confederacy, (con-) feder(-ate), covenant, league.

H1286.d: the same as בְּרִית; Berith, a Shechemitish deity; Berith.

H1287.d: feminine of בֹּר; vegetable alkali; sope.

H1288.d: a primitive root; to kneel; by implication to bless God (as an act of adoration), and (vice-versa) man (as a benefit); also (by euphemism) to curse (God or the king, as treason); [idiom] abundantly, [idiom] altogether, [idiom] at all, blaspheme, bless, congratulate, curse, [idiom] greatly, [idiom] indeed, kneel (down), praise, salute, [idiom] still, thank.

H1289.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to בָרַךְ; {to kneel; by implication to bless God (as an act of adoration), and (vice-versa) man (as a benefit); also (by euphemism) to curse (God or the king, as treason)}; bless, kneel.

H1292.d: from בָרַךְ and אֵל, God has blessed; Barakel, the father of one of Job's friends; Barachel.

H1293.d: from בָרַךְ; benediction; by implication prosperity; blessing, liberal, pool, present.

H1294.d: the same as בְּרָכָה; Berakah, the name of an Israelite, and also of a valley in Palestine; Berachah.

H1295.d: from בָרַךְ; a reservoir (at which camels kneel as a resting-place); (fish-) pool.

H1296.d: or בֶּרֶכְיָהוּ; from בֶּרֶךְ and יָהּ; knee (i.e. blessing) of Jah; Berekjah, the name of six Israelites; Berachiah, Berechiah.

H1297.d: (Aramaic) perhaps from רוּם with a prepositional prefix; properly, highly, i.e. surely; but used adversatively, however; but, nevertheless, yet.

H1298.d: of uncertain derivation; Bera, a Sodomitish king; Bera.

H1299.d: a primitive root; to lighten (lightning); cast forth.

H1300.d: from בָּרַק; lightning; by analogy, a gleam; concretely, a flashing sword; bright, glitter(-ing sword), lightning.

H1301.d: the same as בָּרָק; Barak, an Israelite; Barak.

H1302.d: of uncertain derivation; Barkos, one of the Nethimim; Barkos.

H1303.d: from בָּרָק; a thorn (perhaps as burning brightly); brier.

H1304.d: lemma בָּרְקַת variant form, corrected to בָּרֶקֶת; or בָּרְקַתxlit bârᵉkath corrected to bârᵉqath; from בָּרָק; a gem (as flashing), perhaps the emerald; carbuncle.

H1305.d: a primitive root; to clarify (i.e. brighten), examine, select; make bright, choice, chosen, cleanse (be clean), clearly, polished, (shew self) pure(-ify), purge (out).

H1306.d: probably from רֶשַׁע with a prepositional prefix; with wickedness; Birsha, a king of Gomorrah; Birsha.

H1307.d: patrial from בֵּרוֹתָה; a Berothite, or inhabitant of Berothai; Berothite.

H1308.d: from בָּשַׂר; cheerful; Besor, a stream of Palestine; Besor.

H1309.d: or (shortened) בְּשֹׂרָה; feminine from בָּשַׂר; glad tidings; by implication, reward forgood news; reward for tidings.

H1310.d: a primitive root; properly, to boil up; hence, to be done in cooking; figuratively to ripen; bake, boil, bring forth, roast, seethe, sod (be sodden).

H1311.d: from בָּשַׁל; boiled; [idiom] at all, sodden.

H1312.d: of foreign derivation; Bishlam, a Persian; Bishlam.

H1313.d: from an unused root meaning to be fragrant; (compare סַם); the balsam plant; spice.

H1314.d: or בֹּשֶׂם; from the same as בָּשָׂם; fragrance; by implication, spicery; also the balsam plant; smell, spice, sweet (odour).

H1315.d: feminine of בֶּשֶׂם (the second form); fragrance; Bosmath, the name of a wife of Esau, and of a daughter of Solomon; Bashemath, Basmath.

H1316.d: of uncertain derivation; Bashan (often with the article), a region East of the Jordan; Bashan.

H1318.d: a primitive root; to trample down; tread.

H1319.d: a primitive root; properly, to be fresh, i.e. full (rosy, (figuratively) cheerful); to announce (glad news); messenger, preach, publish, shew forth, (bear, bring, carry, preach, good, tell good) tidings.

H1320.d: from בָּשַׂר; flesh (from its freshness); by extension, body, person; also (by euphemistically) the pudenda of aman; body, (fat, lean) flesh(-ed), kin, (man-) kind, [phrase] nakedness, self, skin.

H1321.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to בָּשָׂר; {flesh (from its freshness); by extension, body, person; also (by euphemistically) the pudenda of aman}; flesh.

H1322.d: from בּוּשׁ; shame (the feeling and the condition, as well as its cause); by implication (specifically) an idol; ashamed, confusion, [phrase] greatly, (put to) shame(-ful thing).

H1323.d: from בָּנָה (as feminine of בֵּן); a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship, literally and figuratively); apple (of the eye), branch, company, daughter, [idiom] first, [idiom] old, [phrase] owl, town, village.

H1324.d: probably from the same as בַּתָּה; a bath or Hebrew measure (as a means of division) of liquids; bath.

H1325.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to בַּת; {a bath or Hebrew measure (as a means of division) of liquids}; bath.

H1326.d: probably an orthographical variation for בַּתָּה; desolation; waste.

H1327.d: feminine from an unused root (meaning to break in pieces); desolation; desolate.

H1328.d: apparently from the same as בָּתָה and אֵל; destroyed of God; Bethuel, the name of a nephew of Abraham, and of a place in Palestine; Bethuel. Compare בְּתוּל.

H1329.d: for בְּתוּאֵל; Bethul (i.e. Bethuel), a place in Palestine; Bethuel.

H1330.d: feminine passive participle of an unused root meaning to separate; a virgin (from her privacy); sometimes (by continuation) a bride; also (figuratively) a city or state; maid, virgin.

H1331.d: masculine plural of the same as בְּתוּלָה; (collectively and abstractly) virginity; by implication and concretely, the tokens of it; [idiom] maid, virginity.

H1332.d: from בַּת and יָהּ; daughter (i.e. worshipper) of Jah; Bithjah, an Egyptian woman; Bithiah.

H1333.d: a primitive root; to cut in pieces; thrust through.

H1334.d: a primitive root,; to chop up; divide.

H1335.d: from בָּתַר; a section; part, piece.

H1336.d: the same as בֶּתֶר; Bether, a (craggy) place in Palestine; Bether.

H1337.d: from בַּת and a masculine plural from רַב; the daughter (i.e. city) of Rabbah; Bath-rabbim.

H1338.d: from בָּתַר; (with the article) the craggy spot; Bithron, a place East of the Jordan; Bithron.

H1339.d: from בַּת and שֶׁבַע (in the sense of שָׁבַע); daughter of an oath; Bath-Sheba, the mother of Solomon; Bath-sheba.

H1340.d: from בַּת and שׁוֹעַ; daughter of wealth;  the same as בַּת־שֶׁבַע; Bath-shua,; Bath-shua.

H1342.d: a primitive root; to mount up; hence, in general, to rise, (figuratively) be majestic; gloriously, grow up, increase, be risen, triumph.

H1343.d: from גָּאָה; lofty; figuratively, arrogant; proud.

H1345.d: from גָּאָה and אֵל; majesty of God; Geuel, an Israelite; Geuel.

H1346.d: xlit gaʻăvâh corrected to gaʼăvâh; from גָּאָה; arrogance or majesty; by implication, (concretely) ornament; excellency, haughtiness, highness, pride, proudly, swelling.

H1347.d: from גָּאָה; the same as גַּאֲוָהxlit gaʻăvâh corrected to gaʼăvâh; {arrogance or majesty; by implication, (concretely) ornament}; arrogancy, excellency(-lent), majesty, pomp, pride, proud, swelling.

H1348.d: from גָּאָה; the same as גַּאֲוָהxlit gaʻăvâh corrected to gaʼăvâh; {arrogance or majesty; by implication, (concretely) ornament}; excellent things, lifting up, majesty, pride, proudly, raging.

H1350.d: a primitive root, to redeem (according to the Oriental law of kinship), i.e.; to be the next of kin (and as such to buy back a relative's property, marry his widow, etc.); [idiom] in any wise, [idiom] at all, avenger, deliver, (do, perform the part of near, next) kinsfolk(-man), purchase, ransom, redeem(-er), revenger.

H1351.d: a primitive root, (rather identified with גָּאַל, through the idea of freeing, i.e. repudiating); to soil or (figuratively) desecrate; defile, pollute, stain.

H1353.d: xlit gᵉullâh corrected to gᵉʼullâh; feminine passive participle of גָּאַל; redemption (including the right and the object); by implication, relationship; kindred, redeem, redemption, right.

H1354.d: from an unused root meaning to hollow or curve; (compare גֵּו and גּוּף); the back (as rounded); by analogy, the top or rim, a boss, a vault, arch of eye, bulwarks, etc.; back, body, boss, eminent (higher) place, (eye) brows, nave, ring.

H1355.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to גַב; {the back (as rounded); by analogy, the top or rim, a boss, a vault, arch of eye, bulwarks, etc.}; back.

H1356.d: from גּוּב; a log (as cut out); also well or cistern (as dug); beam, ditch, pit.

H1357.d: probably from גּוּב (compare גּוֹב); a locust (from its cutting); locust.

H1358.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to גּוּב; a pit (for wild animals) (as cut out); den.

H1359.d: or (fully) גּוֹב; from גּוּב; pit; Gob, a place in Palestine; Gob.

H1360.d: xlit gebe corrected to gebeʼ; from an unused root meaning probably to collect; a reservoir; by analogy, a marsh; marish, pit.

H1361.d: a primitive root; to soar, i.e. be lofty; figuratively, to be haughty; exalt, be haughty, be (make) high(-er), lift up, mount up, be proud, raise up great height, upward.

H1362.d: from גָּבַהּ; lofty (literally or figuratively); high, proud.

H1363.d: from גָּבַהּ; elation, grandeur, arrogance; excellency, haughty, height, high, loftiness, pride.

H1364.d: or גָּבוֹהַּ; (fully) from גָּבַהּ; elevated (or elated), powerful, arrogant; haughty, height, high(-er), lofty, proud, [idiom] exceeding proudly.

H1366.d: or גְּבֻל; (shortened) from גָּבַל; properly, a cord (as twisted), i.e. (by implication) a boundary; by extension the territory inclosed; border, bound, coast, [idiom] great, landmark, limit, quarter, space.

H1367.d: or גְּבֻלָה; (shortened) feminine of גְּבוּל; a boundary, region; border, bound, coast, landmark. place.

H1368.d: or גִּבֹּר; (shortened) intensive from the same as גֶּבֶר; powerful; by implication, warrior, tyrant; champion, chief, [idiom] excel, giant, man, mighty (man, one), strong (man), valiant man.

H1369.d: feminine passive participle from the same as גִּבּוֹר; force (literally or figuratively); by implication, valor, victory; force, mastery, might, mighty (act, power), power, strength.

H1371.d: from an unused root meaning to be high (in the forehead); bald in the forehead; forehead bald.

H1372.d: from the same as גִּבֵּחַ; baldness in the forehead; by analogy, a bare spot on the right side of cloth; bald forehead, [idiom] without.

H1373.d: from the same as גַב; collective; Gabbai, an Israelite; Gabbai.

H1374.d: plural of גֵּב; cisterns; Gebim, a place in Palestine; Gebim.

H1375.d: from an unused root (meaning to be convex); a goblet; by analogy, the calyx of aflower; house, cup, pot.

H1377.d: feminine of גְּבִיר; a mistress; queen.

H1378.d: from an unused root (probably meaning to freeze); crystal (from its resemblance to ice); pearl.

H1379.d: a primitive root; also as a denominative from גְּבוּל; properly, to twist as arope;  to bound (as by a line); be border, set (bounds about).

H1380.d: from גָּבַל (in the sense of a chain of hills); a mountain; Gebal, a place in Phoenicia; Gebal.

H1381.d: the same as גְּבַל; Gebal, a region in Idumaea; Gebal.

H1382.d: ; patrial from גְּבַל; a Gebalite, or inhabitant of Gebal; Giblites, stone-squarer.

H1383.d: from גָּבַל; a twisted chain or lace; end.

H1384.d: from an unused root meaning to be arched or contracted; hunch-backed; crookbackt.

H1385.d: feminine from the same as גִּבֵּן; curdled milk; cheese.

H1386.d: from the same as גִּבֵּן; a hump or peak of hills; high.

H1387.d: from the same as גְּבִיעַ, a hillock; Geba, a place in Palestine; Gaba, Geba, Gibeah.

H1388.d: by permutation for גִּבְעָה; a hill; Giba, a place in Palestine; Gibeah.

H1389.d: feminine from the same as גֶּבַע; a hillock; hill, little hill.

H1390.d: the same as גִּבְעָה; Gibah; the name of three places in Palestine; Gibeah, the hill.

H1391.d: from the same as גֶּבַע; hilly; Gibon, a place in Palestine; Gibeon.

H1392.d: prolonged from גְּבִיעַ; the calyx of a flower; bolled.

H1393.d: patrial from גִּבְעוֹן; a Gibonite, or inhabitant of Gibon; Gibeonite.

H1394.d: from the same as גְּבִיעַ; hilliness; Gibath; Gibeath.

H1395.d: patrial from גִּבְעָה; a Gibathite, or inhabitant of Gibath; Gibeathite.

H1396.d: a primitive root; to be strong; by implication, to prevail, act insolently; exceed, confirm, be great, be mighty, prevail, put to more (strength), strengthen, be stronger, be valiant.

H1397.d: from גָּבַר; properly, a valiant man or warrior; generally, a person simply; every one, man, [idiom] mighty.

H1398.d: the same as גֶּבֶר; Geber, the name of two Israelites; Geber.

H1399.d: from גָּבַר; the same as גֶּבֶר; a person; man.

H1400.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to גְּבַר; {a person}; certain, man.

H1401.d: (Aramaic) intensive of גְּבַר; valiant, or warrior; mighty.

H1402.d: intensive of גְּבַר; Gibbar, an Israelite; Gibbar.

H1403.d: from גֶּבֶר and אֵל; man of God; Gabriel, an archangel; Garbriel.

H1404.d: feminine of גְּבִיר; mistress; lady, mistress.

H1405.d: intensive from גִּבְעָה; a hilly spot; Gibbethon, a place in Palestine; Gibbethon.

H1406.d: probably by reduplication from גָּאָה; a roof; by analogy, the top of an altar; roof (of the house), (house) top (of the house).

H1407.d: from גָּדַד (in the sense of cutting); coriander seed (from its furrows); coriander.

H1408.d: a variation of גָּד; Fortune, a Babylonian deity; that troop.

H1409.d: from גּוּד (in the sense of distributing); fortune; troop.

H1410.d: from גּוּד; Gad, a son of Jacob, including his tribe and its territory; also a prophet; Gad.

H1411.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to גִּזְבָּר; a treasurer; treasurer.

H1412.d: by reduplication from גָּדַד (in the sense of cutting) cleft; Gudgodah, a place in the Desert; Gudgodah.

H1413.d: a primitive root (compare גּוּד); to crowd; also to gash (as if by pressing into); assemble (selves by troops), gather (selves together, self in troops), cut selves.

H1414.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to גָּדַד; to cut down; hew down.

H1415.d: from an unused root (meaning to cut off); a border of a river (as cut into by the stream); bank.

H1416.d: from גָּדַד; a crowd (especially of soldiers); army, band (of men), company, troop (of robbers).

H1417.d: or גְּדֻדָה; (feminine) from גָּדַד; a furrow (as cut); furrow.

H1418.d: feminine participle passive of גָּדַד; an incision; cutting.

H1419.d: or גָּדֹל; (shortened) from גָּדַל; great (in any sense); hence, older; also insolent; [phrase] aloud, elder(-est), [phrase] exceeding(-ly), [phrase] far, (man of) great (man, matter, thing,-er,-ness), high, long, loud, mighty, more, much, noble, proud thing, [idiom] sore, ([idiom]) very.

H1420.d: or גְּדֻלָּה; (shortened) or (less accurately) גְּדוּלָּה; feminine of גָּדוֹל; greatness; (concretely) mighty acts; dignity, great things(-ness), majesty.

H1421.d: or (shortened) גִּדֻּף; and (feminine) גִּדּוּפָהxlit giddûphâh corrected to giddûwphâh; or גִּדֻּפָה; from גְּדוּפָה; vilification; reproach, reviling.

H1422.d: feminine passive participle of גָּדַף; a revilement; taunt.

H1423.d: from the same as גָּדָה; a young goat (from browsing); kid.

H1424.d: from גָּד; fortunate; Gadi, an Israelite; Gadi.

H1425.d: patronymically from גָּד; a Gadite (collectively) or descendants of Gad; Gadites, children of Gad.

H1426.d: intensive for גָּדִי; Gaddi, an Israelite; Gaddi.

H1427.d: from גָּד and אֵל; fortune of God; Gaddiel, an Israelite; Gaddiel.

H1428.d: or גַּדיָה; the same as גָּדָה; a river brink; bank.

H1429.d: feminine of גְּדִי; a young female goat; kid.

H1430.d: from an unused root (meaning to heap up); a stack of sheaves; by analogy, a tomb; shock (stack) (of corn), tomb.

H1431.d: a primitive root; properly, to twist (compare גְּדִל), i.e.; to be (causatively make) large (in various senses, as in body, mind, estate or honor, also in pride); advance, boast, bring up, exceed, excellent, be(-come, do, give, make, wax), great(-er, come to... estate, [phrase] things), grow(up), increase, lift up, magnify(-ifical), be much set by, nourish (up), pass, promote, proudly (spoken), tower.

H1432.d: from גָּדַל; large (literally or figuratively); great, grew.

H1433.d: from גָּדַל; magnitude (literally or figuratively); greatness, stout(-ness).

H1434.d: from גָּדַל (in the sense of twisting); thread, i.e. a tassel or festoon; fringe, wreath.

H1435.d: from גָּדַל; stout; Giddel, the name of one of the Nethinim, also of one of 'Solomon's servants'; Giddel.

H1436.d: or (prolonged) גְּדַלְיָהוּ; from גָּדַל and יָהּ; Jah has become great; Gedaljah, the name of five Israelites; Gedaliah.

H1437.d: from גָּדַל; I have made great; Giddalti, an Israelite; Giddalti.

H1438.d: a primitive root; to fell a tree; generally, to destroy anything; cut (asunder, in sunder, down, off), hew down.

H1439.d: from גָּדַע; feller (i.e. warrior); Gidon, an Israelite; Gideon.

H1440.d: from גָּדַע; a cutting (i.e. desolation); Gidom, a place in Palestine; Gidom.

H1441.d: lemma גִּדְעֹני missing vowel, corrected to גִּדְעֹנִי; from גָּדַע; warlike (compare גִּדְעוֹן); Gidoni, an Israelite; Gideoni.

H1442.d: a primitive root; to hack (with words), i.e. revile; blaspheme, reproach.

H1443.d: a primitive root; to wall in or around; close up, fence up, hedge, inclose, make up (a wall), mason, repairer.

H1445.d: ; the same as גֶּדֶר; Geder, a place in Palestine; Geder.

H1446.d: or (fully) גְּדוֹר; from גָּדַר; inclosure; Gedor, a place in Palestine; also the name of three Israelites; Gedor.

H1447.d: from גָּדַר; a circumvallation; by implication, an inclosure; fence, hedge, wall.

H1448.d: feminine of גָּדֵר; enclosure (especially for flocks); (sheep-) cote (fold) hedge, wall.

H1449.d: the same as גְּדֵרָה; (with the article) Gederah, a place in Palestine; Gederah, hedges.

H1450.d: plural of גְּדֵרָה; walls; Gederoth, a place in Palestine; Gederoth.

H1451.d: patrial from גֶּדֶר; a Gederite, or inhabitant of Geder; Gederite.

H1452.d: patrial from גְּדֵרָה; a Gederathite, or inhabitant of Gederah; Gederathite.

H1453.d: dual of גְּדֵרָה; double wall; Gederothajim, a place in Palestine; Gederothaim.

H1454.d: probably a clerical error for זֶה; this; this.

H1455.d: a primitive root; to remove (a bandage from a wound, i.e. heal it); cure.

H1457.d: a primitive root; to prostrate oneself; cast self down, stretch self.

H1458.d: another form for גֵּו; the back; back.

H1459.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to גֵּו; the middle; midst, same, there-(where-) in.

H1460.d: from גָּאָה (corresponding to גַב); the back; by analogy, the middle; [phrase] among, back, body.

H1461.d: a primitive root; to dig; husbandman.

H1462.d: from גּוּב; the locust (from its grubbing as a larvae); grasshopper, [idiom] great.

H1463.d: of uncertain derivation; Gog, the name of an Israelite, also of some nothern nation; Gog.

H1464.d: a primitive root (akin to גָּדַד); to crowd upon, i.e. attack; invade, overcome.

H1465.d: feminine of גֵּו; the back, i.e. (by extensive) the person; body.

H1466.d: the same as גֵּוָה; exaltation; (figuratively) arrogance; lifting up, pride.

H1468.d: a primitive root (compare גַּזָז); properly, to shear off; but used only in the (figuratively) sense of passing rapidly; bring, cut off.

H1469.d: or (shortened) גֹזָלlemma גזָל missing vowel, corrected to גֹזָל; from גָּזַל; a nestling (as being comparatively nude of feathers); young (pigeon).
