H1474.d: from גּוֹלָה; captive; Golan, a place east of the Jordan; Golan.

H1475.d: of uncertain derivation; a pit; pit.

H1476.d: probably from גָּנַן; protected; Guni, the name of two Israelites; Guni.

H1477.d: patronymically from גּוּנִי; a Gunite (collectively with article prefix) or descendants of Guni; Gunites.

H1478.d: a primitive root; to breathe out, i.e. (by implication) expire; die, be dead, give up the ghost, perish.

H1479.d: a primitive root; properly, to hollow or arch, i.e. (figuratively) close; to shut; shut.

H1480.d: from גּוּף; a corpse (as closed to sense); body.

H1481.d: a primitive root; properly, to turn aside from the road (for a lodging or any other purpose), i.e. sojourn (as a guest); also to shrink, fear (as in a strange place); also to gather forhostility (as afraid); abide, assemble, be afraid, dwell, fear, gather (together), inhabitant, remain, sojourn, stand in awe, (be) stranger, [idiom] surely.

H1482.d: or (shortened) גֻּר; perhaps from גּוּר; a cub (as still abiding in the lair), especially of the lion; whelp, young one.

H1483.d: the same as גּוּר; Gur, a place in Palestine; Gur.

H1484.d: or (feminine) גֹּרָה; a variation of גּוּר; {a cub (as still abiding in the lair), especially of the lion}; whelp.

H1485.d: from גּוּר and בַּעַל; dwelling of Baal; Gur-Baal, a place in Arabia; Gur-baal.

H1486.d: or (shortened) גֹּרָל; from an unused root meaning to be rough (as stone); properly, a pebble, i.e. a lot (small stones being used for that purpose); figuratively, a portion or destiny (as if determined by lot); lot.

H1487.d: or rather (by permutation) גִּישׁ; of uncertain derivation; a mass of earth; clod.

H1488.d: from גַּזָז; a fleece (as shorn); also mown grass; fleece, mowing, mown grass.

H1491.d: a primitive root (akin to גּוּז); to cut off, i.e. portion out; take.

H1492.d: feminine from גַּזָז; a fleece; fleece.

H1493.d: patrial from the unused name of a place apparently in Palestine; a Gizonite or inhabitant of Gizoh; Gizonite.

H1494.d: a primitive root (akin to גּוּז); to cut off; specifically to shear aflock or shave the hair; figuratively to destroy an enemy; cut off (down), poll, shave, (sheep-) shear(-er).

H1495.d: from גַּזָז; shearer; Gazez, the name of two Israelites; Gazez.

H1496.d: from גָּזָה; something cut, i.e. dressed stone; hewed, hewn stone, wrought.

H1497.d: a primitive root; to pluck off; specifically to flay, strip or rob; catch, consume, exercise (robbery), pluck (off), rob, spoil, take away (by force, violence), tear.

H1498.d: from גָּזַל; robbery, or (concretely) plunder; robbery, thing taken away by violence.

H1499.d: from גָּזַל; plunder, i.e. violence; violence, violent perverting.. gozal. See גּוֹזָל.

H1500.d: feminine of גָּזֵל and mean the same; {robbery, or (concretely) plunder}; that (he had robbed) (which he took violently away), spoil, violence.

H1501.d: from an unused root meaning to devour; a kind of locust; palmer-worm.

H1502.d: from the same as גָּזָם; devourer; Gazzam, one of the Nethinim; Gazzam.

H1503.d: from an unused root meaning to cut down (trees); the trunk or stump of atree (as felled or as planted); stem, stock.

H1504.d: a primitive root; to cut down or off; (figuratively) to destroy, divide, exclude, or decide; cut down (off), decree, divide, snatch.

H1505.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to גָּזַר; to quarry; determine; cut out, soothsayer.

H1506.d: from גָּזַר; something cut off; a portion; part, piece.

H1507.d: the same as גֶּזֶר; Gezer, a place in Palestine; Gazer, Gezer.

H1508.d: feminine of גֶּזֶר; the figure or person (as if cut out); also an inclosure (as separated); polishing, separate place.

H1509.d: from גָּזַר; a desert (as separated); not inhabited.

H1510.d: (Aramaic) from גְּזַר (as גָּזַר); a decree; decree.

H1511.d: (in the m patrial from גֶּזֶר; a Gezerite (collectively) or inhabitants of Gezer; but better (as in the text) bytransposition גִּזְרִיxlit Girzîy corrected to Gizrîy; patrial of גְּרִזִים; a Grizite (collectively) or member of a native tribe in Palestine; Gezrites.

H1512.d: probably from גִּיחַlemma גּיחַ missing vowel, corrected to גִּיחַ; (compare גִּיחוֹן); the external abdomen, belly (as the source of the faetus ); belly.

H1513.d: or (feminine) גַּחֶלֶת; from an unused root meaning to glow or kindle; an ember; (burning) coal.

H1514.d: from an unused root meaning to burn; flame; Gacham, a son of Nahor; Gaham.

H1515.d: from an unused root meaning to hide; lurker; Gachar, one of the Nethinim; Gahar.

H1516.d: or (shortened) גַּי; probably (by transmutation) from the same root as גֵּוָה (abbreviated); a gorge (from its lofty sides; hence, narrow, but not a gully or winter-torrent); valley.

H1517.d: probably from גּוּד; a thong (as compressing); by analogy, a tendon; sinew.

H1518.d: lemma גּיחַ missing vowel, corrected to גִּיחַ; or (shortened) גֹּחַ; a primitive root; to gush forth (as water), generally to issue; break forth, labor to bring forth, come forth, draw up, take out.

H1519.d: (Aramaic) or (shortened) גּוּחַ; (Aramaic), corresponding to גִּיחַlemma גּיחַ missing vowel, corrected to גִּיחַ; to rush forth; strive.

H1520.d: from גִּיחַlemma גּיחַ missing vowel, corrected to גִּיחַ; a fountain; Giach, a place in Palestine; Giah.

H1521.d: or (shortened) גִּחוֹן; from גִּיחַlemma גּיחַ missing vowel, corrected to גִּיחַ; stream; Gichon, a river of Paradise; also a valley (or pool) near Jerusalem; Gihon.

H1522.d: or גֵּחֲזִי; apparently from גַּיְא and חָזָה; valley of a visionary; Gechazi, the servant of Elisha; Gehazi.

H1523.d: or (by permutation) גּוּל; a primitive root; properly, to spin round (under the influence of any violent emotion), i.e. usually rejoice, or (as cringing) fear; be glad, joy, be joyful, rejoice.

H1524.d: from גִּיל; a revolution (of time, i.e. an age); also joy; [idiom] exceedingly, gladness, [idiom] greatly, joy, rejoice(-ing), sort.

H1525.d: or גִּילַת; feminine of גִּיל; joy; joy, rejoicing.

H1526.d: patrial from גִּלֹה; a Gilonite or inhabitant of Giloh; Gilonite.

H1527.d: of uncertain derivation; Ginath, an Israelite; Ginath.

H1529.d: from the same as גּוּשׁ; lumpish; Geshan, an Israelite; Geshan.

H1530.d: from גָּלַל; something rolled, i.e. a heap of stone or dung (plural ruins), by analogy, a spring of water (plural waves); billow, heap, spring, wave.

H1531.d: from גָּלַל; a cup for oil (as round); bowl.

H1532.d: from an unused root meaning to shave; a barber; barber.

H1533.d: from גַּל and בָּעָה; fountain of ebullition; Gilboa, a mountain of Palestine; Gilboa.

H1534.d: by reduplication from גָּלַל; a wheel; by analogy, a whirlwind; also dust (as whirled); heaven, rolling thing, wheel.

H1535.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to גַּלְגַּל; a wheel; wheel.

H1536.d: a variation of גַּלְגַּל; {a wheel; by analogy, a whirlwind; also dust (as whirled)}; wheel.

H1537.d: the same as גִּלְגָּל (with the article as a properly, noun); Gilgal, the name of three places in Palestine; Gilgal. See also בֵּית הַגִּלְגָּל.

H1538.d: by reduplication from גָּלַל; a skull (as round); by implication, a head (in enumeration of persons); head, every man, poll, skull.

H1539.d: from an unused root probably meaning to polish; the (human) skin (as smooth); skin.

H1540.d: a primitive root; to denude (especially in a disgraceful sense); by implication, to exile (captives being usually stripped); figuratively, to reveal; [phrase] advertise, appear, bewray, bring, (carry, lead, go) captive (into captivity), depart, disclose, discover, exile, be gone, open, [idiom] plainly, publish, remove, reveal, [idiom] shamelessly, shew, [idiom] surely, tell, uncover.

H1541.d: (Aramaic) or גְּלָא; (Aramaic), corresponding to גָּלָה; {to denude (especially in a disgraceful sense); by implication, to exile (captives being usually stripped); figuratively, to reveal}; bring over, carry away, reveal.

H1542.d: or (fully) גִּילֹה; from גָּלָה; open; Giloh, a place in Palestine; Giloh.

H1543.d: feminine from גָּלַל; a fountain, bowl or globe (all as round); bowl, pommel, spring.

H1544.d: or (shortened) גִּלֻּל; from גָּלַל; properly, a log (as round); by implication, an idol; idol.

H1546.d: feminine from גָּלָה; captivity; concretely, exiles (collectively); (they that are carried away) captives(-ity).

H1547.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to גָּלוּת; {captivity; concretely, exiles (collectively)}; captivity.

H1548.d: a primitive root; properly, to be bald, i.e. (causatively) to shave; figuratively to lay waste; poll, shave (off).

H1549.d: or גִּלְיוֹן; from גָּלָה; a tablet for writing (as bare); by analogy, a mirror (as a plate); glass, roll.

H1550.d: from גָּלַל; a valve of a folding door (as turning); also a ring (as round); folding, ring.

H1551.d: or (prolonged) גָּלִילָה; the same as גָּלִיל; a circle (with the article); Galil (as a special circuit) in the North of Palestine; Galilee.

H1552.d: feminine of גָּלִיל; a circuit or region; border, coast, country.

H1553.d: plural of גְלִילָה; circles; Geliloth, a place in Palestine; Geliloth.

H1554.d: plural of גַּל; springs; Gallim, a place in Palestine; Gallim.

H1555.d: perhaps from גָּלָה; exile; Goljath, a Philistine; Goliath.

H1556.d: a primitive root; to roll (literally or figuratively); commit, remove, roll (away, down, together), run down, seek occasion, trust, wallow.

H1557.d: from גָּלַל; dung (as in balls); dung.

H1558.d: from גָּלַל; a circumstance (as rolled around); only used adverbially, on account of; because of, for (sake).

H1559.d: from גָּלַל, in the sense of גְּלָל; great; Galal, the name of two Israelites; Galal.

H1560.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to גָּלַל; weight or size (as if rolled); great.

H1561.d: a variation of גָּלָל; dung (plural balls of dung); dung.

H1562.d: from גֵּלֶל; dungy; Gilalai, an Israelite; Gilalai.

H1563.d: a primitive root; to fold; wrap together.

H1564.d: from גָּלַם; a wrapped (and unformed mass, i.e. as the embryo); substance yet being unperfect.

H1565.d: probably by prolonged from גָּלַם; sterile (as wrapped up too hard); figuratively, desolate; desolate, solitary.

H1566.d: a primitive root; to be obstinate; (inter-) meddle (with).

H1567.d: from גַּל and עֵד; heap of testimony; Galed, a memorial cairn East of the Jordan; Galeed.

H1568.d: probably from גַּלְעֵד; Gilad, a region East of the Jordan; also the name of three Israelites; Gilead, Gileadite.

H1569.d: patronymically from גִּלְעָד; a Giladite or descendant of Gilad; Gileadite.

H1570.d: a primitive root; probably to caper (as a goat); appear.

H1571.d: by contraction from an unused root meaning to gather; properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and; again, alike, also, (so much) as (soon), both (so)...and, but, either...or, even, for all, (in) likewise (manner), moreover, nay...neither, one, then(-refore), though, what, with, yea.

H1572.d: a primitive root (literally or figuratively) to absorb; to absorb; swallow, drink.

H1573.d: from גָּמָא; properly, an absorbent, i.e. the bulrush (from its porosity); specifically the papyrus; (bul-) rush.

H1574.d: from an unused root apparently meaning to grasp; properly, a span; cubit.

H1575.d: from the same as גֹּמֶד; a warrior (as grasping weapons); Gammadims.

H1576.d: from גָּמַל; treatment, i.e. an act (of good or ill); by implication, service or requital; [phrase] as hast served, benefit, desert, deserving, that which he hath given, recompense, reward.

H1577.d: passive participle of גָּמַל; rewarded; Gamul, an Israelite; Gamul. See also בֵּית גָּמוּל.

H1578.d: feminine of גְּמוּל; meaning the same; deed, recompense, such a reward.

H1579.d: of uncertain derivation; Gimzo, a place in Palestine; Gimzo.

H1580.d: a primitive root; to treat a person (well or ill), i.e. benefit or requite; by implication (of toil), to ripen, i.e. (specifically) to wean; bestow on, deal bountifully, do (good), recompense, requite, reward, ripen, [phrase] serve, mean, yield.

H1581.d: apparently from גָּמַל (in the sense of labor or burden-bearing); a camel; camel.

H1582.d: probably from גָּמָל; cameldriver; Gemalli, an Israelite; Gemalli.

H1583.d: from גָּמַל and אֵל; reward of God; Gamliel, an Israelite; Gamaliel.

H1584.d: a primitive root; to end (in the sense of completion or failure); cease, come to an end, fail, perfect, perform.

H1585.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to גָּמַר; {to end (in the sense of completion or failure)}; perfect.

H1586.d: from גָּמַר; completion; Gomer, the name of a son of Japheth and of his descendants; also of a Hebrewess; Gomer.

H1587.d: or גְּמַרְיָהוּ; from גָּמַר and יָהּ; Jah has perfected; Gemarjah, the name of two Israelites; Gemariah.

H1588.d: from גָּנַן; a garden (as fenced); garden.

H1589.d: a primitive root; to thieve (literally or figuratively); by implication, to deceive; carry away, [idiom] indeed, secretly bring, steal (away), get by stealth.

H1591.d: from גָּנַב; stealing, i.e. (concretely) something stolen; theft.

H1592.d: from גָּנַב; theft; Genubath, an Edomitish prince; Genubath.

H1593.d: feminine of גַּן; a garden; garden.

H1594.d: another form for גַּנָּה; {a garden}; garden.

H1595.d: from an unused root meaning to store; treasure; by implication, a coffer; chest, treasury.

H1597.d: prolonged from גֶּנֶז; a treasury; treasury.

H1598.d: a primitive root; to hedge about, i.e. (generally) protect; defend.

H1599.d: or גִּנְּתוֹ; from גָּנַן; gardener; Ginnethon or Ginnetho, an Israelite; Ginnetho, Ginnethon.

H1600.d: a primitive root; to bellow (as cattle); low.

H1601.d: feminine active participle of גָּעָה; lowing; Goah, a place near Jerusalem; Goath.

H1602.d: a primitive root; to detest; by implication, to reject; abhor, fail, lothe, vilely cast away.

H1603.d: from גָּעַל; loathing; Gaal, an Israelite; Gaal.

H1605.d: a primitive root; to chide; corrupt, rebuke, reprove.

H1606.d: from גָּעַר; a chiding; rebuke(-ing), reproof.

H1607.d: a primitive root; to agitate violently; move, shake, toss, trouble.

H1608.d: from גָּעַשׁ; a quaking; Gaash, a hill in Palestine; Gaash.

H1609.d: of uncertain derivation; Gatam, an Edomite; Gatam.

H1610.d: from an unused root meaning to arch; the back; by extension the body or self; [phrase] highest places, himself.

H1611.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to גַּף; a wing; wing.

H1612.d: from an unused root meaning to bend; a vine (as twining), especially the grape; vine, tree.

H1613.d: from an unused root, probably meaning to house in; a kind of tree or wood (as used for building), apparently the cypress; gopher.

H1614.d: probably feminine of גֹּפֶר; properly, cypress-resin; by analogy, sulphur (as equally inflammable); brimstone.

H1615.d: perhaps from כּוּר; lime (from being burned in a kiln); chalk(-stone).

H1616.d: or (fully) geyr (gare); from גּוּר; properly, a guest; by implication, a foreigner; alien, sojourner, stranger.

H1617.d: perhaps from גֵּרָה; a grain; Gera, the name of six Israelites; Gera.

H1618.d: from an unused root meaning to scratch; scurf (from itching); scab, scurvy.

H1619.d: from the same as גָּרָב; scabby; Gareb, the name of an Israelite, also of a hill near Jerusalem; Gareb.

H1620.d: by reduplication from גָּרַר; a berry (as if a pellet of rumination); berry.

H1621.d: feminine plural from גָּרַר; the throat (as used in rumination); neck.

H1622.d: patrial from an unused name (of uncertain derivation); a Girgashite, one of the native tribes of Canaan; Girgashite, Girgasite.

H1623.d: a primitive root; to abrade; scrape.

H1624.d: a primitive root; properly, to grate, i.e. (figuratively) to anger; contend, meddle, stir up, strive.

H1625.d: from גָּרַר; the cud (as scraping the throat); cud.

H1626.d: from גָּרַר (as in גֵּרָה); properly, (like גַּרְגַּר) a kernel (round as if scraped), i.e.; a gerah or small weight (and coin); gerah.

H1627.d: or (shortened) גָּרֹן; from גָּרַר; (compare גַּרְגְּרוֹת); the throat (as roughened by swallowing); [idiom] aloud, mouth, neck, throat.

H1629.d: a primitive root; to cut off; cut off.

H1630.d: plural of an unused noun from גָּרַז (compare גִּזְרִי), cut up (i.e. rocky); Gerizim, a mountain of Palestine; Gerizim.

H1632.d: from the same as גּוֹרָל; harsh; man of great (as in the margin which reads גָּדוֹל).

H1633.d: a primitive root; to be spare or skeleton-like; used only as a denominative from גֶּרֶם; (causative) to bone, i.e. denude (by extensive, craunch) the bones; gnaw the bones, break.

H1634.d: from גָּרַם; a bone (as the skeleton of the body); hence, self, i.e. (figuratively) very; bone, strong, top.

H1635.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to גֶּרֶם; a bone; bone.

H1636.d: from גֶּרֶם; bony, i.e. strong; Garmite.

H1637.d: from an unused root meaning to smooth; a threshing-floor (as made even); by analogy, any open area; (barn, corn, threshing-) floor, (threshing-, void) place.

H1638.d: a primitive root; to crush; also (intransitively and figuratively) to dissolve; break.

H1639.d: a primitive root; to scrape off; by implication, to shave, remove, lessen, withhold; abate, clip, (di-) minish, do (take) away, keep back, restrain, make small, withdraw.

H1640.d: a primitive root; to bear off violently; sweep away.

H1641.d: a primitive root; to drag off roughly; by implication, to bring up the cud (i.e. ruminate); by analogy, to saw; catch, chew, [idiom] continuing, destroy, saw.

H1642.d: probably from גָּרַר; a rolling country; Gerar, a Philistine city; Gerar.

H1643.d: from an unused root meaning to husk; a kernel (collectively), i.e. grain; beaten corn.

H1644.d: a primitive root; to drive out from a possession; especially to expatriate or divorce; cast up (out), divorced (woman), drive away (forth, out), expel, [idiom] surely put away, trouble, thrust out.

H1645.d: from גָּרַשׁ; produce (as if expelled); put forth.

H1646.d: feminine passive participle of גָּרַשׁ; (abstractly) dispossession; exaction.

H1647.d: for גֵּרְשׁוֹן; Gereshom, the name of four Israelites; Gershom.

H1648.d: or גֵּרְשׁוֹם; from גָּרַשׁ; a refugee; Gereshon or Gereshom, an Israelite; Gershon, Gershom.

H1649.d: patronymically from גֵּרְשׁוֹן; a Gereshonite or descendant of Gereshon; Gershonite, sons of Gershon.

H1650.d: from an unused root (meaning to join); bridge; Geshur, a district of Syria; Geshur, Geshurite.

H1651.d: patrial from גְּשׁוּר; a Geshurite (also collectively) or inhabitants of Geshur; Geshuri, Geshurites.

H1652.d: a primitive root; to shower violently; (cause to) rain.

H1653.d: from גָּשַׁם; a shower; rain, shower.

H1654.d: or (prolonged) גַּשְׁמוּ; the same as גֶּשֶׁם; Geshem or Gashmu, an Arabian; Geshem, Gashmu.

H1655.d: (Aramaic) apparently the same as גֶּשֶׁם; used in a peculiar sense, the body (probably for the (figuratively) idea of a hard rain); body.

H1656.d: from גָּשַׁם; equivalent to גֶּשֶׁם; {a shower}; rained upon.

H1657.d: probably of Egyptian origin; Goshen, the residence of the Israelites in Egypt; also a place in Palestine; Goshen.

H1658.d: of uncertain derivation; Gishpa, an Israelite; Gispa.

H1659.d: a primitive root; apparently; to feel about; grope.

H1660.d: probably from נָגַן (in the sense of treading out grapes); a wine-press (or vat for holding the grapes in pressing them); (wine-) press (fat).

H1661.d: the same as גַּת; Gath, a Philistine city; Gath.

H1662.d: or (abridged) גִּתָּה־חֵפֶר; from גַּת and חָפַר with the article inserted; wine-press of (the) well; Gath-Chepher, a place in Palestine; Gath-kephr, Gittah-kephr.

H1663.d: patrial from גַּת; a Gittite or inhabitant of Gath; Gittite.

H1664.d: dual of גַּת; double winepress; Gittajim, a place in Palestine; Gittaim.

H2254.d: a primitive root; to wind tightly (as a rope), i.e. to bind; specifically, by a pledge; figuratively, to pervert, destroy; also to writhe in pain (especially of parturition); [idiom] at all, band, bring forth, (deal) corrupt(-ly), destroy, offend, lay to (take a) pledge, spoil, travail, [idiom] very, withhold.

H2255.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to חָבַל; to ruin; destroy, hurt.

H2256.d: or חֵבֶל; from חָבַל; a rope (as twisted), especially a measuring line; by implication, a district or inheritance (as measured); or a noose (as of cords); figuratively, a company (as if tied together); also a throe (especially of parturition); also ruin; band, coast, company, cord, country, destruction, line, lot, pain, pang, portion, region, rope, snare, sorrow, tackling.

H2257.d: (Aramaic) from חֲבַל; harm (personal or pecuniary); damage, hurt.

H2258.d: or (feminine) חֲבֹלָה; from חָבַל; a pawn (as security for debt); pledge.

H2259.d: active participle from חָבַל (in the sense of handling ropes); a sailor; pilot, shipmaster.

H2260.d: from חָבַל (in the sense of furnished with ropes); a mast; mast.

H2261.d: of uncertain derivation; probably meadow-saffron; rose.

H2262.d: of uncertain derivation; Chabatstsanjah, a Rechabite; Habazaniah.

H2263.d: a primitive root; to clasp (the hands or in embrace); embrace, fold.

H2264.d: from חָבַק; a clasping of the hands (in idleness); fold.

H2265.d: by reduplication from חָבַק; embrace; Chabakkuk, the prophet; Habakkuk.

H2266.d: a primitive root; to join (literally or figuratively); specifically (by means of spells) to fascinate; charm(-er), be compact, couple (together), have fellowship with, heap up, join (self, together), league.

H2267.d: from חָבַר; a society; also a spell; [phrase] charmer(-ing), company, enchantment, [idiom] wide.

H2268.d: the same as חֶבֶר; community; Cheber, the name of a Kenite and of three Israelites; Heber.

H2269.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to חָבַר; an associate; companion, fellow.

H2270.d: from חָבַר; an associate; companion, fellow, knit together.

H2272.d: by reduplication from חָבַר; a streak (like a line), as on the tiger; spot.

H2273.d: (Aramaic) feminine of חֲבַר; an associate; other.

H2275.d: from חֶבֶר; seat of association; Chebron, a place in Palestine, also the name of two Israelites; Hebron.

H2276.d: or חֶבְרֹנִי; patronymically from חֶבְרוֹן; Chebronite (collectively), an inhabitant of Chebron; Hebronites.

H2277.d: patronymically from חֶבֶר; a Chebrite (collectively) or descendants of Cheber; Heberites.

H2278.d: feminine of חָבֵר; a consort; companion.

H2279.d: feminine active participle of חָבַר; a joint; which coupleth, coupling.

H2280.d: a primitive root; to wrap firmly (especially a turban, compress, or saddle); figuratively, to stop, to rule; bind (up), gird about, govern, healer, put, saddle, wrap about.

H2281.d: from an unused root probably meaning to cook (compare מַחֲבַת); something fried, probably a griddle-cake; pan.

H2282.d: or חָג; from חָגַג; a festival, or a victim therefor; (solemn) feast (day), sacrifice, solemnity.

H2283.d: from an unused root meaning to revolve (compare חָגַג); properly, vertigo, i.e. (figuratively) fear; terror.

H2284.d: of uncertain derivation; a locust; locust.

H2285.d: the same as חָגָב; locust; Chagab, one of the Nethinim; Hagab.

H2286.d: or חֲגָבָה; feminine of חָגָב; locust; Chagaba or Chagabah, one of the Nethinim; Hagaba, Hagabah.

H2287.d: a primitive root (compare חָגָא, חוּג); properly, to move in acircle, i.e. (specifically) to march in asacred procession, to observe afestival; by implication, to be giddy; celebrate, dance, (keep, hold) a (solemn) feast (holiday), reel to and fro.

H2288.d: from an unused root meaning to take refuge; a rift in rocks; cleft.

H2290.d: or חֲגֹר; and (feminine) חֲגוֹרָה; or חֲגֹרָה; from חָגַר; a belt (for the waist); apron, armour, gird(-le).

H2291.d: from חָגַג; festive; Chaggi, an Israelite; also (patronymically) a Chaggite, or descendant of the same; Haggi, Haggites.

H2292.d: from חַג; festive; Chaggai, a Hebrew prophet; Haggai.

H2293.d: from חַג and יָהּ; festival of Jah; Chaggijah, an Israelite; Haggiah.

H2294.d: xlit Chaggiyîth corrected to Chaggîyth; feminine of חַגִּי; festive; Chaggith, a wife of David; Haggith.

H2295.d: of uncertain derivation; probably a partridge; Choglah, an Israelitess; Hoglah. See also בֵּית חׇגְלָה.

H2296.d: a primitive root; to gird on (as a belt, armor, etc.); be able to put on, be afraid, appointed, gird, restrain, [idiom] on every side.

H2298.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to חַד; as card. one; as article single; as an ordinal, first; adverbially, at once; a, first, one, together.

H2300.d: a primitive root; to be (causatively, make) sharp or (figuratively) severe; be fierce, sharpen.

H2301.d: from חָדַד; fierce; Chadad, an Ishmaelite; Hadad.

H2302.d: a primitive root; to rejoice; make glad, be joined, rejoice.

H2306.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to חָזֶה; a breast; breast.

H2307.d: from חָדַד; a peak; Chadid, a place in Palestine; Hadid.

H2308.d: a primitive root; properly, to be flabby, i.e. (by implication) desist; (figuratively) be lacking or idle; cease, end, fall, forbear, forsake, leave (off), let alone, rest, be unoccupied, want.

H2309.d: from חָדַל; rest, i.e. the state of the dead; world.

H2310.d: from חָדַל; vacant, i.e. ceasing or destitute; he that forbeareth, frail, rejected.

H2311.d: from חֶדֶל; idle; Chadlai, an Israelite; Hadlai.

H2312.d: from an unused root meaning to sting; a prickly plant; brier, thorn.

H2313.d: probably of foreign origin; the Chiddekel (or Tigris) river; Hiddekel.

H2314.d: a primitive root; properly, to inclose (as a room), i.e. (by analogy,) to beset (as in a siege); enter a privy chamber.

H2315.d: from חָדַר; an apartment (usually literal); ((bed) inner) chamber, innermost(-ward) part, parlour, [phrase] south, [idiom] within.

H2316.d: another form for חֶדֶר; chamber; Chadar, an Ishmaelite; Hadar.

H2317.d: of uncertain derivation; Chadrak, a Syrian deity; Hadrach.

H2318.d: a primitive root; to be new; causatively, to rebuild; renew, repair.

H2319.d: from חָדַשׁ; new; fresh, new thing.

H2320.d: from חָדַשׁ; the new moon; by implication, a month; month(-ly), new moon.

H2321.d: the same as חֹדֶשׁ; Chodesh, an Israelitess; Hodesh.

H2322.d: feminine of חָדָשׁ; new; Chadashah, a place in Palestine; Hadashah.

H2324.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to חָוָה; to show; shew.

H2325.d: also חָיַב; a primitive root; properly, perhaps to tie, i.e. (figuratively and reflexively) to owe, or (by implication) to forfeit; make endanger.

H2327.d: feminine active participle of חָבָה; hiding place; Chobah, a place in Syria; Hobah.

H2328.d: a primitive root (compare חָגַג); to describe a circle; compass.

H2329.d: from חוּג; a circle; circle, circuit, compass.

H2330.d: a primitive root; properly, to tie a knot, i.e. (figuratively) to propound a riddle; put forth.

H2331.d: a primitive root; (compare חֲוָא, חָיָה); properly, to live; by implication (intensively) to declare or show; show.

H2332.d: causatively from חָוָה; life-giver; Chavvah (or Eve), the first woman; Eve.

H2333.d: properly, the same as חַוָּה (lifegiving, i.e. living-place); by implication, an encampment or village; (small) town.

H2334.d: from the plural of חַוָּה and a modification of יָעוּר; hamlets of Jair, a region of Palestine; (Bashan-) Havoth-jair.

H2335.d: from חֹזֶה; visionary; Chozai, an Israelite; the seers.

H2336.d: from an unused root apparently meaning to pierce; a thorn; by analogy, a ring forthe nose; bramble, thistle, thorn.

H2337.d: perhaps the same as חוֹחַ; a dell or crevice (as if pierced in the earth); thicket.

H2338.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to the root of חוּט, perhaps as a denominative; to string together, i.e. (figuratively) to repair; join.

H2339.d: from an unused root probably meaning to sew; a string; by implication, a measuring tape; cord, fillet, line, thread.

H2340.d: perhaps from חַוָּה; a villager; a Chivvite, one of the aboriginal tribes of Palestine; Hivite.

H2341.d: probably from חוּל; circular; Chavilah, the name of two or three eastern regions; also perhaps of two men; Havilah.

H2342.d: or חִיל; a primitive root; properly, to twist or whirl (in a circular or spiral manner), i.e. (specifically) to dance, to writhe in pain (especially of parturition) or fear; figuratively, to wait, to pervert; bear, (make to) bring forth, (make to) calve, dance, drive away, fall grievously (with pain), fear, form, great, grieve, (be) grievous, hope, look, make, be in pain, be much (sore) pained, rest, shake, shapen, (be) sorrow(-ful), stay, tarry, travail (with pain), tremble, trust, wait carefully (patiently), be wounded.

H2343.d: from חוּל; a circle; Chul, a son of Aram; also the region settled by him; Hul.

H2344.d: from חוּל; sand (as round or whirling particles); sand.

H2345.d: from an unused root meaning to be warm, i.e. (by implication); sunburnt or swarthy (blackish); brown.

H2346.d: feminine active participle of an unused root apparently meaning to join; a wall of protection; wall, walled.

H2347.d: a primitive root; properly, to cover, i.e. (figuratively) to compassionate; pity, regard, spare.

H2348.d: from an unused root meaning to cover; a cove (as a sheltered bay); coast (of the sea), haven, shore, (sea-) side.

H2349.d: from the same as חוֹף; protection; Chupham, an Israelite; Hupham.

H2350.d: patronymically from חוּפָם; a Chuphamite or descendant of Chupham; Huphamites.

H2351.d: or (shortened) חֻץ; (both forms feminine in the plural) from an unused root meaning to sever; properly, separate by awall, i.e. outside, outdoors; abroad, field, forth, highway, more, out(-side, -ward), street, without.

H2352.d: or (shortened) חֻר; from an unused root probably meaning to bore; the crevice of a serpent; the cell of aprison; hole.

H2354.d: the same as חוּר or חוּר; Chur, the name of four Israelites and one Midianite; Hur.

H2355.d: the same as חוּר; white linen; network. Compare חֹר.

H2356.d: or (shortened) חֹר; the same as חוּר; a cavity, socket, den; cave, hole.

H2357.d: a primitive root; to blanch (as with shame); wax pale.

H2358.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to חָוַר; white; white.

H2359.d: probably from חוּר; linen-worker; Churi, an Israelite; Huri.

H2360.d: probably an orthographical variation for חוּרִי; Churai, an Israelite; Hurai.

H2361.d: probably from חוּר; whiteness, i.e. noble; Churam, the name of an Israelite and two Syrians; Huram. Compare חִירָם.

H2362.d: apparently from חָוַר (in the sense of חוּר); cavernous; Chavran, a region East of the Jordan; Hauran.

H2363.d: a primitive root; to hurry; figuratively, to be eager with excitement or enjoyment; (make) haste(-n), ready.

H2364.d: from חוּשׁ; haste; Chushah, an Israelite; Hushah.

H2365.d: from חוּשׁ; hasty; Chushai, an Israelite; Hushai.

H2366.d: or חֻשִׁים; or חֻשִׁם; plural from חוּשׁ; hasters; Chushim, the name of three Israelites; Hushim.

H2367.d: or חֻשָׁם; from חוּשׁ; hastily; Chusham, an Idumaean; Husham.

H2368.d: or חֹתָם; from חָתַם; a signature-ring; seal, signet.

H2369.d: the same as חוֹתָם; seal; Chotham, the name of two Israelites; Hotham, Hothan.

H2370.d: (Aramaic) or חֲזָה; (Aramaic), corresponding to חָזָה; to gaze upon; mentally to dream, be usual (i.e. seem); behold, have (a dream), see, be wont.

H2371.d: or חֲזָהאֵל; from חָזָה and אֵל; God has seen; Chazael, a king of Syria; Hazael.

H2372.d: a primitive root; to gaze at; mentally to perceive, contemplate (with pleasure); specifically, to have avision of; behold, look, prophesy, provide, see.

H2373.d: from חָזָה; the breast (as most seen in front); breast.

H2374.d: active participle of חָזָה; a beholder in vision; also a compact (as looked upon with approval); agreement, prophet, see that, seer, (star-) gazer.

H2375.d: from חָזָה; seer; Chazo, a nephew of Abraham; Hazo.

H2376.d: (Aramaic) from חֲזָא; a sight; look, vision.

H2377.d: from חָזָה; a sight (mentally), i.e. a dream, revelation, or oracle; vision.

H2380.d: from חָזָה; a look; hence (figuratively) striking appearance, revelation, or (by implication) compact; agreement, notable (one), vision.

H2381.d: from חָזָה and אֵל; seen of God; Chaziel, a Levite; Haziel.

H2382.d: from חָזָה and יָהּ; Jah has seen; Chazajah, an Israelite; Hazaiah.

H2383.d: from חָזָה; vision; Chezjon, a Syrian; Hezion.

H2384.d: from חָזָה; a revelation, expectation by dream; vision.

H2385.d: from an unused root meaning to glare; a flash of lightning; bright cloud, lightning.

H2386.d: from an unused root probably meaning to enclose; a hog (perhaps as penned); boar, swine.

H2387.d: from the same as חֲזִיר; perhaps protected; Chezir, the name of two Israelites; Hezir.

H2388.d: a primitive root; to fasten upon; hence, to seize, be strong (figuratively, courageous, causatively strengthen, cure, help, repair, fortify), obstinate; to bind, restrain, conquer; aid, amend, [idiom] calker, catch, cleave, confirm, be constant, constrain, continue, be of good (take) courage(-ous, -ly), encourage (self), be established, fasten, force, fortify, make hard, harden, help, (lay) hold (fast), lean, maintain, play the man, mend, become (wax) mighty, prevail, be recovered, repair, retain, seize, be (wax) sore, strengthen (self), be stout, be (make, shew, wax) strong(-er), be sure, take (hold), be urgent, behave self valiantly, withstand.

H2389.d: from חָזַק; strong (usu. in a bad sense, hard, bold, violent); harder, hottest, [phrase] impudent, loud, mighty, sore, stiff(-hearted), strong(-er).

H2390.d: from חָזַק; powerful; [idiom] wax louder, stronger.

H2393.d: feminine of חֵזֶק; prevailing power; strength(-en self), (was) strong.

H2394.d: feminine of חֹזֶק; vehemence (usually in a bad sense); force, mightily, repair, sharply.

H2395.d: from חָזַק; strong; Chizki, an Israelite; Hezeki.

H2396.d: or חִזְקִיָּהוּ; also יְחִזְקִיָּה; or יְחִזְקִיָּהוּ; from חָזַק and יָהּ; strengthened of Jah; Chizkijah, a king of Judah, also the name of two other Israelites; Hezekiah, Hizkiah, Hizkijah. Compare יְחִזְקִיָּה.

H2397.d: once (Ezekiel 29:4) חָחִי; from the same as חוֹחַ; a ring for the nose (or lips); bracelet, chain, hook.

H2398.d: a primitive root; properly, to miss; hence (figuratively and generally) to sin; by inference, to forfeit, lack, expiate, repent, (causatively) lead astray, condemn; bear the blame, cleanse, commit (sin), by fault, harm he hath done, loss, miss, (make) offend(-er), offer for sin, purge, purify (self), make reconciliation, (cause, make) sin(-ful, -ness), trespass.

H2399.d: from חָטָא; a crime or its penalty; fault, [idiom] grievously, offence, (punishment of) sin.

H2400.d: intensively from חָטָא; a criminal, or one accounted guilty; offender, sinful, sinner.

H2401.d: feminine of חֵטְא; an offence, or a sacrifice forit; sin (offering).

H2402.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to חֲטָאָה; an offence, and the penalty or sacrifice forit; sin (offering).

H2403.d: or חַטָּאת; from חָטָא; an offence (sometimes habitual sinfulness), and its penalty, occasion, sacrifice, or expiation; also (concretely) an offender; punishment (of sin), purifying(-fication for sin), sin(-ner, offering).

H2404.d: a primitive root; to chop or carve wood; cut down, hew(-er), polish.

H2405.d: feminine passive participle of חָטַב; properly, a carving; hence, a tapestry (as figured); carved.

H2406.d: of uncertain derivation; wheat, whether the grain or the plant; wheat(-en).

H2407.d: from an unused root of uncertain signification; Chattush, the name of four or five Israelites; Hattush.

H2408.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to חָטָא; an offence; sin.

H2409.d: (Aramaic) from the same as חֲטִי; an expiation; sin offering.

H2410.d: from an unused root apparently meaning to dig out; explorer; Chatita, a temple porter; Hatita.

H2411.d: from an unused root apparently meaning to wave; fluctuating; Chattil, one of 'Solomon's servants'; Hattil.

H2412.d: from חָטַף; robber; Chatipha, one of the Nethinim; Hatipha.

H2413.d: a primitive root; to stop; refrain.

H2414.d: a primitive root; to clutch; hence, to seize as aprisoner; catch.

H2415.d: from an unused root of uncertain signification; a twig; rod.

H2416.d: from חָיָה; alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively; [phrase] age, alive, appetite, (wild) beast, company, congregation, life(-time), live(-ly), living (creature, thing), maintenance, [phrase] merry, multitude, [phrase] (be) old, quick, raw, running, springing, troop.

H2417.d: (Aramaic) from חֲיָא; alive; also (as noun in plural) life; life, that liveth, living.

H2418.d: (Aramaic) or חֲיָה; (Aramaic), corresponding to חָיָה; to live; live, keep alive.

H2419.d: from חַי and אֵל; living of God; Chiel, an Israelite; Hiel.

H2420.d: from חוּד; a puzzle, hence, a trick, conundrum, sententious maxim; dark saying (sentence, speech), hard question, proverb, riddle.

H2421.d: a primitive root (compare חָוָה, חָיָה); to live, whether literally or figuratively; causatively, to revive; keep (leave, make) alive, [idiom] certainly, give (promise) life, (let, suffer to) live, nourish up, preserve (alive), quicken, recover, repair, restore (to life), revive, ([idiom] God) save (alive, life, lives), [idiom] surely, be whole.

H2425.d: a primitive root (compare חָיָה); to live; causatively to revive; live, save life.

H2426.d: or (shortened) חֵל; a collateral form of חַיִל; an army; also (by analogy,) an intrenchment; army, bulwark, host, [phrase] poor, rampart, trench, wall.

H2427.d: and (feminine) חִילָה; from חוּל; a throe (expectant of childbirth); pain, pang, sorrow.

H2428.d: from חוּל; probably a force, whether of men, means or other resources; an army, wealth, virtue, valor, strength; able, activity, ([phrase]) army, band of men (soldiers), company, (great) forces, goods, host, might, power, riches, strength, strong, substance, train, ([phrase]) valiant(-ly), valour, virtuous(-ly), war, worthy(-ily).

H2429.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to חַיִל; an army, or strength; aloud, army, [idiom] most (mighty), power.

H2430.d: feminine of חַיִל; an intrenchment; bulwark.

H2431.d: or חֵלָאםxlit Chêlʼâm corrected to Chêlâʼm; from חַיִל; fortress; Chelam, a place East of Palestine; Helam.

H2432.d: from חַיִל; fortress; Chilen, a place in Palestine; Hilen.

H2433.d: another form for חֵן; beauty; comely.

H2434.d: another form for חוּץ; a wall; wall.

H2435.d: from חַיִץ; properly, the (outer) wall side; hence, exterior; figuratively, secular (as opposed to sacred); outer, outward, utter, without.

H2436.d: or חֵק; and חוֹק; from an unused root, apparently meaning to inclose; the bosom (literally or figuratively); bosom, bottom, lap, midst, within.

H2437.d: from חָוַר in the sense of splendor; Chirah, an Adullamite; Hirah.

H2438.d: or חִירוֹםlemma חִירֹם missing vav, corrected to חִירוֹם; another form of חוּרָם; Chiram or Chirom, the name of two Tyrians; Hiram, Huram.

H2439.d: another form of חוּשׁ; to hurry; make haste.

H2440.d: from חִישׁ; properly, a hurry; hence (adverb) quickly; soon.

H2441.d: probably from חָנַךְ in the sense of tasting; properly, the palate or inside of the mouth; hence, the mouth itself (as the organ of speech, taste and kissing); (roof of the) mouth, taste.

H2442.d: a primitive root (apparently akin to חָקָה through the idea of piercing); properly, to adhere to; hence, to await; long, tarry, wait.

H2443.d: probably from חָכָה; a hook (as adhering); angle, hook.

H2444.d: from the same as חַכְלִיל; dark; Chakilah, a hill in Palestine; Hachilah.

H2445.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to חָכַם; wise, i.e. a Magian; wise.

H2446.d: from the base of חַכְלִיל and יָהּ; darkness of Jah; Chakaljah, an Israelite; Hachaliah.

H2447.d: by reduplication from an unused root apparently meaning to be dark; darkly flashing (only of the eyes); in a good sense, brilliant (as stimulated by wine); red.

H2448.d: from חַכְלִיל; flash (of the eyes); in a bad sense, blearedness; redness.

H2449.d: a primitive root,; to be wise (in mind, word or act); [idiom] exceeding, teach wisdom, be (make self, shew self) wise, deal (never so) wisely, make wiser.

H2450.d: from חָכַם; wise, (i.e. intelligent, skilful or artful); cunning (man), subtil, (un-), wise((hearted), man).

H2451.d: from חָכַם; wisdom (in a good sense); skilful, wisdom, wisely, wit.

H2453.d: from חָכַם; skilful; Chakmoni, an Israelite; Hachmoni, Hachmonite.

H2454.d: or חַכְמוֹת; collateral forms of חׇכְמָה; wisdom; wisdom, every wise (woman).

H2455.d: from חָלַל; properly, exposed; hence, profane; common, profane (place), unholy.

H2456.d: a primitive root (compare חָלָה); to be sick; be diseased.

H2457.d: from חָלָא; properly, disease; hence, rust; scum.

H2458.d: the same as חֶלְאָה; Chelah, an Israelitess; Helah.

H2459.d: or חֵלֶב; from an unused root meaning to be fat; fat, whether literally or figuratively; hence, the richest or choice part; [idiom] best, fat(-ness), [idiom] finest, grease, marrow.

H2460.d: the same as חֶלֶב; fatness; Cheleb, an Israelite; Heleb.

H2461.d: from the same as חֶלֶב; milk (as the richness of kine); [phrase] cheese, milk, sucking.

H2462.d: feminine of חֶלֶב; fertility; Chelbah, a place in Palestine; Helbah.

H2463.d: from חֶלֶב; fruitful; Chelbon, a place in Syria; Helbah.

H2464.d: from חֶלֶב; galbanam, an odorous gum (as if fatty); galbanum.

H2465.d: from an unused root apparently meaning to glide swiftly; life (as a fleeting portion of time); hence, the world (as transient); age, short time, world.

H2466.d: the same as חֶלֶד; Cheled, an Israelite; Heled.

H2467.d: from the same as חֶלֶד; a weasel (from its gliding motion); weasel.

H2468.d: feminine of חֹלֶד; Chuldah, an Israelitess; Huldah.

H2469.d: from חֵלֶד; worldliness; Cheldai, the name of two Israelites; Heldai.

H2470.d: a primitive root (compare חוּל, חָלָה, חָלַל); properly, to be rubbed or worn; hence (figuratively) to be weak, sick, afflicted; or (causatively) to grieve, make sick; also to stroke (in flattering), entreat; beseech, (be) diseased, (put to) grief, be grieved, (be) grievous, infirmity, intreat, lay to, put to pain, [idiom] pray, make prayer, be (fall, make) sick, sore, be sorry, make suit ([idiom] supplication), woman in travail, be (become) weak, be wounded.

H2471.d: from חָלַל; a cake (as usually punctured); cake.

H2472.d: or (shortened) חֲלֹם; from חָלַם; a dream; dream(-er).

H2473.d: or (shortened) חֹלֹן; probably from חוֹל; sandy; Cholon, the name of two places in Palestine; Holon.

H2475.d: from חָלַף; properly, surviving; by implication (collectively) orphans; [idiom] destruction.

H2476.d: feminine passive participle of חָלַשׁ; defeat; being overcome.

H2477.d: probably of foreign origin; Chalach, a region of Assyria; Halah.

H2478.d: by reduplication from חוּל; contorted; Chalchul, a place in Palestine; Halhul.

H2479.d: feminine from the same as חַלְחוּל; writhing (in childbirth); by implication, terror; (great, much) pain.

H2480.d: a primitive root; to snatch at; catch.

H2481.d: from חָלָה; a trinket (as polished); jewel, ornament.

H2482.d: the same as חֲלִי; Chali, a place in Palestine; Hali.

H2483.d: from חָלָה; malady, anxiety, calamity; disease, grief, (is) sick(-ness).

H2484.d: feminine of חֲלִי; a trinket; jewel.

H2485.d: from חָלַל; a flute (as perforated); pipe.

H2486.d: or חָלִלָה; a directive from חָלַל; literal fora profaned thing; used (interj.) far be it!; be far, ([idiom] God) forbid.

H2487.d: lemma חלִיפָה missing vowel, corrected to חֲלִיפָה; from חָלַף; alternation; change, course.

H2489.d: or חֵלְכָה; apparently from an unused root probably meaning to be dark or (figuratively) unhappy; a wretch, i.e. unfortunate; poor.

H2490.d: a primitive root (compare חָלָה); also  denominative (from חָלִיל); properly, to bore, i.e. (by implication) to wound, to dissolve; figuratively, to profane (a person, place or thing), to break (one's word), to begin (as if by an 'opening wedge'); to play (the flute); begin ([idiom] men began), defile, [idiom] break, defile, [idiom] eat (as common things), [idiom] first, [idiom] gather the grape thereof, [idiom] take inheritance, pipe, player on instruments, pollute, (cast as) profane (self), prostitute, slay (slain), sorrow, stain, wound.

H2491.d: from חָלַל; pierced (especially to death); figuratively, polluted; kill, profane, slain (man), [idiom] slew, (deadly) wounded.

H2492.d: a primitive root; properly, to bind firmly, i.e. (by implication) to be (causatively to make) plump; also (through the figurative sense of dumbness) to dream; (cause to) dream(-er), be in good liking, recover.

H2493.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to חָלַם; a dream; dream.

H2494.d: from חָלַם; a dream; Chelem, an Israelite; Helem. Compare חֶלְדַּי.

H2495.d: from חָלַם (in the sense of insipidity); probably purslain; egg.

H2496.d: probably from חָלַם (in the sense of hardness); flint; flint(-y), rock.

H2497.d: from חַיִל; strong; Chelon, an Israelite; Helon.

H2498.d: a primitive root; properly, to slide by, i.e. (by implication) to hasten away, pass on, spring up, pierce or change; abolish, alter, change, cut off, go on forward, grow up, be over, pass (away, on, through), renew, sprout, strike through.

H2499.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to חָלַף; to pass on (of time); pass.

H2500.d: from חָלַף; properly, exchange; hence (as preposition) instead of; [idiom] for.

H2501.d: the same as חֵלֶף; change; Cheleph, a place in Palestine; Heleph.

H2502.d: a primitive root; to pull off; hence (intensively) to strip, (reflex.) to depart; by implication, to deliver, equip (for fight); present, strengthen; arm (self), (go, ready) armed ([idiom] man, soldier), deliver, draw out, make fat, loose, (ready) prepared, put off, take away, withdraw self.

H2503.d: or חֵלֶץ; from חָלַץ; perhaps, strength; Chelets, the name of two Israelites; Helez.

H2504.d: from חָלַץ (in the sense of strength); only in the dual; the loins (as the seat of vigor); loins, reins.

H2505.d: a primitive root; to be smooth (figuratively); by implication (as smooth stones were used for lots) to apportion or separate; deal, distribute, divide, flatter, give, (have, im-) part(-ner), take away a portion, receive, separate self, (be) smooth(-er).

H2506.d: from חָלַק; properly, smoothness (of the tongue); also an allotment; flattery, inheritance, part, [idiom] partake, portion.

H2507.d: the same as חֵלֶק; portion; Chelek, an Israelite; Helek.

H2508.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to חָלַק; a part; portion.

H2509.d: from חָלַק; smooth (especially of tongue); flattering, smooth.

H2510.d: the same as חָלָק; bare; Chalak, a mountain of Idumaea; Halak.

H2513.d: feminine of חֵלֶק; properly, smoothness; figuratively, flattery; also an allotment; field, flattering(-ry), ground, parcel, part, piece of land (ground), plat, portion, slippery place, smooth (thing).

H2515.d: feminine of חַלֻּק; a distribution; division.

H2516.d: patronymically from חֵלֶק; a Chelkite or descendant of Chelek; Helkites.

H2517.d: from חָלַק; apportioned; Chelkai, an Israelite; Helkai.

H2518.d: or חִלְקִיָּהוּ; from חֵלֶק and יָהּ; portion of Jah; Chilhijah, the name of eight Israelites; Hillkiah.

H2519.d: by reduplication from חָלַק; properly, something very smooth; i.e. a treacherous spot; figuratively, blandishment; flattery, slippery.

H2520.d: a form of חֶלְקָה; smoothness; Chelkath, a place in Palestine; Helkath.

H2521.d: from חֶלְקַת and the plural of צוּר, with the article inserted; smoothness of the rocks; Chelkath Hats-tsurim, a place in Palestine; Helkath-hazzurim.

H2522.d: a primitive root; to prostrate; by implication, to overthrow, decay; discomfit, waste away, weaken.

H2524.d: from the same as חוֹמָה; a father-in-law (as in affinity); father in law.

H2526.d: the same as חָם; hot (from the tropical habitat); Cham, a son of Noah; also (as a patronymic) his descendants or their country; Ham.

H2527.d: from חָמַם; heat; heat, to be hot (warm).

H2528.d: (Aramaic) or חֲמָה; (Aramaic), corresponding to חֵמָה; anger; fury.

H2529.d: or (shortened) חֵמָה; from the same root as חוֹמָה; curdled milk or cheese; butter.

H2530.d: a primitive root; to delight in; beauty, greatly beloved, covet, delectable thing, ([idiom] great) delight, desire, goodly, lust, (be) pleasant (thing), precious (thing).

H2532.d: feminine of חֶמֶד; delight; desire, goodly, pleasant, precious.

H2533.d: from חֶמֶד; pleasant; Chemdan, an Idumaean; Hemdan.

H2534.d: or (Daniel 11:44) חֵמָא; from יָחַם; heat; figuratively, anger, poison (from its fever); anger, bottles, hot displeasure, furious(-ly, -ry), heat, indignation, poison, rage, wrath(-ful). See חֶמְאָה.

H2535.d: from חָם; heat; by implication, the sun; heat, sun.

H2536.d: from חַמָּה and אֵל; anger of God; Chammuel, an Israelite; Hamuel.

H2537.d: or חֲמִיטַל; from חָם and טַל; father-in-law of dew; Chamutal or Chamital, an Israelitess; Hamutal.

H2538.d: from חָמַל; pitied; Chamul, an Israelite; Hamul.

H2539.d: patronymically from חָמוּל; a Chamulite (collectively) or descendants of Chamul; Hamulites.

H2540.d: from חָמַם; warm spring; Chammon, the name of two places in Palestine; Hammon.

H2541.d: from חָמֵץ; properly, violent; by implication, a robber; oppressed.

H2542.d: from חָמַק; a wrapping, i.e. drawers; joints.

H2543.d: or (shortened) חֲמֹר; from חָמַר; a male ass (from its dun red); (he) ass.

H2544.d: the same as חֲמוֹר; donkey; Chamor, a Canaanite; Hamor.

H2545.d: or (shortened) חֲמֹת; feminine of חָם; a mother-in-law; mother in law.

H2546.d: from an unused root probably meaning, to lie low; a lizard (as creeping); snail.

H2547.d: feminine of חֹמֶט; low; Chumtah, a place in Palestine; Humtah.

H2548.d: from חָמֵץ; seasoned, i.e. salt provender; clean.

H2549.d: or חֲמִשִּׁי; ordinal from חָמֵשׁ; fifth; also a fifth; fifth (part).

H2550.d: a primitive root; to commiserate; by implication, to spare; have compassion, (have) pity, spare.

H2552.d: a primitive root; to be hot (literally or figuratively); enflame self, get (have) heat, be (wax) hot, (be, wax) warm (self, at).

H2553.d: from חַמָּה; a sun-pillar; idol, image.

H2554.d: a primitive root; to be violent; by implication, to maltreat; make bare, shake off, violate, do violence, take away violently, wrong, imagine wrongfully.

H2555.d: from חָמַס; violence; by implication, wrong; by meton. unjust gain; cruel(-ty), damage, false, injustice, [idiom] oppressor, unrighteous, violence (against, done), violent (dealing), wrong.

H2556.d: a primitive root; to be pungent; i.e. in taste (sour, i.e. literally fermented, or figuratively, harsh), in color (dazzling); cruel (man), dyed, be grieved, leavened.

H2557.d: xlit châmêtz corrected to châmêts; from חָמֵץ; ferment, (figuratively) extortion; leaven, leavened (bread).

H2559.d: a primitive root; properly, to wrap; hence, to depart (i.e. turn about); go about, withdraw self.

H2560.d: a primitive root; also  as denominative (from חֵמָר); properly, to boil up; hence, to ferment (with scum); to glow (with redness); to smear with pitch; daub, befoul, be red, trouble.

H2561.d: from חָמַר; wine (as fermenting); [idiom] pure, red wine.

H2563.d: from חָמַר; properly, a bubbling up, i.e. of water, a wave; of earth, mire or clay (cement); also a heap; hence, a chomer or dry measure; clay, heap, homer, mire, motion.

H2564.d: from חָמַר; bitumen (as rising to the surface); slime(-pit).

H2565.d: from חָמַר (compare חֹמֶר); a heap; heap.

H2566.d: from חָמַר; red; Chamran, an Idumaean; Amran.

H2567.d: a denominative from חָמֵשׁ; to tax a fifth; take up the fifth participle

H2568.d: masculine חֲמִשָּׁה; a primitive numeral; five; fif(-teen), fifth, five ([idiom] apiece).

H2569.d: from חָמַשׁ; a fifth tax; fifth participle

H2570.d: from an unused root probably meaning, to be stout; the abdomen (as obese); fifth (rib).

H2571.d: passive participle of the same as חֹמֶשׁ; staunch, i.e. able-bodied soldiers; armed (men), harnessed.

H2573.d: from the same as חוֹמָה; a skin bottle (as tied up); bottle.

H2574.d: from the same as חוֹמָה; walled; Chamath, a place in Syria; Hamath, Hemath.

H2575.d: a variation for the first part of חַמֹּת דֹּאר; hot springs; Chammath, a place in Palestine; Hammath.

H2576.d: from the plural of חַמָּה and דּוֹר; hot springs of Dor; Chammath-Dor, a place in Palestine; Hamath-Dor.

H2577.d: patrial from חֲמָת; a Chamathite or native of Chamath; Hamathite.

H2578.d: from חֲמָת and צוֹבָא; Chamath of Tsobah; probably the same as חֲמָת; Chamath-Tsobah; Hamath-Zobah.

H2579.d: from חֲמָת and רַבָּה; Chamath of Rabbah; probably the same as חֲמָת.; Chamath-Rabbah;

H2580.d: from חָנַן; graciousness, i.e. subjective (kindness, favor) or objective (beauty); favour, grace(-ious), pleasant, precious, (well-) favoured.

H2581.d: the same as חֵן; grace; Chen, a figurative name for an Israelite; Hen.

H2582.d: probably from חֵן and הֲדַד; favor of Hadad; Chenadad, an Israelite; Henadad.

H2583.d: a primitive root (compare חָנַן); properly, to incline; by implication, to decline (of the slanting rays of evening); specifically, to pitch atent; gen. to encamp (for abode or siege); abide (in tents), camp, dwell, encamp, grow to an end, lie, pitch (tent), rest in tent.

H2584.d: from חָנַן; favored; Channah, an Israelitess; Hannah.

H2585.d: from חָנַךְ; initiated; Chanok, an antediluvian patriach; Enoch.

H2586.d: from חָנַן; favored; Chanun, the name of an Ammonite and of two Israelites; Hanun.

H2588.d: from חָנָה; properly, a vault or cell (with an arch); by implication, a prison; cabin.

H2589.d: from חָנַן (in the sense of prayer); supplication; be gracious, intreated.

H2590.d: a primitive root; to spice; by implication, to embalm; also to ripen; embalm, put forth.

H2592.d: from חָנַן and אֵל; favor of God; Channiel, the name of two Israelites; Hanniel.

H2593.d: from חָנַךְ; initiated; i.e. practiced; trained.

H2595.d: lemma חֲניִת second vowel, corrected to חֲנִית; from חָנָה; a lance (for thrusting, like pitching a tent); javelin, spear.

H2596.d: a primitive root; (compare חָנַק); properly, to narrow; figuratively, to initiate or discipline; dedicate, train up.

H2598.d: from חָנַךְ; initiation, i.e. consecration; dedicating(-tion).

H2599.d: patronymically from חֲנוֹךְ; a Chanokite (collectively) or descendants of Chanok; Hanochites.

H2600.d: from חֵן; gratis, i.e. devoid of cost, reason or advantage; without a cause (cost, wages), causeless, to cost nothing, free(-ly), innocent, for nothing (nought, in vain.

H2601.d: probably by orthographical variation for חֲנַנְאֵל; Chanamel, an Israelite; Hanameel.

H2602.d: of uncertain derivation; perhaps the aphis or plantlouse; frost.

H2603.d: a primitive root (compare חָנָה); properly, to bend or stoop in kindness to an inferior; to favor, bestow; causatively to implore (i.e. move to favor by petition); beseech, [idiom] fair, (be, find, shew) favour(-able), be (deal, give, grant (gracious(-ly), intreat, (be) merciful, have (shew) mercy (on, upon), have pity upon, pray, make supplication, [idiom] very.

H2604.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to חָנַן; to favor or (causatively) to entreat; shew mercy, make supplication.

H2605.d: from חָנַן; favor; Chanan, the name of seven Israelites; Canan.

H2606.d: from חָנַן and אֵל; God has favored; Chananel, probably an Israelite, from whom a tower of Jerusalem was named; Hananeel.

H2607.d: from חָנַן; gracious; Chanani, the name of six Israelites; Hanani.

H2608.d: or חֲנַנְיָהוּ; from חָנַן and יָהּ; Jah has favored; Chananjah, the name of thirteen Israelites; Hananiah.

H2609.d: of Egyptian derivation; Chanes, a place in Egypt; Hanes.

H2610.d: a primitive root; to soil, especially in a moral sense; corrupt, defile, [idiom] greatly, pollute, profane.

H2611.d: from חָנֵף; soiled (i.e. with sin), impious; hypocrite(-ical).

H2612.d: from חָנֵף; moral filth, i.e. wickedness; hypocrisy.

H2614.d: a primitive root (compare חָנַךְ); to be narrow; by implication, to throttle, or (reflex.) to choke oneself to death (by a rope); hang self, strangle.

H2615.d: probably from חָנַן; favored; Channathon, a place in Palestine; Hannathon.

H2616.d: a primitive root; (compare חָנַן); (compare בָרַךְ); properly, perhaps to bow (the neck only  in courtesy to an equal), i.e. to be kind; also (by euphemistically, but rarely) to reprove; shew self merciful, put to shame.

H2617.d: from חָסַד; kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty; favour, good deed(-liness, -ness), kindly, (loving-) kindness, merciful (kindness), mercy, pity, reproach, wicked thing.

H2618.d: the same as חֵסֵד; favor; Chesed, an Israelite; Hesed.

H2619.d: from חֵסֵד and יָהּ; Jah has favored; Chasadjah, an Israelite; Hasadiah.

H2620.d: a primitive root; (compare בָּטַח); to flee for protection; figuratively, to confide in; have hope, make refuge, (put) trust.

H2621.d: from חָסָה; hopeful; Chosah, an Israelite; also a place in Palestine; Hosah.

H2623.d: from חָסַד; properly, kind, i.e. (religiously) pious (a saint); godly (man), good, holy (one), merciful, saint, (un-) godly.

H2624.d: feminine of חָסִיד; the kind (maternal) bird, i.e. a stork; [idiom] feather, stork.

H2625.d: from חָסַל; the ravager, i.e. a locust; caterpillar.

H2626.d: from חָסַן; properly, firm, i.e. (by implication) mighty; strong.

H2627.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to חָסֵר; deficient; wanting.

H2628.d: a primitive root; to eat off; consume.

H2629.d: a primitive root; to muzzle; by analogy, to stop the nose; muzzle, stop.

H2630.d: a primitive root; properly, to (be) compact; by implication, to hoard; lay up.

H2631.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to חָסַן; to hold in occupancy; possess.

H2633.d: from חָסַן; wealth; riches, strength, treasure.

H2635.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to that of חַסְפַּס; a clod; clay.

H2636.d: reduplicated from an unused root meaning apparently to peel; a shred or scale; round thing.

H2637.d: a primitive root; to lack; by implication, to fail, want, lessen; be abated, bereave, decrease, (cause to) fail, (have) lack, make lower, want.

H2638.d: from חָסֵר; lacking; hence, without; destitute, fail, lack, have need, void, want.

H2639.d: from חָסֵר; lack; hence, destitution; poverty, want.

H2640.d: from חָסֵר; poverty; in want of.

H2641.d: from חָסֵר; want; Chasrah, an Israelite; Hasrah.

H2643.d: from חׇפַף (in the moral sense of covered from soil); pure; innocent.

H2644.d: an orthographical variation of חָפָה; properly, to cover, i.e. (in a sinister sense) to act covertly; do secretly.

H2645.d: a primitive root (compare חָפָא, חׇפַף); to cover; by implication, to veil, to encase, protect; ceil, cover, overlay.

H2646.d: from חָפָה; a canopy; chamber, closet, defence.

H2647.d: the same as חֻפָּה; Chuppah, an Israelite; Huppah.

H2648.d: a primitive root; properly, to start up suddenly, i.e. (by implication) to hasten away, to fear; (make) haste (away), tremble.

H2650.d: plural of חֻפָּה (compare חוּפָם); Chuppim, an Israelite; Huppim.

H2651.d: from an unused root of uncertain signification; a fist (only in the dual); fists, (both) hands, hand(-ful).

H2652.d: from חֹפֶן; perhaps pugilist; Chophni, an Israelite; Hophni.

H2653.d: a primitive root (compare חָפָה, יָחֵף); to cover (in protection); cover.

H2654.d: a primitive root; properly, to incline to; by implication (literally but rarely) to bend; figuratively, to be pleased with, desire; [idiom] any at all, (have, take) delight, desire, favour, like, move, be (well) pleased, have pleasure, will, would.

H2655.d: from חָפֵץ; pleased with; delight in, desire, favour, please, have pleasure, whosoever would, willing, wish.

H2656.d: from חָפֵץ; pleasure; hence (abstractly) desire; concretely, a valuable thing; hence (by extension) a matter (as something in mind); acceptable, delight(-some), desire, things desired, matter, pleasant(-ure), purpose, willingly.

H2657.d: from חֵפֶץ with suffixes; my delight (is) in her; Cheptsi-bah, a fanciful name for Palestine; Hephzi-bah.

H2658.d: a primitive root; properly, to pry into; by implication, to delve, to explore; dig, paw, search out, seek.

H2659.d: a primitive root (perhaps rather the same as חָפַר through the idea of detection); to blush; figuratively, to be ashamed, disappointed; causatively, to shame, reproach; be ashamed, be confounded, be brought to confusion (unto shame), come (be put to) shame, bring reproach.

H2660.d: from חָפַר or חָפֵר; a pit of shame; Chepher, a place in Palestine; also the name of three Israelites; Hepher.

H2661.d: from חָפַר; a hole; only in connection with פֵּרָה, which ought rather to be joined as one word, thus חַפַרְפֵּרָה; by reduplication from חָפַר; a burrower, i.e. probably a rat; [phrase] mole.

H2662.d: patronymically from חֵפֶר; a Chephrite (collectively) or descendants of Chepher; Hepherites.

H2663.d: dual of חֵפֶר; double pit; Chapharajim, a place in Palestine; Haphraim.

H2664.d: a primitive root; to seek; causatively, to conceal oneself (i.e. let be sought), or mask; change, (make) diligent (search), disquise self, hide, search (for, out).

H2665.d: from חָפַשׂ; something covert, i.e. a trick; search.

H2666.d: a primitive root; to spread loose; figuratively, to manumit; be free.

H2667.d: from חָפַשׁ; something spread loosely, i.e. a carpet; precious.

H2669.d: and חׇפְשִׁית; from חָפַשׁ; (with בַּיִת, a hospital); prostration by sickness; several.

H2670.d: from חָפַשׁ; exempt (from bondage, tax or care); free, liberty.

H2671.d: from חָצַץ; also by interchange for עֵץ; properly, a piercer, i.e. an arrow; by implication, a wound; figuratively, (of God) thunderbolt; the shaft of aspear; [phrase] archer, arrow, dart, shaft, staff, wound.

H2672.d: or חָצֵב; a primitive root; to cut or carve (wood, stone or other material); by implication, to hew, split, square, quarry, engrave; cut, dig, divide, grave, hew (out, -er), made, mason.

H2673.d: lemma חָעָה ayin, corrected to חָצָה; a primitive root (compare זֵד)); to cut or split in two; to halve; divide, [idiom] live out half, reach to the midst, participle

H2674.d: a collective form of חָצֵר; village; Chatsor, the name (thus simply) of two places in Palestine and of one in Arabia; Hazor.

H2675.d: from חָצוֹר and a Aramaizing form of the feminine of חָדָשׁ (compare חֲדָת); new Chatsor, a place in Palestine; Hazor, Hadattah (as if two places).

H2676.d: lemma חָעוֹת ayin, corrected to חָצוֹת; from חָצָהlemma חָעָה ayin, corrected to חָצָה; the middle (of the night); mid(-night).

H2677.d: from חָצָהlemma חָעָה ayin, corrected to חָצָה; the half or middle; half, middle, mid(-night), midst, part, two parts.

H2678.d: or חֵצִי; prolongation from חֵץ; an arrow; arrow.

H2679.d: from חֵצִי and the plural of מְנוּחָה, with the article interposed; midst of the resting-places; Chatsi-ham-Menuchoth, an Israelite; half of the Manahethites.

H2680.d: patronymically from חֲצִי הַמְּנֻחוֹת; a Chatsi-ham-Menachtite or descendant of Chatsi-ham-Menuchoth; half of the Manahethites.

H2681.d: a collateral form of חָצֵר; a court or abode; court.

H2682.d: perhaps originally the same as חָצִיר, from the greenness of a courtyard; grass; also a leek (collectively); grass, hay, herb, leek.

H2683.d: from an unused root meaning to hold firmly; the bosom (as comprised between the arms); bosom.

H2684.d: a collateral form of חֵצֶן, and meaning the same; {the bosom (as comprised between the arms)}; arm, lap.

H2685.d: (Aramaic) a primitive root; properly, to shear or cut close; figuratively, to be severe; hasty, be urgent.

H2686.d: a primitive root (compare חָצָהlemma חָעָה ayin, corrected to חָצָה); also as denominative from חֵץ; properly, to chop into, pierce or sever; hence, to curtail, to distribute (into ranks);  to shoot an arrow; archer, [idiom] bands, cut off in the midst.

H2687.d: from חָצָץ;  also like חֵץ; properly, something cutting; hence, gravel (as grit); an arrow; arrow, gravel (stone).

H2688.d: or חַצֲצֹן תָּמָר; from חָצַץ and תָּמָר; division (i.e. perhaps row) of (the) palm-tree; Chatsetson-tamar, a place in Palestine; Hazezon-tamar.

H2689.d: by reduplication from חָצַר; a trumpet (from its sundered or quavering note); trumpet(-er).

H2690.d: a primitive root; properly, to surround with a stockade, and thus separate from the open country; but used only in the reduplicated form חֲצֹצֵר; or (2 Chronicles 5:12) חֲצֹרֵר; as dem. from חֲצֹצְרָה; to trumpet, i.e. blow on that instrument; blow, sound, trumpeter.

H2691.d: (masculine and feminine); from חָצַר in its original sense; a yard (as inclosed by a fence); also a hamlet (as similarly surrounded with walls); court, tower, village.

H2692.d: xlit Addâr corrected to ʼAddâr; from חָצֵר and אַדָּר; (the) village of Addar; Chatsar-Addar, a place in Palestine; Hazar-addar.

H2693.d: from חָצֵר and a feminine of גַּד; (the) village of (female) Fortune; Chatsar-Gaddah, a place in Palestine; Hazar-gaddah.

H2694.d: from חָצֵר and תִּיכוֹן with the article interposed; village of the middle; Chatsar-hat-Tikon, a place in Palestine; Hazar-hatticon.

H2695.d: by an orthographical variation for חֶצְרוֹן; enclosure; Chetsro, an Israelite; Hezro, Hezrai.

H2696.d: from חָצֵר; court-yard; Chetsron, the name of a place in Palestine; also of two Israelites; Hezron.

H2697.d: patronymically from חֶצְרוֹן; a Chetsronite or (collectively) descendants of Chetsron; Hezronites.

H2698.d: feminine plural of חָצֵר; yards; Chatseroth, a place in Palestine; Hazeroth.

H2699.d: plural masculine of חָצֵר; yards; Chatserim, a place in Palestine; Hazerim.

H2700.d: from חָצֵר and מָוֶת; village of death; Chatsarmaveth, a place in Arabia; Hazarmaveth.

H2701.d: from חָצֵר and סוּסָה; village of cavalry; Chatsar-Susah, a place in Palestine; Hazar-susah.

H2702.d: from חָצֵר and the plural of סוּס; village of horses; Chatsar-Susim, a place in Palestine; Hazar-susim.

H2703.d: from חָצֵר and a derivative of עַיִן; village of springs; Chatsar-Enon, a place in Palestine; Hazar-enon.

H2704.d: from חָצֵר and the same as עֵינָן; village of springs; Chatsar-Enan, a place in Palestine; Hazar-enan.

H2705.d: from חָצֵר and שׁוּעָל; village of (the) fox; Chatsar-Shual, a place in Palestine; Hazar-shual.

H2706.d: from חָקַק; an enactment; hence, an appointment (of time, space, quantity, labor or usage); appointed, bound, commandment, convenient, custom, decree(-d), due, law, measure, [idiom] necessary, ordinance(-nary), portion, set time, statute, task.

H2707.d: a primitive root; to carve; by implication, to delineate; also to entrench; carved work, portrayed, set a print.

H2708.d: feminine of חֹק, and meaning substantially the same; {an enactment; hence, an appointment (of time, space, quantity, labor or usage)}; appointed, custom, manner, ordinance, site, statute.

H2709.d: from an unused root probably meaning to bend; crooked; Chakupha, one of the Nethinim; Hakupha.

H2710.d: a primitive root; properly, to hack, i.e. engrave (Judges 5:14, to be a scribe simply); by implication, to enact (laws being cut in stone or metal tablets in primitive times) or (gen.) prescribe; appoint, decree, governor, grave, lawgiver, note, pourtray, print, set.

H2711.d: from חָקַק; an enactment, a resolution; decree, thought.

H2712.d: or (fully) חוּקֹק; from חָקַק; appointed; Chukkok or Chukok, a place in Palestine; Hukkok, Hukok.

H2713.d: a primitive root; properly, to penetrate; hence, to examine intimately; find out, (make) search (out), seek (out), sound, try.

H2714.d: from חָקַר; examination, enumeration, deliberation; finding out, number, (un-) search(-able, -ed, out, -ing).

H2715.d: or (fully) חוֹר; from חָרַר; (compare חֹרִי); properly, white or pure (from the cleansing or shining power of fire; hence (figuratively) noble (in rank); noble.

H2716.d: from an unused (and vulgar) root probably meaning to evacuate the bowels; excrement; dung. Also חֲרִי.

H2717.d: or חֲרֵב; a primitive root; to parch (through drought) i.e. (by analogy,) to desolate, destroy, kill; decay, (be) desolate, destroy(-er), (be) dry (up), slay, [idiom] surely, (lay, lie, make) waste.

H2718.d: (Aramaic) a root corresponding to חָרַב; to demolish; destroy.

H2719.d: from חָרַב; drought; also a cutting instrument (from its destructive effect), as a knife, sword, or other sharp implement; axe, dagger, knife, mattock, sword, tool.

H2720.d: from חָרַב; parched or ruined; desolate, dry, waste.

H2721.d: a collaterally form of חֶרֶב; drought or desolation; desolation, drought, dry, heat, [idiom] utterly, waste.

H2722.d: from חָרַב; desolate; Choreb, a (generic) name for the Sinaitic mountains; Horeb.

H2723.d: feminine of חֹרֶב; properly, drought, i.e. (by implication) a desolation; decayed place, desolate (place, -tion), destruction, (laid) waste (place).

H2724.d: feminine of חָרֵב; a desert; dry (ground, land).

H2726.d: or חַרְבוֹנָה; of Persian origin; Charbona or Charbonah, a eunuch of Xerxes; Harbona, Harbonah.

H2727.d: a primitive root; properly, to leap suddenly, i.e. (by implication) to be dismayed; be afraid.

H2728.d: from חָרַג; the leaping insect, i.e. a locust; beetle.

H2729.d: a primitive root; to shudder with terror; hence, to fear; also to hasten (with anxiety); be (make) afraid, be careful, discomfit, fray (away), quake, tremble.

H2730.d: from חָרַד; fearful; also reverential; afraid, trembling.

H2731.d: feminine of חָרֵד; fear, anxiety; care, [idiom] exceedingly, fear, quaking, trembling.

H2732.d: the same as חֲרָדָה; Charadah, a place in the Desert; Haradah.

H2733.d: patrial from a derivative of חָרַד (compare עֵין חֲרֹד); a Charodite, or inhabitant of Charod; Harodite.

H2734.d: a primitive root (compare חָרַר); to glow or grow warm; figuratively (usually) to blaze up, of anger, zeal, jealousy; be angry, burn, be displeased, [idiom] earnestly, fret self, grieve, be (wax) hot, be incensed, kindle, [idiom] very, be wroth. See תַּחָרָה.

H2735.d: from חוֹר and a collateral (masculine) form of גֻּדְגֹּדָה, with the article interposed; hole of the cleft; Chor-hag-Gidgad, a place in the Desert; Hor-hagidgad.

H2736.d: ; from חָרָה and יָהּ; fearing Jah; Charhajah, an Israelite; Harhaiah.

H2737.d: from an unused root meaning to perforate; properly, pierced, i.e. a bead of pearl, gems or jewels (as strung); chain.

H2738.d: or (shortened) חָרֻל; apparently, a passive participle of an unused root probably meaning to be prickly; properly, pointed, i.e. a bramble or other thorny weed; nettle.

H2739.d: from passive participle of חָרַם and אַף; snub-nosed; Charumaph, an Israelite; Harumaph.

H2740.d: or (shortened) חָרֹן; from חָרָה; a burning of anger; sore displeasure, fierce(-ness), fury, (fierce) wrath(-ful).

H2741.d: a patrial from (probably) a collateral form of חָרִיף; a Charuphite or inhabitant of Charuph (or Chariph); Haruphite.

H2742.d: or חָרֻץ; passive participle of חָרַץ; properly, incised or (active) incisive; hence (as noun masculine or feminine) a trench (as dug), gold (as mined), a threshing-sledge (having sharp teeth); (figuratively) determination; also eager; decision, diligent, (fine) gold, pointed things, sharp, threshing instrument, wall.

H2743.d: the same as חֲרוּץ; earnest; Charuts, an Israelite; Haruz.

H2744.d: a fuller form of חַרְחֻר; inflammation; Charchur, one of the Nethinim; Harhur.

H2745.d: from the same as חֶרֶס; perhaps shining; Charchas, an Israelite; Harhas.

H2746.d: from חָרַר; fever (as hot); extreme burning.

H2747.d: from a primitive root meaning to engrave; a chisel or graver; also a style forwriting; graving tool, pen.

H2748.d: from the same as חֶרֶט; a horoscopist (as drawing magical lines or circles); magician.

H2749.d: (Aramaic) the same as חַרְטֹם; {a horoscopist (as drawing magical lines or circles)}; magician.

H2750.d: from חָרָה; a burning (i.e. intense) anger; fierce, [idiom] great, heat.

H2751.d: from the same as חוּר; white bread; white.

H2752.d: from חוֹר; cave-dweller or troglodyte; a Chorite or aboriginal Idumaean; Horims, Horites.

H2753.d: or חוֹרִי; the same as חֹרִי; Chori, the name of two men; Hori.

H2754.d: or חָרִט; from the same as חֶרֶט; properly, cut out (or hollow), i.e. (by implication) a pocket; bag, crisping pin.

H2755.d: from the plural of חֶרֶא and the plural of יוֹנָה; or perhaps rather the plural of a single word חֲרָאיוֹן, probably a kind of vegetable; excrements of doves {or a vegetable}; doves' dung.

H2756.d: from חָרַף; autumnal; Chariph, the name of two Israelites; Hariph.

H2757.d: or חֲרִץ; from חָרַץ; (compare חֲרוּץ); properly, incisure or (passively) incised; hence, a threshing-sledge (with sharp teeth); also a slice (as cut); [phrase] cheese, harrow.

H2758.d: from חָרַשׁ; ploughing or its season; earing (time), ground.

H2759.d: from חָרַשׁ in the sense of silence; quiet, i.e. sultry (as feminine noun, the sirocco or hot east wind); vehement.

H2760.d: a primitive root; to braid (i.e. to entangle or snare) or catch (game) in anet; roast.

H2761.d: (Aramaic) a root probably allied to the equivalent of חָרַר; to scorch; singe.

H2762.d: from חָרַךְ; properly, a net, i.e. (by analogy) lattice; lattice.

H2763.d: a primitive root; to seclude; specifically (by a ban) to devote to religious uses (especially destruction); physical and reflexive, to be blunt as to the nose; make accursed, consecrate, (utterly) destroy, devote, forfeit, have a flat nose, utterly (slay, make away).

H2764.d: or (Zechariah 14:11) חֶרֶם; from חָרַם; physical (as shutting in) a net (either literally or figuratively); usually a doomed object; abstractly extermination; (ac-) curse(-d, -d thing), dedicated thing, things which should have been utterly destroyed, (appointed to) utter destruction, devoted (thing), net.

H2765.d: from חָרַם; devoted; Chorem, a place in Palestine; Horem.

H2766.d: from חָרַם; snub-nosed; Charim, an Israelite; Harim.

H2767.d: from חָרַם; devoted; Chormah, a place in Palestine; Hormah.

H2768.d: from חָרַם; abrupt; Chermon, a mount of Palestine; Hermon.

H2769.d: plural of חֶרְמוֹן; Hermons, i.e. its peaks; the Hermonites.

H2770.d: from חָרַם; a sickle (as cutting); sickle.

H2771.d: from חָרַר; parched; Charan, the name of a man and also of a place; Haran.

H2772.d: patrial from חֹרֹנַיִם; a Choronite or inhabitant of Choronaim; Horonite.

H2773.d: dual of a derivative from חוֹר; double cave-town; Choronajim, a place in Moab; Horonaim.

H2774.d: of uncertain derivation; Charnepher, an Israelite; Harnepher.

H2775.d: or (with a directive enclitic) חַרְסָה; from an unused root meaning to scrape; also perhaps from the mediating idea of חַרְסוּת; the itch; the sun; itch, sun.

H2776.d: the same as חֶרֶס; shining; Cheres, a mountain in Palestine; Heres.

H2777.d: from חֶרֶס (apparently in the sense of a red tile used for scraping); a potsherd, i.e. (by implication) a pottery; the name of a gate at Jerusalem; east.

H2778.d: a primitive root; also  denominative (from חֹרֶף); to pull off, i.e. (by implication) to expose (as by stripping); specifically, to betroth (as if a surrender); figuratively, to carp at, i.e. defame; to spend the winter; betroth, blaspheme, defy, jeopard, rail, reproach, upbraid.

H2779.d: from חָרַף; properly, the crop gathered, i.e. (by implication) the autumn (and winter) season; figuratively, ripeness of age; cold, winter (-house), youth.

H2780.d: from חָרַף; reproachful; Chareph, an Israelite; Hareph.

H2781.d: from חָרַף; contumely, disgrace, the pudenda; rebuke, reproach(-fully), shame.

H2782.d: a primitive root; properly, to point sharply, i.e. (literally) to wound; figuratively, to be alert, to decide; bestir self, decide, decree, determine, maim, move.

H2783.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to חָרַץ in the sense of vigor; the loin (as the seat of strength); loin.

H2784.d: of uncertain derivation; a fetter; figuratively, a pain; band.

H2785.d: from חָרַץ; a sour grape (as sharp in taste); kernel.

H2786.d: a primitive root; to grate the teeth; gnash.

H2787.d: a primitive root; to glow, i.e. literally (to melt, burn, dry up) or figuratively (to show or incite passion); be angry, burn, dry, kindle.

H2789.d: a collateral form mediating between חֶרֶס and חֶרֶשׁ; a piece of pottery; earth(-en), (pot-) sherd, [phrase] stone.

H2790.d: a primitive root; to scratch, i.e. (by implication) to engrave, plough; hence (from the use of tools) to fabricate (of any material); figuratively, to devise (in a bad sense); hence (from the idea of secrecy) to be silent, to let alone; hence (by implication) to be deaf (as an accompaniment of dumbness); [idiom] altogether, cease, conceal, be deaf, devise, ear, graven, imagine, leave off speaking, hold peace, plow(-er, man), be quiet, rest, practise secretly, keep silence, be silent, speak not a word, be still, hold tongue, worker.

H2791.d: from חָרַשׁ; magical craft; also silence; cunning, secretly.

H2792.d: the same as חֶרֶשׁ; Cheresh, a Levite; Heresh.

H2793.d: from חָרַשׁ; a forest (perhaps as furnishing the material for fabric); bough, forest, shroud, wood.

H2794.d: active participle of חָרַשׁ; a fabricator or mechanic; artificer.

H2795.d: from חָרַשׁ; deaf (whether literally or spiritual); deaf.

H2796.d: from חָרַשׁ; a fabricator or any material; artificer, ([phrase]) carpenter, craftsman, engraver, maker, [phrase] mason, skilful, ([phrase]) smith, worker, workman, such as wrought.

H2797.d: from חֶרֶשׁ; magician; Charsha, one of the Nethinim; Harsha.

H2798.d: plural of חָרָשׁ; mechanics, the name of a valley in Jerusalem; Charashim, craftsmen.

H2799.d: from חָרַשׁ; mechanical work; carving, cutting.

H2800.d: the same as חֲרֹשֶׁת; Charosheth, a place in Palestine; Harosheth.

H2801.d: a primitive root; to engrave; graven.

H2802.d: from חָרַת (but equivalent to חֹרֶשׁ); forest; Chereth, a thicket in Palestine; Hereth.

H2803.d: a primitive root; properly, to plait or interpenetrate, i.e. (literally) to weave or (generally) to fabricate; figuratively, to plot or contrive (usually in a malicious sense); hence (from the mental effort) to think, regard, value, compute; (make) account (of), conceive, consider, count, cunning (man, work, workman), devise, esteem, find out, forecast, hold, imagine, impute, invent, be like, mean, purpose, reckon(-ing be made), regard, think.

H2804.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to חָשַׁב; to regard; repute.

H2805.d: from חָשַׁב; a belt or strap (as being interlaced); curious girdle.

H2806.d: from חָשַׁב and דִּין; considerate judge; Chasbaddanah, an Israelite; Hasbadana.

H2807.d: from חָשַׁב; estimation; Cashubah, an Israelite; Hashubah.

H2808.d: from חָשַׁב; properly, contrivance; by implication, intelligence; account, device, reason.

H2809.d: the same as חֶשְׁבּוֹן; Cheshbon, a place East of the Jordan; Heshbon.

H2810.d: from חָשַׁב; a contrivance, i.e. actual (a warlike machine) or mental (a machination); engine, invention.

H2811.d: or חֲשַׁבְיָהוּ; from חָשַׁב and יָהּ; Jah has regarded; Chashabjah, the name of nine Israelites; Hashabiah.

H2812.d: feminine of חֶשְׁבּוֹן; inventiveness; Chashnah, an Israelite; Hashabnah.

H2813.d: from חֶשְׁבּוֹן and יָהּ; thought of Jah; Chashabnejah, the name of two Israelites; Hashabniah.

H2814.d: a primitive root; to hush or keep quiet; hold peace, keep silence, be silent, (be) still.

H2815.d: lemma חַשְּׁוּב extra sheva, corrected to חַשּׁוּב; from חָשַׁב; intelligent; Chashshub, the name of two or three Israelites; Hashub, Hasshub.

H2816.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to חָשַׁךְ; the dark; darkness.

H2817.d: or חֲשֻׂפָא; from חָשַׂף; nakedness; Chasupha, one of the Nethinim; Hashupha, Hasupha.

H2818.d: (Aramaic) a collateral root to one corresponding to חוּשׁ in the sense of readiness; to be necessary (from the idea of convenience) or (transitively) to need; careful, have need of.

H2819.d: from a root corresponding to חֲשַׁח; necessity; be needful.
