H3662.d: from כָּנַן; planted; Kenani, an Israelite; Chenani.

H3663.d: or כְּנַנְיָהוּ; from כָּנַן and יָהּ; Jah has planted; Kenanjah, an Israelite; Chenaniah.

H3664.d: a primitive root; to collect; hence, to enfold; gather (together), heap up, wrap self.

H3665.d: a primitive root; properly, to bend the knee; hence, to humiliate, vanquish; bring down (low), into subjection, under, humble (self), subdue.

H3666.d: from כָּנַע in the sense of folding (compare כָּנַס); a package; wares.

H3667.d: from כָּנַע; humiliated; Kenaan, a son a Ham; also the country inhabited by him; Canaan, merchant, traffick.

H3668.d: feminine of כְּנַעַן; Kenaanah, the name of two Israelites; Chenaanah.

H3669.d: patrial from כְּנַעַן; a Kenaanite or inhabitant of Kenaan; by implication, a pedlar (the Canaanites standing for their neighbors the Ishmaelites, who conducted mercantile caravans); Canaanite, merchant, trafficker.

H3670.d: a primitive root; properly, to project laterally, i.e. probably (reflexive) to withdraw; be removed.

H3671.d: from כָּנַף; an edge or extremity; specifically (of a bird or army) a wing, (of a garment or bedclothing) a flap, (of the earth) a quarter, (of a building) a pinnacle; [phrase] bird, border, corner, end, feather(-ed), [idiom] flying, [phrase] (one an-) other, overspreading, [idiom] quarters, skirt, [idiom] sort, uttermost part, wing(-ed).

H3672.d: or כִּנֶּרֶתlemma כִּנֶרֶת missing dagesh, corrected to כִּנֶּרֶת; respectively plural and singular feminine from the same as כִּנּוֹר; perhaps harp-shaped; Kinneroth or Kinnereth, a place in Palestine; Chinnereth, Chinneroth, Cinneroth.

H3673.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to כָּנַס; to assemble; gather together.

H3674.d: from כָּנָה; a colleague (as having the same title); companion.

H3675.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to כְּנָת; {a colleague (as having the same title)}; companion.

H3676.d: apparently a contraction for כִּסֵּא, but probably by erroneous transcription for נֵס; {a flag; also a sail; by implication, a flagstaff; generally a signal; figuratively, a token}; sworn.

H3677.d: or כֶּסֶה; apparently from כָּסָה; properly, fulness or the full moon, i.e. its festival; (time) appointed.

H3678.d: or כִּסֵּה; from כָּסָה; properly, covered, i.e. a throne (as canopied); seat, stool, throne.

H3679.d: for כַּשְׂדִּי; {a Kasdite, or descendant of Kesed; by implication, a Chaldaean (as if so descended); also an astrologer (as if proverbial of that people}; Chaldean.

H3680.d: a primitive root; properly, to plump, i.e. fill up hollows; by implication, to cover (for clothing or secrecy); clad self, close, clothe, conceal, cover (self), (flee to) hide, overwhelm. Compare כָּשָׂה.

H3681.d: passive participle of כָּסָה; properly, covered, i.e. (as noun) a covering; covering.

H3682.d: from כָּסָה; a cover (garment); figuratively, a veiling; covering, raiment, vesture.

H3683.d: a primitive root; to cut off; cut down (up).

H3684.d: from כָּסַל; properly, fat, i.e. (figuratively) stupid or silly; fool(-ish).

H3685.d: the same as כְּסִיל; any notable constellation; specifically Orion (as if a burly one); constellation, Orion.

H3686.d: the same as כְּסִיל; Kesil, a place in Palestine; Chesil.

H3688.d: a primitive root; properly, to be fat, i.e. (figuratively) silly; be foolish.

H3689.d: from כָּסַל; properly, fatness, i.e. by implication (literally) the loin (as the seat of the leaf fat) or (generally) the viscera; also (figuratively) silliness or (in a good sense) trust; confidence, flank, folly, hope, loin.

H3690.d: lemma כְּסִלָה first two vowels, corrected to כִּסְלָה; feminine of כֶּסֶל; in a good sense, trust; in a bad one, silliness; confidence, folly.

H3691.d: probably of foreign origin; Kisleu, the 9th Hebrew month; Chisleu.

H3692.d: from כָּסַל; hopeful; Kislon, an Israelite; Chislon.

H3693.d: from כָּסַל; fertile; Kesalon, a place in Palestine; Chesalon.

H3694.d: feminine plural of passive participle of כָּסַל; fattened; Kesulloth, a place in Palestine; Chesulloth.

H3695.d: a plural probably of foreign derivation; Casluchim, a people cognate to the Egyptians; Casluhim.

H3696.d: from the feminine plural of כֶּסֶל and תָּבוֹר; flanks of Tabor; Kisloth-Tabor, a place in Palestine; Chisloth-tabor.

H3697.d: a primitive root; to shear; [idiom] only, poll. Compare כִּרְסֵם.

H3698.d: from כָּסַם; spelt (from its bristliness as if just shorn); fitches, rie.

H3699.d: a primitive root; to estimate; make count.

H3700.d: a primitive root; properly, to become pale, i.e. (by implication) to pine after; also to fear; (have) desire, be greedy, long, sore.

H3701.d: from כָּסַף; silver (from its pale color); by implication, money; money, price, silver(-ling).

H3702.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to כֶּסֶף; {silver (from its pale color); by implication, money}; money, silver.

H3703.d: perhaps from כֶּסֶף; silvery; Casiphja, a place in Babylon; Casiphia.

H3704.d: from כָּסָה; a cushion or pillow (as covering a seat or bed); pillow.

H3706.d: (Aramaic) or כְּעֶת; (Aramaic), feminine of כְּעַן; thus (only in the formula 'and so forth'); at such a time.

H3707.d: a primitive root; to trouble; by implication, to grieve, rage, be indignant; be angry, be grieved, take indignation, provoke (to anger, unto wrath), have sorrow, vex, be wroth.

H3708.d: or (in Job) כַּעַשׂ; from כַּעַס; vexation; anger, angry, grief, indignation, provocation, provoking, [idiom] sore, sorrow, spite, wrath.

H3709.d: from כָּפַף; the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal, of the sole, and even of the bowl of a dish or sling, the handle of a bolt, the leaves of a palm-tree); figuratively, power; branch, [phrase] foot, hand((-ful), -dle, (-led)), hollow, middle, palm, paw, power, sole, spoon.

H3710.d: from כָּפַף; a hollow rock; rock.

H3711.d: a primitive root; properly, to bend, i.e. (figuratively) to tame or subdue; pacify.

H3712.d: feminine of כַּף; a leaf of a palmtree; branch.

H3713.d: from כָּפַר; properly, a cover, i.e. (by implication) a tankard (or covered goblet); also white frost (as covering the ground); bason, hoar(-y) frost.

H3714.d: from an unused root meaning to connect; a girder; beam.

H3715.d: from כָּפַר; a village (as covered in by walls); also a young lion (perhaps as covered with a mane); (young) lion, village. Compare כָּפָר.

H3716.d: feminine of כְּפִיר; the village (always with the art.); Kephirah, a place in Palestine; Chephirah.

H3717.d: a primitive root; to fold together; figuratively, to repeat; double.

H3719.d: a primitive root; to bend; bend.

H3720.d: from כָּפַן; hunger (as making to stoop with emptiness and pain); famine.

H3721.d: a primitive root; to curve; bow down (self).

H3722.d: a primitive root; to cover (specifically with bitumen); figuratively, to expiate or condone, to placate or cancel; appease, make (an atonement, cleanse, disannul, forgive, be merciful, pacify, pardon, purge (away), put off, (make) reconcile(-liation).

H3723.d: from כָּפַר; a village (as protected by walls); village. Compare כְּפִיר.

H3724.d: from כָּפַר; properly, a cover, i.e. (literally) a village (as covered in); (specifically) bitumen (as used for coating), and the henna plant (as used for dyeing); figuratively, a redemption-price; bribe, camphire, pitch, ransom, satisfaction, sum of money, village.

H3725.d: from כָּפַר; expiation (only in plural); atonement.

H3726.d: from כָּפָר and עַמּוֹנִי, with the article interposed; village of the Ammonite; Kefar-ha-Ammoni, a place in Palestine; Chefarhaamonai.

H3727.d: from כָּפַר; a lid (used only of the cover of the sacred Ark); mercy seat.

H3728.d: a primitive root; to tread down; figuratively, to humiliate; cover.

H3729.d: (Aramaic) a root of uncertain correspondence; to fetter; bind.

H3730.d: or (Amos 9:1) כַּפְתּוֹר; probably from an unused root meaning to encircle; a chaplet; but used only in an architectonic sense, i.e. the capital of acolumn, or a wreath-like button or disk on the candelabrum; knop, (upper) lintel.

H3731.d: or (Amos 9:7) כַּפְתּוֹר; apparently the same as כַּפְתֹּר; Caphtor (i.e. a wreath-shaped island), the original seat of the Philistines; Caphtor.

H3732.d: patrial from כַּפְתֹּר; a Caphtorite (collectively) or native of Caphtor; Caphthorim, Caphtorim(-s).

H3733.d: from כָּרַר in the sense of plumpness; a ram (as full-grown and fat), including a battering-ram (as butting); hence, a meadow (as for sheep); also a pad or camel's saddle (as puffed out); captain, furniture, lamb, (large) pasture, ram. See also בֵּית כַּר, כָּרִי.

H3734.d: from the same as כּוּר; properly, a deep round vessel, i.e. (specifically) a cor or measure for things dry; cor, measure. Aramaic the same.

H3735.d: (Aramaic) probably corresponding to כָּרָה in the sense of piercing(figuratively); to grieve; be grieved.

H3736.d: from the same as כֶּבֶל; to gird or clothe; clothed.

H3737.d: (Aramaic) from a verb corresponding to that of כַּרְבֵּל; a mantle; hat.

H3738.d: a primitive root; properly, to dig; figuratively, to plot; generally, to bore or open; dig, [idiom] make (a banquet), open.

H3739.d: usually assigned as a primitive root, but probably only a special application of כָּרָה (through the common idea of planning implied in a bargain); to purchase; buy, prepare.

H3741.d: feminine of כַּר; a meadow; cottage.

H3742.d: of uncertain derivation; a cherub or imaginary figure; cherub, (plural) cherubims.

H3743.d: the same as כְּרוּב; Kerub, a place in Babylon; Cherub.

H3745.d: (Aramaic) probably of Greek origin; to proclaim; make a proclamation.

H3746.d: perhaps an abridged plural of כַּר in the sense of leader (of the flock); a life-guardsman; captains, Cherethites (from the margin).

H3747.d: from כָּרַת; a cut; Kerith, a brook of Palestine; Cherith.

H3748.d: from כָּרַת; a cutting (of the matrimonial bond), i.e. divorce; divorce(-ment).

H3749.d: expanded from the same as כַּבּוֹן; a rim or top margin; compass.

H3750.d: probably of foreign origin; the crocus; saffron.

H3751.d: of foreign derivation; Karkemish, a place in Syria; Carchemish.

H3752.d: of Persian origin; Karkas, a eunuch of Xerxes; Carcas.

H3753.d: from כָּרַר; a dromedary (from its rapid motion as if dancing); swift beast.

H3754.d: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a garden or vineyard; vines, (increase of the) vineyard(-s), vintage. See also בֵּית הַכֶּרֶם.

H3755.d: active participle of an imaginary denominative from כֶּרֶם; a vinedresser; vine dresser (as one or two words).

H3756.d: from כֶּרֶם; gardener; Karmi, the name of three Israelites; Carmi.

H3757.d: patronymically from כַּרְמִי; a Karmite or descendant of Karmi; Carmites.

H3758.d: probably of foreign origin; carmine, a deep red; crimson.

H3759.d: from כֶּרֶם; a planted field (garden, orchard, vineyard or park); by implication, garden produce; full (green) ears (of corn), fruitful field (place), plentiful (field).

H3760.d: the same as כַּרְמֶל; Karmel, the name of a hill and of a town in Palestine; Carmel, fruitful (plentiful) field, (place).

H3761.d: patron from כַּרְמֶל; a Karmelite or inhabitant of Karmel (the town); Carmelite.

H3762.d: feminine of כַּרְמְלִי; a Karmelitess or female inhabitant of Karmel; Carmelitess.

H3763.d: of uncertain derivation; Keran, an aboriginal Idumaean; Cheran.

H3764.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to כִּסֵּא; a throne; throne.

H3765.d: from כָּסַם; to lay waste; waste.

H3766.d: a primitive root; to bend the knee; by implication, to sink, to prostrate; bow (down, self), bring down (low), cast down, couch, fall, feeble, kneeling, sink, smite (stoop) down, subdue, [idiom] very.

H3767.d: from כָּרַע; the leg (from the knee to the ankle) of men or locusts (only in the dual); leg.

H3768.d: of foreign origin; byssus or fine vegetable wool; green.

H3769.d: a primitive root; to dance (i.e. whirl); dance(-ing).

H3770.d: by variation from קָרַס; the paunch or belly (as swelling out); belly.

H3771.d: of foreign origin; Karshena, a courtier of Xerxes; Carshena.

H3772.d: a primitive root; to cut (off, down or asunder); by implication, to destroy or consume; specifically, to covenant (i.e. make an alliance or bargain, originally by cutting flesh and passing between the pieces); be chewed, be con-(feder-) ate, covenant, cut (down, off), destroy, fail, feller, be freed, hew (down), make a league (covenant), [idiom] lose, perish, [idiom] utterly, [idiom] want.

H3773.d: passive participle feminine of כָּרַת; something cut, i.e. a hewn timber; beam.

H3774.d: probably from כָּרַת in the sense of executioner; (compare טַבָּח) (only collectively in the singular as plural); a Kerethite or life-guardsman; Cherethims, Cherethites.

H3775.d: apparently by transposition for כֶּבֶשׂ; a young sheep; lamb.

H3776.d: feminine of כֶּשֶׂב; a young ewe; lamb.

H3777.d: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Kesed, a relative of Abraham; Chesed.

H3778.d: (occasionally with enclitic) כַּשְׂדִּימָה; towards the Kasdites into Chaldea), patronymically from כֶּשֶׂד (only in the plural); a Kasdite, or descendant of Kesed; by implication, a Chaldaean (as if so descended); also an astrologer (as if proverbial of that people; Chaldeans, Chaldees, inhabitants of Chaldea.

H3779.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to כַּשְׂדִּי; a Chaldaean or inhabitant of Chaldaea; by implication, a Magian or professional astrologer; Chaldean.

H3780.d: a primitive root; to grow fat (i.e. be covered with flesh); be covered. Compare כָּסָה.

H3781.d: from כָּשַׁל; properly, a feller, i.e. an axe; ax.

H3782.d: a primitive root; to totter or waver (through weakness of the legs, especially the ankle); by implication, to falter, stumble, faint or fall; bereave (from the margin), cast down, be decayed, (cause to) fail, (cause, make to) fall (down, -ing), feeble, be (the) ruin(-ed, of), (be) overthrown, (cause to) stumble, [idiom] utterly, be weak.

H3783.d: from כָּשַׁל; properly, a tottering, i.e. ruin; fall.

H3784.d: a primitive root; properly, to whisper aspell, i.e. to inchant or practise magic; sorcerer, (use) witch(-craft).

H3787.d: a primitive root properly, to be straight or right; by implication, to be acceptable; also to succeed or prosper; direct, be right, prosper.

H3788.d: from כָּשֵׁר; success, advantage; equity, good, right.

H3789.d: a primitive root; to grave, by implication, to write (describe, inscribe, prescribe, subscribe); describe, record, prescribe, subscribe, write(-ing, -ten).

H3790.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to כָּתַב; {to grave, by implication, to write (describe, inscribe, prescribe, subscribe)}; write(-ten).

H3791.d: from כָּתַב; something written, i.e. a writing, record or book; register, scripture, writing.

H3792.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to כָּתָב; {something written, i.e. a writing, record or book}; prescribing, writing(-ten).

H3793.d: from כָּתַב; a letter or other mark branded on the skin; [idiom] any (mark).

H3794.d: or כִּתִּיִּי; patrial from an unused name denoting Cyprus (only in the plural); a Kittite or Cypriote; hence, an islander in general, i.e. the Greeks or Romans on the shores opposite Palestine; Chittim, Kittim.

H3795.d: from כָּתַת; beaten, i.e. pure (oil); beaten.

H3796.d: from an unused root meaning to compact; a wall (as gathering inmates); wall.

H3797.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to כֹּתֶל; {a wall (as gathering inmates)}; wall.

H3798.d: lemma כְּתִלִישׁ first two vowels, corrected to כִּתְלִישׁ; from כֹּתֶל and אִישׁ; wall of a man; Kithlish, a place in Palestine; Kithlish.

H3799.d: a primitive root; properly, to carve or engrave, i.e. (by implication) to inscribe indelibly; mark.

H3800.d: from כָּתַם; properly, something carved out, i.e. ore; hence, gold (pure as originally mined); ((most) fine, pure) gold(-en wedge).

H3801.d: or כֻּתֹּנֶת; from an unused root meaning to cover (compare כָּתֵף); a shirt; coat, garment, robe.

H3802.d: from an unused root meaning to clothe; the shoulder (proper, i.e. upper end of the arm; as being the spot where the garments hang); figuratively, side-piece or lateral projection of anything; arm, corner, shoulder(-piece), side, undersetter.

H3803.d: a primitive root; to enclose; hence (in a friendly sense) to crown, (in a hostile one) to besiege; also to wait (as restraining oneself); beset round, compass about, be crowned inclose round, suffer.

H3804.d: from כָּתַר; properly, a circlet, i.e. a diadem; crown.

H3805.d: feminine active participle of כָּתַר; the capital of a column; chapiter.

H3806.d: a primitive root; to butt or pound; bray.

H3807.d: a primitive root; to bruise or violently strike; beat (down, to pieces), break in pieces, crushed, destroy, discomfit, smite, stamp. l

H3808.d: or לוֹא; or לֹה; (Deuteronomy 3:11), a primitive particle; not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles; [idiom] before, [phrase] or else, ere, [phrase] except, ig(-norant), much, less, nay, neither, never, no((-ne), -r, (-thing)), ([idiom] as though...,(can-), for) not (out of), of nought, otherwise, out of, [phrase] surely, [phrase] as truly as, [phrase] of a truth, [phrase] verily, for want, [phrase] whether, without.

H3809.d: (Aramaic) or לָה; (Aramaic) (Daniel 4:32), corresponding to לֹא; {not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no;}; or even, neither, no(-ne, -r), (can-) not, as nothing, without.

H3810.d: or לוֹ דבַר; (Samuel 9:4,5), or לִדְבִר; (Joshua 13:26), (probably rather לֹדְבַר ); from לֹא and דֹּבֶר; pastureless; Lo-Debar, a place in Palestine; Debir, Lodebar.

H3811.d: a primitive root; to tire; (figuratively) to be (or make) disgusted; faint, grieve, lothe, (be, make) weary (selves).

H3812.d: from לָאָה; weary; Leah, a wife of Jacob; Leah.

H3813.d: a primitive root; to muffle; cover.

H3814.d: from לָאַט (or perhaps for active participle of לוּט); properly, muffled, i.e. silently; softly.

H3815.d: from the prepositional prefix and אֵל; (belonging) to God; Lael an Israelite; Lael.

H3816.d: xlit lᵉôm corrected to lᵉʼôm; or לְאוֹם; from an unused root meaning to gather; a community; nation, people.

H3817.d: plural of לְאֹם; communities; Leum mim, an Arabian; Leummim.

H3818.d: from לֹא and עַם with pronominal suffix; not my people; Lo-Ammi, the symbolic name of a son of Hosea; Lo-ammi.

H3819.d: from לֹא and רָחַם; not pitied; Lo-Ruchamah, the symbolic name of a son of Hosea; Lo-ruhamah.

H3820.d: a form of לֵבָב; the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything; [phrase] care for, comfortably, consent, [idiom] considered, courag(-eous), friend(-ly), ((broken-), (hard-), (merry-), (stiff-), (stout-), double) heart(-ed), [idiom] heed, [idiom] I, kindly, midst, mind(-ed), [idiom] regard(-ed), [idiom] themselves, [idiom] unawares, understanding, [idiom] well, willingly, wisdom.

H3821.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to לֵב; {the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything}; heart.

H3822.d: plural of לָבִיא; lionesses; Lebaoth, a place in Palestine; Lebaoth. See also בֵּית לְבָאוֹת.

H3823.d: a primitive root; properly, to be enclosed (as if with fat); by implication (as denominative from לֵבָב);  to unheart;  also as denominative from לָבִיבָה i.e.; (in a good sense) transport (with love), or (in a bad sense) stultify; to make cakes; make cakes, ravish, be wise.

H3824.d: from לָבַב; used also like לֵב; the heart (as the most interior organ); [phrase] bethink themselves, breast, comfortably, courage, ((faint), (tender-) heart(-ed), midst, mind, [idiom] unawares, understanding.

H3825.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to לֵבָב; {the heart (as the most interior organ);}; heart.

H3826.d: feminine of לֵב; the heart; heart.

H3828.d: or לְבֹנָה; from לָבָן; frankincense (from its whiteness or perhaps that of its smoke); (frank-) incense.

H3829.d: the same as לְבוֹנָה; Lebonah, a place in Palestine; Lebonah.

H3830.d: or לְבֻשׁ; from לָבַשׁ; a garment (literally or figuratively); by implication (euphemistically) a wife; apparel, clothed with, clothing, garment, raiment, vestment, vesture.

H3831.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to לְבוּשׁ; {a garment (literally or figuratively); by implication (euphemistically) a wife}; garment.

H3832.d: a primitive root; to overthrow; intransposed, to fall; fall.

H3833.d: or (Ezekiel 19:2) לְבִיָּא; irregular masculine plural לְבָאִים; irregular feminine plural לְבָאוֹת; from an unused root meaning;  compare אֲרִי; to roar; a lion (properly, a lioness as the fiercer (although not a roarer;)); (great, old, stout) lion, lioness, young (lion).

H3834.d: or rather לְבִבָה; from לָבַב in its original sense of fatness (or perhaps of folding); a cake (either as fried or turned); cake.

H3835.d: a primitive root; also as denominative from לְבֵנָה; to be (or become) white;  to make bricks; make brick, be (made, make) white(-r).

H3836.d: or (Genesis 49:12) לָבֵן; from לָבַן; white; white.

H3837.d: the same as לָבָן; Laban, a Mesopotamian; also a place in the Desert; Laban.

H3838.d: or לְבָנָה; the same as לְבָנָה; Lebana or Lebanah, one of the Nethinim; Lebana, Lebanah.

H3839.d: from לָבַן; some sort of whitish tree, perhaps the storax; poplar.

H3840.d: from לָבַן; properly, whiteness, i.e. (by implication) transparency; paved.

H3841.d: the same as לִבְנֶה; Libnah, a place in the Desert and one in Palestine; Libnah.

H3842.d: from לָבַן; properly, (the) white, i.e. the moon; moon. See also לְבָנָא.

H3843.d: from לָבַן; a brick (from the whiteness of the clay); (altar of) brick, tile.

H3844.d: from לְבַב; (the) white mountain (from its snow); Lebanon, a mountain range in Palestine; Lebanon.

H3845.d: from לָבַן; white; Libni, an Israelite; Libni.

H3846.d: patronymically from לִבְנִי; a Libnite or descendants of Libni (collectively); Libnites.

H3847.d: or לָבֵשׁ; a primitive root; properly, wrap around, i.e. (by implication) to put on agarment or clothe (oneself, or another), literally or figuratively; (in) apparel, arm, array (self), clothe (self), come upon, put (on, upon), wear.

H3848.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to לָבַשׁ; {properly, wrap around, i.e. (by implication) to put on agarment or clothe (oneself, or another), literally or figuratively}; clothe.

H3849.d: from an unused root apparently meaning to deepen or hollow (like כַּד); a log or measure forliquids; log (of oil).

H3850.d: from an unused root of uncertain signification; Lod, a place in Palestine; Lod.

H3851.d: from an usused root meaning to gleam; a flash; figuratively, a sharply polished blade or point of aweapon; blade, bright, flame, glittering.

H3852.d: or לַהֶבֶת; feminine of לַהַב, and meaning the same; {a flash; figuratively, a sharply polished blade or point of aweapon}; flame(-ming), head (of a spear).

H3853.d: plural of לַהַב; flames; Lehabim, a son of Mizraim, and his descendants; Lehabim.

H3854.d: from an unused root meaning to be eager; intense mental application; study.

H3855.d: from an unused root meaning to glow (compare לַהַב) or else to be earnest (compare לַהַג); Lahad, an Israelite; Lahad.

H3856.d: a primitive root meaning properly, to burn, i.e. (by implication); to be rabid (figuratively, insane); also (from the exhaustion of frenzy) to languish; faint, mad.

H3857.d: a primitive root; properly, to lick, i.e. (by implication) to blaze; burn (up), set on fire, flaming, kindle.

H3858.d: from לָהַט; a blaze; also (from the idea of enwrapping) magic (as covert); flaming, enchantment.

H3859.d: a primitive root; properly, to burn in, i.e. (figuratively) to rankle; wound.

H3860.d: from the prepositional prefix meaning to or for and הֵן; popularly for if; hence, therefore; for them (by mistake for prepositional suffix).

H3861.d: xlit lâwhên corrected to lâhên; (Aramaic) corresponding to לָהֵן; therefore; also except; but, except, save, therefore, wherefore.

H3862.d: probably from an unused root meaning to gather; an assembly; company.

H3863.d: or לֻא; or לוּ; a conditional particle; if; by implication (interj. as a wish) would that!; if (haply), peradventure, I pray thee, though, I would, would God (that).

H3864.d: or לֻבִּי; (Daniel 11:43), partrial from a name probably derived from an unused root meaning to thirst, i.e. a dry region; apparently; a Libyan or inhabitant of interior Africa (only in plural); Lubim(-s), Libyans.

H3865.d: probably of foreign derivation; Lud, the name of two nations; Lud, Lydia.

H3866.d: or לוּדִיִּי; patrial from לוּד; a Ludite or inhabitants of Lud (only in plural); Ludim. Lydians.

H3867.d: a primitive root; properly, to twine, i.e. (by implication) to unite, to remain; also to borrow (as a form of obligation) or (caus.) to lend; abide with, borrow(-er), cleave, join (self), lend(-er).

H3868.d: a primitive root; (compare לָוָה, לוּט and לוּן); to turn aside , i.e. (literally) to depart, (figuratively) be perverse; depart, froward, perverse(-ness).

H3869.d: probably of foreign origin; some kind of nuttree, perhaps the almond; hazel.

H3870.d: probably from לוּז (as growing there); Luz, the name of two places in Palestine; Luz.

H3871.d: or לֻחַ; from a primitive root; probably meaning to glisten; a tablet (as polished), of stone, wood or metal; board, plate, table.

H3872.d: or לֻחוֹת; (Jeremiah 48:5), from the same as לוּחַ; floored; Luchith, a place East of the Jordan; Luhith.

H3873.d: active participle of לָחַשׁ; (the) enchanter; Lochesh, an Israelite; Hallohesh, Haloshesh (includ. the article).

H3874.d: a primitive root; to wrap up; cast, wrap.

H3876.d: the same as לוֹט; Lot, Abraham's nephew; Lot.

H3877.d: from לוֹט; covering; Lotan, an Idumaean; Lotan.

H3878.d: from לָוָה; attached; Levi, a son of Jacob; Levi. See also לֵוִי, לֵוִיִּי.

H3879.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to לִוְיָה; {something attached, i.e. a wreath}; Levite.

H3880.d: from לָוָה; something attached, i.e. a wreath; ornament.

H3881.d: or לֵוִי; patronymically from לֵוִי; a Levite or descendant of Levi; Leviite.

H3882.d: from לָוָה; a wreathed animal, i.e. a serpent (especially the crocodile or some other large sea-monster); figuratively, the constellation of the dragon; also as a symbol of Babylon; leviathan, mourning.

H3883.d: from an unused root meaning to fold back; a spiral step; winding stair. Compare לֻלָאָה.

H3884.d: or לוּלֵי; from לוּא and לֹא; if not; except, had not, if (...not), unless, were it not that.

H3885.d: or לִין; a primitive root; to stop (usually over night); by implication, to stay permanently; hence (in a bad sense) to be obstinate (especially in words, to complain); abide (all night), continue, dwell, endure, grudge, be left, lie all night, (cause to) lodge (all night, in, -ing, this night), (make to) murmur, remain, tarry (all night, that night).

H3886.d: a primitive root; to gulp; figuratively, to be rash; swallow down (up).

H3887.d: a primitive root; properly, to make mouths at, i.e. to scoff; hence (from the effort to pronounce a foreign language) to interpret, or (generally) intercede; ambassador, have in derision, interpreter, make a mock, mocker, scorn(-er, -ful), teacher.

H3888.d: a primitive root; to knead; knead.

H3889.d: from לוּשׁ; kneading; Lush, a place in Palestine; Laish (from the margin). Compare לַיִשׁ.

H3890.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to לָוָה; properly, adhesion, i.e. (as preposition) with; [idiom] thee.

H3892.d: from an unused root meaning to be new; fresh, i.e. unused or undried; green, moist.

H3893.d: from the same as לַח; freshness, i.e. vigor; natural force.

H3894.d: or לָחֻם; passive participle of לָחַם; properly, eaten, i.e. food; also flesh, i.e. body; while...is eating, flesh.

H3895.d: from an unused root meaning to be soft; the cheek (from its fleshiness); hence, the jaw-bone; cheek (bone), jaw (bone).

H3896.d: a form of לְחִי; Lechi, a place in Palestine; Lehi. Compare also רָמַת לֶחִי.

H3897.d: a primitive root; to lick; lick (up).

H3898.d: a primitive root; to feed on; figuratively, to consume; by implication, to battle (as destruction); devour, eat, [idiom] ever, fight(-ing), overcome, prevail, (make) war(-ring).

H3899.d: from לָחַם; See also בֵּית לְעַפְרָה; food (for man or beast), especially bread, or grain (for making it); (shew-) bread, [idiom] eat, food, fruit, loaf, meat, victuals.

H3900.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to לֶחֶם; {(for man or beast), especially bread, or grain (for making it)}; feast.

H3902.d: from לֶחֶם; foodful; (or perhaps erroneous transcription) for בֵּית הַלַּחְמִי; Lachmi, an Israelite; or rather probably a brief form; Lahmi. See also יָשֻׁבִי לֶחֶם.

H3903.d: probably by erroneous transcription for לַחְמָם; from לֶחֶם; food-like; Lachmam or Lachmas, a place in Palestine; Lahmam.

H3904.d: (Aramaic) from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a concubine; concubine.

H3905.d: a primitive root; properly, to press, i.e. (figuratively) to distress; afflict, crush, force, hold fast, oppress(-or), thrust self.

H3907.d: a primitive root; to whisper; by implication, to mumble aspell (as a magician); charmer, whisper (together).

H3908.d: from לָחַשׁ; properly, a whisper, i.e. by implication, (in a good sense) a private prayer, (in a bad one) an incantation; concretely, an amulet; charmed, earring, enchantment, orator, prayer.

H3909.d: a form of לָאט or else participle from לוּט; properly, covered, i.e. secret; by implication, incantation; also secrecy or (adverb) covertly; enchantment, privily, secretly, softly.

H3910.d: probably from לוּט; a gum (from its sticky nature), probably ladanum; myrrh.

H3911.d: from an unused root meaning to hide; a kind of lizard (from its covert habits); lizard.

H3912.d: masculine plural of passive participle of לָטַשׁ; hammered (i.e. oppressed) ones; Letushim, an Arabian tribe; Letushim.

H3913.d: a primitive root; properly, to hammer out (an edge), i.e. to sharpen; instructer, sharp(-en), whet.

H3914.d: a form of לִוְיָה; a wreath; addition.

H3915.d: or (Isaiah 21:11) לֵיל; also לַיְלָה; from the same as לוּל; properly, a twist (away of the light), i.e. night; figuratively, adversity; (mid-)night (season).

H3916.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to לָאֵל; {Lael an Israelite}; night.

H3917.d: from לַיִל; a night spectre; screech owl.

H3918.d: from לוּשׁ in the sense of crushing; a lion (from his destructive blows); (old) lion.

H3919.d: the same as לַיִשׁ; Laish, the name of two places in Palestine; Laish. Compare לוּשׁ.

H3920.d: a primitive root; to catch (in a net, trap or pit); generally, to capture or occupy; also to choose (by lot); figuratively, to cohere; [idiom] at all, catch (self), be frozen, be holden, stick together, take.

H3921.d: from לָכַד; something to capture with, i.e. a noose; being taken.

H3922.d: from יָלַךְ; a journey; Lekah, a place in Palestine; Lecah.

H3923.d: xlit Lâchîysh corrected to Lâkîysh; from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Lakish, a place in Palestine; Lachish.

H3924.d: from the same as לוּל; a loop; loop.

H3925.d: a primitive root; properly, to goad, i.e. (by implication) to teach (the rod being an Oriental incentive); (un-) accustomed, [idiom] diligently, expert, instruct, learn, skilful, teach(-er, -ing).

H3926.d: a prolonged and separable form of the prepositional prefix; to or for; at, for, to, upon.

H3927.d: or לְמוֹאֵל; from לְמוֹ and אֵל; (belonging) to God; Lemuel or Lemoel, a symbolic name of Solomon; Lemuel.

H3928.d: or לִמֻּד; from לָמַד; instructed; accustomed, disciple, learned, taught, used.

H3929.d: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Lemek, the name of two antediluvian patriarchs; Lamech.

H3931.d: a primitive root; to deride; mock.

H3932.d: a primitive root; to deride; by implication (as if imitating a foreigner) to speak unintelligibly; have in derision, laugh (to scorn), mock (on), stammering.

H3933.d: from לָעַג; derision, scoffing; derision, scorn (-ing).

H3934.d: from לָעַג; a buffoon; also a foreigner; mocker, stammering.

H3935.d: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Ladah, an Israelite; Laadah.

H3936.d: from the same as לַעְדָּה; Ladan, the name of two Israelites; Laadan.

H3937.d: a primitive root; to speak in a foreign tongue; strange language.

H3938.d: a primitive root; to swallow greedily; causatively, to feed; feed.

H3939.d: from an unused root supposed to mean to curse; wormwood (regarded as poisonous, and therefore accursed); hemlock, wormwood.

H3940.d: or לַפִּד; from an unused root probably meaning to shine; a flambeau, lamp or flame; (fire-) brand, (burning) lamp, lightning, torch.

H3941.d: feminine plural of לַפִּיד; Lappidoth, the husband of Deborah; Lappidoth.

H3942.d: from the prepositional prefix (to or for) and פָּנִים; anterior; before.

H3943.d: a primitive root; properly, to bend, i.e. (by implication) to clasp; also (reflexively) to turn around or aside; take hold, turn aside (self).

H3945.d: a primitive root; to deride; scorn.

H3946.d: from an unused root thought to mean to stop up by a barricade; perhaps fortification; Lakkum, a place in Palestine; Lakum.

H3947.d: a primitive root; to take (in the widest variety of applications); accept, bring, buy, carry away, drawn, fetch, get, infold, [idiom] many, mingle, place, receive(-ing), reserve, seize, send for, take (away, -ing, up), use, win.

H3948.d: from לָקַח; properly, something received, i.e. (mentally) instruction (whether on the part of the teacher or hearer); also (in an active and sinister sense) inveiglement; doctrine, learning, fair speech.

H3949.d: from לָקַח; learned; Likchi, an Israelite; Likhi.

H3950.d: a primitive root; properly, to pick up, i.e. (generally) to gather; specifically, to glean; gather (up), glean.

H3952.d: a primitive root; to lick or lap; lap, lick.

H3953.d: a primitive root; to gather the after crop; gather.

H3954.d: from לָקַשׁ; the after crop; latter growth.

H3955.d: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; apparently juice, i.e.; (figuratively) vigor; also a sweet or fat cake; fresh, moisture.

H3956.d: or לָשֹׁן; also (in plural) feminine לְשֹׁנָה; from לָשַׁן; the tongue (of man or animals), used literally (as the instrument of licking, eating, or speech), and figuratively (speech, an ingot, a fork of flame, a cove of water); [phrase] babbler, bay, [phrase] evil speaker, language, talker, tongue, wedge.

H3957.d: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a room in a building (whether for storage, eating, or lodging); chamber, parlour. Compare נִשְׁכָּה.

H3958.d: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a gem, perhaps the jacinth; ligure.

H3959.d: the same as לֶשֶׁם; Leshem, a place in Palestine; Leshem.

H3960.d: a primitive root; properly, to lick; but used only as a denominative from לָשׁוֹן; to wag the tongue, i.e. to calumniate; accuse, slander.

H3961.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to לָשׁוֹן; speech, i.e. a nation; language.

H3962.d: from an unused root thought to mean to break through; a boiling spring; Lesha, a place probably East of the Jordan; Lasha.

H3963.d: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a measure for things dry; half homer. m

H3964.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מָה; (as indefinitely) that; [phrase] what.

H3966.d: from the same as אוּד; properly, vehemence, i.e. (with or without preposition) vehemently; by implication, wholly, speedily, etc. (often with other words as an intensive or superlative; especially when repeated); diligently, especially, exceeding(-ly), far, fast, good, great(-ly), [idiom] louder and louder, might(-ily, -y), (so) much, quickly, (so) sore, utterly, very ([phrase] much, sore), well.

H3967.d: or מֵאיָה; properly, a primitive numeral; a hundred; also as a multiplicative and a fraction; hundred((-fold), -th), [phrase] sixscore.

H3968.d: the same as מֵאָה; Meah, a tower in Jerusalem; Meah.

H3969.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מֵאָה; properly, a primitive numeral; a hundred; also as a multiplicative and a fraction}; hundred.

H3971.d: usually מוּם; as if passive participle from an unused root probably meaning; to stain; a blemish (physically or morally); blemish, blot, spot.

H3972.d: apparently a form of מאוּם; properly, a speck or point, i.e. (by implication) something; with negative, nothing; fault, [phrase] no(-ught), ought, somewhat, any (no-)thing.

H3974.d: or מָאֹר; also (in plural) feminine מְאוֹרָה; or מְאֹרָה; from אוֹר; properly, a luminous body or luminary, i.e. (abstractly) light (as an element); figuratively, brightness, i.e.cheerfulness; specifically, a chandelier; bright, light.

H3975.d: feminine passive participle of אוֹר; something lighted, i.e. an aperture; by implication, a crevice or hole (of a serpent); den.

H3976.d: from אָזַן; (only in the dual) a pair of scales; balances.

H3977.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מֹאזֵן; {(only in the dual) a pair of scales}; balances.

H3978.d: from אָכַל; an eatable (includ. provender, flesh and fruit); food, fruit, (bake-)meat(-s), victual.

H3979.d: from אָכַל; something to eat with,i.e. a knife; knife.

H3980.d: from אָכַל; something eaten (by fire), i.e. fuel; fuel.

H3981.d: from אָמַץ; strength, i.e. (plural) resources; force.

H3982.d: from אָמַר; something (authoritatively) said, i.e. an edict; commandment, decree.

H3983.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מַאֲמַר; {something (authoritatively) said, i.e. an edict}; appointment, word.

H3984.d: (Aramaic) probably from a root corresponding to אָנָה in the sense of an inclosure by sides; a utensil; vessel.

H3985.d: a primitive root; to refuse; refuse, [idiom] utterly.

H3988.d: a primitive root; to spurn; also (intransitively) to disappear; abhor, cast away (off), contemn, despise, disdain, (become) loathe(some), melt away, refuse, reject, reprobate, [idiom] utterly, vile person.

H3989.d: from אָפָה; something baked, i.e. a batch; baken.

H3990.d: from the same as אָפֵל; something opaque; darkness.

H3991.d: lemma מַאֲפֵלְיָה second vowel, corrected to מַאְפֵלְיָה; prolonged feminine of מַאֲפֵל; opaqueness; darkness.

H3992.d: a primitive root; to be bitter or (causatively) to embitter, i.e. be painful; fretting, picking.

H3993.d: from אָרַב; an ambuscade; lie in ambush, ambushment, lurking place, lying in wait.

H3995.d: from בָּדַל; a separation, i.e. (concretely) a separate place; separate.

H3996.d: from בּוֹא; (with or without שֶׁמֶשׁ); an entrance (the place or the act); specifically sunset or the west; also (adverb with preposition) towards; by which came, as cometh, in coming, as men enter into, entering, entrance into, entry, where goeth, going down, [phrase] westward. Compare מוֹבָא.

H3997.d: feminine of מָבוֹא; a haven; entry.

H3999.d: from יָבַל in the sense of flowing; a deluge; flood.

H4001.d: from בּוּס; a trampling; treading (trodden) down (under foot).

H4002.d: from נָבַע; a fountain; fountain, spring.

H4003.d: from the same as בּוּקָה; emptiness; void.

H4004.d: from בָּחַר; select, i.e. well fortified; choice.

H4005.d: from בָּחַר; select, i.e. best; choice(-st), chosen.

H4006.d: the same as מִבְחָר; Mibchar, an Israelite; Mibhar.

H4007.d: or מֶבָּט; from נָבַט; something expected, i.e. (abstractly) expectation; expectation.

H4008.d: from בָּטָא; a rash utterance (hasty vow); (that which...) uttered (out of).

H4009.d: from בָּטַח; properly, a refuge, i.e. (objective) security, or (subjective) assurance; confidence, hope, sure, trust.

H4010.d: from בָּלַג; desistance (or rather desolation); comfort self.

H4012.d: from בָּנָה; built up; Mebunnai, an Israelite; Mebunnai.

H4013.d: also (in plural) feminine (Daniel 11:l5) מִבְצָרָה; from בָּצַר; a fortification, castle, or fortified city; figuratively, a defender; (de-, most) fenced, fortress, (most) strong (hold).

H4014.d: the same as מִבְצָר; Mibtsar, an Idumaean; Mibzar.

H4017.d: from the same as בֶּשֶׂם; fragrant; Mibsam, the name of an Ishmaelite and of an Israelite; Mibsam.

H4018.d: from בָּשַׁל; a cooking hearth; boiling-place.

H4019.d: from the same as גָּבִישׁ; stiffening; Magbish, an Israelite, or a place in Palestine; Magbish.

H4021.d: from the same as גִּבְעָה; a cap (as hemispherical); bonnet.

H4022.d: from an unused root probably meaning to be eminent; properly, a distinguished thing; hence something valuable, as aproduct or fruit; pleasant, precious fruit (thing).

H4023.d: (Zechariah אַבְדָן) or מְגִדּוֹ; from גָּדַד; rendezvous; Megiddon or Megiddo, a place in Palestine; Megiddo, Megiddon.

H4024.d: or מִגְדֹּל; probably of Egyptian origin; Migdol, a place in Egypt; Migdol, tower.

H4025.d: from מֶגֶד and אֵל; preciousness of God; Magdiel, an Idumaean; Magdiel.

H4026.d: also (in plural) feminine מִגְדָּלָה; from גָּדַל; a tower (from its size or height); by analogy, a rostrum; figuratively, a (pyramidal) bed of flowers; castle, flower, tower. Compare the names following.

H4027.d: from מִגְדָּל and אֵל; tower of God; Migdal-El, a place in Palestine; Migdal-el.

H4028.d: from מִגְדָּל and גַּד; tower of Fortune; Migdal-Gad, a place in Palestine; Migdal-gad.

H4029.d: from מִגְדָּל and עֵדֶר; tower of a flock; Migdal-Eder, a place in Palestine; Migdal-eder, tower of the flock.

H4030.d: from the same as מֶגֶד; preciousness, i.e. a gem; precious thing, present.

H4031.d: from גּוֹג; Magog, a son of Japheth; also a barbarous northern region; Magog.

H4032.d: or (Lamentations 2:22) מָגוּר; from גּוּר in the sense of fearing; a fright (objective or subjective); fear, terror. Compare מָגוֹר מִסָּבִיב.

H4033.d: or מָגֻר; from גּוּר in the sense of lodging; a temporary abode; by extension, a permanent residence; dwelling, pilgrimage, where sojourn, be a stranger. Compare מָגוֹר.

H4035.d: feminine of מָגוֹר or of מָגוּר; a fright; also a granary; barn, fear.

H4036.d: from מָגוֹר and סָבִיב with the preposition inserted; affright from around; Magor-mis-Sabib, a symbolic name of Pashur; Magormissabib.

H4037.d: from גָּזַר; a cutting implement, i.e. a blade; axe.

H4038.d: from an unused root meaning to reap; a sickle; sickle.

H4039.d: from גָּלַל; a roll; roll, volume.

H4041.d: from the same as גַּם; properly, accumulation, i.e. impulse or direction; sup up.

H4042.d: a denominative from מָגֵן; properly, to shield; encompass with; figuratively, to rescue, to hand safely over (i.e. surrender); deliver.

H4043.d: also (in plural) feminine מְגִנָּה; from גָּנַן; a shield (i.e. the small one or buckler); figuratively, a protector; also the scaly hide of the crocodile; [idiom] armed, buckler, defence, ruler, [phrase] scale, shield.

H4044.d: from מָגַן; a covering (in a bad sense), i.e. blindness or obduracy; sorrow. See also מָגֵן.

H4046.d: from נָגַף; a pestilence; by analogy, defeat; ([idiom] be) plague(-d), slaughter, stroke.

H4047.d: apparently from גּוּף or נָגַף and עָשׁ; exterminator of (the) moth; Magpiash, an Israelite; Magpiash.

H4048.d: a primitive root; to yield up; intensively, to precipitate; cast down, terror.

H4049.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מָגַר; to overthrow; destroy.

H4050.d: from גָּרַר; a saw; axe, saw.

H4051.d: from מָגַר; precipice; Migron, a place in Palestine; Migron.

H4052.d: from גָּרַע; a ledge or offset; narrowed rest.

H4053.d: from גָּרַף; something thrown off (by the spade), i.e. a clod; clod.

H4054.d: also (in plural) feminine (Ezekiel 27:28) מִגְרָשָׁה; from גָּרַשׁ; a suburb (i.e. open country whither flocks are driven from pasture); hence, the area around abuilding, or the margin of the sea; cast out, suburb.

H4055.d: or מֵד; from מָדַד; properly, extent, i.e. height; also a measure; by implication, a vesture (as measured); also a carpet; armour, clothes, garment, judgment, measure, raiment, stature.

H4056.d: (Aramaic) from דְּבַח; a sacrificial altar; altar.

H4057.d: from דָבַר in the sense of driving; a pasture (i.e. open field, whither cattle are driven); by implication, a desert; also speech (including its organs); desert, south, speech, wilderness.

H4058.d: a primitive root; properly, to stretch; by implication, to measure (as if by stretching a line); figuratively, to be extended; measure, mete, stretch self.

H4060.d: feminine of מַד; properly, extension, i.e. height or breadth; also a measure (including its standard); hence a portion (as measured) or a vestment; specifically, tribute (as measured); garment, measure(-ing, meteyard, piece, size, (great) stature, tribute, wide.

H4061.d: (Aramaic) or מִנְדָּה; (Aramaic), corresponding to מִדָּה; tribute in money; toll, tribute.

H4062.d: perhaps from the equivalent of דְּהַב; goldmaking, i.e. exactness; golden city.

H4063.d: from an unused root meaning to stretch; properly, extent, i.e. measure; by implication, a dress (as measured); garment.

H4065.d: from נָדַח; seduction; cause of banishment.

H4066.d: from דִּין; a contest or quarrel; brawling, contention(-ous), discord, strife. Compare מִדְיָן, מְדָן.

H4067.d: from the same as מֶדֶו; extensiveness, i.e. height; stature.

H4068.d: the same as מָדוֹן; Madon, a place in Palestine; Madon.

H4069.d: or מַדֻּעַ; from מָה and the passive participle of יָדַע; what (is) known?; i.e. (by implication) (adverbially) why?; how, wherefore, why.

H4070.d: (Aramaic) or מְדֹר; (Aramaic), or מְדָר; (Aramaic), from דּוּר; a dwelling; dwelling.

H4071.d: or מְדֻרָה; from דּוּר in the sense of accumulation; a pile of fuel; pile (for fire).

H4073.d: from דָּחַף; a push, i.e. ruin; overthrow.

H4074.d: of foreign derivation; Madai, a country of central Asia; Madai, Medes, Media.

H4075.d: patrial from מָדַי; a Madian or native of Madai; Mede.

H4076.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מָדַי; {Madai, a country of central Asia}; Mede(-s).

H4077.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מָדַי; {a Madian or native of Madai}; Median.

H4078.d: from מָה and דַּי; what (is) enough, i.e. sufficiently; sufficiently.

H4079.d: a variation for מָדוֹן; {a contest or quarrel}; brawling, contention(-ous).

H4080.d: the same as מִדְיָן; Midjan, a son of Abraham; also his country and (collectively) his descendants; Midian, Midianite.

H4081.d: a variation for מִדְיָן; {Midjan, a son of Abraham; also his country and (collectively) his descendants}; Middin.

H4082.d: from דִּין; properly, a judgeship, i.e. jurisdiction; by implication, a district (as ruled by a judge); generally, a region; ([idiom] every) province.

H4083.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מְדִינָה; {properly, a judgeship, i.e. jurisdiction; by implication, a district (as ruled by a judge); generally, a region}; province.

H4084.d: patronymical or patrial from מִדְיָן; a Midjanite or descendant (native) of Midjan; Midianite. Compare מְדָנִי.

H4086.d: from the same as דֹּמֶן; dunghill; Madmen, a place in Palestine; Madmen.

H4087.d: feminine from the same as דֹּמֶן; a dunghill; dunghill.

H4088.d: the same as מַדְמֵנָה; Madmenah, a place in Palestine; Madmenah.

H4089.d: a variation for מַדְמֵנָה; Madmannah, a place in Palestine; Madmannah.

H4090.d: a form of מָדוֹן; {a contest or quarrel}; discord, strife.

H4091.d: the same as מְדָן; Medan, a son of Abraham; Medan.

H4092.d: a variation of מִדְיָנִי; {a Midjanite or descendant (native) of Midjan}; Midianite.

H4093.d: or מַדַּע; from יָדַע; intelligence or consciousness; knowledge, science, thought.

H4095.d: from an unused root meaning to step; properly, a step; by implication, a steep or inaccessible place; stair, steep place.

H4096.d: from דָּרַךְ; a treading, i.e. a place for stepping on; (foot-) breadth.

H4097.d: from דָּרַשׁ; properly, an investigation, i.e. (by implication) a treatise or elaborate compilation; story.

H4098.d: from דּוּשׁ; a threshing, i.e. (concretely and figuratively) down-trodden people; threshing.

H4099.d: xlit Mᵉdâthâ corrected to Mᵉdâthâʼ; of Persian origin; Medatha, the father of Haman; Hammedatha (including the article).

H4100.d: or מַה; or מָ; or מַ; also מֶה; a primitive particle; properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses; how (long, oft, (-soever)), (no-) thing, what (end, good, purpose, thing), whereby(-fore, -in, -to, -with), (for) why.

H4101.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מָה; {properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what}; how great (mighty), that which, what(-soever), why.

H4102.d: apparently a denominative from מָה; properly, to question or hesitate, i.e. (by implication) to be reluctant; delay, linger, stay selves, tarry.

H4103.d: from הוּם; confusion or uproar; destruction, discomfiture, trouble, tumult, vexation, vexed.

H4104.d: of Persian origin; Mehuman, a eunuch of Xerxes; Mehuman.

H4105.d: from יָטַב (augmented) and אֵל; bettered of God; Mehetabel, the name of an Edomitish man and woman; Mehetabeel, Mehetabel.

H4106.d: or מָהִר; from מָהַר; quick; hence, skilful; diligent, hasty, ready.

H4107.d: a primitive root; properly, to cut down or reduce, i.e. by implication, to adulterate; mixed.

H4108.d: from הָלַךְ; a walking (plural collectively), i.e. access; place to walk.

H4109.d: from הָלַךְ; a walk, i.e. a passage or a distance; journey, walk.

H4111.d: from מַהֲלָל and אֵל; praise of God; Mahalalel, the name of an antediluvian patriarch and of an Israelite; Mahalaleel.

H4112.d: from הָלַם; a blow; stripe, stroke.

H4113.d: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; perhaps an abyss; deep pit.

H4114.d: from הָפַךְ; a destruction; when...overthrew, overthrow(-n).

H4115.d: from הָפַךְ; a wrench, i.e. the stocks; prison, stocks.

H4116.d: a primitive root; properly, to be liquid or flow easily, i.e. (by implication); to hurry (in a good or a bad sense); often used (with another verb) adverbially, promptly; be carried headlong, fearful, (cause to make, in, make) haste(-n, -ily), (be) hasty, (fetch, make ready) [idiom] quickly, rash, [idiom] shortly, (be so) [idiom] soon, make speed, [idiom] speedily, [idiom] straightway, [idiom] suddenly, swift.

H4117.d: a primitive root (perhaps rather the same as מָהַר through the idea of readiness in assent); to bargain (for a wife), i.e. to wed; endow, [idiom] surely.

H4118.d: from מָהַר; properly, hurrying; hence (adverbially) in ahurry; hasteth, hastily, at once, quickly, soon, speedily, suddenly.

H4119.d: from מָהַר; a price (for a wife); dowry.

H4120.d: feminine of מַהֵר; properly, a hurry; hence (adverbially) promptly; hastily, quickly, shortly, soon, make (with) speed(-ily), swiftly.

H4121.d: from מָהַר; hasty; Maharai, an Israelite; Maharai.

H4122.d: from מַהֵר and שָׁלָל and חוּשׁ and בַּז; hasting (is he (the enemy) to the) booty, swift (to the) prey; Maher-Shalal-Chash-Baz; the symbolical name of the son of Isaiah; Maher-sha-lal-bash-baz.

H4124.d: from a prolonged form of the prepositional prefix m-and אָב; from (her (the mother's)) father; Moab, an incestuous son of Lot; also his territory and descendants; Moab.

H4125.d: feminine מוֹאָבִיָּה; or מוֹאָבִיתxlit Môwâbîyth corrected to Môwʼâbîyth; patronymical from מוֹאָב; a Moabite or Moabitess, i.e. a descendant from Moab; (woman) of Moab, Moabite(-ish, -ss).

H4126.d: by transp. for מָבוֹא; an entrance; coming.

H4127.d: a primitive root; to melt, i.e. literally (to soften, flow down, disappear), or figuratively (to fear, faint); consume, dissolve, (be) faint(-hearted), melt (away), make soft.

H4128.d: a primitive root; to shake; measure.

H4129.d: or rather מֹדָע; from יָדַע; an acquaintance; kinswoman.

H4131.d: a primitive root; to waver; by implication, to slip, shake, fall; be carried, cast, be out of course, be fallen in decay, [idiom] exceedingly, fall(-ing down), be (re-) moved, be ready, shake, slide, slip.

H4132.d: from מוֹט; a wavering, i.e. fall; by implication, a pole (as shaking); hence, a yoke (as essentially a bent pole); bar, be moved, staff, yoke.

H4133.d: feminine of מוֹט; a pole; by implication, an ox-bow; hence, a yoke (either literal or figurative); bands, heavy, staves, yoke.

H4134.d: a primitive root; to become thin, i.e. (figuratively) be impoverished; be (waxen) poor(-er).

H4135.d: a primitive root; to cut short, i.e. curtail (specifically the prepuce, i.e. to circumcise); by implication, to blunt; figuratively, to destroy; circumcise(-ing), selves), cut down (in pieces), destroy, [idiom] must needs.

H4136.d: or מוֹל; (Deuteronomy 1:1), or מוֹאל; (Nehemiah 12:38), or מֻל; (Numbers 22:5), from מוּל; properly, abrupt, i.e. a precipice; by implication, the front; used only adverbially (with prepositional prefix) opposite; (over) against, before, (fore-) front, from, (God-) ward, toward, with.

H4137.d: from יָלַד; birth; Moladah, a place in Palestine; Moladah.

H4138.d: from יָלַד; nativity (plural birth-place); by implication, lineage, native country; also offspring, family; begotten, born, issue, kindred, native(-ity).

H4140.d: from יָלַד; genitor; Molid, an Israelite; Molid.

H4141.d: from סָבַב; a turn, i.e. circuit (of a building); winding about.

H4142.d: or מֻסַבָּה; feminine of מוּסָב; a reversal, i.e. the backside (of a gem), fold (of a double-leaved door), transmutation (of a name); being changed, inclosed, be set, turning.

H4145.d: feminine of מוּסָד; a foundation; figuratively, an appointment; foundation, grounded. Compare מְיֻסָּדָה.

H4146.d: or מֹסָדָה; feminine of מוֹסָד; a foundation; foundation.

H4147.d: also (in plural) feminine מוֹסֵרָה; or מֹסְרָה; from יָסַר; properly, chastisement, i.e. (by implication) a halter; figuratively, restraint; band, bond.

H4148.d: from יָסַר; properly, chastisement; figuratively, reproof, warning or instruction; also restraint; bond, chastening(-eth), chastisement, check, correction, discipline, doctrine, instruction, rebuke.

H4149.d: or (plural) מֹסְרוֹת feminine of מוֹסֵר; correction or corrections; Moserah or Moseroth, a place in the Desert; Mosera, Moseroth.

H4150.d: or מֹעֵד; or (feminine) מוֹעָדָה; (2 Chronicles 8:13), from יָעַד; properly, an appointment, i.e. a fixed time or season; specifically, a festival; conventionally ayear; by implication, an assembly (as convened for a definite purpose); technically the congregation; by extension, the place of meeting; also a signal (as appointed beforehand); appointed (sign, time), (place of, solemn) assembly, congregation, (set, solemn) feast, (appointed, due) season, solemn(-ity), synogogue, (set) time (appointed).

H4151.d: from יָעַד; (as in מוֹעֵד); properly, an assembly  figuratively, a troop; appointed time.

H4152.d: from יָעַד; an appointed place, i.e. asylum; appointed.

H4153.d: from מוֹעָד and יָהּ; assembly of Jah; Moadjah, an Israelite; Moadiah. Compare מַעֲדְיָה.

H4154.d: feminine passive participle of מָעַד; properly, made to slip, i.e. dislocated; out of joint.

H4155.d: from עוּף; properly, covered, i.e. dark; abstractly, obscurity, i.e. distress; dimness.

H4156.d: from יָעַץ; a purpose; counsel, device.

H4157.d: from עוּק; pressure, i.e. (figuratively) distress; affliction.

H4158.d: (Jeremiah 48:21) or מֵיפַעַת; or מֵפַעַת; from יָפַע; illuminative; Mophaath or Mephaath, a place in Palestine; Mephaath.

H4159.d: or מֹפֵת; from יָפָה in the sense of conspicuousness; a miracle; by implication, a token or omen; miracle, sign, wonder(-ed at).

H4160.d: a primitive root; to press, i.e. (figuratively) to oppress; extortioner.

H4161.d: or מֹצָאxlit môtsâ corrected to môtsâʼ; from יָצָא; a going forth, i.e. (the act) an egress, or (the place) an exit; hence, a source or product; specifically, dawn, the rising of the sun (the East), exportation, utterance, a gate, a fountain, a mine, a meadow (as producing grass); brought out, bud, that which came out, east, going forth, goings out, that which (thing that) is gone out, outgoing, proceeded out, spring, vein, (water-) course (springs).

H4162.d: the same as מוֹצָא; Motsa, the name of two Israelites; Moza.

H4163.d: feminine of מוֹצָא; (marg.; compare צוֹאָה); a family descent; also a sewer; draught house; going forth.

H4164.d: or מוּצָק; from יָצַק; narrowness; figuratively, distress; anguish, is straitened, straitness.

H4165.d: from עָגִיל; properly, fusion, i.e. literally, a casting (of metal); figuratively, a mass (of clay); casting, hardness.

H4166.d: or מֻצָקָה; from יָצַק; properly, something poured out, i.e. a casting (of metal); by implication, a tube (as cast); when it was cast, pipe.

H4167.d: a primitive root; to jeer, i.e. (intens.) blaspheme; be corrupt.

H4168.d: from יָקַד; a fire or fuel; abstractly, a conflagration; burning, hearth.

H4170.d: or מֹקֵשׁ; from יָקֹשׁ; a noose (for catching animals) (literally or figuratively); by implication, a hook (for the nose); be ensnared, gin, (is) snare(-d), trap.

H4171.d: a primitive root; to alter; by implication, to barter, to dispose of; [idiom] at all, (ex-) change, remove.

H4172.d: or מֹרָא; or מוֹרָהxlit môrâh corrected to môwrâh; (Psalm 9:20), from יָרֵא; fear; by implication, a fearful thing or deed; dread, (that ought to be) fear(-ed), terribleness, terror.

H4173.d: or מֹרַג; from an unused root meaning to triturate; a threshing sledge; threshing instrument.

H4174.d: from יָרַד; a descent; as architecture, an ornamental appendage, perhaps a festoon; going down, steep place, thin work.

H4175.d: from יָרָה; (see יוֹרֶה); an archer; also teacher or teaching; also the early rain; (early) rain.

H4176.d: or מֹרֶה; the same as מוֹרֶה; Moreh, a Canaanite; also a hill (perhaps named from him); Moreh.

H4177.d: from מוּר in the sense of shearing; a razor; razor.

H4178.d: from יָרַט; obstinate, i.e. independent; peeled.

H4179.d: or מֹרִיָּה; from רָאָה and יָהּ; seen of Jah; Morijah, a hill in Palestine; Moriah.

H4180.d: from יָרַשׁ; a possession; figuratively, delight; possession, thought.

H4181.d: feminine of מוֹרָשׁ; a possession; heritage, inheritance, possession.

H4182.d: from יָרַשׁ and גַּת; possession of Gath; Moresheth-Gath, a place in Palestine; Moresheth-gath.

H4183.d: xlit Morashtîy corrected to Môwrashtîy; patrial from מוֹרֶשֶׁת גַּת; a Morashtite or inhabitant of Moresheth-Gath; Morashthite.

H4184.d: a primitive root; to touch; feel, handle.

H4185.d: a primitive root (perhaps rather the same as מוּשׁ through the idea of receding by contact); to withdraw (both literally and figuratively, whether intransitive or transitive); cease, depart, go back, remove, take away.

H4186.d: or מֹשָׁב; from יָשַׁב; a seat; figuratively, a site; abstractly, a session; by extension an abode (the place or the time); by implication, population; assembly, dwell in, dwelling(-place), wherein (that) dwelt (in), inhabited place, seat, sitting, situation, sojourning.

H4187.d: or מֻשִּׁי; from מוּשׁ; sensitive; Mushi, a Levite; Mushi.

H4188.d: patronymical from מוּשִׁי; a Mushite (collectively) or descendants of Mushi; Mushites.

H4189.d: act participle feminine of מָשַׁךְ; something drawing, i.e. (figuratively) a cord; band.

H4191.d: a primitive root; to die (literally or figuratively); causatively, to kill; [idiom] at all, [idiom] crying, (be) dead (body, man, one), (put to, worthy of) death, destroy(-er), (cause to, be like to, must) die, kill, necro(-mancer), [idiom] must needs, slay, [idiom] surely, [idiom] very suddenly, [idiom] in (no) wise.

H4192.d: (Psalm אֲבִירָם or מוּת לַבֵּן; from מוּת and בֵּן with the preposition and article interposed; 'To die for the son', probably the title of a popular song; death, Muthlabben.

H4194.d: from מוּת; death (natural or violent); concretely, the dead, their place or state (hades); figuratively, pestilence, ruin; (be) dead(-ly), death, die(-d).

H4195.d: from יָתַר; literally gain; figuratively, superiority; plenteousness, preeminence, profit.

H4197.d: from an unused root meaning to mingle (water with wine); tempered wine; liquor.

H4198.d: from an unused root meaning to suck out; exhausted; burnt.

H4199.d: probably from an unused root meaning to faint with fear; terror; Mizzah, an Edomite; Mizzah.

H4200.d: probably from an unused root meaning to gather in; a granary; garner.

H4201.d: or מְזֻזָה; from the same as זִיז; a door-post (as prominent); (door, side) post.

H4204.d: from זוּר in the sense of turning aside from truth; treachery, i.e. a plot; wound.

H4205.d: or מָזֹר; from זוּר in the sense of binding up; a bandage, i.e. remedy; hence, a sore (as needing a compress); bound up, wound.

H4206.d: or מֵזַח; from זָחַח; a belt (as movable); girdle, strength.

H4207.d: or (feminine) מִזְלָגָה; from an unused root meaning to draw up; a fork; fleshhook.

H4208.d: apparently from נָזַל in the sense of raining; a constellation, i.e. Zodiacal sign (perhaps as affecting the weather); planet. Compare מַזָּרָה.

H4209.d: from זָמַם; a plan, usually evil (machination), sometimes good (sagacity); (wicked) device, discretion, intent, witty invention, lewdness, mischievous (device), thought, wickedly.

H4210.d: from זָמַר; properly, instrumental music; by implication, a poem set to notes; psalm.

H4212.d: from זָמַר; a tweezer (only in the plural); snuffers.

H4213.d: from the same as זְעֵירxlit zeʻêyr corrected to zᵉʻêyr; fewness; by implication, as superl. diminutiveness; few, [idiom] very.

H4214.d: from זָרָה; a winnowing shovel (as scattering the chaff); fan.

H4215.d: apparently from זָרָה; properly, a scatterer, i.e. the north wind (as dispersing clouds; only in plural); north.

H4216.d: apparently from נָזַר in the sense of distinction; some noted constellation (only in the plural), perhaps collectively, the zodiac; Mazzoroth. Compare מַזָּלָה.

H4217.d: from זָרַח; sunrise, i.e. the east; east (side, -ward), (sun-) rising (of the sun).

H4218.d: from זָרַע; a planted field; thing sown.

H4219.d: from זָרַק; a bowl (as if for sprinkling); bason, bowl.

H4220.d: from מָחָה in the sense of greasing; fat; figuratively, rich; fatling (one).

H4221.d: from the same as מֵחַ; fat, i.e. marrow; marrow.

H4222.d: a primitive root; to rub or strike the hands together (in exultation); clap.

H4223.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מָחָא; to strike in pieces; also to arrest; specifically to impale; hang, smite, stay.

H4224.d: or מַחֲבֹא; from חָבָא; a refuge; hiding (lurking) place.

H4225.d: from חָבַר; a junction, i.e. seam or sewed piece; coupling.

H4226.d: from חָבַר; a joiner, i.e. brace or cramp; coupling, joining.

H4227.d: from the same as חָבֵת; a pan for baking in; pan.

H4229.d: a primitive root; properly, to stroke or rub; by implication, to erase; also to smooth (as if with oil), i.e. grease or make fat; also to touch, i.e. reach to; abolish, blot out, destroy, full of marrow, put out, reach unto, [idiom] utterly, wipe (away, out).

H4230.d: from חוּג; an instrument for marking a circle, i.e. compasses; compass.

H4231.d: from an unused root meaning to enclose; a harbor (as shut in by the shore); haven.

H4232.d: or מְחִיּיָאֵל; from מָחָה and אֵל; smitten of God; Mechujael or Mechijael, an antediluvian patriarch; Mehujael.

H4233.d: apparently a patrial, but from an unknown place (in the plural only for a singular); a Machavite or inhabitant of some place named Machaveh; Mahavite.

H4235.d: the same as מָחוֹל; dancing; Machol, an Israelite; Mahol.

H4238.d: feminine plural from חָזָה; visions; Machazioth, an Israelite; Mahazioth.

H4239.d: from מָחָה; a stroke, i.e. battering-ram; engines.

H4240.d: from חוּד; junction; Mechida, one of the Nethinim; Mehida.

H4241.d: from חָיָה; preservation of life; hence, sustenance; also the live flesh, i.e. the quick; preserve life, quick, recover selves, reviving, sustenance, victuals.

H4242.d: from an unused root meaning to buy; price, payment, wages; gain, hire, price, sold, worth.

H4243.d: the same as מְחִיר; price; Mechir, an Israelite; Mehir.

H4244.d: from חָלָה; sickness; Machlah, the name apparently of two Israelitesses; Mahlah.

H4245.d: or (feminine) מַחֲלָה; from חָלָה; sickness; disease, infirmity, sickness.

H4246.d: xlit mᵉchôwlâh corrected to mᵉchôlâh; feminine of מָחוֹל; a dance; company, dances(-cing).

H4247.d: from חָלַל; a cavern (as if excavated); cave.

H4248.d: from חָלָה; sick; Machlon, an Israelite; Mahlon.

H4249.d: from חָלָה; sick; Machli, the name of two Israelites; Mahli.

H4250.d: patronymical from מַחְלִי; a Machlite or (collectively) descendants of Machli; Mahlites.

H4252.d: from חָלַף; a (sacrificial) knife (as gliding through the flesh); knife.

H4253.d: from חָלַף; a ringlet of hair (as gliding over each other); lock.

H4254.d: from חָלַץ; a mantle (as easily drawn off); changeable suit of apparel, change of raiment.

H4255.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מַחֲלֹקֶת; a section (of the Levites); course.

H4256.d: from חָלַק; a section (of Levites, people or soldiers); company, course, division, portion. See also סֶלַע הַמַּחְלְקוֹת.

H4257.d: from חָלָה; sickness; 'Machalath', probably the title (initial word) of a popular song; Mahalath.

H4258.d: the same as מַחֲלַת; sickness; Machalath, the name of an Ishmaelitess and of an Israelitess; Mahalath.

H4259.d: patrial from אָבֵל מְחוֹלָה; a Mecholathite or inhabitant of Abel-Mecholah; Mecholathite.

H4260.d: a denominative from חֶמְאָה; something buttery (i.e. unctuous and pleasant), as (figuratively) flattery; [idiom] than butter.

H4261.d: from חָמַד; delightful; hence, a delight, i.e. object of affection or desire; beloved, desire, goodly, lovely, pleasant (thing).

H4262.d: or מַחְמוּד; from חָמַד; desired; hence, a valuable; pleasant thing.

H4263.d: from חָמַל; (by paronomasia with מַחְמָד) delight; properly, sympathy; pitieth.

H4264.d: from חָנָה; an encampment (of travellers or troops); hence, an army, whether literal (of soldiers) or figurative (of dancers, angels, cattle, locusts, stars; or even the sacred courts); army, band, battle, camp, company, drove, host, tents.

H4265.d: from מַחֲנֶה and דָּן; camp of Dan; Machaneh-Dan, a place in Palestine; Mahaneh-dan.

H4266.d: dual of מַחֲנֶה; double camp; Machanajim, a place in Palestine; Mahanaim.

H4268.d: or מַחְסֶה; from חָסָה; a shelter (literally or figuratively); hope, (place of) refuge, shelter, trust.

H4270.d: or מַחְסֹר; from חָסֵר; deficiency; hence, impoverishment; lack, need, penury, poor, poverty, want.

H4271.d: from מַחֲסֶה and יָהּ; refuge of (i.e. in) Jah; Machsejah, an Israelite; Maaseiah.

H4272.d: a primitive root; to dash asunder; by implication, to crush, smash or violently plunge; figuratively, to subdue or destroy; dip, pierce (through), smite (through), strike through, wound.

H4274.d: from חָצַב; properly, a hewing; concretely, a quarry; hewed(-n).

H4275.d: from חָצָהlemma חָעָה ayin, corrected to חָצָה; a halving; half.

H4276.d: from חָצָהlemma חָעָה ayin, corrected to חָצָה; a halving or the middle; half (so much), mid(-day).

H4277.d: a primitive root; to crush; smite off.

H4278.d: from חָקַר; properly, scrutinized, i.e. (by implication) a recess; deep place.

H4279.d: probably from אָחַר; properly, deferred, i.e. the morrow; usually (adverbially) tomorrow; indefinitely, hereafter; time to come, tomorrow.

H4280.d: from the same as חֶרֶא; a sink; draught house.

H4281.d: from חָרַשׁ; probably a pick-axe; mattock.

H4282.d: from חָרַשׁ; probably a hoe; share.

H4283.d: or מׇחֳרָתָם; (1 Samuel 30:17), feminine from the same as מָחָר; the morrow or (adverbially) tomorrow; morrow, next day.

H4284.d: or מַחֲשֶׁבֶת; from חָשַׁב; a contrivance, i.e. (concretely) a texture, machine, or (abstractly) intention, plan (whether bad, a plot; or good, advice); cunning (work), curious work, device(-sed), imagination, invented, means, purpose, thought.

H4285.d: from חָשַׁךְ; darkness; concretely, a dark place; dark(-ness, place).

H4286.d: from חָשַׂף; a peeling; made appear.

H4287.d: probably from מָחָה; erasure; Machath, the name of two Israelites; Mahath.

H4288.d: from חָתָה; properly, a dissolution; concretely, a ruin, or (abstractly) consternation; destruction, dismaying, ruin, terror.

H4289.d: the same as מְחִתָּה in the sense of removal; a pan for live coals; censer, firepan, snuffdish.

H4290.d: from חָתַר; a burglary; figuratively, unexpected examination; breaking up, secret search.

H4291.d: (Aramaic) or מְטָה; (Aramaic), apparently corresponding to מָצָא in the intransitive sense of being found present; to arrive, extend or happen; come, reach.

H4292.d: apparently a denominative from טִיט; a broom (as removing dirt (compare English 'to dust', i.e. remove dust)); besom.

H4294.d: or (feminine) מַטָּה; from נָטָה; a branch (as extending); figuratively, a tribe; also a rod, whether for chastising (figuratively, correction), ruling (a sceptre), throwing (a lance), or walking (a staff; figuratively, a support of life, e.g. bread); rod, staff, tribe.

H4295.d: from עָוַר with directive enclitic appended; downward, below or beneath; often adverbially with or without prefixes; beneath, down(-ward), less, very low, under(-neath).

H4296.d: from נָטָה; a bed (as extended) forsleeping or eating; by analogy, a sofa, litter or bier; bed(-chamber), bier.

H4297.d: from נָטָה; a stretching, i.e. distortion (figuratively, iniquity); perverseness.

H4300.d: from טוּל in the sense of hammering out; an iron bar (as forged); bar.

H4301.d: or מַטְמֹן; or מַטְמֻן; from טָמַן; a secret storehouse; hence, a secreted valuable (buried); generally money; hidden riches, (hid) treasure(-s).

H4302.d: from נָטַע; something planted, i.e. the place (a garden or vineyard), or the thing (a plant, figuratively or men); by implication, the act, planting; plant(-ation, -ing).

H4303.d: or (feminine) מַטְעַמָּה; from טָעַם; a delicacy; dainty (meat), savoury meat.

H4304.d: from טָפַח; a wide cloak (for a woman); vail, wimple.

H4305.d: a primitive root; to rain; (cause to) rain (upon).

H4307.d: or מַטָּרָה; from נָטַר; a jail (as a guard-house); also an aim (as being closely watched); mark, prison.

H4308.d: from טָרַד; propulsive; Matred, an Edomitess; Matred.

H4309.d: from מָטַר; rainy; Matri, an Israelite; Matri.

H4310.d: an interrogative pronoun of persons, as מָה is of things,; who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix; any (man), [idiom] he, [idiom] him, [phrase] O that! what, which, who(-m, -se, -soever), [phrase] would to God.

H4311.d: from מַיִם and דֹּבֶא; water of quiet; Medeba, a place in Palestine; Medeba.

H4312.d: from יָדַד in the sense of loving; affectionate; Medad, an Israelite; Medad.

H4313.d: from מַיִם and יֵרָקוֹן with the art. interposed; water of the yellowness; Me-haj-Jarkon, a place in Palestine; Me-jarkon.

H4314.d: from מַיִם and זָהָב, water of gold; Me-Zahab, an Edomite; Mezahab.

H4315.d: from יָטַב; the best part; best.

H4316.d: a variation for מִיכָה; Mica, the name of two Israelites; Micha.

H4317.d: from מִי and (the prefix derivative from) כִּי and אֵל; who (is) like God?; Mikael, the name of an archangel and of nine Israelites; Michael.

H4318.d: an abbreviated form of מִיכָיָה; Micah, the name of seven Israelites; Micah, Micaiah, Michah.

H4319.d: a contr. for מִיכָיְהוּ; Mikehu, an Israelite prophet; Micaiah (2 Chronicles 18:8).

H4320.d: from מִי and (the prefix derivative from) כִּי and יָהּ; who (is) like Jah?; Micajah, the name of two Israelites; Micah, Michaiah. Compare מִיכָה.

H4321.d: or מִכָיְהוּ; (Jeremiah 36:11), abbreviated form for מִיכָיָהוּ; Mikajah, the name of three Israelites; Micah, Micaiah, Michaiah.

H4322.d: for מִיכָיָה; Mikajah, the name of an Israelite and an Israelitess; Michaiah.

H4323.d: from יָכֹל; properly, a container, i.e. a streamlet; brook.

H4324.d: apparently the same as מִיכָל; revulet; Mikal, Saul's daughter; Michal.

H4325.d: dual of a primitive noun (but used in a singular sense); water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen; [phrase] piss, wasting, water(-ing, (-course, -flood, -spring)).

H4326.d: a form for מִנְיָמִין; Mijamin, the name of three Israelites; Miamin, Mijamin.

H4327.d: from an unused root meaning to portion out; a sort, i.e. species; kind. Compare מִן.

H4328.d: properly, feminine passive participle of יָסַד; something founded, i.e. a foundation; foundation.

H4329.d: from סָכַךְ; a portico (as covered); covert.

H4330.d: from מוּץ; pressure; churning, forcing, wringing.

H4331.d: from מוּשׁ; departure; Mesha, a place in Arabia; also an Israelite; Mesha.

H4332.d: from מִי and אֵל with the abbreviated form insep. relatively (see אֲשֶׁר) interposed; who (is) what God (is) ?; Mishael, the name of three Israelites; Mishael.

H4333.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מִישָׁאֵל; Mishael, an Israelite; Mishael.

H4334.d: or מִישֹׁר; from יָשַׁר; a level, i.e. a plain (often used (with the article prefix) as a proper name of certain districts); figuratively, concord; also straightness, i.e. (figuratively) justice (sometimes adverbially, justly); equity, even place, plain, right(-eously), (made) straight, uprightness.

H4335.d: borrowed from מֵישַׁךְ; Meshak, an Israelite; Meshak.

H4336.d: (Aramaic) of foreign origin and doubtful significance; name of מִישָׁאֵל; Meshak, the Babylonian; Meshak.

H4337.d: from יָשַׁע; safety; Mesha, an Israelite; Mesha.

H4338.d: a variation for מֵישָׁע; safety; Mesha, a Moabite; Mesha.

H4339.d: from יָשַׁר; evenness, i.e. (figuratively) prosperity or concord; also straightness, i.e. (figuratively) rectitude (only in plural with singular sense; often adverbially); agreement, aright, that are equal, equity, (things that are) right(-eously, things), sweetly, upright(-ly, -ness).

H4340.d: from יָתַר; (compare יֶתֶר); a cord (of a tent); or the string (of a bow); cord, string.

H4341.d: sometimes מַכְאוֹב; also (feminine Isaiah 53:3) מַכְאֹבָה; from כָּאַב; anguish or (figuratively) affliction; grief, pain, sorrow.

H4342.d: transitive participle of כָּבַר; plenty; abundance.

H4343.d: from the same as כַּבּוֹן; knoll; Macbena, a place in Palestine settled by him; Machbenah.

H4344.d: patrial from מַכְבֵּנָא; a Macbannite or native of Macbena; Machbanai.

H4345.d: from כָּבַר in the sense of covering (compare כְּבָרָה); a grate; grate.

H4346.d: from כָּבַר in the sense of covering; (compare מַכְבֵּר); a cloth (as netted); thick cloth.

H4347.d: or (masculine) מַכֶּה; (plural only) from נָכָה; a blow (in 2 Chronicles 2:10, of the flail); by implication,; a wound; figuratively, carnage, also pestilence; beaten, blow, plague, slaughter, smote, [idiom] sore, stripe, stroke, wound(-ed).

H4348.d: from כָּוָה; a burn; that burneth, burning.

H4349.d: from כּוּן; properly, a fixture, i.e. a basis; generally a place, especially as an abode; foundation, habitation, (dwelling-, settled) place.

H4350.d: or מְכֹנָה; feminine of מָכוֹן; a pedestal, also a spot; base.

H4351.d: or מְכֹרָה; from the same as כּוּר in the sense of dipping; origin (as if a mine); birth, habitation, nativity.

H4352.d: probably from מוּךְ; pining; Maki, an Israelite; Machi.

H4353.d: from מָכַר; salesman; Makir, an Israelite; Machir.

H4354.d: patronymical from מָכִיר; a Makirite or descendant of Makir; of Machir.

H4355.d: a primitive root; to tumble (in ruins); figuratively, to perish; be brought low, decay.

H4356.d: or מִכְלָה; from כָּלָא; a pen (for flocks); (sheep-)fold. Compare מִכְלָה.

H4357.d: from כָּלָה; completion (in plural concrete adverbial, wholly); perfect. Compare מִכְלָאָה.

H4358.d: from כָּלַל; perfection (i.e. concrete adverbial, splendidly); most gorgeously, all sorts.

H4360.d: from כָּלַל; something perfect, i.e. a splendid garment; all sorts.

H4362.d: from the same as כַּמֹּן in the sense of hiding; treasure (as hidden); treasure.

H4363.d: (Ezra 2:2 or מִכְמָשׁ; or מִכְמַשׁ; (Nehemiah 11:31), from כָּמַס; hidden; Mikmas or Mikmash, a place in Palestine; Mikmas, Mikmash.

H4364.d: or מִכְמֹר; from כָּמַר in the sense of blackening by heat; a (hunter's) net (as dark from concealment); net.

H4365.d: or מִכְמֹרֶת; feminine of מַכְמָר; a (fisher's) net; drag, net.

H4366.d: apparently from an unused root meaning to hide; concealment; Mikmethath, a place in Palestine; Michmethath.

H4367.d: from מָה and נָדַב with a particle interposed; what (is) like (a) liberal (man) ?; Maknadbai, an Israelite; Machnadebai.

H4368.d: the same as מְכוֹנָה; a base; Mekonah, a place in Palestine; Mekonah.

H4369.d: the same as מְכוֹנָה; a spot; base.

H4370.d: from כָּמַס in the sense of hiding; (only in dual) drawers (from concealing the private parts); breeches.

H4371.d: probably from an unused root meaning to enumerate; an assessment (as based upon a census); tribute.

H4372.d: from כָּסָה; a covering, i.e. weatherboarding; covering.

H4373.d: feminine of מֶכֶס; an enumeration; by implication, a valuation; number, worth.

H4374.d: from כָּסָה; a covering, i.e. garment; specifically, a coverlet (for a bed), an awning (from the sun); also the omentum (as covering the intestines); clothing, to cover, that which covereth.

H4375.d: from כָּפַל; a fold; Makpelah, a place in Palestine; Machpelah.

H4376.d: a primitive root; to sell, literally (as merchandise, a daughter in marriage, into slavery), or figuratively (to surrender); [idiom] at all, sell (away, -er, self).

H4377.d: from מָכַר; merchandise; also value; pay, price, ware.

H4379.d: from כָּרָה; a pit (for salt); (salt-) pit.

H4380.d: probably from the same as כּוּר in the sense of stabbing; a sword; habitation.

H4381.d: from מָכַר; salesman; Mikri, an Israelite; Michri.

H4382.d: patrial from an unused name (the same as מְכֵרָה) of a place in Palestine; a Mekerathite, or inhabitant of Mekerah; Mecherathite.

H4383.d: or מִכְשֹׁל; masculine from כָּשַׁל; a stumbling-block, literally or figuratively (obstacle, enticement (specifically an idol), scruple); caused to fall, offence, [idiom] (no-) thing offered, ruin, stumbling-block.

H4384.d: feminine from כָּשַׁל; a stumbling-block, but only figuratively (fall, enticement (idol)); ruin, stumbling-block.

H4385.d: from כָּתַב; a thing written, the characters, or a document (letter, copy, edict, poem); writing.

H4387.d: from כָּתַם; an engraving, i.e. (techn.) a poem; Michtam.

H4388.d: from כָּתַשׁ; a mortar; by analogy, a socket (of a tooth); hollow place, mortar.

H4389.d: the same as מַכְתֵּשׁ; dell; the Maktesh, a place in Jerusalem; Maktesh.

H4390.d: or מָלָא; (Esther 7:5), a primitive root; to fill or (intransitively) be full of, in a wide application (literally and figuratively); accomplish, confirm, [phrase] consecrate, be at an end, be expired, be fenced, fill, fulfil, (be, become, [idiom] draw, give in, go) full(-ly, -ly set, tale), (over-) flow, fulness, furnish, gather (selves, together), presume, replenish, satisfy, set, space, take a (hand-) full, [phrase] have wholly.

H4391.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מָלֵא; to fill; fill, be full.

H4392.d: from מָלֵא; full (literally or figuratively) or filling (literally); also (concretely) fulness; adverbially, fully; [idiom] she that was with child, fill(-ed, -ed with), full(-ly), multitude, as is worth.

H4393.d: rarely מְלוֹא; or מְלוֹ; (Ezekiel [41:8), from מָלֵא; fulness (literally or figuratively); [idiom] all along, [idiom] all that is (there-) in, fill, ([idiom] that whereof...was) full, fulness, (hand-) full, multitude.

H4394.d: from מָלֵא; a fulfilling (only in plural), i.e. (literally) a setting (of gems), or (technically) consecration (also concretely, a dedicatory sacrifice); consecration, be set.

H4395.d: feminine of מָלֵא; something fulfilled, i.e. abundance (of produce); (first of ripe) fruit, fulness.

H4396.d: feminine of מִלֻּא; a filling, i.e. setting (of gems); enclosing, setting.

H4397.d: from an unused root meaning to despatch as a deputy; a messenger; specifically, of God, i.e. an angel (also a prophet, priest or teacher); ambassador, angel, king, messenger.

H4398.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מֲלְאָךְ; an angel; angel.
