H4399.d: from the same as מֲלְאָךְ; properly, deputyship, i.e. ministry; generally, employment (never servile) or work (abstractly or concretely); also property (as the result of labor); business, [phrase] cattle, [phrase] industrious, occupation, ([phrase] -pied), [phrase] officer, thing (made), use, (manner of) work((-man), -manship).

H4400.d: from the same as מֲלְאָךְ; a message; message.

H4401.d: xlit Malʻâkîy corrected to Malʼâkîy; from the same as מֲלְאָךְ; ministrative; Malaki, a prophet; Malachi.

H4402.d: from מָלֵא; fulness, i.e. (concretely) a plump socket (of the eye); [idiom] fitly.

H4403.d: or מַלְבֻּשׁ; from לָבַשׁ; a garment, or (collectively) clothing; apparel, raiment, vestment.

H4405.d: from מָלַל (plural masculine as if from מִלֶּה; a word; collectively, a discourse; figuratively, a topic; [phrase] answer, by-word, matter, any thing (what) to say, to speak(-ing), speak, talking, word.

H4406.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מִלָּה; a word, command, discourse, or subject; commandment, matter, thing. word.

H4407.d: or מִלֹּא; (2 Kings 12:20), from מָלֵא; a rampart (as filled in), i.e. the citadel; Millo. See also בֵּית מִלּוֹא.

H4408.d: lemma מַלוּחַ missing dagesh, corrected to מַלּוּחַ; from מָלַח; sea-purslain (from its saltness); mallows.

H4409.d: or מַלּוּכִי; (Nehemiah 12:14), from מָלַךְ; remnant; Malluk, the name of five Israelites; Malluch, Melichu (from the margin).

H4410.d: feminine passive participle of מָלַךְ; something ruled, i.e. a realm; kingsom, king's, [idiom] royal.

H4411.d: from לוּן; a lodgment, i.e. caravanserai or encampment; inn, place where...lodge, lodging (place).

H4412.d: feminine from לוּן; a hut, a hammock; cottage, lodge.

H4413.d: apparently from מָלַל; I have talked (i.e. loquacious); Mallothi, an Israelite; Mallothi.

H4414.d: a primitive root; also as denominative from מֶלַח; properly, to rub to pieces or pulverize; intransitively, to disappear as dust; to salt whether internally (to season with salt) or externally (to rub with salt); [idiom] at all, salt, season, temper together, vanish away.

H4415.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מָלַח; to eat salt, i.e. (generally) subsist; [phrase] have maintenance.

H4417.d: from מָלַח; properly, powder, i.e. (specifically) salt (as easily pulverized and dissolved); salt(-pit).

H4418.d: from מָלַח in its original sense; a rag or old garment; rotten rag.

H4419.d: from מָלַח in its second. sense; a sailor (as following 'the salt'); mariner.

H4420.d: from מָלַח (in its denominative sense); understood as land (אֶרֶץ); properly, salted (i.e. land), i.e. a desert; barren land(-ness), salt (land).

H4421.d: from לָחַם (in the sense of fighting); a battle (i.e. the engagement); generally, war (i.e. warfare); battle, fight(-ing), war(-rior).

H4422.d: a primitive root; properly, to be smooth, i.e. (by implication) to escape (as if by slipperiness); causatively, to release or rescue; specifically, to bring forth young, emit sparks; deliver (self), escape, lay, leap out, let alone, let go, preserve, save, [idiom] speedily, [idiom] surely.

H4423.d: from מָלַט,; cement (from its plastic smoothness); clay.

H4424.d: from מֶלֶט and יָהּ; (whom) Jah has delivered; Melatjah, a Gibeonite; Melatiah.

H4425.d: from מְלַל (in the sense of cropping (compare מוּל)); a head of grain (as cut off); ear.

H4426.d: from לוּץ; an aphorism; also a satire; interpretation, taunting.

H4427.d: a primitive root; to reign; inceptively, to ascend the throne; causatively, to induct into royalty; hence (by implication) to take counsel; consult, [idiom] indeed, be (make, set a, set up) king, be (make) queen, (begin to, make to) reign(-ing), rule, [idiom] surely.

H4428.d: from מָלַךְ; a king; king, royal.

H4429.d: the same as מֶלֶךְ; king; Melek, the name of two Israelites; Melech, Hammelech (by including the article).

H4430.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מֶלֶךְ; a king; king, royal.

H4431.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to מָלַךְ in the sense of consultation; advice; counsel.

H4432.d: from מָלַךְ; Molek (i.e. king), the chief deity of the Ammonites; Molech. Compare מַלְכָּם.

H4433.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מַלְכָּה; a queen; queen.

H4435.d: a form of מַלְכָּה; queen; Milcah, the name of a Hebrewess and of an Israelite; Milcah.

H4436.d: feminine of מֶלֶךְ; a queen; queen.

H4437.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מַלְכוּת; dominion (abstractly or concretely); kingdom, kingly, realm, reign.

H4438.d: or מַלְכֻת; or (in plural) מַלְכֻיָּה; from מָלַךְ; a rule; concretely, a dominion; empire, kingdom, realm, reign, royal.

H4439.d: from מֶלֶךְ and אֵל; king of (i.e. appointed by) God; Malkiel, an Israelite; Malchiel.

H4440.d: patronymical from מַלְכִּיאֵל; a Malkielite or descendant of Malkiel; Malchielite.

H4441.d: or מַלְכִּיָּהוּlemma מַלְכִּיָהוּ missing dagesh, corrected to מַלְכִּיָּהוּ; (Jeremiah [38:6), from מֶלֶךְ and יָהּ; king of (i.e. appointed by) Jah; Malkijah, the name of ten Israelites; Malchiah, Malchijah.

H4442.d: from מֶלֶךְ and צֶדֶק; king of right; Malki-Tsedek, an early king in Palestine; Melchizedek.

H4443.d: from מֶלֶךְ and רוּם; king of a high one (i.e. of exaltation); Malkiram, an Israelite; Malchiram.

H4444.d: from מֶלֶךְ and שׁוּעַ; king of wealth; Malkishua, an Israelite; Malchishua.

H4445.d: or מִלְכּוֹם; from מֶלֶךְ for מֹלֶךְ; Malcam or Milcom, the national idol of the Ammonites; Malcham, Milcom.

H4447.d: feminine active participle of מָלַךְ; queen; Moleketh, an Israelitess; Hammoleketh (including the article).

H4448.d: a primitive root; to speak (mostly poetical) or say; say, speak, utter.

H4449.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מָלַל; to speak; say, speak(-ing).

H4450.d: from מָלַל; talkative; Milalai, an Israelite; Milalai.

H4451.d: from לָמַד; a goad for oxen; goad.

H4452.d: a primitive root; to be smooth, i.e. (figuratively) pleasant; be sweet.

H4453.d: of Persian derivation; the butler or other officer in the Babylonian court; Melzar.

H4454.d: a primitive root; to crack a joint; by implication, to wring the neck of afowl (without separating it); wring off.

H4455.d: from לָקַח; transitively (in dual) the jaws (as taking food); intransitively, spoil (and captives) (as taken); booty, jaws, prey.

H4456.d: from לָקַשׁ; (compare לֶקֶשׁ); the spring rain; figuratively, eloquence; latter rain.

H4457.d: or מַלְקָח; from לָקַח; (only in dual) tweezers; snuffers, tongs.

H4458.d: from an unused root meaning to spread out; a wardrobe (i.e. room where clothing is spread); vestry.

H4459.d: transp. for מְתַלְּעָה; a grinder, i.e. back tooth; great tooth.

H4460.d: from מָגַר (in the sense of depositing); a granary; barn.

H4462.d: or (transp.) מוֹמֻכָן; (Esther 1:16), of Persian derivation; Memucan or Momucan, a Persian satrap; Memucan.

H4463.d: from מוּת; a mortal disease; concretely, a corpse; death.

H4464.d: from an unused root meaning to alienate; a mongrel, i.e. born of aJewish father and aheathen mother; bastard.

H4465.d: from מָכַר; merchandise; abstractly, a selling; [idiom] ought, (that which cometh of) sale, that which...sold, ware.

H4466.d: feminine of מִמְכָּר; a sale; [phrase] sold as.

H4467.d: from מָלַךְ; dominion, i.e. (abstractly) the estate (rule) or (concretely) the country (realm); kingdom, king's, reign, royal.

H4468.d: a form of מַמְלָכָה and equiv. to it; {dominion, i.e. (abstractly) the estate (rule) or (concretely) the country (realm)}; kingdom, reign.

H4469.d: from מָסַךְ; mixture, i.e. (specifically) wine mixed (with water or spices); drink-offering, mixed wine.

H4470.d: from an unused root meaning to grieve; sorrow; bitterness.

H4471.d: from מָרָא(in the sense of vigor); lusty; Mamre, an Amorite; Mamre.

H4472.d: from מָרַר; a bitterness, i.e. (figuratively) calamity; bitterness.

H4473.d: from מָשַׁח, in the sense of expansion; outspread (i.e. with outstretched wings); anointed.

H4474.d: from מָשַׁל; a ruler or (abstractly) rule; dominion, that ruled.

H4475.d: feminine of מִמְשָׁל; rule; also (concretely in plural) a realm or a ruler; dominion, government, power, to rule.

H4476.d: from the same as מֶשֶׁק; a possession; breeding.

H4477.d: from מָתַק; something sweet (literally or figuratively); (most) sweet.

H4478.d: from מָה; literally a whatness (so to speak), i.e. manna (so called from the question about it); manna.

H4479.d: (Aramaic) from מָה; who or what (properly, interrogatively, hence, also indefinitely and relatively); what, who(-msoever, [phrase] -so).

H4480.d: or מִנִּי; or מִנֵּי; (constructive plural) (Isaiah 30:11); for מֵן; properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses; above, after, among, at, because of, by (reason of), from (among), in, [idiom] neither, [idiom] nor, (out) of, over, since, [idiom] then, through, [idiom] whether, with.

H4481.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מִן; {properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of}; according, after, [phrase] because, [phrase] before, by, for, from, [idiom] him, [idiom] more than, (out) of, part, since, [idiom] these, to, upon, [phrase] when.

H4482.d: from an unused root meaning to apportion; a part; hence,; a musical chord (as parted into strings); in (the same) (Psalm 68:23), stringed instrument (Psalm 150:4), whereby (Psalm 45:8 (defective plural)).

H4483.d: (Aramaic) or מְנָה; (Aramaic), corresponding to מָנָה; to count, appoint; number, ordain, set.

H4484.d: xlit menêʼ corrected to mᵉnêʼ; (Aramaic) passive participle of מְנָא; numbered; Mene.

H4486.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מַדָּע; wisdom or intelligence; knowledge, reason, understanding.

H4487.d: a primitive root; properly, to weigh out; by implication, to allot or constitute officially; also to enumerate or enroll; appoint, count, number, prepare, set, tell.

H4488.d: from מָנָה; properly, a fixed weight or measured amount, i.e. (techn.) a maneh or mina; maneh, pound.

H4489.d: from מָנָה; properly, something weighed out, i.e. (figuratively) a portion of time, i.e. an instance; time.

H4490.d: from מָנָה; properly, something weighed out, i.e. (generally) a division; specifically (of food) a ration; also a lot; such things as belonged, part, portion.

H4491.d: from נָהַג; the driving (of a chariot); driving.

H4492.d: from נָהַר; properly, a channel or fissure, i.e. (by implication) a cavern; den.

H4493.d: from נוּד; a nodding or toss (of the head in derision); shaking.

H4494.d: from נוּחַ; quiet, i.e. (concretely) a settled spot, or (figuratively) a home; (place of) rest.

H4495.d: the same as מָנוֹחַ; rest; Manoach, an Israelite; Manoah.

H4496.d: or מְנֻחָה; feminine of מָנוֹחַ; repose or (adverbially) peacefully; figuratively, consolation (specifically, matrimony); hence (concretely) an abode; comfortable, ease, quiet, rest(-ing place), still.

H4497.d: from נוּן; a continuator, i.e. heir; son.

H4498.d: from נוּס; a retreat (literally or figuratively); abstractly, a fleeing; [idiom] apace, escape, way to flee, flight, refuge.

H4499.d: or מְנֻסָה; feminine of מָנוֹס; retreat; fleeing, flight.

H4500.d: from נִיר; a yoke (properly, for plowing), i.e. the frame of aloom; beam.

H4501.d: or מְנֹרָה; feminine of מָנוֹר (in the original sense of נִיר); a chandelier; candlestick.

H4503.d: from an unused root meaning to apportion, i.e. bestow; a donation; euphemistically, tribute; specifically a sacrificial offering (usually bloodless and voluntary); gift, oblation, (meat) offering, present, sacrifice.

H4504.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מִנְחָה; a sacrificial offering; oblation, meat offering.

H4505.d: from נָחַם; comforter; Menachem, an Israelite; Menahem.

H4506.d: from נוּחַ; rest; Manachath, the name of an Edomite and of a place in Moab; Manahath.

H4507.d: from מָנָה; the Apportioner, i.e. Fate (as an idol); number.

H4508.d: of foreign derivation; Minni, an Armenian province; Minni.

H4509.d: from מִן and יָמִין; from (the) right hand; Minjamin, the name of two Israelites; Miniamin. Compare מִיָּמִן.

H4511.d: from the same as מֵן; enumeration; Minnith, a place East of the Jordan; Minnith.

H4512.d: from נָלָה; completion, i.e. (in produce) wealth; perfection.

H4513.d: a primitive root; to debar (negatively or positively) from benefit or injury; deny, keep (back), refrain, restrain, withhold.

H4514.d: or מַנְעֻל; from נָעַל; a bolt; lock.

H4515.d: xlit manʻâl corrected to minʻâl; from נָעַל; a bolt; shoe.

H4517.d: from נוּעַ; a sistrum (so called from its rattling sound); cornet.

H4518.d: from נָקָה; a sacrificial basin (for holding blood); bowl.

H4519.d: from נָשָׁה; causing to forget; Menashsheh, a grandson of Jacob, also the tribe descended from him, and its territory; Manasseh.

H4520.d: from מְנַשֶּׁה; a Menashshite or descendant of Menashsheh; of Manasseh, Manassites.

H4521.d: from מָנָה; an allotment (by courtesy, law or providence); portion.

H4522.d: or מִס; from מָסַס; properly, a burden (as causing to faint), i.e. a tax in the form of forced labor; discomfited, levy, task(-master), tribute(-tary).

H4523.d: from מָסַס; fainting, i.e. (figuratively) disconsolate; is afflicted.

H4524.d: plural masculine מְסִבִּים; or feminine מְסִבּוֹת; from סָבַב; a divan (as enclosing the room); abstractly (adverbial) around; that compass about, (place) round about, at table.

H4525.d: from סָגַר; a fastener, i.e. (of a person) a smith, (of a thing) a prison; prison, smith.

H4526.d: from סָגַר; something enclosing, i.e. a margin (of a region, of a panel); concretely, a stronghold; border, close place, hole.

H4528.d: from the same as סֶדֶר; a colonnade or internal portico (from its rows of pillars); porch.

H4529.d: a primitive root; to dissolve; make to consume away, (make to) melt, water.

H4530.d: from מָסַס (in the sense of flowing); abundance, i.e. (adverbially) liberally; tribute.

H4531.d: from נָסָה; a testing, of men (judicial) or of God (querulous); temptation, trial.

H4532.d: the same as מַסָּה; Massah, a place in the Desert; Massah.

H4533.d: apparently from an unused root meaning to cover; a veil; vail.

H4534.d: for מְשׂוּכָה; a hedge; thorn hedge.

H4535.d: from נָסַח in the sense of staving off; a cordon, (adverbially) or (as a) military barrier; broken down.

H4537.d: a primitive root; to mix, especially wine (with spices); mingle.

H4538.d: from מָסַךְ; a mixture, i.e. of wine with spices; mixture.

H4539.d: from סָכַךְ; a cover, i.e. veil; covering, curtain, hanging.

H4540.d: from סָכַךְ; a covering, i.e. garniture; covering.

H4541.d: from נָסַךְ; properly, a pouring over, i.e. fusion of metal (especially a cast image); by implication, a libation, i.e. league; concretely a coverlet (as if poured out); covering, molten (image), vail.

H4543.d: by transp. from כָּנַס; a magazine; store(-house), treasure.

H4545.d: from נָסַךְ in the sense of spreading out; something expanded, i.e. the warp in aloom (as stretched out to receive the woof); web.

H4546.d: from סָלַל; a thoroughfare (as turnpiked), literally or figuratively; specifically a viaduct, a staircase; causeway, course, highway, path, terrace.

H4547.d: from סָלַל; a thoroughfare (as turnpiked); highway.

H4548.d: or מִסְמֵר; also (feminine) מַסְמְרָה; or מִסְמְרָה; or even מַשְׂמְרָה; (Ecclesiastes 12:11), from סָמַר; a peg (as bristling from the surface); nail.

H4549.d: a primitive root; to liquefy; figuratively, to waste (with disease), to faint (with fatigue, fear or grief); discourage, faint, be loosed, melt (away), refuse, [idiom] utterly.

H4550.d: from נָסַע; a departure (from striking the tents), i.e. march (not necessarily a single day's travel); by implication, a station (or point of departure); journey(-ing).

H4551.d: from נָסַע in the sense of projecting; a missile (spear or arrow); also a quarry (whence stones are, as it were, ejected); before it was brought, dart.

H4552.d: ' from סָעַד; a balustrade (for stairs); pillar.

H4553.d: from סָפַד; a lamentation; lamentation, one mourneth, mourning, wailing.

H4554.d: from an unused root meaning to collect; fodder; provender.

H4555.d: from סָפַח; a veil (as spread out); kerchief.

H4556.d: from סָפַח; scruf (as spreading over the surface); scab.

H4557.d: from סָפַר; a number, definite (arithmetical) or indefinite (large, innumerable; small, a few); also (abstractly) narration; [phrase] abundance, account, [idiom] all, [idiom] few, (in-) finite, (certain) number(-ed), tale, telling, [phrase] time.

H4558.d: the same as מֶלְקָח; number; Mispar, an Israelite; Mizpar. Compare מִסְפֶּרֶת.

H4559.d: feminine of מַלְכוּ; enumeration; Mispereth, an Israelite; Mispereth. Compare מֶלְתָּחָה.

H4560.d: a primitive root; to sunder, i.e. (transitively) set apart, or (reflex.) apostatize; commit, deliver.

H4564.d: from סָתַר; properly, a hider, i.e. (abstractly) a hiding, i.e. aversion; hid.

H4565.d: from סָתַר; properly, a concealer, i.e. a covert; secret(-ly, place).

H4567.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מַעְבָּד; an act; work.

H4568.d: from עָבָה; properly, compact (part of soil), i.e. loam; clay.

H4569.d: or feminine מַעֲבָרָה; from עָבַר; a crossing-place (of a river, a ford; of a mountain, a pass); abstractly, a transit, i.e. (figuratively) overwhelming; ford, place where...pass, passage.

H4570.d: or feminine מַעְגָּלָה; from the same as עָגֹל; a track (literally or figuratively); also a rampart (as circular); going, path, trench, way(-side).

H4571.d: a primitive root; to waver; make to shake, slide, slip.

H4572.d: from עָדָה; ornamental; Maadai, an Israelite; Maadai.

H4573.d: from עָדָה and יָהּ; ornament of Jah; Maadjah, an Israelite; Maadiah. Compare מוֹעַדְיָה.

H4574.d: or (feminine) מַעֲדַנָּה; from עָדַן; a delicacy or (abstractly) pleasure (adverbially, cheerfully); dainty, delicately, delight.

H4575.d: by transitive from עָנַד; a bond, i.e. group; influence.

H4577.d: (Aramaic) or מְעָא; (Aramaic), corresponding to מֵעֶהxlit mêʻâh corrected to mêʻeh; only in plural the bowels; belly.

H4578.d: xlit mêʻâh corrected to mêʻeh; from an unused root probably meaning to be soft; used only in plural the intestines, or (collectively) the abdomen, figuratively, sympathy; by implication, a vest; by extension the stomach, the uterus (or of men, the seat of generation), the heart (figuratively); belly, bowels, [idiom] heart, womb.

H4579.d: feminine of מֵעֶהxlit mêʻâh corrected to mêʻeh; the belly, i.e. (figuratively) interior; gravel.

H4580.d: from עוּג; also with לָעֵג a table-buffoon, i.e.; a cake of bread; parasite; cake, feast.

H4581.d: (also מָעוּז ); or מָעֹז (also מָעֻז; from עָזַז; a fortified place; figuratively, a defence; force, fort(-ress), rock, strength(-en), ([idiom] most) strong (hold).

H4582.d: from מָעַךְ; oppressed; Maok, a Philistine; Maoch.

H4583.d: or מָעִין; (1 Chronicles 4:41), from the same as עוֹנָה; an abode, of God (the Tabernacle or the Temple), men (their home) or animals (their lair); hence, a retreat (asylum); den, dwelling((-) place), habitation.

H4584.d: the same as מָעוֹן; a residence; Maon, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine; Maon, Maonites. Compare בֵּית בַּעַל מְעוֹן, מְעוּנִיlemma מְעוּנָי third vowel, corrected to מְעוּנִי.

H4585.d: or מְעֹנָה; feminine of מָעוֹן, and meaning the same; {an abode, of God (the Tabernacle or the Temple), men (their home) or animals (their lair); hence, a retreat (asylum)}; den, habitation, (dwelling) place, refuge.

H4586.d: lemma מְעוּנָי third vowel, corrected to מְעוּנִי; or מְעִינִי; probably patrial from מָעוֹן; a Meunite, or inhabitant of Maon (only in plural); Mehunim(-s), Meunim.

H4587.d: plural of מְעוֹנָה; habitative; Meonothai, an Israelite; Meonothai.

H4588.d: from עוּף in the sense of covering with shade (compare מוּעָף); darkness; dimness.

H4589.d: from עוּר; nakedness, i.e. (in plural) the pudenda; nakedness.

H4590.d: or מַעַזְיָהוּ; probably from עוּז (in the sense of protection) and יָהּ; rescue of Jah; Maazjah, the name of two Israelites; Maaziah.

H4591.d: a primitive root; properly, to pare off, i.e. lessen; intransitively, to be (or causatively, to make) small or few (or figuratively, ineffective); suffer to decrease, diminish, (be, [idiom] borrow a, give, make) few (in number, -ness), gather least (little), be (seem) little, ([idiom] give the) less, be minished, bring to nothing.

H4592.d: or מְעָט; from מָעַט; a little or few (often adverbial or compar.); almost (some, very) few(-er, -est), lightly, little (while), (very) small (matter, thing), some, soon, [idiom] very.

H4593.d: passive adjective of מָעַט; thinned (as to the edge), i.e. sharp; wrapped up.

H4596.d: from עָוָה; (compare עִי); a pile of rubbish (as contorted), i.e. a ruin; heap.

H4597.d: xlit Mâʻai corrected to Mâʻay; probably from מֵעֶהxlit mêʻâh corrected to mêʻeh; sympathetic; Maai, an Israelite; Maai.

H4598.d: from מָעַל in the sense of covering; a robe (i.e. upper and outer garment); cloke, coat, mantle, robe.

H4599.d: or מַעְיְנוֹ; (Psalm 114:8), or (feminine) מַעְיָנָה; from עַיִן (as a denominative in the sense of a spring); a fountain (also collectively), figuratively, a source (of satisfaction); fountain, spring, well.

H4600.d: a primitive root; to press, i.e. to pierce, emasculate, handle; bruised, stuck, be pressed.

H4601.d: or מַעֲכָת; (Joshua 13:13), from מָעַךְ; depression; Maakah (or Maakath), the name of a place in Syria, also of a Mesopotamian, of three Israelites, and of four Israelitesses and one Syrian woman; Maachah, Maachathites. See also בֵּית מַעֲכָה.

H4602.d: patrial from מַעֲכָה; a Maakathite, or inhabitant of Maakah; Maachathite.

H4603.d: a primitive root; properly, to cover up; used only figuratively, to act covertly, i.e. treacherously; transgress, (commit, do a) trespass(-ing).

H4604.d: from מָעַל; treachery, i.e. sin; falsehood, grievously, sore, transgression, trespass, [idiom] very.

H4605.d: from עָלָה; properly, the upper part, used only adverbially with prefix upward, above, overhead, from the top, etc.; above, exceeding(-ly), forward, on ([idiom] very) high, over, up(-on, -ward), very.

H4606.d: (Aramaic) from עֲלַל; (only in plural as singular) the setting (of the sun); going down.

H4607.d: from עָלָה; a raising (of the hands); lifting up.

H4608.d: from עָלָה; an elevation, i.e. (concretely) acclivity or platform; abstractly (the relation or state) a rise or (figuratively) priority; ascent, before, chiefest, cliff, that goeth up, going up, hill, mounting up, stairs.

H4609.d: feminine of מַעֲלֶה; elevation, i.e. the act (literally, a journey to a higher place, figuratively, a thought arising), or (concretely) the condition (literally, a step or grademark, figuratively, a superiority of station); specifically a climactic progression (in certain Psalms); things that come up, (high) degree, deal, go up, stair, step, story.

H4610.d: from מַעֲלֶה and (the plural of) עַקְרָב; Steep of Scorpions, a place in the Desert; Maaleh-accrabim, the ascent (going up) of Akrabbim.

H4611.d: from עָלַל; an act (good or bad); doing, endeavour, invention, work.

H4612.d: from עָמַד; (figuratively) a position; attendance, office, place, state.

H4613.d: from עָמַד; literally a foothold; standing.

H4615.d: from עָמַק; a deep; deep, depth.

H4616.d: from עָנָה; properly, heed, i.e. purpose; used only adverbially, on account of (as a motive or an aim), teleologically, in order that; because of, to the end (intent) that, for (to,... 's sake), [phrase] lest, that, to.

H4617.d: from עָנָה; a reply (favorable or contradictory); answer, [idiom] himself.

H4618.d: from עָנָה, in the sense of depression or tilling; a furrow; [phrase] acre, furrow.

H4619.d: from עָצָה; closure; Maats, an Israelite; Maaz.

H4621.d: from an unused root meaning to hew; an axe; ax, tongs.

H4622.d: from עָצָר; objectively, a hindrance; restraint.

H4624.d: from an unused root meaning to repress; a parapet; battlement.

H4625.d: from עָקַשׁ; a crook (in a road); crooked thing.

H4626.d: from עָרָה; a nude place, i.e. (literally) the pudenda, or (figuratively) a vacant space; nakedness, proportion.

H4627.d: from עָרַב, in the sense of trading; traffic; by implication, mercantile goods; market, merchandise.

H4628.d: or (feminine) מַעֲרָבָה; from עָרַב, in the sense of shading; the west (as a region of the evening sun); west.

H4629.d: from עָרָה; a nude place, i.e. a common; meadows.

H4630.d: feminine of מַעֲרֶה; an open spot; army (from the margin).

H4631.d: from עוּר; a cavern (as dark); cave, den, hole.

H4632.d: the same as מְעָרָה; cave; Mearah, a place in Palestine; Mearah.

H4633.d: from עָרַךְ; an arrangement, i.e. (figuratively) mental disposition; preparation.

H4634.d: feminine of מַעֲרָךְ; an arrangement; concretely, a pile; specifically a military array; army, fight, be set in order, ordered place, rank, row.

H4635.d: from עָרַךְ; an arrangement, i.e. (concretely) a pile (of loaves); row, shewbread.

H4636.d: from עָרַם, in the sense of stripping; bare; naked.

H4638.d: a form of מַעֲרָה; waste; Maarath, a place in Palestine; Maarath.

H4639.d: from עָשָׂה; an action (good or bad); generally, a transaction; abstractly, activity; by implication, a product (specifically, a poem) or (generally) property; act, art, [phrase] bakemeat, business, deed, do(-ing), labor, thing made, ware of making, occupation, thing offered, operation, possession, [idiom] well, (handy-, needle-, net-) work(ing, -manship), wrought.

H4640.d: xlit Maʻsay corrected to Maʻăsay; from עָשָׂה; operative; Maasai, an Israelite; Maasiai.

H4641.d: or מַעֲשֵׂיָהוּ; from מַעֲשֶׂה and יָהּ; work of Jah; Maasejah, the name of sixteen Israelites; Maaseiah.

H4643.d: or מַעֲשַׂר; and (in plural) feminine מַעַשְׂרָה; from עָשָׂר; a tenth; especially a tithe; tenth (part), tithe(-ing).

H4644.d: of Egyptian origin; Moph, the capital of Lower Egypt; Memphis. Compare נֹף.

H4645.d: from פָּגַע; an object of attack; mark.

H4646.d: from נָפַח; a breathing out (of life), i.e. expiring; giving up.

H4647.d: from נָפַח; the bellows (i.e. blower) of aforge; bellows.

H4648.d: or מְפִבֹשֶׁת; probably from פָּאָה and בֹּשֶׁת; dispeller of shame (i.e. of Baal); Mephibosheth, the name of two Israelites; Mephibosheth.

H4649.d: a plural apparently from נוּף; wavings; Muppim, an Israelite; Muppim. Compare שֻׁפִּים.

H4650.d: from פּוּץ; a breaker, i.e. mallet; maul.

H4651.d: from נָפַל; a falling off, i.e. chaff; also something pendulous, i.e. a flap; flake, refuse.

H4652.d: from פָּלָא; a miracle; wondrous work.

H4654.d: or מַפֵּלָה; from נָפַל; something fallen, i.e. a ruin; ruin(-ous).

H4656.d: from פָּלַץ; a terror, i.e. an idol; idol.

H4657.d: from an unused root meaning to balance; a poising; balancing.

H4658.d: from נָפַל; fall, i.e. decadence; concretely, a ruin; specifically a carcase; carcase, fall, ruin.

H4659.d: or (feminine) מִפְעָלָה; from פָּעַל; a performance; work.

H4660.d: from נָפַץ; a smiting to pieces; slaughter.

H4661.d: from נָפַץ; a smiter, i.e. a war club; battle ax.

H4662.d: from פָּקַד; an appointment, i.e. mandate; concretely, a designated spot; specifically, a census; appointed place, commandment, number.

H4663.d: the same as מִפְקָד; assignment; Miphkad, the name of a gate in Jerusalem; Miphkad.

H4664.d: from פָּרַץlemma פּרַץ missing vowel, corrected to פָּרַץ; a break (in the shore), i.e. a haven; breach.

H4665.d: xlit miphreketh corrected to miphreqeth; from פָּרַק; properly, a fracture, i.e. joint (vertebrae) of the neck; neck.

H4666.d: from פָּרַשׂ; an expansion; that which...spreadest forth, spreading.

H4667.d: from פָּשַׂע; a stride, i.e. (by euphemism) the crotch; buttocks.

H4668.d: from פָּתַח; an opener, i.e. a key; key.

H4669.d: from פָּתַח; an aperture, i.e. (figuratively) utterance; opening.

H4670.d: from the same as פֶּתֶן; a stretcher, i.e. a sill; threshold.

H4671.d: or מוֹץ; (Zephaniah 2:2), from מוּץ; chaff (as pressed out, i.e. winnowed or (rather) threshed loose); chaff.

H4672.d: a primitive root; properly, to come forth to, i.e. appear or exist; transitively, to attain, i.e. find or acquire; figuratively, to occur, meet or be present; [phrase] be able, befall, being, catch, [idiom] certainly, (cause to) come (on, to, to hand), deliver, be enough (cause to) find(-ing, occasion, out), get (hold upon), [idiom] have (here), be here, hit, be left, light (up-) on, meet (with), [idiom] occasion serve, (be) present, ready, speed, suffice, take hold on.

H4673.d: from נָצַב; a fixed spot; figuratively, an office, a military post; garrison, station, place where...stood.

H4674.d: from נָצַב; a station, i.e. military post; mount.

H4675.d: or מִצָּבָה; feminine of מַצָּב; a military guard; army, garrison.

H4676.d: feminine (causatively) participle of נָצַב; something stationed, i.e. a column or (memorial stone); by analogy, an idol; garrison, (standing) image, pillar.

H4677.d: apparently from מָצָא and יָהּ; found of Jah; Metsobajah, a place in Palestine; Mesobaite.

H4678.d: from נָצַב; something stationary, i.e. a monumental stone; also the stock of atree; pillar, substance.

H4679.d: or מְצָד; or (feminine) מְצָדָה; from צוּד; a fastness (as a covert of ambush); castle, fort, (strong) hold, munition.

H4680.d: a primitive root; to suck out; by implication, to drain, to squeeze out; suck, wring (out).

H4681.d: active participle feminine of מָצָה; drained; Motsah, a place in Palestine; Mozah.

H4682.d: from מָצַץ in the sense of greedily devouring for sweetness; properly, sweetness; concretely, sweet (i.e. not soured or bittered with yeast); specifically, an unfermented cake or loaf, or (elliptically) the festival of Passover (because no leaven was then used); unleaved (bread, cake), without leaven.

H4683.d: from נָצָה; a quarrel; contention, debate, strife.

H4684.d: from צָהַל; a whinnying (through impatience for battle or lust); neighing.

H4685.d: or (feminine) מְצוֹדָה; or מצֹדָה; from צוּד; also (by interchange for מְצַד); a net (for capturing animals or fishes);  afastness or (beseiging) tower; bulwark, hold, munition, net, snare.

H4686.d: or (feminine) מְצוּדָה; or מְצֻדָה; for מָצוֹד; a net, or (abstractly) capture; also a fastness; castle, defense, fort(-ress), (strong) hold, be hunted, net, snare, strong place.

H4687.d: from צָוָה; a command, whether human or divine (collectively, the Law); (which was) commanded(-ment), law, ordinance, precept.

H4688.d: or מְצֹלָה; also מְצוּלָה; or מְצֻלָה; from the same as צוּלָה; a deep place (of water or mud); bottom, deep, depth.

H4689.d: from צוּק; a narrow place, i.e. (abstractly and figuratively) confinement or disability; anguish, distress, straitness.

H4690.d: or מָצֻק; from צוּק; something narrow, i.e. a column or hilltop; pillar, situate.

H4691.d: or מְצֻקָה; feminine of מָצוּק; narrowness, i.e. (figuratively) trouble; anguish, distress.

H4692.d: or מָצוּר; from צוּר; something hemming in, i.e. (objectively) a mound (of besiegers), (abstractly) a siege, (figuratively) distress; or (subjectively) a fastness; besieged, bulwark, defence, fenced, fortress, siege, strong (hold), tower.

H4693.d: the same as מָצוֹר in the sense of a limit; Egypt (as the border of Palestine); besieged places, defense, fortified.

H4694.d: or מְצֻרָה; feminine of מָצוֹר; a hemming in, i.e. (objectively) a mound (of siege), or (subjectively) a rampart (of protection), (abstractly) fortification; fenced (city, fort, munition, strong hold.

H4695.d: from נָצָה; a quarrel; that contended.

H4696.d: from an unused root meaning to be clear, i.e. conspicuous; the forehead (as open and prominent); brow, forehead, [phrase] impudent.

H4697.d: from the same as מֵצַח; a shinpiece of armor (as prominent), only plural; greaves.

H4698.d: from צָלַל; a tinkler, i.e. a bell; bell.

H4700.d: from צָלַל; (only dual) double tinklers, i.e. cymbals; cymbals.

H4701.d: from צָנַף; a tiara, i.e. official turban (of a king or high priest); diadem, mitre.

H4703.d: from צָעַד; a step; figuratively, companionship; going, step.

H4704.d: feminine of מִצְעָר; properly, littleness; concretely, diminutive; little.

H4705.d: from צָעַר; petty (in size or number); adverbially, a short (time); little one (while), small.

H4706.d: the same as מִצְעָר; Mitsar, a peak of Lebanon; Mizar.

H4707.d: from צָפָה; an observatory, especially formilitary purposes; watch tower.

H4708.d: the same as מִצְפֶּה; Mitspeh, the name of five places in Palestine; Mizpeh, watch tower. Compare מִצְפָּה.

H4709.d: feminine of מִצְפֶּה; Mitspah, the name of two places in Palestine; Mitspah. (This seems rather to be only an orthographic variation of מִצְפֶּה when 'in pause'.)

H4710.d: from צָפַן; a secret (place or thing, perhaps, treasure); hidden thing.

H4711.d: a primitive root; to suck; milk.

H4712.d: from קֵבָה; something tight, i.e. (figuratively) trouble; distress, pain, strait.

H4713.d: from מִצְרַיִם; a Mitsrite, or inhabitant of Mitsrajim; Egyptian, of Egypt.

H4714.d: dual of מָצוֹר; Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt; Egypt, Egyptians, Mizraim.

H4715.d: from צָרַף; a crucible; fining pot.

H4716.d: from מָקַק; properly, a melting, i.e. putridity; rottenness, stink.

H4717.d: from נָקַב; properly, a perforatrix, i.e. a hammer (as piercing); hammer.

H4718.d: from נָקַב; properly, a perforator, i.e. a hammer (as piercing); also (intransitively) a perforation, i.e. a quarry; hammer, hole.

H4719.d: from the same as נָקֹד in the denominative sense of herding (compare נֹקֵד); fold; Makkedah, a place in Palestine; Makkedah.

H4720.d: or מִקְּדָשׁ; (Exodus 15:17), from קָדַשׁ; a consecrated thing or place, especially, a palace, sanctuary (whether of Jehovah or of idols) or asylum; chapel, hallowed part, holy place, sanctuary.

H4721.d: or (feminine) מַקְהֵלָה; from קָהַל; an assembly; congregation.

H4722.d: plural of מַקְהֵל (feminine); assemblies; Makheloth, a place in the Desert; Makheloth.

H4723.d: or מִקְוֵה; (1 Kings 10:28), or מִקְוֵאlemma מִּקְוֵא extra dagesh, corrected to מִקְוֵא; (2 Chronicles 1:16), from קָוָה; something waited for, i.e. confidence (objective or subjective); also a collection, i.e. (of water) a pond, or (of men and horses) a caravan or drove; abiding, gathering together, hope, linen yarn, plenty (of water), pool.

H4724.d: feminine of מִקְוֶה; a collection, i.e. (of water) a reservoir; ditch.

H4725.d: or מָקֹם; also (feminine) מְקוֹמָה; or מְקֹמָה; from קוּם; properly, a standing, i.e. a spot; but used widely of a locality (general or specific); also (figuratively) of a condition (of body or mind); country, [idiom] home, [idiom] open, place, room, space, [idiom] whither(-soever).

H4726.d: or מָקֹר; from קוּר; properly, something dug, i.e. a (general) source (of water, even when naturally flowing; also of tears, blood (by euphemism, of the female pudenda); figuratively, of happiness, wisdom, progeny); fountain, issue, spring, well(-spring).

H4728.d: from לָקַח; something received, i.e. merchandise (purchased); ware.

H4729.d: from קָטַר; something to fume (incense) on i.e. a hearth place; to burn...upon.

H4730.d: feminine of מִקְטָר; something to fume (incense) in, i.e. a coal-pan; censer.

H4731.d: or (feminine) מַקְּלָה; from an unused root meaning apparently to germinate; a shoot, i.e. stick (with leaves on, or for walking, striking, guiding, divining); rod, (hand-)staff.

H4732.d: (or perhaps mik-kel-ohth') plural of (feminine) מַקֵּל; rods; Mikloth, a place in the Desert; Mikloth.

H4733.d: from קָלַט in the sense of taking in; an asylum (as a receptacle); refuge.

H4734.d: from קָלַע; a sculpture (probably in bas-relief); carved (figure), carving, graving.

H4735.d: from קָנָה; something bought, i.e. property, but only livestock; abstractly, acquisition; cattle, flock, herd, possession, purchase, substance.

H4736.d: feminine of מִקְנֶה; properly, a buying, i.e. acquisition; concretely, a piece of property (land or living); also the sum paid; (he that is) bought, possession, piece, purchase.

H4737.d: from מִקְנֶה and יָהּ; possession of Jah; Miknejah, an Israelite; Mikneiah.

H4739.d: from קָצַץ; end; Makats, a place in Palestine; Makaz.

H4740.d: or מַקְצֹעַ; or (feminine) מַקְצֹעָה; from קָצַע in the denominative sense of bending; an angle or recess; corner, turning.

H4741.d: from קָצַע; a scraper, i.e. a carving chisel; plane.

H4742.d: from קָצַע in the denominative sense of bending; an angle; corner.

H4743.d: ' a primitive root; to melt; figuratively, to flow, dwindle, vanish; consume away, be corrupt, dissolve, pine away.

H4744.d: from קָרָא; something called out, i.e. a public meeting (the act, the persons, or the place); also a rehearsal; assembly, calling, convocation, reading.

H4745.d: from קָרָה; something met with, i.e. an accident or fortune; something befallen, befalleth, chance, event, hap(-peneth).

H4746.d: from קָרָה; properly, something meeting, i.e. a frame (of timbers); building.

H4747.d: from the same as קַר; a cooling off; [idiom] summer.

H4748.d: from קָשָׁה in the sense of knotting up round and hard; something turned (rounded), i.e. a curl (of tresses); [idiom] well (set) hair.

H4749.d: feminine of מִקְשֶׁה; rounded work, i.e. moulded by hammering (repousse); beaten (out of one piece, work), upright, whole piece.

H4750.d: denominative from קִשֻּׁא; literally a cucumbered field, i.e. a cucumber patch; garden of cucumbers.

H4751.d: or (feminine) מָרָה; from מָרַר; bitter (literally or figuratively); also (as noun) bitterness, or (adverbially) bitterly; [phrase] angry, bitter(-ly, -ness), chafed, discontented, [idiom] great, heavy.

H4752.d: from מָרַר in its original sense of distillation; a drop; drop.

H4753.d: or מוֹר; from מָרַר; myrrh (as distilling in drops, and also as bitter); myrrh.

H4754.d: a primitive root; to rebel; hence (through the idea of maltreating) to whip, i.e. lash (self with wings, as the ostrich in running); be filthy, lift up self.

H4755.d: for מַר feminine; bitter; Mara, a symbolic name of Naomi; Mara.

H4756.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to מָרָא in the sense of domineering; a master; lord, Lord.

H4757.d: of foreign derivation; Merodak-Baladan, a Babylonian king; Merodach-baladan. Compare מְרֹדָךְ.

H4758.d: from רָאָה; a view (the act of seeing); also an appearance (the thing seen), whether (real) a shape (especially if handsome, comeliness; often plural the looks), or (mental) a vision; [idiom] apparently, appearance(-reth), [idiom] as soon as beautiful(-ly), countenance, fair, favoured, form, goodly, to look (up) on (to), look(-eth), pattern, to see, seem, sight, visage, vision.

H4759.d: feminine of מַרְאֶה; a vision; also (causatively) a mirror; looking glass, vision.

H4760.d: apparently feminine passive causative participle of רָאָה; something conspicuous, i.e. the craw of abird (from its prominence); crop.

H4761.d: denominative from רֹאשׁ; properly, headship, i.e. (plural for collective) dominion; principality.

H4762.d: or מַרֵשָׁה; formed like מַרְאָשָׁה; summit; Mareshah, the name of two Israelites and of a place in Palestine; Mareshah.

H4763.d: formed like מַרְאָשָׁה; properly, a headpiece, i.e. (plural for adverbial) at (or as) the head-rest (or pillow); bolster, head, pillow. Compare מַרְגְלָה.

H4764.d: from רָבַב; increase; Merab, a daughter of Saul; Merab.

H4765.d: from רָבַד; a coverlet; covering of tapestry.

H4766.d: from רָבָה; properly, increasing; as noun, greatness, or (adverbially) greatly; great, increase.

H4767.d: from רָבָה; abundance, i.e. a great quantity; much.

H4768.d: from רָבָה; a multitude; also offspring; specifically interest (on capital); greatest part, greatness, increase, multitude.

H4769.d: from רָבַץ; a reclining place, i.e. fold (for flocks); couching place, place to lie down.

H4770.d: from an unused root meaning to tie up; a stall (for cattle); [idiom] fat(-ted), stall.

H4771.d: from רָגַע; a resting place; rest.

H4772.d: denominative from רֶגֶל; (plural for collective) a footpiece, i.e. (adverbially) at the foot, or (direct.) the foot itself; feet. Compare מְרַאֲשָׁה.

H4775.d: a primitive root; to rebel; rebel(-lious).

H4776.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to מָרַד; rebellion; rebellion.

H4778.d: the same as מֶרֶד; Mered, an Israelite; Mered.

H4779.d: (Aramaic) from the same as מְרַד; rebellious; rebellious.

H4781.d: of foreign derivation; Merodak, a Babylonian idol; Merodach. Compare מְרֹאדַךְ בַּלְאָדָן.

H4782.d: of foreign derivation; Mordecai, an Israelite; Mordecai.

H4784.d: a primitive root; to be (causatively, make) bitter (or unpleasant); (figuratively) to rebel (or resist; causatively, to provoke); bitter, change, be disobedient, disobey, grievously, provocation, provoke(-ing), (be) rebel (against, -lious).

H4785.d: the same as מַר feminine; bitter; Marah, a place in the Desert; Marah.

H4786.d: from מָרַר; bitterness, i.e. (figuratively) trouble; grief.

H4787.d: lemma מָרָה missing dagesh, corrected to מׇרָּה; a form of מֹרָה; trouble; bitterness.

H4788.d: from רוּד in the sense of maltreatment; an outcast; (abstractly) destitution; cast out, misery.

H4789.d: of uncertain derivation; Meroz, a place in Palestine; Meroz.

H4790.d: from מָרַח; bruised, i.e. emasculated; broken.

H4791.d: from רוּם; altitude, i.e. concretely (an elevated place), abstractly (elevation, figuratively (elation), or adverbially (aloft); (far) above, dignity, haughty, height, (most, on) high (one, place), loftily, upward.

H4792.d: formed like מָרוֹם; height; Merom, a lake in Palestine; Merom.

H4793.d: from רוּץ; a run (the trial of speed); race.

H4794.d: or מְרֻצָה; feminine of מֵרוֹץ; a race (the act), whether the manner or the progress; course, running. Compare מְרֻצָה.

H4795.d: from מָרַק; properly, rubbed; but used abstractly, a rubbing (with perfumery); purification.

H4796.d: plural of מַר feminine; bitter springs; Maroth, a place in Palestine; Maroth.

H4797.d: from an unused root meaning to scream; a cry, i.e. (of job), a revel; banquet.

H4798.d: formed like מִרְזַח; a cry, i.e. (of grief) a lamentation; mourning.

H4799.d: a primitive root; properly, to soften by rubbing or pressure; hence (medicinally) to apply as an emollient; lay for a plaister.

H4800.d: from רָחַב; enlargement, either literally (an open space, usually in a good sense), or figuratively (liberty); breadth, large place (room).

H4801.d: ; from רָחַק; remoteness, i.e. (concretely) a distant place; often (adverbially) from afar; (a-, dwell in, very) far (country, off). See also בֵּית הַמֶּרְחָק.

H4803.d: a primitive root; to polish; by implication, to make bald (the head), to gall (the shoulder); also, to sharpen; bright, furbish, (have his) hair (be) fallen off, peeled, pluck off (hair).

H4804.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מָרַט; to pull off; be plucked.

H4805.d: from מָרָה; bitterness, i.e. (figuratively) rebellion; concretely, bitter, or rebellious; bitter, (most) rebel(-lion, -lious).

H4806.d: from מָרָא in the sense of grossness, through the idea of domineering (compare מָרֵא); stall-fed; often (as noun) a beeve; fat (fed) beast (cattle, -ling).

H4807.d: from רִיב and בַּעַל; quarreller of Baal, Merib-Baal, an epithet of Gideon; Merib-baal. Compare מְרִי בַעַל.

H4809.d: the same as מְרִיבָה; Meribah, the name of two places in the Desert; Meribah.

H4810.d: from מְרִי and בַּעַל; rebellion of (i.e. against) Baal; Meri-Baal, an epithet of Gideon; Meri-baal. Compare מְרִיב בַּעַל.

H4811.d: from מָרָה; rebellion; Merajah, an Israelite; Meraiah. Compare יִמְרָה.

H4812.d: plural of מְרָיָה; rebellious; Merajoth, the name of two Israelites; Meraioth.

H4813.d: from מְרִי; rebelliously; Mirjam, the name of two Israelitesses; Miriam.

H4814.d: from מָרַר; bitterness, i.e. (figuratively) grief; bitterness.

H4815.d: from מָרַר; bitter, i.e. poisonous; bitter.

H4816.d: perhaps from רָכַךְ; softness, i.e. (figuratively) fear; faintness.

H4817.d: from רָכַב; a chariot; also a seat (in a vehicle); chariot, covering, saddle.

H4818.d: feminine of מֶרְכָּב; a chariot; chariot. See also בֵּית הַמַּרְכָּבוֹת.

H4820.d: from רָמָה in the sense of deceiving; fraud; craft, deceit(-ful, -fully), false, feigned, guile, subtilly, treachery.

H4821.d: the same as מִרְמָה; Mirmah, an Israelite; Mirma.

H4822.d: plural from רוּם; heights; Meremoth, the name of two Israelites; Meremoth.

H4823.d: from רָמַס; abasement (the act or the thing); tread (down) -ing, (to be) trodden (down) under foot.

H4824.d: patrial from an unused noun; a Meronothite, or inhabitant of some (otherwise unknown) Meronoth.; Meronothite.

H4825.d: of foreign derivation; Meres, a Persian; Meres.

H4826.d: of foreign derivation; Marsena, a Persian; Marsena.

H4827.d: from רָעַע; used as (abstract) noun, wickedness; do mischief.

H4828.d: from רָעָה in the sense of companionship; a friend; companion, friend.

H4829.d: from רָעָה in the sense of feeding; pasture (the place or the act); also the haunt of wild animals; feeding place, pasture.

H4830.d: from רָעָה in the sense of feeding; pasturage; concretely, a flock; flock, pasture.

H4831.d: from רָעַל; perhaps, earthquake; Maralah, a place in Palestine; Maralah.

H4832.d: from רָפָא; properly, curative, i.e. literally (concretely) a medicine, or (abstractly) a cure; figuratively (concretely) deliverance, or (abstractly) placidity; (in-)cure(-able), healing(-lth), remedy, sound, wholesome, yielding.

H4833.d: from רָפַשׂ; muddled water; that which...have fouled.

H4834.d: a primitive root; properly, to press, i.e. (figuratively) to be pungent or vehement; to irritate; embolden, be forcible, grievous, sore.

H4835.d: from רָצַץ; oppression; violence. See also מְרוּצָה.

H4838.d: a primitive root; to polish; by implication, to sharpen; also to rinse; bright, furbish, scour.

H4839.d: from מָרַק; soup (as if a rinsing); broth. See also פָּרָק.

H4840.d: from רָקַח; a spicy herb; [idiom] sweet.

H4841.d: feminine of מֶרְקָח; abstractly, a seasoning (with spicery); concretely, an unguentkettle (for preparing spiced oil); pot of ointment, [idiom] well.

H4842.d: from רָקַח; an aromatic unguent; also an unguent-pot; prepared by the apothecaries' art, compound, ointment.

H4843.d: a primitive root; properly, to trickle (see מַר); but used only as a denominative from מַר; to be (causatively, make) bitter (literally or figuratively); (be, be in, deal, have, make) bitter(-ly, -ness), be moved with choler, (be, have sorely, it) grieved(-eth), provoke, vex.

H4844.d: or מְרוֹר; from מָרַר; a bitter herb; bitter(-ness).

H4845.d: from מָרַר; bile (from its bitterness); gall.

H4846.d: or מְרוֹרָה; from מָרַר; properly, bitterness; concretely, a bitter thing; specifically bile; also venom (of a serpent); bitter (thing), gall.

H4847.d: from מָרַר; bitter; Merari, an Israelite; Merari. See also מְרָרִי.

H4848.d: from מְרָרִי; a Merarite (collectively), or decendants of Merari; Merarites.

H4849.d: from רָשַׁע; a female wicked doer; wicked woman.

H4850.d: dual of מַר feminine; double bitterness; Merathajim, an epithet of Babylon; Merathaim.

H4851.d: of foreign derivation; Mash, a son of Aram, and the people descended from him; Mash.

H4852.d: of foreign derivation; Mesha, a place in Arabia; Mesha.

H4853.d: from נָשָׂא; a burden; specifically, tribute, or (abstractly) porterage; figuratively, an utterance, chiefly adoom, especially singing; mental, desire; burden, carry away, prophecy, [idiom] they set, song, tribute.

H4854.d: the same as מַשָּׂא; burden; Massa, a son of Ishmael; Massa.

H4855.d: from נָשָׁה; a loan; by implication, interest on adebt; exaction, usury.

H4856.d: from נָשָׂא; partiality (as a lifting up); respect.

H4857.d: from שָׁאַב; a trough for cattle to drink from; place of drawing water.

H4858.d: from נָשָׂא; a conflagration (from the rising of smoke); burden.

H4859.d: feminine of מַשָּׁא; a loan; [idiom] any(-thing), debt.

H4861.d: from שָׁאַל; request; Mishal, a place in Palestine; Mishal, Misheal. Compare מָשָׁל.

H4862.d: from שָׁאַל; a request; desire, petition.

H4863.d: from שָׁאַר in the original sense of swelling; a kneading-trough (in which the dough rises); kneading trough, store.

H4864.d: from נָשָׂא; properly, (abstractly) a raising (as of the hands in prayer), or rising (of flame); figuratively, an utterance; concretely, a beacon (as raised); a present (as taken), mess, or tribute; figuratively, a reproach (as a burden); burden, collection, sign of fire, (great) flame, gift, lifting up, mess, oblation, reward.

H4865.d: from שָׁבַץ; a brocade; by analogy, a (reticulated) setting of agem; ouch, wrought.

H4866.d: from שָׁבַר; the orifice of the womb (from which the fetus breaks forth); birth, breaking forth.

H4867.d: from שָׁבַר; a breaker (of the sea); billow, wave.

H4868.d: from שָׁבַת; cessation, i.e. destruction; sabbath.

H4869.d: from שָׂגַב; properly, a cliff (or other lofty or inaccessible place); abstractly, altitude; figuratively, a refuge; defence, high fort (tower), refuge, Misgab, a place in Moab; Misgab.

H4871.d: a primitive root; to pull out (literally or figuratively); draw(out).

H4872.d: from מָשָׁה; drawing out (of the water), i.e. rescued; Mosheh, the Israelite lawgiver; Moses.

H4873.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מֹשֶׁה; {Mosheh, the Israelite lawgiver}; Moses.

H4875.d: or מְשֹׁאָה; from the same as שׁוֹא; (a) ruin, abstractly (the act) or concretely (the wreck); desolation, waste.

H4876.d: or מַשֻּׁאָה; for מְשׁוֹאָה; ruin; desolation, destruction.

H4877.d: from שׁוּב; returned; Meshobab, an Israelite; Meshobab.

H4878.d: or מְשֻׁבָה; from שׁוּב; apostasy; backsliding, turning away.

H4879.d: lemma מְשׁוּגָּה extra dagesh, corrected to מְשׁוּגָה; from an unused root meaning to stray; mistake; error.

H4880.d: or מִשּׁוֹט; from שׁוּט; an oar; oar.

H4881.d: or מְשֻׂכָה; from שׂוּךְ; a hedge; hedge.

H4882.d: from an unused root meaning to plunder; spoilation; spoil.

H4883.d: from an unused root meaning to rasp; a saw; saw.

H4884.d: from an unused root meaning apparently to divide; a measure (for liquids); measure.

H4885.d: from שׂוּשׂ; delight, concretely (the cause or object) or abstractly (the feeling); joy, mirth, rejoice.

H4886.d: a primitive root; to rub with oil, i.e. to anoint; by implication, to consecrate; also to paint; anoint, paint.

H4887.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to מָשַׁח; oil; oil.

H4888.d: or מׇשְׁחָה; from מָשַׁח; unction (the act); by implication, a consecratory gift; (to be) anointed(-ing), ointment.

H4889.d: from שָׁחַת; destructive, i.e. (as noun) destruction, literally (specifically a snare) or figuratively (corruption); corruption, (to) destroy(-ing), destruction, trap, [idiom] utterly.

H4891.d: from שָׁחַר in the sense of day breaking; dawn; morning.

H4893.d: or מׇשְׁחָת; from שָׁחַת; disfigurement; corruption, marred.

H4894.d: or מִשְׁטַח; from שָׁטַח; a spreading-place; (to) spread (forth, -ing, upon).

H4895.d: from the same as שֹׁטֵט; enmity; hatred.

H4897.d: from מָשָׁה; silk (as drawn from the cocoon); silk.

H4898.d: from an equiv. to שְׁזַב and אֵל; delivered of God; Meshezabel, an Israelite; Meshezabeel.

H4899.d: from מָשַׁח; anointed; usually a consecrated person (as a king, priest, or saint); specifically, the Messiah; anointed, Messiah.

H4900.d: a primitive root; to draw, used in a great variety of applications (including to sow, to sound, to prolong, to develop, to march, to remove, to delay, to be tall, etc.); draw (along, out), continue, defer, extend, forbear, [idiom] give, handle, make (pro-, sound) long, [idiom] sow, scatter, stretch out.

H4901.d: from מָשַׁךְ; a sowing; also a possession; precious, price.

H4902.d: the same in form as מֶשֶׁךְ, but probably of foreign derivation; Meshek, a son of Japheth, and the people descended from him; Mesech, Meshech.

H4903.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מִשְׁכָּב; a bed; bed.

H4904.d: from שָׁכַב; a bed (figuratively, a bier); abstractly, sleep; by euphemism, carnal intercourse; bed(-chamber), couch, lieth (lying) with.

H4905.d: from שָׂכַל; instructive, i.e. a didactic poem; Maschil.

H4906.d: from the same as שֵׂכוּ; a figure (carved on stone, the wall, or any object); figuratively, imagination; conceit, image(-ry), picture, [idiom] wish.

H4908.d: from שָׁכַן; a residence (including a shepherd's hut, the lair of animals, figuratively, the grave; also the Temple); specifically, the Tabernacle (properly, its wooden walls); dwelleth, dwelling (place), habitation, tabernacle, tent.

H4909.d: from שָׂכַר; wages or a reward; reward, wages.

H4910.d: a primitive root; to rule; (have, make to have) dominion, governor, [idiom] indeed, reign, (bear, cause to, have) rule(-ing, -r), have power.

H4911.d: denominative from מָשָׁל; to liken, i.e. (transitively) to use figurative language (an allegory, adage, song or the like); intransitively, to resemble; be(-come) like, compare, use (as a) proverb, speak (in proverbs), utter.

H4912.d: apparently from מָשַׁל in some original sense of superiority in mental action; properly, a pithy maxim, usually of metaphorical nature; hence, a simile (as an adage, poem, discourse); byword, like, parable, proverb.

H4913.d: for מִשְׁאָל; Mashal, a place in Palestine; Mashal.

H4914.d: xlit mᵉshôwl corrected to mᵉshôl; from מָשַׁל; a satire; byword.

H4915.d: (1) from מָשַׁל; (2) from מָשַׁל; empire; a parallel; dominion, like.

H4916.d: or מִשְׁלֹחַ; also מִשְׁלָח; from שָׁלַח; a sending out, i.e. (abstractly) presentation (favorable), or seizure (unfavorable); also (concretely) a place of dismissal, or a business to be discharged; to lay, to put, sending (forth), to set.

H4917.d: feminine of מִשְׁלוֹחַ; a mission, i.e. (abstractly and favorable) release, or (concretely and unfavorable) an army; discharge, sending.

H4918.d: from שָׁלַם; allied; Meshullam, the name of seventeen Israelites; Meshullam.

H4919.d: plural from שָׁלַם; reconciliations; Meshillemoth, an Israelite; Meshillemoth. Compare מְשִׁלֵּמִית.

H4920.d: or מְשֶׁלֶמְיָהוּ; from שָׁלַם and יָהּ; ally of Jah; Meshelemjah, an Israelite; Meshelemiah.

H4921.d: from שָׁלַם; reconciliation; Meshillemith, an Israelite; Meshillemith. Compare מְשִׁלֵּמוֹת.

H4922.d: feminine of מְשֻׁלָּם; Meshullemeth, an Israelitess; Meshullemeth.

H4923.d: from שָׁמֵם; a waste or amazement; astonishment, desolate.

H4924.d: from שָׁמַן; fat, i.e. (literally and abstractly) fatness; but usually (figuratively and concretely) a rich dish, a fertile field, a robust man; fat (one, -ness, -test, -test place).

H4925.d: from שָׁמַן; fatness; Mashmannah, an Israelite; Mishmannah.

H4927.d: the same as מִשְׁמָע; Mishma, the name of a son of Ishmael, and of an Israelite; Mishma.

H4928.d: feminine of מִשְׁמָע; audience, i.e. the royal court; also obedience, i.e. (concretely) a subject; bidding, guard, obey.

H4929.d: from שָׁמַר; a guard (the man, the post or the prison); a deposit (figuratively); also (as observed) a usage (abstractly), or an example (concretely); diligence, guard, office, prison, ward, watch.

H4930.d: for מַסְמֵר fem.; a peg; nail.

H4931.d: feminine of מִשְׁמָר; watch, i.e. the act (custody), or (concretely) the sentry, the post; objectively preservation, or (concretely) safe; figuratively observance, i.e. (abstractly) duty or (objectively) a usage or party; charge, keep, or to be kept, office, ordinace, safeguard, ward, watch.

H4932.d: from שָׁנָה; properly, a repetition, i.e. a duplicate (copy of a document), or a double (in amount); by implication, a second (in order, rank, age, quality or location); college, copy, double, fatlings, next, second (order), twice as much.

H4934.d: from the same as שֹׁעַל; a hollow, i.e. a narrow passage; path.

H4935.d: probably from שָׁעָה; inspection; to supple.

H4936.d: apparently from שָׁעָה; inspection; Misham, an Israelite; Misham.

H4937.d: or מִשְׁעָן; from שָׁעַן; a support (concretely), i.e. (figuratively) a protector or sustenance; stay.

H4938.d: or מִשְׁעֶנֶת; feminine of מִשְׁעֵן; support (abstractly), i.e. (figuratively) sustenance or (concretely) a walking-stick; staff.

H4940.d: from שָׁפָה (compare שִׁפְחָה); a family, i.e. circle of relatives; figuratively, a class (of persons), a species (of animals) or sort (of things); by extension a tribe or people; family, kind(-red).

H4941.d: from שָׁפַט; properly, a verdict (favorable or unfavorable) pronounced judicially, especially a sentence or formal decree (human or (participant's) divine law, individual or collective), including the act, the place, the suit, the crime, and the penalty; abstractly, justice, including a participant's right or privilege (statutory or customary), or even a style; [phrase] adversary, ceremony, charge, [idiom] crime, custom, desert, determination, discretion, disposing, due, fashion, form, to be judged, judgment, just(-ice, -ly), (manner of) law(-ful), manner, measure, (due) order, ordinance, right, sentence, usest, [idiom] worthy, [phrase] wrong.

H4942.d: from שָׁפָה; a stall for cattle (only dual); burden, sheepfold.

H4943.d: from an unused root meaning to hold; possession; [phrase] steward.

H4944.d: from שָׁקַק; a traversing, i.e. rapid motion; running to and fro.

H4945.d: from שָׁקָה; properly, causing to drink, i.e. a butler; by implication (intransitively), drink (itself); figuratively, a well-watered region; butler(-ship), cupbearer, drink(-ing), fat pasture, watered.

H4947.d: from שָׁקַף in its original sense of overhanging; a lintel; lintel.

H4948.d: from שָׁקַל; weight (numerically estimated); hence, weighing (the act); (full) weight.

H4949.d: or מִשְׁקֹלֶת; feminine of מִשְׁקָל or מַשְׁקוֹף; a weight, i.e. a plummet (with line attached); plummet.

H4950.d: from שָׁקַע; a settling place (of water), i.e. a pond; deep.

H4952.d: from שָׁרָה in the sense of loosening; maceration, i.e. steeped juice; liquor.

H4953.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to שָׁרַק; a (musical) pipe (from its whistling sound); flute.

H4954.d: patrial from an unused noun from an unused root; probably meaning to stretch out; extension; a Mishraite, or inhabitant (collectively) of Mishra; Mishraites.

H4955.d: from שָׂרַף; combustion, i.e. cremation (of a corpse), or calcination (of lime); burning.

H4956.d: from the plural of מִשְׂרָפָה and מַיִם; burnings of water; Misrephoth-Majim, a place in Palestine; Misrephoth-mayim.

H4957.d: a form for שׂוֹרֵק used denominatively; vineyard; Masrekah, a place in Idumaea; Masrekah.

H4958.d: apparently from an unused root meaning to perforate, i.e. hollow out; a pan; pan.

H4959.d: a primitive root; to feel of; by implication, to grope; feel, grope, search.

H4960.d: from שָׁתָה; drink, by implication, drinking (the act); also (by implication) a banquet or (generally) feast; banquet, drank, drink, feast((-ed), -ing).

H4961.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מִשְׁתֶּה; a banquet; banquet.

H4962.d: from the same as מָתַי; properly, an adult (as of full length); by implication, a man (only in the plural); [phrase] few, [idiom] friends, men, persons, [idiom] small.

H4963.d: denominative from תֶּבֶן; straw in the heap; straw.

H4964.d: from an unused root meaning to curb; a bit; bit, bridle.

H4965.d: from מֶתֶג and אַמָּה with the art. interposed; bit of the metropolis; Metheg-ha-Ammah, an epithet of Gath; Metheg-ammah.

H4966.d: or מָתוּק; from מָתַק; sweet; sweet(-er, -ness).

H4967.d: from מַת and אֵל, with the relative interposed; man who (is) of God; Methusael, an antediluvian patriarch; Methusael.

H4968.d: from מַת and שֶׁלַח; man of a dart; Methushelach, an antediluvian patriarch; Methuselah.

H4969.d: a primitive root; to stretch out; spread out.

H4970.d: from an unused root meaning to extend; properly, extent (of time); but used only adverbially (especially with other particle prefixes), when (either relative or interrogative); long, when.

H4971.d: or מַתְכֻנֶת; from תָּכַן in the transferred sense of measuring; proportion (in size, number or ingredients); composition, measure, state, tale.

H4972.d: from מָה and תְּלָאָה; what a trouble!; what a weariness.

H4973.d: contr. from יָלַע; properly, a biter, i.e. a tooth; cheek (jaw) tooth, jaw.

H4974.d: from תָּמַם; wholesomeness; also (adverb) completely; men (by reading מַת), soundness.

H4975.d: from an unused root meaning to be slender; properly, the waist or small of the back; only in plural the loins; [phrase] greyhound, loins, side.

H4976.d: from נָתַן; a present; gift, to give, reward.

H4977.d: the same as מַתָּן; Mattan, the name of a priest of Baal, and of an Israelite; Mattan.

H4978.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to מַתָּנָה; {a present; specifically (in a good sense), a sacrificial offering, (in a bad sense) a bribe}; gift.

H4979.d: feminine of מַתָּן; a present; specifically (in a good sense), a sacrificial offering, (in a bad sense) a bribe; gift.

H4980.d: the same as מַתָּנָה; Mattanah, a place in the Desert; Mattanah.

H4981.d: probably patrial from an unused noun meaning slenderness; a Mithnite, or inhabitant of Methen; Mithnite.

H4982.d: from מַתָּן; liberal; Mattenai, the name of three Israelites; Mattenai.

H4983.d: or מַתַּנְיָהוּ; from מַתָּן and יָהּ; gift of Jah; Mattanjah, the name of ten Israelites; Mattaniah.

H4984.d: from נָשָׂא; (used as abstractly) supreme exaltation; exalted.

H4985.d: a primitive root; to suck, by implication, to relish, or (intransitively) be sweet; be (made, [idiom] take) sweet.

H4986.d: from מָתַק; figuratively, pleasantness (of discourse); sweetness.

H4988.d: from מָתַק; a dainty, i.e. (generally) food; feed sweetly.

H4989.d: feminine of מֹתֶק; sweetness; Mithkah, a place in the Desert; Mithcah.

H4990.d: of Persian origin; Mithredath, the name of two Persians; Mithredath.

H4991.d: feminine of מַתָּן abbreviated form; a present; gift.

H4992.d: for מַתִּתְיָה; gift of Jah; Mattattah, an Israelite; Mattathah.

H4993.d: or מַתִּתְיָהוּ; from מַתָּת and יָהּ; gift of Jah; Mattithjah, the name of four Israelites; Mattithiah. n

H4994.d: a primitive particle of incitement and entreaty, which may usually be rendered; 'I pray', 'now', or 'then'; added mostly to verbs (in the Imperative or Future), or to interjections, occasionally to an adverb or conjunction; I beseech (pray) thee (you), go to, now, oh.

H4995.d: apparently from נוּא in the sense of harshness from refusal; properly, tough, i.e. uncooked (flesh); raw.

H4996.d: of Egyptian origin; No (i.e. Thebes), the capital of Upper Egypt; No. Compare אָמוֹן.

H4997.d: or נאוֹדlemma נֹאוד vowel, corrected to נאוֹדxlit nôʼwd corrected to nʼôwd; also (feminine) נֹאדָה; from an unused root of uncertain signification; a (skin or leather) bag (for fluids); bottle.

H4998.d: a primitive root; properly, to be at home, i.e. (by implication) to be pleasant (or suitable), i.e. beautiful; be beautiful, become, be comely.

H4999.d: from נָאָה; a home; figuratively, a pasture; habitation, house, pasture, pleasant place.

H5000.d: from נָאָה or נָוֶה; suitable, or beautiful; becometh, comely, seemly.

H5001.d: a primitive root; properly, to whisper, i.e. (by implication) to utter as aoracle; say.

H5002.d: from נָאַם; an oracle; (hath) said, saith.

H5003.d: a primitive root; to commit adultery; figuratively, to apostatize; adulterer(-ess), commit(-ing) adultery, woman that breaketh wedlock.

H5006.d: a primitive root; in Ecclesiastes 12:5, by interchange for נוּץ, to bloom; to scorn; abhor, (give occasion to) blaspheme, contemn, despise, flourish, [idiom] great, provoke.

H5007.d: or נֶאָצָה; from נָאַץ; scorn; blasphemy.

H5008.d: a primitive root; to groan; groan.

H5010.d: a primitive root; to reject; abhor, make void.

H5011.d: the same as נוֹב; fruit; Nob, a place in Palestine; Nob.

H5012.d: a primitive root; to prophesy, i.e. speak (or sing) by inspiration (in prediction or simple discourse); prophesy(-ing), make self a prophet.

H5013.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to נָבָא; {to prophesy, i.e. speak (or sing) by inspiration (in prediction or simple discourse) to prophesy, i.e. speak (or sing) by inspiration (in prediction or simple discourse)}; prophesy.

H5014.d: a primitive root; to pierce; to be hollow, or (figuratively) foolish; hollow, vain.

H5015.d: probably of foreign derivation; Nebo, the name of a Babylonian deity, also of a mountain in Moab, and of a place in Palestine; Nebo.

H5016.d: from נָבָא; a prediction (spoken or written); prophecy.

H5017.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to נְבוּאָה; inspired teaching; prophesying.

H5018.d: xlit Nᵉbûwzarădân corrected to Nᵉbûwzarʼădân; of foreign origin; Nebuzaradan, a Babylonian general; Nebuzaradan.

H5019.d: or נְבֻּכַדְנֶאצַּר; (2 Kings 24:1,10), or נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר; (Esther 2:6; Daniel 1:18), or נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּר; or נְבוּכַדְרֶאצּוֹר; (Ezra 2:1; Jeremiah 49:28), or foreign derivation; Nebukadnetstsar (or -retstsar, or -retstsor), king of Babylon; Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuchadrezzar.

H5020.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּר; {Nebukadnetstsar (or -retstsar, or -retstsor), king of Babylon}; Nebuchadnezzar.

H5021.d: of foreign derivation; Nebushazban, Nebuchadnezzar's chief eunuch; Nebushazban.

H5022.d: feminine plural from the same as נֹב; fruits; Naboth, an Israelite; Naboth.

H5023.d: (Aramaic) of uncertain derivation; a largess; reward.

H5024.d: a primitive root; to bark (as a dog); bark.

H5025.d: from נָבַח; a bark; Nobach, the name of an Israelite, and of a place East of the Jordan; Nobah.

H5026.d: of foreign origin; Nibchaz, a deity of the Avites; Nibhaz.

H5027.d: a primitive root; to scan, i.e. look intently at; by implication, to regard with pleasure, favor or care; (cause to) behold, consider, look (down), regard, have respect, see.

H5028.d: from נָבַט; regard; Nebat, the father of Jeroboam I; Nebat.

H5029.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to נָבִיא; a prophet; prophet.

H5030.d: from נָבָא; a prophet or (generally) inspired man; prophecy, that prophesy, prophet.

H5031.d: feminine of נָבִיא; a prophetess or (generally) inspired woman; by implication, a poetess; by association a prophet's wife; prophetess.

H5032.d: or נְבָיֹת; feminine plural from נוּב; fruitfulnesses; Nebajoth, a son of Ismael, and the country settled by him; Nebaioth, Nebajoth.

H5033.d: from an unused root meaning to burst forth; a fountain; spring.

H5034.d: a primitive root; to wilt; generally, to fall away, fail, faint; figuratively, to be foolish or (morally) wicked; causatively, to despise, disgrace; disgrace, dishounour, lightly esteem, fade (away, -ing), fall (down, -ling, off), do foolishly, come to nought, [idiom] surely, make vile, wither.

H5035.d: or נֵבֶל; from נָבֵל; a skin-bag for liquids (from collapsing when empty); hence, a vase (as similar in shape when full); also a lyre (as having a body of like form); bottle, pitcher, psaltery, vessel, viol.

H5036.d: from נָבֵל; stupid; wicked (especially impious); fool(-ish, -ish man, -ish woman), vile person.

H5037.d: the same as נָבָל; dolt; Nabal, an Israelite; Nabal.

H5038.d: from נָבֵל; a flabby thing, i.e. a carcase or carrion (human or bestial, often collectively); figuratively, an idol; (dead) body, (dead) carcase, dead of itself, which died, (beast) that (which) dieth of itself.

H5039.d: feminine of נָבָל; foolishness, i.e. (morally) wickedness; concretely, a crime; by extension, punishment; folly, vile, villany.

H5040.d: from נָבָל; properly, disgrace, i.e. the (female) pudenda; lewdness.

H5041.d: apparently from נָבָל and לָט; foolish secrecy; Neballat, a place in Palestine; Neballat.

H5042.d: a primitive root; to gush forth; figuratively, to utter (good or bad words); specifically, to emit (a foul odor); belch out, flowing, pour out, send forth, utter (abundantly).

H5043.d: (Aramaic) from an unused root meaning to shine; a light; plural (collectively) a chandelier; candlestick.

H5044.d: of uncertain derivation; Nibshan, a place in Palestine; Nibshan.

H5045.d: from an unused root meaning to be parched; the south (from its drought); specifically, the Negeb or southern district of Judah, occasionally, Egypt (as south to Palestine); south (country, side, -ward).

H5046.d: a primitive root; properly, to front, i.e. stand boldly out opposite; by implication (causatively), to manifest; figuratively, to announce (always by word of mouth to one present); specifically, to expose, predict, explain, praise; bewray, [idiom] certainly, certify, declare(-ing), denounce, expound, [idiom] fully, messenger, plainly, profess, rehearse, report, shew (forth), speak, [idiom] surely, tell, utter.

H5047.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to נָגַד; to flow (through the idea of clearing the way); issue.

H5048.d: from נָגַד; a front, i.e. part opposite; specifically a counterpart, or mate; usually (adverbial, especially with preposition) over against or before; about, (over) against, [idiom] aloof, [idiom] far (off), [idiom] from, over, presence, [idiom] other side, sight, [idiom] to view.

H5050.d: a primitive root; to glitter; causatively, to illuminate; (en-) lighten, (cause to) shine.

H5051.d: from נָגַהּ; brilliancy (literally or figuratively); bright(-ness), light, (clear) shining.

H5052.d: the same as נֹגַהּ; Nogah, a son of David; Nogah.

H5055.d: a primitive root; to butt with the horns; figuratively, to war against; gore, push (down, -ing).

H5056.d: from נָגַח; butting, i.e. vicious; used (wont) to push.

H5057.d: or נָגִד; from נָגַד; a commander (as occupying the front), civil, military or religious; generally (abstractly, plural), honorable themes; captain, chief, excellent thing, (chief) governor, leader, noble, prince, (chief) ruler.

H5058.d: or נְגִינַת; (Psalm 61:title), from נָגַן; properly, instrumental music; by implication, a stringed instrument; by extension, a poem set to music; specifically, an epigram; stringed instrument, musick, Neginoth (plural), song.

H5059.d: a primitive root; properly, to thrum, i.e. beat atune with the fingers; expectation. to play on astringed instrument; hence (generally), to make music; player on instruments, sing to the stringed instruments, melody, ministrel, play(-er, -ing).

H5060.d: a primitive root; properly, to touch, i.e. lay the hand upon (for any purpose; euphemistically, to lie with a woman); by implication, to reach (figuratively, to arrive, acquire); violently, to strike (punish, defeat, destroy, etc.); beat, ([idiom] be able to) bring (down), cast, come (nigh), draw near (nigh), get up, happen, join, near, plague, reach (up), smite, strike, touch.

H5061.d: from נָגַע; a blow (figuratively, infliction); also (by implication) a spot (concretely, a leprous person or dress); plague, sore, stricken, stripe, stroke, wound.

H5062.d: a primitive root; to push, gore, defeat, stub (the toe), inflict (a disease); beat, dash, hurt, plague, slay, smite (down), strike, stumble, [idiom] surely, put to the worse.

H5063.d: from נָגַף; a trip (of the foot); figuratively, an infliction (of disease); plague, stumbling.

H5064.d: a primitive root; to flow; figuratively, to stretch out; causatively, to pour out or down; figuratively, to deliver over; fall, flow away, pour down (out), run, shed, spilt, trickle down.

H5065.d: a primitive root; to drive (an animal, a workman, a debtor, an army); by implication, to tax, harass, tyrannize; distress, driver, exact(-or), oppress(-or), [idiom] raiser of taxes, taskmaster.

H5066.d: a primitive root; to be or come (causatively, bring) near (for any purpose); euphemistically, to lie with a woman; as an enemy, to attack; religious to worship; causatively, to present; figuratively, to adduce an argument; by reversal, to stand back; (make to) approach (nigh), bring (forth, hither, near), (cause to) come (hither, near, nigh), give place, go hard (up), (be, draw, go) near (nigh), offer, overtake, present, put, stand.

H5067.d: from נוּד in the sense of piling up; a mound, i.e. wave; heap.

H5068.d: a primitive root; to impel; hence, to volunteer (as a soldier), to present spontaneously; offer freely, be (give, make, offer self) willing(-ly).

H5069.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to נָדַב; be (or give) liberal(-ly); (be minded of...own) freewill (offering), offer freely (willingly).

H5070.d: from נָדַב; liberal; Nadab, the name of four Israelites; Nadab.

H5071.d: from נָדַב; properly (abstractly) spontaneity, or (adjectively) spontaneous; also (concretely) a spontaneous or (by inference, in plural) abundant gift; free(-will) offering, freely, plentiful, voluntary(-ily, offering), willing(-ly), offering).

H5072.d: from נָדַב and יָהּ; largess of Jah; Nedabjah, an Israelite; Nedabiah.

H5073.d: (Aramaic) from a root meaning to stick; a layer (of building materials); row.

H5074.d: a primitive root; properly, to wave to and fro (rarely to flap up and down); figuratively, to rove, flee, or (causatively) to drive away; chase (away), [idiom] could not, depart, flee ([idiom] apace, away), (re-) move, thrust away, wander (abroad, -er, -ing).

H5075.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to נָדַד; to depart; go from.

H5076.d: passive participle of נָדַד; properly, tossed; abstractly, a rolling (on the bed); tossing to and fro.

H5077.d: or נָדָא; (2 Kings 17:21), a primitive root; properly, to toss; figuratively, to exclude, i.e. banish, postpone, prohibit; cast out, drive, put far away.

H5078.d: from נָדָה in the sense of freely flinging money; a bounty (for prostitution); gifts.

H5079.d: from נָדַד; properly, rejection; by implication, impurity, especially personal (menstruation) or moral (idolatry, incest); [idiom] far, filthiness, [idiom] flowers, menstruous (woman), put apart, [idiom] removed (woman), separation, set apart, unclean(-ness, thing, with filthiness).

H5080.d: a primitive root; to push off; used in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (to expel, mislead, strike, inflict, etc.); banish, bring, cast down (out), chase, compel, draw away, drive (away, out, quite), fetch a stroke, force, go away, outcast, thrust away (out), withdraw.

H5081.d: from נָדַב; properly, voluntary, i.e. generous; hence, magnanimous; as noun, a grandee (sometimes a tyrant); free, liberal (things), noble, prince, willing (hearted).

H5082.d: feminine of נָדִיב; properly, nobility, i.e. reputation; soul.

H5083.d: probably from an unused root meaning to give; a present (for prostitution); gift.

H5084.d: of uncertain derivation; a sheath (of a sword); sheath.

H5085.d: (Aramaic) from the same as נָדָן; a sheath; figuratively, the body (as the receptacle of the soul); body.

H5086.d: a primitive root; to shove asunder, i.e. disperse; drive (away, to and fro), thrust down, shaken, tossed to and fro.

H5087.d: a primitive root; to promise (pos., to do or give something to God); (make a) vow.

H5088.d: or נֵדֶר; from נָדַר; a promise (to God); also (concretely) a thing promised; vow(-ed).

H5089.d: from an unused root meaning to lament; lamentation; wailing.

H5090.d: a primitive root; to drive forth (a person, an animal or chariot), i.e. lead, carry away; reflexively, to proceed (i.e. impel or guide oneself); also (from the panting induced by effort), to sigh; acquaint, bring (away), carry away, drive (away), lead (away, forth), (be) guide, lead (away, forth).

H5091.d: a primitive root; to groan, i.e. bewail; hence (through the idea of crying aloud), to assemble (as if on proclamation); lament, wail.

H5092.d: from נָהָה; an elegy; lamentation, wailing.

H5094.d: (Aramaic) or נְהִירוּ; (Aramaic), from the same as נְהָרָה; illumination, i.e. (figuratively) wisdom; light.

H5095.d: a primitive root; properly, to run with asparkle, i.e. flow; hence (transitively), to conduct, and (by inference) to protect, sustain; carry, feed, guide, lead (gently, on).

H5096.d: or נַהֲלֹל; the same as נַהֲלֹל; Nahalal or Nahalol, a place in Palestine; Nahalal, Nahallal, Nahalol.

H5098.d: a primitive root; to growl; mourn, roar(-ing).

H5100.d: feminine of נַהַם; snarling; disquietness, roaring.

H5101.d: a primitive root; to bray (as an ass), scream (from hunger); bray.

H5102.d: a primitive root; to sparkle, i.e. (figuratively) be cheerful; hence (from the sheen of a running stream) to flow, i.e. (figuratively) assemble; flow (together), be lightened.

H5103.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to נָהַר; a river, especially the Euphrates; river, stream.

H5104.d: from נָהַר; a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile, Euphrates, etc.); figuratively, prosperity; flood, river.

H5105.d: from נָהַר in its original sense; daylight; light.

H5106.d: a primitive root; to refuse, forbid, dissuade, or neutralize; break, disallow, discourage, make of none effect.

H5107.d: a primitive root; to germinate, i.e. (figuratively) to (causatively, make) flourish; also (of words), to utter; bring forth (fruit), make cheerful, increase.

H5108.d: or נֵיב; from נוּב; produce, literally or figuratively; fruit.

H5109.d: from נוֹב; fruitful; Nobai, an Israelite; Nebai (from the margin).

H5110.d: a primitive root; to nod, i.e. waver; figuratively, to wander, flee, disappear; also (from shaking the head in sympathy), to console, deplore, or (from tossing the head in scorn) taunt; bemoan, flee, get, mourn, make to move, take pity, remove, shake, skip for joy, be sorry, vagabond, way, wandering.

H5111.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to נָוֶה; to flee; get away.

H5112.d: lemma נוֹדּ extra dagesh, corrected to נוֹד; (only defective נֹד ); from נוּד; exile; wandering.

H5113.d: the same as נוֹדlemma נוֹדּ extra dagesh, corrected to נוֹד; vagrancy; Nod, the land of Cain; Nod.

H5114.d: from נָדַב; noble; Nodab, an Arab tribe; Nodab.

H5115.d: a primitive root; (compare נָוֶה); to rest (as at home); causatively (through the implied idea of beauty ), to celebrate (with praises); keept at home, prepare an habitation.

H5116.d: or (feminine) נָוָה; from נָוָה; (adjectively) at home; hence (by implication of satisfaction) lovely; also (noun) a home, of God (temple), men (residence), flocks (pasture), or wild animals (den); comely, dwelling (place), fold, habitation, pleasant place, sheepcote, stable, tarried.

H5117.d: a primitive root; to rest, i.e. settle down; used in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, intransitive, transitive and causative (to dwell, stay, let fall, place, let alone, withdraw, give comfort, etc.); cease, be confederate, lay, let down, (be) quiet, remain, (cause to, be at, give, have, make to) rest, set down. Compare יָנִים.

H5118.d: or נוֹחַ; from נוּחַ; quiet; rest(-ed, -ing place).

H5119.d: feminine of נוּחַ; quietude; Nochah, an Israelite; Nohah.

H5121.d: from נָוָה; residence; Navith, a place in Palestine; Naioth (from the margin).

H5122.d: (Aramaic) or נְוָלִי; (Aramaic), from an unused root probably meaning to be foul; a sink; dunghill.

H5123.d: a primitive root; to slumber (from drowsiness); sleep, slumber.

H5125.d: a primitive root; to resprout, i.e. propagate by shoots; figuratively, to be perpetual; be continued.

H5126.d: or נוֹן; (1 Chronicles 7:27), from נוּן; perpetuity,; Nun or Non, the father of Joshua; Non, Nun.

H5127.d: a primitive root; to flit, i.e. vanish away (subside, escape; causatively, chase, impel, deliver); [idiom] abate, away, be displayed, (make to) flee (away, -ing), put to flight, [idiom] hide, lift up a standard.

H5128.d: a primitive root; to waver, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (as subjoined); continually, fugitive, [idiom] make, to (go) up and down, be gone away, (be) move(-able, -d), be promoted, reel, remove, scatter, set, shake, sift, stagger, to and fro, be vagabond, wag, (make) wander (up and down).

H5129.d: from יָעַד and יָהּ; convened of Jah; Noadjah, the name of an Israelite, and a false prophetess; Noadiah.

H5130.d: a primitive root; to quiver (i.e. vibrate up and down, or rock to and fro); used in a great variety of applications (including sprinkling, beckoning, rubbing, bastinadoing, sawing, waving, etc.); lift up, move, offer, perfume, send, shake, sift, strike, wave.

H5131.d: from נוּף; elevation; situation. Compare נֹף.
