H7346.d: from רָחַב and עַם; a people has enlarged; Rechabam, an Israelite king; Rehoboam.

H7347.d: from an unused root meaning to pulverize; a mill-stone; mill (stone).

H7348.d: a form of רַחוּם; Rechum, the name of a Persian and of three Israelites; Rehum.

H7349.d: from רָחַם; compassionate; full of compassion, merciful.

H7350.d: or רָחֹק; from רָחַק; remote, literally or figuratively, of place or time; specifically, precious; often used adverbially (with preposition); (a-) far (abroad, off), long ago, of old, space, great while to come.

H7351.d: from the same as רַהַט; a panel (as resembling a trough); rafter.

H7352.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to רָחוֹק; {remote, literally or figuratively, of place or time; specifically, precious; often used adverbially (with preposition)}; far.

H7353.d: from an unused root meaning to journey; a ewe (the females being the predominant element of a flock) (as a good traveller); ewe, sheep.

H7354.d: the same as רָחֵל; Rachel, a wife of Jacob; Rachel.

H7355.d: a primitive root; to fondle; by implication, to love, especially to compassionate; have compassion (on, upon), love, (find, have, obtain, shew) mercy(-iful, on, upon), (have) pity, Ruhamah, [idiom] surely.

H7356.d: from רָחַם; compassion (in the plural); by extension, the womb (as cherishing the fetus); by implication, a maiden; bowels, compassion, damsel, tender love, (great, tender) mercy, pity, womb.

H7357.d: the same as רַחַם; pity; Racham, an Israelite; Raham.

H7358.d: from רָחַם; (compare רַחַם); the womb; matrix, womb.

H7360.d: or (feminine) רָחָמָה; from רָחַם; a kind of vulture (supposed to be tender towards its young); gier-eagle.

H7361.d: feminine of רַחַם; a maiden; damsel.

H7363.d: a primitive root; to brood; by implication, to be relaxed; flutter, move, shake.

H7364.d: a primitive root; to lave (the whole or a part of a thing); bathe (self), wash (self).

H7365.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to רָחַץ (probably through the accessory idea of ministering as a servant at the bath); to attend upon; trust.

H7367.d: feminine of רַחַץ; a bathing place; washing.

H7368.d: a primitive root; to widen (in any direction), i.e. (intransitively) recede or (transitively) remove (literally or figuratively, of place or relation); (a-, be, cast, drive, get, go, keep (self), put, remove, be too, (wander), withdraw) far (away, off), loose, [idiom] refrain, very, (be) a good way (off).

H7369.d: from רָחַק; remote; that are far.

H7370.d: a primitive root; to gush; indite.

H7371.d: from רוּחַ; a winnowing-fork (as blowing the chaff away); shovel.

H7372.d: a primitive root; to be moist; be wet.

H7374.d: from an unused root meaning to tremble; terror; fear.

H7375.d: xlit ruwṭăphash corrected to ruṭăphash; a root compounded from רָטֹב and טָפַשׁ; to be rejuvenated; be fresh.

H7376.d: a primitive root; to dash down; dash (in pieces).

H7377.d: from רָוָה; irrigation, i.e. a shower; watering.

H7575.d: feminine of רֶתֶם; Rithmah, a place in the Desert; Rithmah.

H7576.d: a primitive root; to fasten; bind.

H7577.d: feminine passive participle of רָתַק; something fastened, i.e. a chain; chain.

H7579.d: a primitive root; to bale up water; (woman to) draw(-er, water).

H7580.d: a primitive root; to rumble or moan; [idiom] mightily, roar.

H7581.d: from שָׁאַג; a rumbling or moan; roaring.

H7582.d: a primitive root; to rush; by implication, to desolate; be desolate, (make a) rush(-ing), (lay) waste.

H7583.d: a primitive root (identical with through the idea of whirling to giddiness); to stun, i.e. (intransitively) be astonished; wonder.

H7584.d: from שָׁאָה; a tempest (as rushing); desolation.

H7585.d: or שְׁאֹל; from שָׁאַל; Hades or the world of the dead (as if a subterranean retreat), including its accessories and inmates; grave, hell, pit.

H7586.d: passive participle of שָׁאַל; asked; Shaul, the name of an Edomite and two Israelites; Saul, Shaul.

H7587.d: patronymic from שִׂטְנָה; a Shaulite or descendant of Shaul; Shaulites.

H7588.d: from שָׁאָה; uproar (as of rushing); by implication, destruction; [idiom] horrible, noise, pomp, rushing, tumult ([idiom] -uous).

H7589.d: from an unused root meaning to push aside; contempt; despite(-ful).

H7590.d: for active part of שׂוּט (compare שְׁאָט); one contemning; that (which) despise(-d).

H7592.d: or שָׁאֵל; a primitive root; to inquire; by implication, to request; by extension, to demand; ask (counsel, on), beg, borrow, lay to charge, consult, demand, desire, [idiom] earnestly, enquire, [phrase] greet, obtain leave, lend, pray, request, require, [phrase] salute, [idiom] straitly, [idiom] surely, wish.

H7593.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁאַל; {to inquire; by implication, to request; by extension, to demand}; ask, demand, require.

H7594.d: from שָׁאַל; request; Sheal, an Israelite; Sheal.

H7595.d: (Aramaic) from שְׁאֵל; properly, a question (at law), i.e. judicial decision or mandate; demand.

H7596.d: or שֵׁלָה; (1 Samuel 1:17), from שָׁאַל; a petition; by implication, a loan; loan, petition, request.

H7597.d: or שַׁלְתִּיאֵל; from שָׁאַל and אֵל; I have asked God; Shealtiel, an Israelite; Shalthiel, Shealtiel.

H7598.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל; {Shealtiel, an Israelite}; Shealtiel.

H7599.d: a primitive root; to loll, i.e. be peaceful; be at ease, be quiet, rest. See also בֵּית שְׁאָן.

H7600.d: from שָׁאַן; secure; in a bad sense, haughty; that is at ease, quiet, tumult. Compare שַׁלְאֲנָן.

H7601.d: a primitive root; to plunder; spoil.

H7602.d: a primitive root; to inhale eagerly; figuratively, to cover; by implication, to be angry; also to hasten; desire (earnestly), devour, haste, pant, snuff up, swallow up.

H7603.d: from שָׁאַר; barm or yeast-cake (as swelling by fermentation); leaven.

H7604.d: a primitive root; properly, to swell up, i.e. be (causatively, make) redundant; leave, (be) left, let, remain, remnant, reserve, the rest.

H7605.d: from שָׁאַר; a remainder; [idiom] other, remnant, residue, rest.

H7606.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שְׁאָר; {a remainder}; [idiom] whatsoever more, residue, rest.

H7607.d: from שָׁאַר; flesh (as swelling out), as living or forfood; generally food of any kind; figuratively, kindred by blood; body, flesh, food, (near) kin(-sman, -swoman), near (nigh) (of kin).

H7608.d: feminine of שְׁאֵר; female kindred by blood; near kinswomen.

H7609.d: the same as שַׁאֲרָה; Sheerah, an Israelitess; Sherah.

H7610.d: from שְׁאָר and שׁוּב; a remnant will return; Shear-Jashub, the symbolic name of one of Isaiah's sons; Shear-jashub.

H7611.d: from שָׁאַר; a remainder or residual (surviving, final) portion; that had escaped, be left, posterity, remain(-der), remnant, residue, rest.

H7613.d: from נָשָׂא; an elevation or leprous scab; figuratively, elation or cheerfulness; exaltation in rank or character; be accepted, dignity, excellency, highness, raise up self, rising.

H7614.d: of foreign origin; Sheba, the name of three early progenitors of tribes and of an Ethiopian district; Sheba, Sabeans.

H7615.d: patronymic from שְׁבָא; a Shebaite or descendant of Sheba; Sabean.

H7616.d: from an unused root meaning to break up; a fragment, i.e. ruin; broken in pieces.

H7617.d: a primitive root; to transport into captivity; (bring away, carry, carry away, lead, lead away, take) captive(-s), drive (take) away.

H7618.d: from an unused root (probably identical with that of שָׁבָה through the idea of subdivision into flashes or streamers (compare שָׁבִיב) meaning to flame; a gem (from its sparkle), probably the agate; agate.

H7619.d: or שׁוּבָאֵל; from שָׁבָה (abbreviated form) or שׁוּב and אֵל; captive (or returned) of God; Shebuel or Shubael, the name of two Israelites; Shebuel, Shubael.

H7620.d: or שָׁבֻעַ; also (feminine) שְׁבֻעָה; properly, passive participle of שָׁבַע as a denominative of שֶׁבַע; literally, sevened, i.e. a week (specifically, of years); seven, week.

H7621.d: feminine passive participle of שָׁבַע; properly, something sworn, i.e. an oath; curse, oath, [idiom] sworn.

H7622.d: or שְׁבִית; from שָׁבָה; exile, concretely, prisoners; figuratively, a former state of prosperity; captive(-ity).

H7623.d: a primitive root; properly, to address in aloud tone, i.e. (specifically) loud; figuratively, to pacify (as if by words); commend, glory, keep in, praise, still, triumph.

H7624.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁבַח; to adulate, i.e. adore; praise.

H7625.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שֵׁבֶט; a clan; tribe.

H7626.d: from an unused root probably meaning to branch off; a scion, i.e. (literally) a stick (for punishing, writing, fighting, ruling, walking, etc.) or (figuratively) a clan; [idiom] correction, dart, rod, sceptre, staff, tribe.

H7627.d: of foreign origin; Shebat, a Jewish month; Sebat.

H7628.d: from שְׁבוּ; exiled; captured; as noun, exile (abstractly or concretely and collectively); by extension, booty; captive(-ity), prisoners, [idiom] take away, that was taken.

H7629.d: from שָׁבָה; captor; Shobi, an Ammonite; Shobi.

H7630.d: for שֹׁבִי; Shobai, an Israelite; Shobai.

H7631.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁבִיב; {flame (as split into tongues)}; flame.

H7632.d: from the same as שָׁבָב; flame (as split into tongues); spark.

H7633.d: feminine of שְׁבִי; exile (abstractly or concretely and collectively); captives(-ity).

H7634.d: feminine of the same as שֹׁבִי; captivation; Shobjah, an Israelite; Shachia (from the margin).

H7635.d: from the same as שֹׁבֶל; a track or passage-way (as if flowing along); path.

H7636.d: from an unused root meaning to interweave; a netting for the hair; caul.

H7637.d: or שְׁבִעִי; ordinal from שִׁבְעִים; seventh; seventh (time).

H7638.d: from an unused root meaning to intwine; a netting (ornament to the capital of a column); net.

H7639.d: feminine of שָׂבָךְ; a net-work, i.e. (in hunting) a snare, (in architecture) a ballustrade; also a reticulated ornament to apillar; checker, lattice, network, snare, wreath(-enwork).

H7640.d: from an unused root meaning to flow; a lady's train (as trailing after her); leg.

H7641.d: or (feminine) שִׁבֹּלֶת; from the same as שֹׁבֶל; a stream (as flowing); also an ear of grain (as growing out); by analogy, a branch; branch, channel, ear (of corn), (water-)flood, Shibboleth. Compare סִבֹּלֶת.

H7642.d: from the same as שֹׁבֶל; a snail (as if floating in its own slime); snail.

H7643.d: or (feminine) שִׂבְמָה; probably from בָּשָׂם; spice; Sebam or Sibmah, a place in Moab; Shebam, Shibmah, Sibmah.

H7644.d: or שֶׁבְנָה; from an unused root meaning to grow; growth; Shebna or Shebnah, an Israelite; Shebna, Shebnah.

H7645.d: or שְׁבַנְיָהוּ; from the same as שֶׁבְנָא and יָהּ; Jah has grown (i.e. prospered); Shebanjah, the name of three or four Israelites; Shebaniah.

H7646.d: or שָׂבֵעַ; a primitive root; to sate, i.e. fill to satisfaction (literally or figuratively); have enough, fill (full, self, with), be (to the) full (of), have plenty of, be satiate, satisfy (with), suffice, be weary of.

H7648.d: from שָׂבַע; satisfaction (of food or (figuratively) joy); fill, full(-ness), satisfying, be satisfied.

H7649.d: from שָׂבַע; satiated (in a pleasant or disagreeable sense); full (of), satisfied (with).

H7650.d: a primitive root; properly to be complete, but used only as a denominative from שֶׁבַע; to seven oneself, i.e. swear (as if by repeating a declaration seven times); adjure, charge (by an oath, with an oath), feed to the full (by mistake for שָׂבַע), take an oath, [idiom] straitly, (cause to, make to) swear.

H7651.d: or (masculine) (שִׁבְעָה); from שָׁבַע; a primitive cardinal number; seven (as the sacred full one); also (adverbially) seven times; by implication, a week; by extension, an indefinite number; ([phrase] by) seven(-fold),-s, (-teen, -teenth), -th, times). Compare שִׁבְעָנָה.

H7652.d: the same as שֶׁבַע; seven; Sheba, the name of a place in Palestine, and of two Israelites; Sheba.

H7654.d: feminine of שֹׂבַע; satiety; (to have) enough, [idiom] till...be full, (un-) satiable, satisfy, [idiom] sufficiently.

H7655.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שֶׁבַע; {seven (as the sacred full one); also (adverbially) seven times; by implication, a week; by extension, an indefinite number}; seven (times).

H7656.d: masculine of שֶׁבַע; seven(-th); Shebah, a well in Palestine; Shebah.

H7657.d: multiple of שֶׁבַע; seventy; seventy, threescore and ten ([phrase] -teen).

H7658.d: prolonged for the masculine of שֶׁבַע; seven; seven.

H7659.d: dual (adverbially) of שֶׁבַע; seven-times; seven(-fold, times).

H7660.d: a primitive root; to interweave (colored) threads in squares; by implication (of reticulation) to inchase gems in gold; embroider, set.

H7661.d: from שָׁבַץ; entanglement, i.e. (figuratively) perplexity; anguish.

H7662.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to the root of שׁוֹבֵק; to quit, i.e. allow to remain; leave, let alone.

H7663.d: erroneously שָׁבַר; (Nehemiah 2:13,15), a primitive root; to scrutinize; by implication (of watching) to expect (with hope and patience); hope, tarry, view, wait.

H7665.d: a primitive root; to burst (literally or figuratively); break (down, off, in pieces, up), broken (-hearted), bring to the birth, crush, destroy, hurt, quench, [idiom] quite, tear, view (by mistake for שָׂבַר).

H7666.d: denominative from שֶׁבֶר; to deal in grain; buy, sell.

H7667.d: or שֵׁבֶר; from שָׁבַר; a fracture, figuratively, ruin; specifically, a solution (of a dream); affliction, breach, breaking, broken(-footed, -handed), bruise, crashing, destruction, hurt, interpretation, vexation.

H7668.d: the same as שֶׁבֶר; grain (as if broken into kernels); corn, victuals.

H7669.d: the same as שֶׁבֶר; Sheber, an Israelite; Sheber.

H7670.d: from שָׁבַר; rupture, i.e. a pang; figuratively, ruin; breaking, destruction.

H7671.d: plural of שֶׁבֶר; ruins; Shebarim, a place in Palestine; Shebarim.

H7672.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁבַץ; to entangle, i.e. perplex; be astonished.

H7673.d: a primitive root; to repose, i.e. desist from exertion; used in many implied relations (causative, figurative or specific); (cause to, let, make to) cease, celebrate, cause (make) to fail, keep (sabbath), suffer to be lacking, leave, put away (down), (make to) rest, rid, still, take away.

H7674.d: from שָׁבַת; rest, interruption, cessation; cease, sit still, loss of time.

H7675.d: infinitive of יָשַׁב; properly, session; but used also concretely, an abode or locality; place, seat. Compare יֹשֵׁב בַּשֶּׁבֶת.

H7676.d: intensive from שָׁבַת; intermission, i.e (specifically) the Sabbath; ([phrase] every) sabbath.

H7677.d: from שַׁבָּת; a sabbatism or special holiday; rest, sabbath.

H7678.d: from שַׁבָּת; restful; Shabbethai, the name of three Israelites; Shabbethai.

H7679.d: ; a primitive root; to grow, i.e. (causatively) to enlarge, (figuratively) laud; increase, magnify.

H7680.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׂגָא; to increase; grow, be multiplied.

H7681.d: probably from שָׁגָה; erring; Shage, an Israelite; Shage.

H7682.d: a primitive root; to be (causatively, make) lofty, especially inaccessible; by implication, safe, strong; used literally and figuratively; defend, exalt, be excellent, (be, set on) high, lofty, be safe, set up (on high), be too strong.

H7683.d: a primitive root; to stray, i.e. (figuratively) sin (with more or less apology); [idiom] also for that, deceived, err, go astray, sin ignorantly.

H7684.d: from שָׁגַג; a mistake or inadvertent transgression; error, ignorance, at unawares; unwittingly.

H7685.d: a primitive root; to enlarge (especially upward, also figuratively); grow (up), increase.

H7686.d: a primitive root; to stray (causatively, mislead), usually (figuratively) to mistake, especially (morally) to transgress; by extension (through the idea of intoxication) to reel, (figuratively) be enraptured; (cause to) go astray, deceive, err, be ravished, sin through ignorance, (let, make to) wander.

H7687.d: from שָׂגַב; aloft; Segub, the name of two Israelites; Segub.

H7688.d: a primitive root; to peep, i.e. glance sharply at; look (narrowly).

H7690.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שַׂגִּיא; large (in size, quantity or number, also adverbial); exceeding, great(-ly); many, much, sore, very.

H7691.d: from שָׁגָה; a moral mistake; error.

H7692.d: or שִׁגָּיֹנָה; from שָׁגָה; properly, aberration, i.e. (technically) a dithyramb or rambling poem; Shiggaion, Shigionoth.

H7693.d: a primitive root; to copulate with; lie with, ravish.

H7694.d: from שָׁגַל; a queen (from cohabitation); queen.

H7695.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שֵׁגָל; a (legitimate) queen; wife.

H7696.d: a primitive root; to rave through insanity; (be, play the) mad (man).

H7698.d: from an unused root probably meaning to eject; the fetus (as finally expelled); that cometh of, increase.

H7699.d: or שֹׁד; probably from שׁוּד (in its original sense) contracted; the breast of a woman or animal (as bulging); breast, pap, teat.

H7700.d: from שׁוּד; a doemon (as malignant); devil.

H7701.d: or שׁוֹד; (Job 5:21), from שׁוּד; violence, ravage; desolation, destruction, oppression, robbery, spoil(-ed, -er, -ing), wasting.

H7702.d: a primitive root; to abrade, i.e. harrow afield; break clods, harrow.

H7703.d: a primitive root; properly, to be burly, i.e. (figuratively) powerful (passively, impregnable); by implication, to ravage; dead, destroy(-er), oppress, robber, spoil(-er), [idiom] utterly, (lay) waste.

H7704.d: or שָׂדַי; from an unused root meaning to spread out; a field (as flat); country, field, ground, land, soil, [idiom] wild.

H7705.d: from שָׁדַד; a wife (as mistress of the house); [idiom] all sorts, musical instrument.

H7707.d: from the same as שָׂדֶה and אוּר; spreader of light; Shedejur, an Israelite; Shedeur.

H7708.d: plural from the same as שָׂדֶה; flats; Siddim, a valley in Palestine; Siddim.

H7709.d: apparently from שָׂדֶה; a cultivated field; blasted, field.

H7710.d: a primitive root; to scorch; blast.

H7711.d: or שִׁדָּפוֹן; from שָׁדַף; blight; blasted(-ing).

H7712.d: (Aramaic) a primitive root; to endeavor; labour.

H7713.d: from an unused root meaning to regulate; a row, i.e. rank (of soldiers), story (of rooms); board, range.

H7714.d: probably of foreign origin; Shadrak, the Babylonian name of one of Daniel's companions; Shadrach.

H7715.d: (Aramaic) the same as שַׁדְרַךְ; {Shadrak, the Babylonian name of one of Daniel's companions}; Shadrach.

H7716.d: or שֵׂי; probably from שָׁאָה through the idea of pushing out to graze; a member of a flock, i.e. a sheep or goat; (lesser, small) cattle, ewe, goat, lamb, sheep. Compare זֶה.

H7717.d: from an unused root meaning to testify; a witness; record.

H7718.d: from an unused root probably mean to blanch; a gem, probably the beryl (from its pale green color); onyx.

H7719.d: the same as שֹׁהַם; Shoham, an Israelite; Shoham.

H7720.d: from the same as סַהַר; a round pendant for the neck; ornament, round tire like the moon.

H7721.d: from an unused root (akin to נָשָׂא and שׁוֹא) meaning to rise; a rising; arise.

H7722.d: or (feminine) שׁוֹאָה; or שֹׁאָה; from an unused root meaning to rush over; a tempest; by implication, devastation; desolate(-ion), destroy, destruction, storm, wasteness.

H7723.d: or שַׁו; from the same as שׁוֹא in the sense of desolating; evil (as destructive), literally (ruin) or morally (especially guile); figuratively idolatry (as false, subjective), uselessness (as deceptive, objective; also adverbially, in vain); false(-ly), lie, lying, vain, vanity.

H7724.d: from the same as שָׁוְא; false; Sheva, an Israelite; Sheva.

H7725.d: a primitive root; to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again; ((break, build, circumcise, dig, do anything, do evil, feed, lay down, lie down, lodge, make, rejoice, send, take, weep)) [idiom] again, (cause to) answer ([phrase] again), [idiom] in any case (wise), [idiom] at all, averse, bring (again, back, home again), call (to mind), carry again (back), cease, [idiom] certainly, come again (back), [idiom] consider, [phrase] continually, convert, deliver (again), [phrase] deny, draw back, fetch home again, [idiom] fro, get (oneself) (back) again, [idiom] give (again), go again (back, home), (go) out, hinder, let, (see) more, [idiom] needs, be past, [idiom] pay, pervert, pull in again, put (again, up again), recall, recompense, recover, refresh, relieve, render (again), requite, rescue, restore, retrieve, (cause to, make to) return, reverse, reward, [phrase] say nay, send back, set again, slide back, still, [idiom] surely, take back (off), (cause to, make to) turn (again, self again, away, back, back again, backward, from, off), withdraw.

H7726.d: from שׁוּב; apostate, i.e. idolatrous; backsliding, frowardly, turn away (from margin).

H7727.d: the same as שׁוֹבָב; rebellious; Shobab, the name of two Israelites; Shobab.

H7728.d: from שׁוּב; apostate, i.e. heathenish or (actually) heathen; backsliding.

H7730.d: for סֹבֶךְ; a thicket, i.e. interlaced branches; thick boughs.

H7731.d: perhaps for שׂוֹבֶךְ; Shobak, a Syrian; Shobach.

H7732.d: from the same as שֹׁבֶל; overflowing; Shobal, the name of an Edomite and two Israelites; Shobal.

H7733.d: active participle from a primitive root meaning to leave (compare שְׁבַק); forsaking; Shobek, an Israelite; Shobek.

H7734.d: a primitive root; to retreat; turn back.

H7735.d: a primitive root; to hedge in; make to grow.

H7736.d: a primitive root; properly, to swell up, i.e. figuratively (by implication of insolence) to devastate; waste.

H7737.d: a primitive root; properly, to level, i.e. equalize; figuratively, to resemble; by implication, to adjust (i.e. counterbalance, be suitable, compose, place, yield, etc.); avail, behave, bring forth, compare, countervail, (be, make) equal, lay, be (make, a-) like, make plain, profit, reckon.

H7738.d: a primitive root; to destroy; [idiom] substance (from the margin).

H7739.d: (Aramaic); corresponding to שָׁוָה; to resemble; make like.

H7740.d: from שָׁוָה; plain; Shaveh, a place in Palestine; Shaveh.

H7741.d: from the same as שָׁוֵה and the dual of קִרְיָה; plain of a double city; Shaveh-Kirjathajim, a place East of the Jordan; Shaveh Kiriathaim.

H7742.d: a primitive root; to muse pensively; meditate.

H7743.d: a primitive root; to sink, literally or figuratively; bow down, incline, humble.

H7744.d: from שׁוּחַ; dell; Shuach, a son of Abraham; Shuah.

H7745.d: from שׁוּחַ; a chasm; ditch, pit.

H7746.d: the same as שׁוּחָה; Shuchah, an Israelite; Shuah.

H7747.d: xlit Shûchîy corrected to Shûwchîy; patronymic from שׁוּחַ; a Shuchite or descendant of Shuach; Shuhite.

H7748.d: from שׁוּחַ; humbly; Shucham, an Israelite; Shuham.

H7749.d: patronymic from שׁוּחָם; a Shuchamite (collectively); Shuhamites.

H7750.d: or (by permutation) סוּט; a primitive root; to detrude, i.e. (intransitively and figuratively) become derelict (wrongly practise; namely, idolatry); turn aside to.

H7751.d: a primitive root; properly, to push forth; (but used only figuratively) to lash, i.e. (the sea with oars) to row; by implication, to travel; go (about, through, to and fro), mariner, rower, run to and fro.

H7752.d: from שׁוּט; a lash (literally or figuratively); scourge, whip.

H7753.d: a primitive root; to entwine, i.e. shut in (for formation, protection or restraint); fence, (make an) hedge (up).

H7754.d: or (feminine) שׂוֹכָה; from שׂוּךְ; a branch (as interleaved); bough.

H7755.d: or שֹׂכֹה; or שׂוֹכוֹ; from שׂוּךְ; Sokoh or Soko, the name of two places in Palestine; Shocho, Shochoh, Sochoh, Soco, Socoh.

H7756.d: probably patronymic from a name corresponding to שׂוֹךְ (feminine); a Sukathite or descendant of an unknown Israelite named Sukah; Suchathite.

H7757.d: from an unused root meaning to hang down; a skirt; by implication, a bottom edge; hem, skirt, train.

H7758.d: or שֵׁילָל; (Micah 1:8), from שָׁלַל; nude (especially bare-foot); by implication, captive; spoiled, stripped.

H7759.d: from שָׁלַם; peaceful (with the article always prefixed, making it a pet name); the Shulammith, an epithet of Solomon's queen; Shulamite.

H7760.d: or שִׂים; a primitive root; to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically); [idiom] any wise, appoint, bring, call (a name), care, cast in, change, charge, commit, consider, convey, determine, [phrase] disguise, dispose, do, get, give, heap up, hold, impute, lay (down, up), leave, look, make (out), mark, [phrase] name, [idiom] on, ordain, order, [phrase] paint, place, preserve, purpose, put (on), [phrase] regard, rehearse, reward, (cause to) set (on, up), shew, [phrase] stedfastly, take, [idiom] tell, [phrase] tread down, (over-)turn, [idiom] wholly, work.

H7761.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שׂוּם; {to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)}; [phrase] command, give, lay, make, [phrase] name, [phrase] regard, set.

H7762.d: from an unused root meaning to exhale; garlic (from its rank odor); garlic.

H7763.d: or שֹׁמֵר; active participle of שָׁמַר; keeper; Shomer, the name of two Israelites; Shomer.

H7764.d: from an unused root meaning to rest; quiet; Shuni, an Israelite; Shuni.

H7765.d: patronymic from שׁוּנִי; a Shunite (collectively) or descendants of Shuni; Shunites.

H7766.d: probably from the same as שׁוּנִי; quietly; Shunem, a place in Pal; Shunem.

H7767.d: patrial from שׁוּנֵם; a Shunammitess, or female inhabitant of Shunem; Shunamite.

H7768.d: a primitive root; properly, to be free; but used only causatively and reflexively, to halloo (for help, i.e. freedom from some trouble); cry (aloud, out), shout.

H7769.d: from שָׁוַע; a halloo; cry, riches.

H7770.d: the same as שׁוּעַ; Shua, a Canaanite; Shua, Shuah.

H7771.d: from שָׁוַע in the original sense of freedom; a noble, i.e. liberal, opulent; also (as noun in the derived sense) a halloo; bountiful, crying, rich.

H7772.d: the same as שׁוֹעַ; rich; Shoa, an Oriental people; Shoa.

H7774.d: from שָׁוַע; wealth; Shua, an Israelitess; Shua.

H7775.d: feminine of שֶׁוַע; a hallooing; crying.

H7776.d: or שֻׁעָל; from the same as שֹׁעַל; a jackal (as a burrower); fox.

H7777.d: the same as שׁוּעָל; Shual, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine; Shual.

H7778.d: or שֹׁעֵר active participle of שָׁעַר (as denominative from שַׁעַר); a janitor; doorkeeper, porter.

H7779.d: a primitive root; properly, to gape, i.e. snap at; figuratively, to overwhelm; break, bruise, cover.

H7780.d: from שָׁפַךְ; poured; Shophak, a Syrian; Shophach.

H7781.d: patronymic from שְׁפוּפָם; a Shuphamite (collectively) or descendants of Shephupham; Shuphamite.

H7782.d: or שֹׁפָר; from שָׁפַר in the original sense of incising; a cornet (as giving a clear sound) or curved horn; cornet, trumpet.

H7783.d: a primitive root; to run after or over, i.e. overflow; overflow, water.

H7784.d: from שׁוּק; a street (as run over); street.

H7785.d: from שׁוּק; the (lower) leg (as a runner); hip, leg, shoulder, thigh.

H7786.d: a primitive root; properly, to vanquish; by implication, to rule (causatively, crown); make princes, have power, reign. See סוּר.

H7787.d: a primitive root (identical with שׂוּר through the idea of reducing to pieces; compare מַשּׂוֹר); to saw; cut.

H7788.d: a primitive root; properly, to turn, i.e. travel about (as a harlot or a merchant); go, singular See also שִׁיר.

H7789.d: a primitive root (identical with through the idea of going round for inspection); to spy out, i.e. (generally) survey, (for evil) lurk for, (for good) care for; behold, lay wait, look, observe, perceive, regard, see.

H7790.d: from שִׁימוֹן; a foe (as lying in wait); enemy.

H7791.d: from שׁוּר; a wall (as going about); wall.

H7792.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שׁוּר; {a wall (as going about)}; wall.

H7793.d: the same as שׁוּר; Shur, a region of the Desert; Shur.

H7794.d: from שׁוּר; a bullock (as a traveller); bull(-ock), cow, ox, wall (by mistake for שׁוּר).

H7795.d: from שׂוּר in the primitive sense of סוּר; properly, a ring, i.e. (by analogy) a row (adverbially); principal.

H7796.d: the same as שֹׂרֵק; a vine; Sorek, a valley in Palestine; Sorek.

H7797.d: or שִׂישׂ; a primitive root; to be bright, i.e. cheerful; be glad, [idiom] greatly, joy, make mirth, rejoice.

H7798.d: from שׂוּשׂ; joyful; Shavsha, an Israelite; Shavsha.

H7799.d: or שׁוֹשָׁן; or שֹׁשָׁן; and (feminine) שׁוֹשַׁנָּה; from שׂוּשׂ; a lily (from its whiteness), as aflower of architectural ornament; also a (straight) trumpet (from the tubular shape); lily, Shoshannim.

H7800.d: the same as שׁוּשַׁן; Shushan, a place in Persia; Shushan.

H7801.d: (Aramaic) of foreign origin; a Shushankite (collectively) or inhabitants of some unknown place in Assyrian; Susanchites.

H7802.d: or (plural of former) שׁוֹשַׁנִּים עֵדוּתlemma שׁוֹשַׁנִּיס עֵדוּת samekh, corrected to שׁוֹשַׁנִּים עֵדוּת; from שׁוּשַׁן and עֵדוּת; lily (or trumpet) of assemblage; Shushan-Eduth or Shoshannim-Eduth, the title of a popular song; Shoshannim-Eduth, Shushan-eduth.

H7803.d: probably from שָׁאָה and the same as תֶּלַח; crash of breakage; Shuthelach, the name of two Israelites; Shuthelah.

H7804.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to עָזַב; to leave, i.e. (causatively) free; deliver.

H7805.d: a primitive root; to tan (by sunburning); figuratively (as if by a piercing ray) to scan; look up, see.

H7806.d: a primitive root; to twist (a thread of straw); twine.

H7807.d: from שָׁחַח; sunk, i.e. downcast; [phrase] humble.

H7808.d: for שִׂיחַ; communion, i.e. (reflexively) meditation; thought.

H7809.d: a primitive root; to donate, i.e. bribe; hire, give a reward.

H7810.d: from שָׁחַד; a donation (venal or redemptive); bribe(-ry), gift, present, reward.

H7811.d: a primitive root; to swim; causatively, to inundate; (make to) swim.

H7812.d: a primitive root; to depress, i.e. prostrate (especially reflexive, in homage to royalty or God); bow (self) down, crouch, fall down (flat), humbly beseech, do (make) obeisance, do reverence, make to stoop, worship.

H7813.d: from שָׂחָה; a pond (for swimming); to swim in.

H7814.d: or שְׂחֹק; from שָׂחַק; laughter (in merriment or defiance); derision, laughter(-ed to scorn, -ing), mocked, sport.

H7815.d: from שָׁחַר; dinginess, i.e. perhaps soot; coal.

H7817.d: a primitive root; to sink or depress (reflexive or causative); bend, bow (down), bring (cast) down, couch, humble self, be (bring) low, stoop.

H7818.d: a primitive root; to tread out, i.e. squeeze (grapes); press.

H7819.d: a primitive root; to slaughter (in sacrifice or massacre); kill, offer, shoot out, slay, slaughter.

H7820.d: a primitive root (identical with שָׁחַט through the idea of striking); to hammer out; beat.

H7822.d: from an unused root probably meaning to burn; inflammation, i.e. an ulcer; boil, botch.

H7823.d: or סָחִישׁ; from an unused root apparently meaning to sprout; aftergrowth; (that) which springeth of the same.

H7824.d: from the same as שַׁחַף; a board (as chipped thin); cieled with.

H7825.d: from שָׁחָה; a pit-fall (literally or figuratively); destruction, pit.

H7826.d: from an unused root probably meaning to roar; a lion (from his characteristic roar); (fierce) lion.

H7827.d: lemma שְׁחֶלֶת second vowel, corrected to שְׁחֵלֶת; apparently from the same as שַׁחַל through some obscure idea, perhaps that of peeling off by concussion of sound; a scale or shell, i.e. the aromatic mussel.; onycha.

H7828.d: from an unused root meaning to peel, i.e. emaciate; the gull (as thin); cuckoo.

H7829.d: from the same as שַׁחַף; emaciation; consumption.

H7830.d: from an unused root apparently meaning to strut; haughtiness (as evinced by the attitude); [idiom] lion, pride.

H7831.d: from the same as שַׁחַץ; proudly; Shachatsom, a place in Palestine; Shahazimah (from the margin).

H7832.d: a primitive root; to laugh (in pleasure or detraction); by implication, to play; deride, have in derision, laugh, make merry, mock(-er), play, rejoice, (laugh to) scorn, be in (make) sport.

H7833.d: a primitive root; to comminate (by trituration or attrition); beat, wear.

H7834.d: from שָׁחַק; a powder (as beaten small); by analogy, a thin vapor; by extension, the firmament; cloud, small dust, heaven, sky.

H7835.d: a primitive root (identical with שָׁחַר through the idea of the duskiness of early dawn); to be dim or dark (in color); be black.

H7836.d: a primitive root; properly, to dawn, i.e. (figuratively) be (up) early at any task (with the implication of earnestness); by extension, to search for (with painstaking); (do something) betimes, enquire early, rise (seek) betimes, seek diligently) early, in the morning).

H7837.d: from שָׁחַר; dawn (literal, figurative or adverbial); day(-spring), early, light, morning, whence riseth.

H7838.d: or שָׁחוֹר; from שָׁחַר; properly, dusky, but also (absol.) jetty; black.

H7839.d: from שָׁחַר; a dawning, i.e. (figuratively) juvenescence; youth.

H7841.d: from שָׁחַר and יָהּ; Jah has sought; Shecharjah, an Israelite; Shehariah.

H7842.d: dual of שַׁחַר; double dawn; Shacharajim, an Israelite; Shaharaim.

H7843.d: a primitive root; to decay, i.e. (causatively) ruin (literally or figuratively); batter, cast off, corrupt(-er, thing), destroy(-er, -uction), lose, mar, perish, spill, spoiler, [idiom] utterly, waste(-r).

H7844.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁחַת; {to decay, i.e. (causatively) ruin (literally or figuratively)}; corrupt, fault.

H7845.d: from שׁוּחַ; a pit (especially as a trap); figuratively, destruction; corruption, destruction, ditch, grave, pit.

H7846.d: or סֵט; from שׂוּט; a departure from right, i.e. sin; revolter, that turn aside.

H7847.d: a primitive root; to deviate from duty; decline, go aside, turn.

H7848.d: feminine of a derivative (only in the plural שִׁטִּים; meaning the sticks of wood) from the same as שֹׁטֵט; the acacia (from its scourging thorns); shittah, shittim. See also בֵּית הַשִּׁטָּה.

H7849.d: a primitive root; to expand; all abroad, enlarge, spread, stretch out.

H7850.d: active participle of an otherwise unused root meaning (properly, to pierce; but only as a denominative from שׁוֹט); to flog; a goad; scourge.

H7851.d: the same as the plural of שִׁטָּה; acacia trees; Shittim, a place East of the Jordan; Shittim.

H7852.d: a primitive root; properly, to lurk for, i.e. persecute; hate, oppose self against.

H7853.d: a primitive root; to attack, (figuratively) accuse; (be an) adversary, resist.

H7854.d: from שָׂטַן; an opponent; especially (with the article prefixed) Satan, the arch-enemy of good; adversary, Satan, withstand.

H7856.d: the same as שִׂטְנָה; Sitnah, the name of a well in Pal; Sitnah.

H7857.d: a primitive root; to gush; by implication, to inundate, cleanse; by analogy, to gallop, conquer; drown, (over-) flow(-whelm, rinse, run, rush, (throughly) wash (away).

H7858.d: or שֵׁטֶף; from שָׁטַף; a deluge (literally or figuratively); flood, outrageous, overflowing.

H7859.d: (Aramaic) of uncertain derivation; a side; side.

H7860.d: active participle of an otherwise unused root probably meaning to write; properly, a scribe, i.e. (by analogy or implication) an official superintendent or magistrate; officer, overseer, ruler.

H7861.d: from the same as שֹׁטֵר; magisterial; Shitrai, an Israelite; Shitrai.

H7862.d: probably from שָׁוָה; a gift (as available); present.

H7863.d: from the same as שׂוֹא by permutation; elevation; excellency.

H7864.d: for שְׁוָא; Sheja, an Israelite; Sheva (from the margin).

H7865.d: from שִׂיא; peak; Sion, the summit of Mount Hermon; Sion.

H7866.d: xlit Shîʼyôwn corrected to Shîyʼôwn; from the same as שׁוֹא; ruin; Shijon, a place in Palestine; Shihon.

H7867.d: a primitive root; properly, to become aged, i.e. (by implication) to grow gray; (be) grayheaded.

H7868.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שִׂיב; {properly, to become aged, i.e. (by implication) to grow gray}; elder.

H7870.d: by permutation from שׁוּב; a return (of property); captivity.

H7872.d: feminine of שֵׂיב; old age; (be) gray (grey hoar,-y) hairs (head,-ed), old age.

H7873.d: from שׂוּג; a withdrawal (into a private place); pursuing.

H7874.d: lemma שׂיד missing vowel, corrected to שִׂיד; a primitive root probably meaning to boil up (compare שׁוּד); used only as denominative from שִׂיד; to plaster; plaister.

H7875.d: from שִׂידlemma שׂיד missing vowel, corrected to שִׂיד; lime (as boiling when slacked); lime, plaister.

H7876.d: a primitive root; to keep in memory; be unmindful. (Render Deuteronomy 32:18, 'A Rock bore thee, thou must recollect; and (yet) thou hast forgotten,' etc.)

H7877.d: of unknown derivation; Shiza, an Israelite; Shiza.

H7878.d: a primitive root; to ponder, i.e. (by implication) converse (with oneself, and hence, aloud) or (transitively) utter; commune, complain, declare, meditate, muse, pray, speak, talk (with).

H7879.d: from שִׂיחַ; a contemplation; by implication, an utterance; babbling, communication, complaint, meditation, prayer, talk.

H7880.d: from שִׂיחַ; a shoot (as if uttered or put forth), i.e. (generally) shrubbery; bush, plant, shrub.

H7881.d: feminine of שִׂיחַ; reflection; be extension, devotion; meditation, prayer.

H7883.d: or שִׁחוֹר; or שִׁחֹר; probably from שָׁחַר; dark, i.e. turbid; Shichor, a stream of Egypt; Shihor, Sihor.

H7884.d: from the same as שִׁיחוֹר and לָבַן; darkish whiteness; Shichor-Libnath, a stream of Palestine; Shihor-libnath.

H7885.d: from שׁוּט; also compare שׁוֹט; an oar; a scourge (figuratively); oar, scourge.

H7886.d: from שָׁלָה; tranquil; Shiloh, an epithet of the Messiah; Shiloh.

H7887.d: or שִׁלֹה; or שִׁילוֹ; or שִׁלוֹ; from the same as שִׁילֹה; Shiloh, a place in Palestine; Shiloh.

H7888.d: or שִׁילֹנִי; or שִׁלֹנִי; from שִׁילֹה; a Shilonite or inhabitant of Shiloh; Shilonite.

H7889.d: apparently for יְשִׁימוֹן; desert; Shimon, an Israelite; Shimon.

H7890.d: from an unused root meaning to urinate; urine; piss.

H7891.d: or (the original form) שׁוּר; (1 Samuel 18:6), a primitive root (rather identical with שׁוּר through the idea of strolling minstrelsy); to sing; behold (by mistake for שׁוּר), sing(-er, -ing man, -ing woman).

H7892.d: or feminine שִׁירָה; from שִׁיר; a song; abstractly, singing; musical(-ick), [idiom] sing(-er, -ing), song.

H7893.d: from an unused root meaning to bleach, i.e. whiten;  See שֵׁשׁ.; white, i.e. marble.;

H7894.d: from the same as שַׁיִשׁ; whiteness; Shisha, an Israelite; Shisha.

H7895.d: or שׁוּשַׁק; of Egyptian derivation; Shishak, an Egyptian king; Shishak.

H7896.d: a primitive root; to place (in a very wide application); apply, appoint, array, bring, consider, lay (up), let alone, [idiom] look, make, mark, put (on), [phrase] regard, set, shew, be stayed, [idiom] take.

H7897.d: from שִׁית; a dress (as put on); attire.

H7898.d: from שִׁית; scrub or trash, i.e. wild growth of weeds or briers (as if put on the field); thorns.

H7899.d: from סָכַךְ in the sense of שׂוּךְ; a brier (as of a hedge); prick.

H7900.d: from סָכַךְ in the sense of שׂוּךְ; a booth (as interlaced); tabernacle.

H7901.d: a primitive root; to lie down (for rest, sexual connection, decease or any other purpose); [idiom] at all, cast down, (lover-)lay (self) (down), (make to) lie (down, down to sleep, still with), lodge, ravish, take rest, sleep, stay.

H7902.d: from שָׁכַב; a lying down (of dew, or for the sexual act); [idiom] carnally, copulation, [idiom] lay, seed.

H7903.d: lemma שֶׁכֹבֶת first vowel, corrected to שְׁכֹבֶת; from שָׁכַב; a (sexual) lying with; [idiom] lie.

H7904.d: a primitive root; to roam (through lust); in the morning (by mistake for שָׁכַם).

H7905.d: feminine of שֹׂךְ in the sense of שֵׂךְ; a dart (as pointed like a thorn); barbed iron.

H7906.d: from an unused root apparently meaning to surmount; an observatory (with the article); Seku, a place in Palestine; Sechu.

H7907.d: from the same as שֵׂכוּ; observant, i.e. (concretely) the mind; heart.

H7908.d: infinitive of שָׁכֹל; bereavement; loss of children, spoiling.

H7909.d: or שַׁכֻּל; from שָׁכֹל; bereaved; barren, bereaved (robbed) of children (whelps).

H7910.d: or שִׁכֹּר; from שָׁכַר; intoxicated, as astate or a habit; drunk(-ard, -en, -en man).

H7911.d: or שָׁכֵחַ; a primitive root; to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of, from want of memory or attention; [idiom] at all, (cause to) forget.

H7912.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁכַח through the idea of disclosure of a covered or forgotten thing; to discover (literally or figuratively); find.

H7914.d: feminine from the same as שֵׂכוּ; a conspicuous object; picture.

H7915.d: intensive perhaps from the same as שֵׂכוּ in the sense of שׂוּךְ; a knife (as pointed or edged); knife.

H7916.d: from שָׂכַר; a man at wages  by the day or year; hired (man, servant), hireling.

H7917.d: feminine of שָׂכִיר; a hiring; that is hired.

H7918.d: a primitive root; to weave (i.e. lay) a trap; figuratively, (through the idea of secreting) to allay (passions; physically, abate a flood); appease, assuage, make to cease, pacify, set.

H7919.d: a primitive root; to be (causatively, make or act) circumspect and hence, intelligent; consider, expert, instruct, prosper, (deal) prudent(-ly), (give) skill(-ful), have good success, teach, (have, make to) understand(-ing), wisdom, (be, behave self, consider, make) wise(-ly), guide wittingly.

H7920.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׂכַל; {to be (causatively, make or act) circumspect and hence, intelligent}; consider.

H7921.d: a primitive root; properly, to miscarry, i.e. suffer abortion; by analogy, to bereave (literally or figuratively); bereave (of children), barren, cast calf (fruit, young), be (make) childless, deprive, destroy, [idiom] expect, lose children, miscarry, rob of children, spoil.

H7922.d: or שֵׂכֶל; from שָׂכַל; intelligence; by implication, success; discretion, knowledge, policy, prudence, sense, understanding, wisdom, wise.

H7923.d: plural from שָׁכֹל; childlessness (by continued bereavements); to have after loss of others.

H7925.d: a primitive root; properly, to incline (the shoulder to a burden); but used only as denominative from שְׁכֶם; literally, to load up (on the back of man or beast), i.e. to start early in the morning; (arise, be up, get (oneself) up, rise up) early (betimes), morning.

H7926.d: from שָׁכַם; the neck (between the shoulders) as the place of burdens; figuratively, the spur of ahill; back, [idiom] consent, portion, shoulder.

H7927.d: the same as שְׁכֶם; ridge; Shekem, a place in Palestine; Shechem.

H7928.d: for שְׁכֶם; Shekem, the name of a Hivite and two Israelites; Shechem.

H7929.d: feminine of שְׁכֶם; the shoulderbone; shoulder blade.

H7930.d: patronymic from שֶׁכֶם; a Shikmite (collectively), or descendants of Shekem; Shichemites.

H7931.d: a primitive root (apparently akin (by transmission) to שָׁכַב through the idea of lodging; compare סִכְלוּת, שָׁכַם); to reside or permanently stay (literally or figuratively); abide, continue, (cause to, make to) dwell(-er), have habitation, inhabit, lay, place, (cause to) remain, rest, set (up).

H7932.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁכַן; {to reside or permanently stay (literally or figuratively)}; cause to dwell, have habitation.

H7934.d: from שָׁכַן; a resident; by extension, a fellow-citizen; inhabitant, neighbour, nigh.

H7935.d: or (prolonged) שְׁכַנְיָהוּ; from שָׁכַן and יָהּ; Jah has dwelt; Shekanjah, the name of nine Israelites; Shecaniah, Shechaniah.

H7936.d: or (by permutation) סָכַר; (Ezra 4:5), a primitive root (apparently akin (by prosthesis) to כָּרָה through the idea of temporary purchase; compare שָׁכַר); to hire; earn wages, hire (out self), reward, [idiom] surely.

H7937.d: a primitive root; to become tipsy; in a qualified sense, to satiate with astimulating drink or (figuratively) influence; (be filled with) drink (abundantly), (be, make) drunk(-en), be merry. (Superlative of שָׁקָה.)

H7939.d: from שָׂכַר; payment of contract; concretely, salary, fare, maintenance; by implication, compensation, benefit; hire, price, reward(-ed), wages, worth.

H7940.d: the same as שָׂכָר; recompense; Sakar, the name of two Israelites; Sacar.

H7941.d: from שָׁכַר; an intoxicant, i.e. intensely alcoholic liquor; strong drink, [phrase] drunkard, strong wine.

H7942.d: for שִׁכָּרוֹן; drunkenness, Shikkeron, a place in Palestine; Shicron.

H7944.d: from שָׁלָה abbreviated form; a fault; error.

H7945.d: for the rel. אֲשֶׁר; used with prepositional prefix, and often followed by some pronominal affix; on account of, whatsoever, whichsoever; cause, sake.

H7946.d: for שַׁאֲנָן; tranquil; being at ease.

H7947.d: a primitive root; to space off; intensive (evenly) to make equidistant; equally distant, set in order.

H7948.d: from שָׁלַב; a spacer or raised interval, i.e. the stile in aframe or panel; ledge.

H7949.d: a primitive root; properly, meaning to be white; used only as denominative from שֶׁלֶג; to be snow-white (with the linen clothing of the slain); be as snow.

H7950.d: from שָׁלַג; snow (probably from its whiteness); snow(-y).

H7951.d: or שָׁלַו; (Job 3:26), a primitive root; to be tranquil, i.e. secure or successful; be happy, prosper, be in safety.

H7952.d: a primitive root (probably identical with שָׁלָה through the idea of educing); to mislead; deceive, be negligent.

H7953.d: a primitive root (rather cognate (by contraction) to the base of נָשַׁל, שָׁלַל and their congeners through the idea of extracting); to draw out or off, i.e. remove (the soul by death); take away.

H7954.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁלָה; to be secure; at rest.

H7955.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to שָׁלָה; a wrong; thing amiss.

H7956.d: the same as שְׁאֵלָה (shortened); request; Shelah, the name of a postdiluvian patriarch and of an Israelite; Shelah.

H7957.d: from the same as לַהַב with sibilant prefix; a flare of fire; (flaming) flame.

H7958.d: or שְׂלָיו; by orthographical variation from שָׁלָה through the idea of sluggishness; the quail collectively (as slow in flight from its weight); quails.

H7960.d: (Aramaic) or שָׁלוּת; (Aramaic), from the same as שָׁלָה; a fault; error, [idiom] fail, thing amiss.

H7961.d: or שָׁלֵיו; feminine שְׁלֵוָה; from שָׁלָה; tranquil; (in a bad sense) careless; abstractly, security; (being) at ease, peaceable, (in) prosper(-ity), quiet(-ness), wealthy.

H7962.d: from שָׁלָה; security (genuine or false); abundance, peace(-ably), prosperity, quietness.

H7963.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שַׁלְוָה; safety; tranquillity. See also שָׁלֵו.

H7964.d: or שִׁלֻּחַ; from שָׁלַח; (only in plural) a dismissal, i.e. (of a wife) divorce (especially the document); also (of a daughter) dower; presents, have sent back.

H7965.d: or שָׁלֹם; from שָׁלַם; safe, i.e. (figuratively) well, happy, friendly; also (abstractly) welfare, i.e. health, prosperity, peace; [idiom] do, familiar, [idiom] fare, favour, [phrase] friend, [idiom] great, (good) health, ([idiom] perfect, such as be at) peace(-able, -ably), prosper(-ity, -ous), rest, safe(-ty), salute, welfare, ([idiom] all is, be) well, [idiom] wholly.

H7966.d: or שִׁלֻּם; from שָׁלַם; a requital, i.e. (secure) retribution, (venal) a fee; recompense, reward.

H7967.d: or (shorter) שַׁלֻּם; the same as שִׁלּוּם; Shallum, the name of fourteen Israelites; Shallum.

H7968.d: probably for שַׁלּוּם; Shallun, an Israelite; Shallum.

H7969.d: or שָׁלֹשׁ; masculine שְׁלוֹשָׁה; or שְׁלֹשָׁה; a primitive number; three; occasionally (ordinal) third, or (multiple) thrice; [phrase] fork, [phrase] often(-times), third, thir(-teen, -teenth), three, [phrase] thrice. Compare שָׁלִישׁ.

H7970.d: or שְׁלֹשִׁים; multiple of שָׁלוֹשׁ; thirty; or (ordinal) thirtieth; thirty, thirtieth. Compare שָׁלִישׁ.

H7971.d: a primitive root; to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications); [idiom] any wise, appoint, bring (on the way), cast (away, out), conduct, [idiom] earnestly, forsake, give (up), grow long, lay, leave, let depart (down, go, loose), push away, put (away, forth, in, out), reach forth, send (away, forth, out), set, shoot (forth, out), sow, spread, stretch forth (out).

H7972.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁלַח; {to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)}; put, send.

H7973.d: from שָׁלַח; a missile of attack, i.e. spear; also (figuratively) a shoot of growth; i.e. branch; dart, plant, [idiom] put off, sword, weapon.

H7974.d: the same as שֶׁלַח; Shelach, a postdiluvian patriarch; Salah, Shelah. Compare שִׁלֹחַlemma שִׁלֹּחַ extra dagesh, corrected to שִׁלֹחַ.

H7975.d: lemma שִׁלֹּחַ extra dagesh, corrected to שִׁלֹחַ; or (in imitation of שֶׁלַח) שֶׁלַח; (Nehemiah 3:15), from שָׁלַח; rill; Shiloach, a fountain of Jerusalem; Shiloah, Siloah.

H7976.d: feminine of שִׁלּוּחַ; a shoot; branch.

H7977.d: from שֶׁלַח; missive, i.e. armed; Shilchi, an Israelite; Shilhi.

H7978.d: plural of שֶׁלַח; javelins or sprouts; Shilchim, a place in Palestine; Shilhim.

H7979.d: from שָׁלַח; a table (as spread out); by implication, a meal; table.

H7980.d: a primitive root; to dominate, i.e. govern; by implication, to permit; (bear, have) rule, have dominion, give (have) power.

H7981.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁלַט; {to dominate, i.e. govern; by implication, to permit}; have the mastery, have power, bear rule, be (make) ruler.

H7982.d: from שָׁלַט; probably a shield (as controlling, i.e. protecting the person); shield.

H7984.d: (Aramaic) or שִׁלְטֹןlemma שִׁלְטן missing vowel, corrected to שִׁלְטֹן; corresponding to שִׁלְטוֹן; {a potentate}; ruler.

H7985.d: (Aramaic) from שְׁלֵט; empire (abstractly or concretely); dominion.

H7986.d: feminine from שָׁלַט; a vixen; imperious.

H7988.d: feminine from שָׁלָה; a fetus or babe (as extruded in birth); young one.

H7989.d: from שָׁלַט; potent; concretely, a prince or warrior; governor, mighty, that hath power, ruler.

H7990.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שַׁלִּיט; mighty; abstractly, permission; concretely, a premier; captain, be lawful, rule(-r).

H7991.d: or שָׁלוֹשׁ; (1 Chronicles 11:11; 1 Chronicles 12:18), or שָׁלֹשׁ; (2 Samuel 23:13), from שָׁלוֹשׁ; a triple, i.e. (as a musical instrument) a triangle (or perhaps rather threestringed lute); also (as an indefinite, great quantity) a three-fold measure (perhaps a treble ephah); also (as an officer) a general of the third rank (upward, i.e. the highest); captain, instrument of musick, (great) lord, (great) measure, prince, three (from the margin).

H7992.d: ordinal from שָׁלוֹשׁ; third; feminine athird (part); by extension, a third (day, year or time); specifically, a third-story cell); third (part, rank, time), three (years old).

H7993.d: a primitive root; to throw out, down or away (literally or figuratively); adventure, cast (away, down, forth, off, out), hurl, pluck, throw.

H7994.d: from שָׁלַךְ; bird of prey, usually thought to be the pelican (from casting itself into the sea); cormorant.

H7995.d: from שָׁלַךְ; a felling (of trees); when cast.

H7996.d: the same as שַׁלֶּכֶת; Shalleketh, a gate in Jerusalem; Shalleketh.

H7997.d: a primitive root; to drop or strip; by implication, to plunder; let fall, make self a prey, [idiom] of purpose, (make a, (take)) spoil.

H7999.d: a primitive root; to be safe (in mind, body or estate); figuratively, to be (causatively, make) completed; by implication, to be friendly; by extension, to reciprocate (in various applications); make amends, (make an) end, finish, full, give again, make good, (re-) pay (again), (make) (to) (be at) peace(-able), that is perfect, perform, (make) prosper(-ous), recompense, render, requite, make restitution, restore, reward, [idiom] surely.

H8000.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁלַם; to complete, to restore; deliver, finish.

H8002.d: from שָׁלַם; properly, requital, i.e. a (voluntary) sacrifice in thanks; peace offering.

H8003.d: from שָׁלַם; complete (literally or figuratively); especially friendly; full, just, made ready, peaceable, perfect(-ed), quiet, Shalem (by mistake for a name), whole.

H8004.d: the same as שָׁלֵם; peaceful; Shalem, an early name of Jerusalem; Salem.

H8006.d: the same as שִׁלֵּם; Shillem, an Israelite; Shillem.

H8007.d: probably for שַׂלְמָה; clothing; Salma, the name of two Israelites; Salma.

H8008.d: transp. for שִׂמְלָה; a dress; clothes, garment, raiment.

H8009.d: the same as שַׂלְמָה; clothing; Salmah, an Israelite; Salmon. Compare שַׂלְמוֹן.

H8010.d: from שָׁלוֹם; peaceful; Shelomah, David's successor; Solomon.

H8012.d: from שַׂלְמָה; investiture; Salmon, an Israelite; Salmon. Compare שַׂלְמָה.

H8013.d: feminine plural of שָׁלוֹם; pacifications; Shelomoth, the name of two Israelites; Shelomith (from the margin), Shelomoth. Compare שְׁלֹמִית.

H8014.d: from שַׂלְמָה; clothed; Salmai, an Israelite; Shalmai.

H8015.d: from שָׁלוֹם; peaceable; Shelomi, an Israelite; Shelomi.

H8016.d: patronymically from שִׁלֵּם; a Shilemite (collectively) or descendants of Shillem; Shillemites.

H8017.d: lemma שִׁלֻמִיאֵל corrected to שְׁלֻמִיאֵל; from שָׁלוֹם and אֵל; peace of God; Shelumiel, an Israelite; Shelumiel.

H8018.d: or שֶׁלֶמְיָהוּ; from שֶׁלֶם and יָהּ; thankoffering of Jah; Shelemjah, the name of nine Israelites; Shelemiah.

H8019.d: or שׁלוֹמִית; (Ezra 8:10), from שָׁלוֹם; peaceableness; Shelomith, the name of five Israelites and three Israelitesses; Shelomith.

H8020.d: of foreign derivation; Shalman, a king apparently of Assyria; Shalman. Compare שַׁלְמַנְאֶסֶר.

H8022.d: of foreign derivation; Shalmaneser, an Assyrian king; Shalmaneser. Comp שַׁלְמַן.

H8023.d: the same as שִׁילוֹנִי; Shiloni, an Israelite; Shiloni.

H8024.d: from שֵׁלָה; a Shelanite (collectively), or descendants of Shelah; Shelanites.

H8025.d: a primitive root; to pull out, up or off; draw (off), grow up, pluck off.

H8026.d: from שָׁלַף; extract; Sheleph, a son of Jokthan; Sheleph.

H8027.d: a primitive root perhaps originally to intensify, i.e. treble; but apparently used only as denominative from שָׁלוֹשׁ,; to be (causatively, make) triplicate (by restoration, in portions, strands, days or years); do the third time, (divide into, stay) three (days, -fold, parts, years old).

H8028.d: from שָׁלַשׁ; triplet; Shelesh, an Israelite; Shelesh.

H8029.d: from שָׁלַשׁ; a descendant of the third degree, i.e. great grandchild; third (generation).

H8030.d: feminine from the same as שֶׁלֶשׁ; triplication; Shilshah, an Israelite; Shilshah.

H8031.d: feminine from שָׁלַשׁ; trebled land; Shalishah, a place in Palestine; Shalisha.

H8032.d: or שִׁלְשֹׁם; from the same as שֶׁלֶשׁ; trebly, i.e. (in time) day before yesterday; [phrase] before (that time, -time), excellent things (from the margin), [phrase] heretofore, three days, [phrase] time past.

H8033.d: a primitive particle (rather from the relative pronoun, אֲשֶׁר); there (transferring to time) then; often thither, or thence; in it, [phrase] thence, there (-in, [phrase] of, [phrase] out), [phrase] thither, [phrase] whither.

H8034.d: a primitive word (perhaps rather from through the idea of definite and conspicuous position; compare שָׁמַיִם); an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character; [phrase] base, (in-) fame(-ous), named(-d), renown, report.

H8035.d: the same as שֵׁם; name; Shem, a son of Noah (often includ. his posterity); Sem, Shem.

H8036.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שֵׁם; {an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character}; name.

H8037.d: from שָׁמֵם; desolation; Shamma, an Israelite; Shamma.

H8038.d: apparently from שֵׁם and אֵבֶר; name of pinion, i.e. illustrious; Shemeber, a king of Zeboim; Shemeber.

H8039.d: perhaps for שִׁמְעָה; Shimah, an Israelite; Shimah. Compare שִׁמְאָם.

H8040.d: or שְׂמֹאל; a primitive word (rather perhaps from the same as שִׂמְלָה (by insertion of the aleph) through the idea of wrapping up); properly, dark (as enveloped), i.e. the north; hence (by orientation), the left hand; left (hand, side).

H8041.d: a primitive root (denominative from שְׂמֹאול); to use the left hand or pass in that direction); (go, turn) (on the, to the) left.

H8042.d: from שְׂמֹאול; situated on the left side; left.

H8043.d: for שִׁמְאָה (compare אֲבִיָּם); Shimam, an Israelite; Shimeam.

H8044.d: of uncertain derivation; Shamgar, an Israelite judge; Shamgar.

H8045.d: a primitive root; to desolate; destory(-uction), bring to nought, overthrow, perish, pluck down, [idiom] utterly.

H8047.d: from שָׁמֵם; ruin; by implication, consternation; astonishment, desolate(-ion), waste, wonderful thing.

H8048.d: the same as שַׁמָּה; Shammah, the name of an Edomite and four Israelites; Shammah.

H8049.d: for שַׁמָּה; desolation; Shamhuth, an Israelite; Shamhuth.

H8050.d: from the passive participle of שָׁמַע and אֵל; heard of God; Shemuel, the name of three Israelites; Samuel, Shemuel.

H8051.d: from שָׁמֵם; renowned; Shammua, the name of four Israelites; Shammua, Shammuah.

H8052.d: feminine passive participle of שָׁמֵם; something heard, i.e. an announcement; bruit, doctrine, fame, mentioned, news, report, rumor, tidings.

H8053.d: passive participle of שִׁמְצָה; observed; Shamur, an Israelite; Shamir (from the margin).

H8054.d: plural of שַׁמָּה; ruins; Shammoth, an Israelite; Shamoth.

H8055.d: a primitive root; probably to brighten up, i.e. (figuratively) be (causatively, make) blithe or gleesome; cheer up, be (make) glad, (have, make) joy(-ful), be (make) merry, (cause to, make to) rejoice, [idiom] very.

H8056.d: from שָׂמַח; blithe or gleeful; (be) glad, joyful, (making) merry((-hearted), -ily), rejoice(-ing).

H8057.d: from שָׂמֵחַ; blithesomeness or glee, (religious or festival); [idiom] exceeding(-ly), gladness, joy(-fulness), mirth, pleasure, rejoice(-ing).

H8058.d: a primitive root; to fling down; incipiently to jostle; figuratively, to let alone, desist, remit; discontinue, overthrow, release, let rest, shake, stumble, throw down.

H8059.d: from שָׁמַט; remission (of debt) or suspension of labor); release.

H8060.d: from שַׁמְלַי; destructive; Shammai, the name of three Israelites; Shammai.

H8061.d: apparently from שֵׁם and יָדַע; name of knowing; Shemida, an Israelite; Shemida, Shemidah.

H8062.d: patronymically from שְׁמִידָע; a Shemidaite (collectively) or descendants of Shemida; Shemidaites.

H8063.d: from סָמַךְ; a run (as sustaining the Oriental sitter); mantle.

H8064.d: dual of an unused singular שָׁמֶה; from an unused root meaning to be lofty; the sky (as aloft; the dual perhaps alluding to the visible arch in which the clouds move, as well as to the higher ether where the celestial bodies revolve); air, [idiom] astrologer, heaven(-s).

H8065.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁמַיִם; {the sky (as aloft; the dual perhaps alluding to the visible arch in which the clouds move, as well as to the higher ether where the celestial bodies revolve)}; heaven.

H8067.d: feminine of שְׁמִינִי; probably an eight-stringed lyre; Sheminith.

H8068.d: from שָׁמַר in the original sense of pricking; a thorn; also (from its keenness for scratching) a gem, probably the diamond; adamant (stone), brier, diamond.

H8069.d: the same as שָׁמִיר; Shamir, the name of two places in Palestine; Shamir. Compare שָׁמוּר.

H8070.d: or שְׁמָרִימוֹת; probably from שֵׁם and plural of רָמָה; name of heights; Shemiramoth, the name of two Israelites; Shemiramoth.

H8071.d: perhaps by permutation for the feminine of סֶמֶל (through the idea of a cover assuming the shape of the object beneath); a dress, especially a mantle; apparel, cloth(-es, -ing), garment, raiment. Compare שַׂלְמָה.

H8072.d: probably for the same as שִׂמְלָה; Samlah, an Edomite; Samlah.

H8073.d: for שַׂלְמַי; Shamlai, one of the Nethinim; Shalmai (from the margin).

H8074.d: a primitive root; to stun (or intransitively, grow numb), i.e. devastate or (figuratively) stupefy (both usually in a passive sense); make amazed, be astonied, (be an) astonish(-ment), (be, bring into, unto, lay, lie, make) desolate(-ion, places), be destitute, destroy (self), (lay, lie, make) waste, wonder.

H8075.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁמֵם; {to stun (or intransitively, grow numb), i.e. devastate or (figuratively) stupefy (both usually in a passive sense)}; be astonied.

H8077.d: or שִׁמָמָה; feminine of שָׁמֵם; devastation; figuratively, astonishment; (laid, [idiom] most) desolate(-ion), waste.

H8079.d: probably from שָׁמֵם (in the sense of poisoning); a lizard (from the superstition of its noxiousness); spider.

H8080.d: a primitive root; to shine, i.e. (by analogy) be (causatively, make) oily or gross; become (make, wax) fat.

H8081.d: from שָׁמַן; grease, especially liquid (as from the olive, often perfumed); figuratively, richness; anointing, [idiom] fat (things), [idiom] fruitful, oil(-ed), ointment, olive, [phrase] pine.

H8082.d: from שָׁמַן; greasy, i.e. gross; figuratively, rich; fat, lusty, plenteous.

H8083.d: or שְׁמוֹנֶה; feminine שְׁמֹנָה; or שְׁמוֹנָה; apparently from שָׁמֵן through the idea of plumpness; a cardinal number, eight (as if a surplus above the 'perfect' seven); also (as ordinal) eighth; eight(-een, -eenth), eighth.

H8084.d: or שְׁמוֹנִים; multiple from שְׁמֹנֶה; eighty, also eightieth; eighty(-ieth), fourscore.

H8085.d: a primitive root; to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.); [idiom] attentively, call (gather) together, [idiom] carefully, [idiom] certainly, consent, consider, be content, declare, [idiom] diligently, discern, give ear, (cause to, let, make to) hear(-ken, tell), [idiom] indeed, listen, make (a) noise, (be) obedient, obey, perceive, (make a) proclaim(-ation), publish, regard, report, shew (forth), (make a) sound, [idiom] surely, tell, understand, whosoever (heareth), witness.

H8086.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁמַע; {to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)}; hear, obey.

H8087.d: for the same as שֵׁמַע; Shema, the name of a place in Palestine and of four Israelites; Shema.

H8088.d: from שָׁמַע; something heard, i.e. a sound, rumor, announcement; abstractly, audience; bruit, fame, hear(-ing), loud, report, speech, tidings.

H8090.d: for שֶׁמַע; Shema, a place in Palestine; Shema.

H8091.d: from שָׁמַע; obedient; Shama, an Israelite; Shama.

H8092.d: for שִׁמְעָה; Shima, the name of four Israelites; Shimea, Shimei, Shamma.

H8093.d: feminine of שֵׁמַע; annunciation; Shimah, an Israelite; Shimeah.

H8094.d: for שִׁמְעָה; Shemaah, an Israelite; Shemaah.

H8095.d: from שָׁמַע; hearing; Shimon, one of Jacob's sons, also the tribe descended from him; Simeon.

H8096.d: from שֵׁמַע; famous; Shimi, the name of twenty Israelites; Shimeah (from the margin), Shimei, Shimhi, Shimi.

H8097.d: patronymically from שִׁמְעִי; a Shimite (collectively) or descendants of Shimi; of Shimi, Shimites.

H8098.d: or שְׁמַעְיָהוּ; from שָׁמַע and יָהּ; Jah has heard; Shemajah, the name of twenty-five Israelites; Shemaiah.

H8099.d: patronymically from שִׁמְעוֹן; a Shimonite (collectively) or descendants of Shimon; tribe of Simeon, Simeonites.

H8100.d: feminine of שֵׁמַע; annunciation; Shimath, an Ammonitess; Shimath.

H8101.d: patronymically from שִׁמְעָה; a Shimathite (collectively) or descendants of Shimah; Shimeathites.

H8102.d: from an unused root meaning to emit a sound; an inkling; a little.

H8103.d: feminine of שֶׁמֶץ; scornful whispering (of hostile spectators); shame.

H8104.d: a primitive root; properly, to hedge about (as with thorns), i.e. guard; generally, to protect, attend to, etc.; beward, be circumspect, take heed (to self), keep(-er, self), mark, look narrowly, observe, preserve, regard, reserve, save (self), sure, (that lay) wait (for), watch(-man).

H8105.d: from שָׁמַר; something preserved, i.e. the settlings (plural only) of wine; dregs, (wines on the) lees.

H8106.d: the same as שֶׁמֶר; Shemer, the name of three Israelites; Shamer, Shemer.

H8107.d: from שָׁמַר; an observance; [idiom] be (much) observed.

H8108.d: feminine of an unused noun from שָׁמַר meaning a guard; watchfulness; watch.

H8109.d: feminine of passive participle of שָׁמַר; something guarded, i.e. an eye-lid; waking.

H8110.d: from שֶׁמֶר in its original sense; guardianship; Shimron, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine; Shimron.

H8111.d: from the active participle of שָׁמַר; watch-station; Shomeron, a place in Palestine; Samaria.

H8112.d: from שִׁמְרוֹן and a derivative of מָרָא; guard of lashing; Shimron-Meron, a place in Palestine; Shimon-meron.

H8113.d: from שֶׁמֶר in its original sense; watchful; Shimri, the name of four Israelites; Shimri.

H8114.d: or שְׁמַרְיָהוּ; from שָׁמַר and יָהּ; Jah has guarded; Shemarjah, the name of four Israelites; Shamariah, Shemariah.

H8115.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שֹׁמְרוֹן; Shomrain, a place in Palestine; Samaria.

H8116.d: feminine of שִׁמְרִי; female guard; Shimrith, a Moabitess; Shimrith.

H8117.d: lemma שׁמְרֹנִי missing vowel, corrected to שִׁמְרֹנִי; patronymically from שִׁמְרוֹן; a Shimronite (collectively) or descendants of Shimron; Shimronites.

H8118.d: patrial from שֹׁמְרוֹן; a Shomeronite (collectively) or inhabitants of Shomeron; Samaritans.

H8119.d: from שָׁמַר; guardship; Shimrath, an Israelite; Shimrath.

H8120.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to the root of שֶׁמֶשׁ through the idea of activity implied in day-light; to serve; minister.

H8121.d: from an unused root meaning to be brilliant; the sun; by implication, the east; figuratively, a ray, i.e. (architectural) a notched battlement; [phrase] east side(-ward), sun (rising), [phrase] west(-ward), window. See also בֵּית שֶׁמֶשׁ.

H8122.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שֶׁמֶשׁ; the sun; sun.

H8123.d: from שֶׁמֶשׁ; sunlight; Shimshon, an Israelite; Samson.

H8124.d: (Aramaic) from שֶׁמֶשׁ; sunny; Shimshai, a Samaritan; Shimshai.

H8125.d: apparently from שֶׁמֶשׁ; sunlike; Shamsherai, an Israelite; Shamsherai.

H8126.d: patronymically from an unused name from שׁוּם probably meaning garlic-smell; a Shumathite (collectively) or descendants of Shumah; Shumathites.

H8127.d: from שָׁנַן; compare  שֶׁנְהַבִּים; a tooth (as sharp); specifically  ivory; figuratively, a cliff; crag, [idiom] forefront, ivory, [idiom] sharp, tooth.

H8128.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שֵׁן; a tooth; tooth.

H8129.d: the same as שֵׁן; crag; Shen, a place in Palestine; Shen.

H8130.d: a primitive root; to hate (personally); enemy, foe, (be) hate(-ful, -r), odious, [idiom] utterly.

H8132.d: a primitive root; to alter; change.

H8133.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁנָא; {to alter}; alter, change, (be) diverse.

H8134.d: probably from שָׁנָא and אָב; a father has turned; Shinab, a Canaanite; Shinab.

H8136.d: from שָׁנָא; change, i.e. repetition; [idiom] angels.

H8137.d: xlit Shenatstsar corrected to Shenʼatstsar; apparently of Babylonian origin; Shenatstsar, an Israelite; Senazar.

H8138.d: a primitive root; to fold, i.e. duplicate (literally or figuratively); by implication, to transmute (transitive or intransitive); do (speak, strike) again, alter, double, (be given to) change, disguise, (be) diverse, pervert, prefer, repeat, return, do the second time.

H8140.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁנֶה; {a year (as a revolution of time)}; year.

H8141.d: (in plural or (feminine) שָׁנָה; from שָׁנָה; a year (as a revolution of time); [phrase] whole age, [idiom] long, [phrase] old, year([idiom] -ly).

H8142.d: or שֵׁנָא; (Psalm 127:2), from יָשֵׁן; sleep; sleep.

H8143.d: from שֵׁן and the plural apparently of a foreign word; probably, tooth of elephants, i.e. ivory tusk; ivory.

H8144.d: of uncertain derivation; crimson, properly, the insect or its color, also stuff dyed with it; crimson, scarlet (thread).

H8145.d: from שָׁנָה; properly, double, i.e. second; also adverbially, again; again, either (of them), (an-) other, second (time).

H8147.d: dual of שֵׁנִי; feminine שְׁתַּיִם; two; also (as ordinal) twofold; both, couple, double, second, twain, [phrase] twelfth, [phrase] twelve, [phrase] twenty (sixscore) thousand, twice, two.

H8148.d: from שָׁנַן; something pointed, i.e. a gibe; byword, taunt.

H8149.d: or שְׂנִיר; from an unused root meaning to be pointed; peak; Shenir or Senir, a summit of Lebanon; Senir, Shenir.

H8150.d: a primitive root; to point (transitive or intransitive); intensively, to pierce; figuratively, to inculcate; prick, sharp(-en), teach diligently, whet.

H8151.d: a primitive root; to compress (with a belt); gird up.

H8152.d: probably of foreign derivation; Shinar, a plain in Babylonia; Shinar.

H8154.d: or שָׁשָׂה; (Isaiah 10:13), a primitive root; to plunder; destroyer, rob, spoil(-er).

H8155.d: a primitive root; to plunder; rifle, spoil.

H8156.d: a primitive root; to split or tear; figuratively, to upbraid; cleave, (be) cloven (footed), rend, stay.

H8157.d: from שָׁסַע; a fissure; cleft, clovenfooted.

H8158.d: a primitive root; to cut in pieces, i.e. slaughter; hew in pieces.

H8159.d: a primitive root; to gaze at or about (properly, for help); by implication, to inspect, consider, compassionate, be nonplussed (as looking around in amazement) or bewildered; depart, be dim, be dismayed, look (away), regard, have respect, spare, turn.

H8160.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to שָׁעָה; properly, a look, i.e. a moment; hour.

H8161.d: feminine from an unused root meaning to stamp; a clatter (of hoofs); stamping.

H8162.d: probably of foreign derivation; linsey-woolsey, i.e. cloth of linen and wool carded and spun together; garment of divers sorts, linen and wollen.

H8163.d: or שָׂעִר; from שָׂעַר; shaggy; as noun, a he-goat; by analogy, a faun; devil, goat, hairy, kid, rough, satyr.

H8164.d: formed the same as שָׂעִיר; a shower (as tempestuous); small rain.

H8165.d: formed like שָׂעִיר; rough; Seir, a mountain of Idumaea and its aboriginal occupants, also one in Palestine; Seir.

H8166.d: feminine of שָׂעִיר; a she-goat; kid.

H8167.d: formed as שְׂעִירָה; roughness; Seirah, a place in Palestine; Seirath.

H8168.d: from an unused root meaning to hollow out; the palm; by extension, a handful; handful, hollow of the hand.

H8169.d: or שַׁעֲלַבִּין; plural from שׁוּעָל; fox-holes; Shaalbim or Shaalabbin, a place in Palestine; Shaalabbin, Shaalbim.

H8170.d: patrial from שַׁעַלְבִים; a Shaalbonite or inhabitant of Shaalbin; Shaalbonite.

H8171.d: plural of שׁוּעָל; foxes; Shaalim, a place in Palestine; Shalim.

H8172.d: a primitive root; to support one's self; lean, lie, rely, rest (on, self), stay.

H8173.d: a primitive root; (in a good acceptation) to look upon (with complacency), i.e. fondle, please or amuse (self); (in a bad one) to look about (in dismay), i.e. stare; cry (out) (by confusion with שָׁוַע), dandle, delight (self), play, shut.

H8174.d: from סָעַף; fluctuation; Shaaph, the name of two Israelites; Shaaph.

H8175.d: a primitive root; to storm; by implication, to shiver, i.e. fear; be (horribly) afraid, fear, hurl as a storm, be tempestuous, come like (take away as with) a whirlwind.

H8176.d: a primitive root; to split or open, i.e. (literally, but only as denominative from שַׁעַר); compare see שׁוֹעֵר; to act as gatekeeper; (figuratively) to estimate; think.

H8178.d: from שָׂעַר; a tempest; also a terror; affrighted, [idiom] horribly, [idiom] sore, storm. See שֵׂעָר.

H8179.d: from שָׁעַר in its original sense; an opening, i.e. door or gate; city, door, gate, port ([idiom] -er).

H8180.d: from שָׁעַר; a measure (as a section); (hundred-) fold.

H8181.d: or שַׂעַר; (Isaiah 7:20), from שָׂעַר in the sense of dishevelling; hair (as if tossed or bristling); hair(-y), [idiom] rough.

H8182.d: from שָׁעַר; harsh or horrid, i.e. offensive; vile.

H8183.d: feminine of שַׂעַר; a hurricane; storm, tempest.

H8184.d: or שְׂעוֹרָה (feminine meaning the plant); and (masculine meaning the grain); also שְׂעֹר; or שְׂעוֹר; from שָׂעַר in the sense of roughness; barley (as villose); barley.

H8186.d: or שַׁעֲרִירִיָּה; or שַׁעֲרֻרִת; feminine from שָׁעַר in the sense of שָׂעַר; something fearful; horrible thing.

H8187.d: from שָׁעַר and יָהּ; Jah has stormed; Shearjah, an Israelite; Sheariah.

H8188.d: masculine plural of שְׂעֹרָה; barley grains; Seorim, an Israelite; Seorim.

H8189.d: dual of שַׁעַר; double gates; Shaarajim, a place in Palestine; Shaaraim.

H8190.d: of Persian derivation; Shaashgaz, a eunuch of Xerxes; Shaashgaz.

H8192.d: a primitive root; to abrade, i.e. bare; high, stick out.

H8193.d: or (in dual and plural) שֶׂפֶת; probably from סָפָה or שָׁפָה through the idea of termination (compare סוֹף); the lip (as a natural boundary); by implication, language; by analogy, a margin (of a vessel, water, cloth, etc.); band, bank, binding, border, brim, brink, edge, language, lip, prating, (sea-)shore, side, speech, talk, (vain) words.

H8194.d: from שָׁפָה in the sense of clarifying; a cheese (as strained from the whey); cheese.

H8195.d: or שְׁפִי; from שָׁפָה; baldness (compare שְׁפִי); Shepho or Shephi, an Idumaean; Shephi, Shepho.

H8196.d: or שְׁפוּט; from שָׁפַט; a judicial sentence, i.e. punishment; judgment.

H8197.d: or שְׁפוּפָן; from the same as שְׁפִיפֹן; serpent-like; Shephupham or Shephuphan, an Israelite; Shephuphan, Shupham.

H8198.d: feminine from an unused root meaning to spread out (as a family; see מִשְׁפָּחָה); a female slave (as a member of the household); (bond-, hand-) maid(-en, -servant), wench, bondwoman, womanservant.

H8199.d: a primitive root; to judge, i.e. pronounce sentence (for or against); by implication, to vindicate or punish; by extenssion, to govern; passively, to litigate (literally or figuratively); [phrase] avenge, [idiom] that condemn, contend, defend, execute (judgment), (be a) judge(-ment), [idiom] needs, plead, reason, rule.

H8200.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁפַט; to judge; magistrate.

H8201.d: from שָׁפַט; a sentence, i.e. infliction; judgment.

H8202.d: from שָׁפַט; judge; Shaphat, the name of four Israelites; Shaphat.

H8203.d: or שְׁפַטְיָהוּ; from שָׁפַט and יָהּ; Jah has judged; Shephatjah, the name of ten Israelites; Shephatiah.

H8204.d: from שָׁפַט; judge-like; Shiphtan, an Israelite; Shiphtan.

H8205.d: from שָׁפָה; bareness; concretely, a bare hill or plain; high place, stick out.

H8206.d: plural of an unused noun from the same as שְׁפִיפֹן and meaning the same; serpents; Shuppim, an Israelite; Shuppim.

H8207.d: from an unused root meaning the same as שׁוּף; a kind of serpent (as snapping), probably the cerastes or horned adder; adder.

H8208.d: from שָׁפַר; beautiful; Shaphir, a place in Palestine; Saphir.

H8209.d: (Aramaic) intensive of a form corresponding to שָׁפִיר; beautiful; fair.

H8210.d: a primitive root; to spill forth (blood, a libation, liquid metal; or even a solid, i.e. to mound up); also (figuratively) to expend (life, soul, complaint, money, etc.); intensively, to sprawl out; cast (up), gush out, pour (out), shed(-der, out), slip.

H8211.d: from שָׁפַךְ; an emptying place, e.g. an ash-heap; are poured out.

H8212.d: feminine of a derivative from שָׁפַךְ; a pipe (for pouring forth, e.g. wine), i.e. the penis; privy member.

H8213.d: a primitive root; to depress or sink (expectation figuratively, to humiliate, intransitive or transitive); abase, bring (cast, put) down, debase, humble (self), be (bring, lay, make, put) low(-er).

H8214.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁפֵל; {to depress or sink (expectation figuratively, to humiliate, intransitive or transitive)}; abase, humble, put down, subdue.

H8216.d: from שָׁפֵל; an humble rank; low estate (place).

H8217.d: from שָׁפֵל; depressed, literally or figuratively; base(-st), humble, low(-er, -ly).

H8218.d: feminine of שֶׁפֶל; depression; low place.

H8219.d: from שָׁפֵל; Lowland, i.e. (with the article) the maritime slope of Palestine; low country, (low) plain, vale(-ley).

H8221.d: probably from שָׁפָה; bare spot; Shepham, a place in or near Palestine; Shepham.

H8222.d: from שָׂפָה; the beard (as a lippiece); beard, (upper) lip.

H8223.d: formed like שְׁפָם; baldly; Shapham, an Israelite; Shapham.

H8224.d: feminine plural of שְׁפָם; Siphmoth, a place in Palestine; Siphmoth.

H8225.d: patrial from שְׁפָם; a Shiphmite or inhabitant of Shepham; Shiphmite.

H8226.d: a primitive root; to conceal (as a valuable); treasure.

H8227.d: from שָׂפַן; a species of rockrabbit (from its hiding), i.e. probably the hyrax; coney.

H8228.d: from an unused root meaning to abound; resources; abundance.

H8229.d: feminine of שֶׁפַע; copiousness; abundance, company, multitude.

H8230.d: from שֶׁפַע; copious; Shiphi, an Israelite; Shiphi.

H8231.d: a primitive root; to glisten, i.e. (figuratively) be (causatively, make) fair; [idiom] goodly.

H8232.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁפַר; to be beautiful; be acceptable, please, [phrase] think good.

H8234.d: the same as שֶׁפֶר; Shepher, a place in the Desert; Shapper.

H8236.d: the same as שִׁפְרָה; Shiphrah, an Israelitess; Shiphrah.

H8237.d: from שָׁפַר; splendid, i.e. a tapestry or canopy; royal pavilion.

H8238.d: (Aramaic) from שָׁפַר; the dawn (as brilliant with aurora); [idiom] very early in the morning.

H8239.d: a primitive root; to locate, i.e. (generally) hang on or (figuratively) establish, reduce; bring, ordain, set on.

H8240.d: from שָׁפַת; a (double) stall (for cattle); also a (two-pronged) hook (for flaying animals on); hook, pot.

H8241.d: from שָׁטַף (for alliteration with קֶצֶף); an outburst (of anger); little.

H8242.d: from שָׁקַק; properly, a mesh (as allowing a liquid to run through), i.e. coarse loose cloth or sacking (used in mourning and for bagging); hence, a bag (for grain, etc.); sack(-cloth, -clothes).

H8243.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שׁוֹק; the leg; leg.

H8244.d: a primitive root; to fasten; bind.

H8245.d: a primitive root; to be alert, i.e. sleepless; hence to be on the lookout (whether for good or ill); hasten, remain, wake, watch (for).

H8246.d: a denominative from שָׁקֵד; to be (intensively, make) almond-shaped; make like (unto, after the fashion of) almonds.

H8247.d: from שָׁקַד; the almond (tree or nut; as being the earliest in bloom); almond (tree).

H8248.d: a primitive root; to quaff, i.e. (causatively) to irrigate or furnish apotion to; cause to (give, give to, let, make to) drink, drown, moisten, water. See שָׁכַר, שָׁתָה.

H8249.d: from שָׁקָה; (plural collective) a draught; drink.

H8250.d: from שָׁקָה; a beverage; moisture, i.e. (figuratively) refreshment; drink, marrow.

H8251.d: or שִׁקֻּץ; from שָׁקַץ; disgusting, i.e. filthy; especially idolatrous or (concretely) an idol; abominable filth (idol, -ation), detestable (thing).

H8252.d: a primitive root; to repose (usually figurative); appease, idleness, (at, be at, be in, give) quiet(-ness), (be at, be in, give, have, take) rest, settle, be still.

H8254.d: a primitive root; to suspend or poise (especially in trade); pay, receive(-r), spend, [idiom] throughly, weigh.

H8255.d: from שָׁקַל; probably a weight; used as a commercial standard; shekel.

H8256.d: or (feminine) שִׁקְמָה; of uncertain derivation; a sycamore (usually the tree); sycamore (fruit, tree).

H8257.d: (abbreviated Amos 8:8); a primitive root; to subside; by implication, to be overflowed, cease; causatively, to abate, subdue; make deep, let down, drown, quench, sink.

H8258.d: from שָׁקַע; a depression; hollow strake.

H8259.d: a primitive root; properly, to lean out (of a window), i.e. (by implication) peep or gaze (passively, be a spectacle); appear, look (down, forth, out).

H8260.d: from שָׁקַף; a loophole (for looking out), to admit light and air; window.

H8261.d: passive participle of שָׁקַף; (compare שֶׁקֶף); an embrasure or opening  with bevelled jam; light, window.

H8262.d: a primitive root; to be filthy, i.e. (intensively) to loathe, pollute; abhor, make abominable, have in abomination, detest, [idiom] utterly.
