H8263.d: from שָׁקַץ; filth, i.e. (figuratively and specifically) an idolatrous object; abominable(-tion).

H8264.d: a primitive root; to course (like a beast of prey); by implication, to seek greedily; have appetite, justle one against another, long, range, run (to and fro).

H8265.d: a primitive root; to ogle, i.e. blink coquettishly; wanton.

H8266.d: a primitive root; to cheat, i.e. be untrue (usually in words); fail, deal falsely, lie.

H8267.d: from שָׁקַר; an untruth; by implication, a sham (often adverbial); without a cause, deceit(-ful), false(-hood, -ly), feignedly, liar, [phrase] lie, lying, vain (thing), wrongfully.

H8268.d: from שָׁקָה; a trough (for watering); trough.

H8269.d: from שָׂרַר; a head person (of any rank or class); captain (that had rule), chief (captain), general, governor, keeper, lord,(-task-)master, prince(-ipal), ruler, steward.

H8270.d: from שָׁרַר; (compare שָׁרִיר); a string (as twisted ), i.e. (specifically) the umbilical cord (also figuratively, as the centre of strength); navel.

H8271.d: (Aramaic) a root corresponding to that of שֵׁרוּת; to free, separate; figuratively, to unravel, commence; by implication (of unloading beasts) to reside; begin, dissolve, dwell, loose.

H8272.d: of foreign derivation; Sharetser, the name of an Assyrian and an Israelite; Sharezer.

H8273.d: from an unused root meaning to glare; quivering glow (of the air), expectation. the mirage; heat, parched ground.

H8274.d: from שָׁרָב and יָהּ; Jah has brought heat; Sherebjah, the name of two Israelites; Sherebiah.

H8275.d: for שֵׁבֶט; a rod of empire; sceptre.

H8276.d: a primitive root; to intwine; wrap together, wreath.

H8277.d: a primitive root; (compare שֶׂרֶד); properly, to puncture, i.e. (figuratively through the idea of slipping out) to escape or survive; remain.

H8278.d: from שָׂרַד; stitching (as pierced with a needle); service.

H8279.d: from שָׂרַד; a (carpenter's) scribing-awl (for pricking or scratching measurements); line.

H8280.d: a primitive root; to prevail; have power (as a prince).

H8281.d: a primitive root; to free; direct.

H8282.d: feminine of שַׂר; a mistress, i.e. female noble; lady, princess, queen.

H8283.d: the same as שָׂרָה; Sarah, Abraham's wife; Sarah.

H8284.d: probably feminine of שׁוּר; a fortification (literally or figuratively); sing (by mistake for שִׁיר), wall.

H8285.d: from שָׁרַר in its original sense of pressing; a wrist-band (as compact or clasping); bracelet.

H8286.d: from שָׂרַג; tendril; Serug, a postdiluvian patriarch; Serug.

H8287.d: probably from שָׁרָה (in the sense of dwelling (compare שְׁרֵא) and חֵן; abode of pleasure; Sharuchen, a place in Palestine; Sharuhen.

H8288.d: from שָׂרַךְ; a thong (as laced or tied); (shoe-)latchet.

H8289.d: probably abridged from יָשַׁר; plain, Sharon, the name of a place in Palestine; Lasharon, Sharon.

H8290.d: patrial from שָׁרוֹן; a Sharonite or inhabitant of Sharon; Sharonite.

H8291.d: passive participle from the same as שֹׂרֵק; a grapevine; principal plant. See שָׂרֻק, שֹׂרֵק.

H8292.d: or (by permutation) שְׁרִיקָה; feminine passive participle of שָׁרַק; a whistling (in scorn); by analogy, a piping; bleating, hissing.

H8294.d: by permutation for סֶרַח; superfluity; Serach, an Israelitess; Sarah, Serah.

H8295.d: a primitive root; to gash; cut in pieces, make (cuttings) pieces.

H8296.d: and שָׂרֶטֶת; from שָׂרַט; an incision; cutting.

H8297.d: from שַׂר; dominative; Sarai, the wife of Abraham; Sarai.

H8298.d: probably from שָׁרַר; hostile; Sharay, an Israelite; Sharai.

H8299.d: from שָׂרַג; a tendril (as entwining); branch.

H8300.d: from שָׂרַד; a survivor; [idiom] alive, left, remain(-ing), remnant, rest.

H8301.d: the same as שָׂרִיד; Sarid, a place in Palestine; Sarid.

H8302.d: or שִׁרְיֹן; and שִׁרְיָן; also (feminine) שִׁרְיָה; and שִׁרְיֹנָה; from שָׁרָה in the original sense of turning; a corslet (as if twisted); breastplate, coat of mail, habergeon, harness. See סִרְיֹן.

H8303.d: and שִׂרְיֹן; the same as שְׂרָיָה (i.e. sheeted with snow); Shirjon or Sirjon, a peak of the Lebanon; Sirion.

H8304.d: or שְׂרָיָהוּ; from שָׂרָה and יָהּ; Jah has prevailed; Serajah, the name of nine Israelites; Seraiah.

H8305.d: from the same as שֹׂרֵק in the original sense of piercing; hetchelling (or combing flax), i.e. (concretely) tow (by extension, linen cloth); fine.

H8306.d: from שָׁרַר in the original sense as in שֹׁר (compare שֹׁרֶר); a cord, i.e. (by analogy) sinew; navel.

H8307.d: from שָׁרַר in the sense of twisted, i.e. firm; obstinacy; imagination, lust.

H8308.d: a primitive root; to interlace; traverse.

H8309.d: probably by an orthographical error for שְׁדֵמָה; a common; field.

H8310.d: of foreign derivation; Sarsekim, a Babylonian general; Sarsechim.

H8311.d: a primitive root; to prolong, i.e. (reflex) be deformed by excess of members; stretch out self, (have any) superfluous thing.

H8313.d: a primitive root; to be (causatively, set) on fire; (cause to, make a) burn((-ing), up) kindle, [idiom] utterly.

H8314.d: from שָׂרַף; burning, i.e. (figuratively) poisonous (serpent); specifically, a saraph or symbolical creature (from their copper color); fiery (serpent), seraph.

H8315.d: the same as שָׂרָף; Saraph, an Israelite; Saraph.

H8317.d: a primitive root; to wriggle, i.e. (by implication) swarm or abound; breed (bring forth, increase) abundantly (in abundance), creep, move.

H8318.d: from שָׁרַץ; a swarm, i.e. active mass of minute animals; creep(-ing thing), move(-ing creature).

H8319.d: a primitive root; properly, to be shrill, i.e. to whistle or hiss (as a call or in scorn); hiss.

H8320.d: from שָׁרַק; bright red (as piercing to the sight), i.e. bay; speckled. See שָׂרוּק.

H8321.d: or שׂוֹרֵק; and (feminine) שֹׂרֵקָה; from שָׁרַק in the sense of redness (compare שָׂרֻק); a vine stock (properly, one yielding purple grapes, the richest variety); choice(-st, noble) wine. Compare שָׂרוּק.

H8323.d: a primitive root; to have (transitively, exercise; reflexively, get) dominion; [idiom] altogether, make self a prince, (bear) rule.

H8324.d: a primitive root; to be hostile (only active participle an opponent); enemy.

H8325.d: from שָׁרַר; hostile; Sharar, an Israelite; Sharar.

H8326.d: from שָׁרַר in the sense of twisting (compare שֹׁר); the umbilical cord, i.e. (by extension) a bodice; navel.

H8327.d: a primitive root; to root, i.e. strike into the soil, or (by implication) to pluck from it; (take, cause to take) root (out).

H8328.d: from שָׁרַשׁ; a root (literally or figuratively); bottom, deep, heel, root.

H8329.d: the same as שֶׁרֶשׁ; Sheresh, an Israelite; Sharesh.

H8330.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שֶׁרֶשׁ; {a root (literally or figuratively)}; root.

H8331.d: from שָׁרַשׁ; a chain (as rooted, i.e. linked); chain. Compare שַׁרְשְׁרָה.

H8332.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to שָׁרַשׁ; eradication, i.e. (figuratively) exile; banishment.

H8333.d: from שָׁרַשׁ (compare שַׁרְשָׁה); a chain; (architectural) probably a garland; chain.

H8334.d: a primitive root; to attend as a menial or worshipper; figuratively, to contribute to; minister (unto), (do) serve(-ant, -ice, -itor), wait on.

H8335.d: infinitive of שָׁרַת; service (in the Temple); minister(-ry).

H8336.d: or (for alliteration with מֶשִׁי) שְׁשִׁי; for שַׁיִשׁ; bleached stuff, i.e. white linen or (by analogy) marble; [idiom] blue, fine (twined) linen, marble, silk.

H8337.d: masculine שִׁשָּׁה; a primitive number; compare שׂוּשׂ; six (as an overplus  beyond five or the fingers of the hand); as ord. sixth; six(-teen, -teenth), sixth.

H8338.d: xlit shâwshâw corrected to shâshâʼ; a primitive root; apparently,; to annihilate; leave by the sixth part (by confusion with שָׁשָׁה).

H8339.d: of foreign derivation; Sheshbatstsar, Zerubbabel's Persian name; Sheshbazzar.

H8340.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שֵׁשְׁבַּצַּר; {Sheshbatstsar, Zerubbabel's Persian name}; Sheshbazzar.

H8341.d: a denominative from שֵׁשׁ; to sixth or divide into sixths; give the sixth participle

H8342.d: or שָׂשֹׂן; from שׂוּשׂ; cheerfulness; specifically, welcome; gladness, joy, mirth, rejoicing.

H8343.d: perhaps from שֵׁשׁ; whitish; Shashai, an Israelite; Shashai.

H8344.d: probably for שָׁשַׁי; Sheshai, a Canaanite; Sheshai.

H8345.d: from שֵׁשׁ; sixth, ord. or (feminine) fractional; sixth (part).

H8346.d: multiple of שֵׁשׁ; sixty; sixty, three score.

H8347.d: of foreign derivation; Sheshak, a symbolic name of Babylon; Sheshach.

H8348.d: perhaps for שׁוּשַׁן; lily; Sheshan, an Israelite; Sheshan.

H8349.d: probably from the base of שׁוֹק; pedestrian; Shashak, an Israelite; Shashak.

H8350.d: perhaps from the base of שָׁרַר in the sense of that of שָׂרֻק; red ochre (from its piercing color); vermillion.

H8352.d: from שִׁית; put, i.e. substituted; Sheth, third son of Adam; Seth, Sheth.

H8353.d: (Aramaic) or שִׁת; (Aramaic), corresponding to שֵׁשׁ; {six}; six(-th).

H8354.d: a primitive root; to imbibe (literally or figuratively); [idiom] assuredly, banquet, [idiom] certainly, drink(-er, -ing), drunk ([idiom] -ard), surely. (Prop. intensive of שָׁקָה.)

H8355.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁתָה; {to imbibe (literally or figuratively)}; drink.

H8356.d: from שִׁית; a basis, i.e. (figuratively) political or moral support; foundation, purpose.

H8357.d: from שִׁית; the seat (of the person); buttock.

H8359.d: from שִׁית; a fixture, i.e. the warp in weaving; warp.

H8361.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שִׁשִּׁים (compare שֵׁת); sixty; threescore.

H8362.d: a primitive root; to transplant; plant.

H8363.d: xlit shᵉthiyl corrected to shᵉthil; from שָׁתַל; a sprig (as if transplanted), i.e. sucker; plant.

H8364.d: patronymically from שׁוּתֶלַח; a Shuthalchite (collectively) or descendants of Shuthelach; Shuthalhites.

H8365.d: a primitive root; to unveil (figuratively); be open.

H8366.d: a primitive root; (causatively) to make water, i.e. urinate; piss.

H8367.d: a primitive root; to subside; be calm, cease, be quiet.

H8368.d: a primitive root; to break out (as an eruption); have in (one's) secret parts.

H8369.d: of foreign derivation; Shethar, a Persian satrap; Shethar.

H8370.d: of foreign derivation; Shethar-Bozenai, a Persian officer; Shetharboznai.

H8371.d: a primitive root; to place, i.e. array; reflex. to lie; be laid, set. t

H8372.d: and (feminine) תָּאָה; (Ezekiel 40:12), from (the base of) תָּאָה; a room (as circumscribed); (little) chamber.

H8373.d: a primitive root; to desire; long.

H8374.d: a primitive root (probably identical with תָּאַב through the idea of puffing disdainfully at; compare אָיַב); to loathe (morally); abhor.

H8376.d: a primitive root; to mark off, i.e. (intensively) designate; point out.

H8377.d: and תּוֹא; (the original form), from תָּאָה; a species of antelope (probably from the white stripe on the cheek); wild bull (ox).

H8378.d: from אָוָה (abbreviated); a longing; by implication, a delight (subjectively, satisfaction, objectively, a charm); dainty, desire, [idiom] exceedingly, [idiom] greedily, lust(ing), pleasant. See also קִבְרוֹת הַתַּאֲוָה.

H8379.d: from תָּאָה; a limit, i.e. full extent; utmost bound.

H8380.d: or תָּאֹם; from תָּאַם; a twin (in plural only), literally or figuratively; twins.

H8382.d: a primitive root; to be complete; but used only as denominative from תָּאוֹם,; to be (causatively, make) twinned, i.e. (figuratively) duplicate or (architectural) jointed; coupled (together), bear twins.

H8383.d: from אָוֶן; naughtiness, i.e. toil; lie.

H8384.d: or (in the singular, feminine) תְּאֵנָה; perhaps of foreign derivation; the fig (tree or fruit); fig (tree).

H8385.d: or תֹּאֲנָה; from אָנָה; an opportunity or (subjectively) purpose; occasion.

H8387.d: from תַּאֲנָה and שִׁילֹה; approach of Shiloh; Taanath-Shiloh, a place in Palestine; Taanath-shiloh.

H8388.d: a primitive root; to delineate; reflex. to extend; be drawn, mark out, (Rimmon-) methoar (by union with רִמּוֹן).

H8389.d: from תָּאַר; outline, i.e. figure or appearance; [phrase] beautiful, [idiom] comely, countenance, [phrase] fair, [idiom] favoured, form, [idiom] goodly, [idiom] resemble, visage.

H8390.d: perhaps from אֲרַע; Taarea, an Israelite; Tarea. See תַּחְרֵעַ.

H8391.d: from אָשַׁר; a species of cedar (from its erectness); box (tree).

H8392.d: perhaps of foreign derivation; a box; ark.

H8393.d: from בּוֹא; income, i.e. produce (literally or figuratively); fruit, gain, increase, revenue.

H8394.d: and (feminine) תְּבוּנָה; or תּוֹבֻנָה; from בִּין; intelligence; by implication, an argument; by extension, caprice; discretion, reason, skilfulness, understanding, wisdom.

H8395.d: from בּוּס; a treading down, i.e. ruin; destruction.

H8396.d: from a root corresponding to תְּבַר; broken region; Tabor, a mountain in Palestine, also a city adjacent; Tabor.

H8397.d: apparently from בָּלַל; mixture, i.e. unnatural bestiality; confusion.

H8398.d: from יָבַל; the earth (as moist and therefore inhabited); by extension, the globe; by implication, its inhabitants; specifically, a particular land, as Babylonia, Palestine; habitable part, world.

H8400.d: from בָּלַל in the original sense of flowing; a cataract (in the eye); blemish.

H8401.d: probably from בָּנָה; properly, material, i.e. (specifically) refuse haum or stalks of grain (as chopped in threshing and used for fodder); chaff, straw, stubble.

H8402.d: xlit Tibni corrected to Tibnîy; from תֶּבֶן; strawy; Tibni, an Israelite; Tibni.

H8403.d: from בָּנָה; structure; by implication, a model, resemblance; figure, form, likeness, pattern, similitude.

H8404.d: from בָּעַר; burning; Taberah, a place in the Desert; Taberah.

H8405.d: from the same as בּוּץ; whiteness; Tebets, a place in Palestine; Thebez.

H8406.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁבַר; to be fragile (figuratively); broken.

H8407.d: or תִּגְלַת פְּלֶסֶר; or תִּלְגַּת פִּלְנְאֶסֶר or תִּלְגַּת פִּלְנֶסֶר; of foreign derivation; Tiglath-Pileser or Tilgath-pilneser, an Assyryrian king; Tiglath-pileser, Tilgath-pilneser.

H8409.d: from גָּרָה; strife, i.e. infliction; blow.

H8410.d: apparently from דָּהַר; enduring; a species of hard-wood or lasting tree (perhaps oak); pine (tree).

H8411.d: (Aramaic) from דּוּר in the original sense of enduring; permanence, i.e. (adverb) constantly; continually.

H8412.d: or תַּמֹּר; (1 Kings 9:18), apparently from תָּמָר; palm-city; Tadmor, a place near Palestine; Tadmor.

H8413.d: perhaps from דְּחַל; fearfulness; Tidal, a Canaanite; Tidal.

H8414.d: from an unused root meaning to lie waste; a desolation (of surface), i.e. desert; figuratively, a worthless thing; adverbially, in vain; confusion, empty place, without form, nothing, (thing of) nought, vain, vanity, waste, wilderness.

H8415.d: or תְּהֹם; (usually feminine) from הוּם; an abyss (as a surging mass of water), especially the deep (the main sea or the subterranean watersupply); deep (place), depth.

H8416.d: from הָלַל; laudation; specifically (concretely) a hymn; praise.

H8417.d: feminine of an unused noun (apparently from הָלַל) meaning bluster; braggadocio, i.e. (by implication) fatuity; folly.

H8419.d: from הָפַךְ; a perversity or fraud; (very) froward(-ness, thing), perverse thing.

H8420.d: from תָּוָה; a mark; by implication, a signature; desire, mark.

H8421.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שׁוּב, to come back; specifically (transitive and ellip.) to reply; answer, restore, return (an answer).

H8422.d: or תֻּבַל; probably of foreign derivation; Tubal, a postdiluvian patriarch and his posterity; Tubal.

H8423.d: apparently from יָבַל (compare יְבוּל) and קַיִן; offspring of Cain; Tubal-Kajin, an antidiluvian patriarch; Tubal-cain.

H8424.d: from יָגָה; depression (of spirits); concretely a grief; heaviness, sorrow.

H8425.d: or תֹּגַרְמָה; probably of foreign derivation; Togarmah, a son of Gomer and his posterity; Togarmah.

H8426.d: from יָדָה; properly, an extension of the hand, i.e. (by implication) avowal, or (usually) adoration; specifically, a choir of worshippers; confession, (sacrifice of) praise, thanks(-giving, offering).

H8427.d: a primitive root; to mark out, i.e. (primitive) scratch or (definite) imprint; scrabble, set (a mark).

H8428.d: a primitive root (or perhaps identical with תָּוָה through a similar idea from scraping to pieces); to grieve; limit (by confusion with תָּוָה).

H8429.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to תָּמַהּ or perhaps to שָׁאָה through the idea of sweeping to ruin (compare תָּוָה); to amaze, i.e. (reflex. by implication) take alarm; be astonied.

H8430.d: from an unused root meaning to depress; humble; Toach, an Israelite; Toah.

H8432.d: from an unused root meaning to sever; a bisection, i.e. (by implication) the centre; among(-st), [idiom] between, half, [idiom] (there-, where-), in(-to), middle, mid(-night), midst (among), [idiom] out (of), [idiom] through, [idiom] with(-in).

H8433.d: and תּוֹכַחַת; from יָכַח; chastisement; figuratively (by words) correction, refutation, proof (even in defence); argument, [idiom] chastened, correction, reasoning, rebuke, reproof, [idiom] be (often) reproved.

H8434.d: from יָלַד; posterity; Tolad, a place in Palestine; Tolad. Compare אֶלְתּוֹלַד.

H8435.d: or תֹּלְדָה; from יָלַד; (plural only) descent, i.e. family; (figuratively) history; birth, generations.

H8436.d: xlit Tûwlôn corrected to Tûwlôwn; from תָּלַל; suspension; Tulon, an Israelite; Tilon (from the margin).

H8437.d: from יָלַל; causing to howl, i.e. an oppressor; that wasted.

H8438.d: and (feminine) תּוֹלֵעָה; or תּוֹלַעַת; or תֹּלַעַת; from יָלַע; a maggot (as voracious); specifically (often with ellipsis of שָׁנִי); the crimson-grub, but used only (in this connection) of the colorfrom it, and cloths dyed therewith; crimson, scarlet, worm.

H8439.d: the same as תּוֹלָע; worm; Tola, the name of two Israelites; Tola.

H8440.d: patronymically from תּוֹלָע; a Tolaite (collectively) or descendants of Tola; Tolaites.

H8441.d: or תֹּעֵבַה; feminine active participle of תַּעָב; properly, something disgusting (morally), i.e. (as noun) an abhorrence; especially idolatry or (concretely) an idol; abominable (custom, thing), abomination.

H8442.d: feminine active participle of תָּעָה; mistake, i.e. (morally) impiety, or (political) injury; error, hinder.

H8443.d: from יָעַף; (only in plural collective) weariness, i.e. (by implication) toil (treasure so obtained) or speed; plenty, strength.

H8444.d: or תֹּצָאָה; from יָצָא; (only in plural collective) exit, i.e. (geographical) boundary, or (figuratively) deliverance, (actively) source; border(-s), going(-s) forth (out), issues, outgoings.

H8445.d: from the same as יִקָּהָה; obedience; Tokahath, an Israelite; Tikvath (by correction for תִּקְוָה).

H8446.d: a primitive root; to meander (causatively, guide) about, especially fortrade or reconnoitring; chap(-man), sent to descry, be excellent, merchant(-man), search (out), seek, (e-) spy (out).

H8447.d: or תֹּר; from תּוּר; a succession, i.e. a string or (abstractly) order; border, row, turn.

H8448.d: probably the same as תּוֹר; a manner (as a sort of turn); estate.

H8449.d: or תֹּר; probably the same as תּוֹר; a ring-dove, often (figuratively) as a term of endearment; (turtle) dove.

H8450.d: (Aramaic) corresponding (by permutation) to שׁוֹר; a bull; bullock, ox.

H8451.d: or תֹּרָה; from יָרָה; a precept or statute, especially the Decalogue or Pentateuch; law.

H8452.d: probably feminine of תּוֹר; a custom; manner.

H8453.d: or תֹּשָׁב; (1 Kings 17:1), from יָשַׁב; a dweller (but not outlandish (נׇכְרִי)); especially (as distinguished from a native citizen (active participle of יָשַׁב) and a temporary inmate (גֵּר) or mere lodger (לוּן)); resident alien; foreigner, inhabitant, sojourner, stranger.

H8454.d: or תֻּשִׁיָּה; from an unused root probably meaning to substantiate; support or (by implication) ability, i.e. (direct) help, (in purpose) an undertaking, (intellectual) understanding; enterprise, that which (thing as it) is, substance, (sound) wisdom, working.

H8455.d: from an unused root meaning to smite; a club; darts.

H8456.d: a primitive root; to lop off; cut down.

H8457.d: or תַּזְנֻת; from זָנָה; harlotry, i.e. (figuratively) idolatry; fornication, whoredom.

H8458.d: or תַּחְבּוּלָה; from חָבַל as denominative from חֶבֶל; (only in plural) properly, steerage (as a management of ropes), i.e. (figuratively) guidance or (by implication) a plan; good advice, (wise) counsels.

H8459.d: from an unused root meaning to depress; abasement; Tochu, an Israelite; Tohu.

H8460.d: (Aramaic) or תּחֹת; (Aramaic), corresponding to תַּחַת; beneath; under.

H8461.d: probably for חַכְמוֹנִי; sagacious; Tachkemoni, an Israelite; Tachmonite.

H8462.d: from חָלַל in the sense of opening; a commencement; rel. original (adverb, -ly); begin(-ning), first (time).

H8463.d: or תַּחֲלֻא; from חָלָא; a malady; disease, [idiom] grievous, (that are) sick(-ness).

H8464.d: from חָמַס; a species of unclean bird (from its violence), perhaps an owl; night hawk.

H8465.d: probably from חָנָה; station; Tachan, the name of two Israelites; Tahan.

H8466.d: from חָנָה; (only plural collectively) an encampment; camp.

H8467.d: from חָנַן; graciousness; causatively, entreaty; favour, grace, supplication.

H8468.d: the same as תְּחִנָּה; Techinnah, an Israelite; Tehinnah.

H8469.d: or (feminine) תַּחֲנוּנָה; from חָנַן; earnest prayer; intreaty, supplication.

H8470.d: patronymically from תַּחַן; a Tachanite (collectively) or descendants of Tachan; Tahanites.

H8471.d: or תְּחַפְנְחֵס; (Ezekiel 30:18), or תַּחְפְּנֵס; (Jeremiah 2:16), of Egyptian derivation; Tachpanches, Techaphneches or Tachpenes, a place in Egypt; Tahapanes, Tahpanhes, Tehaphnehes.

H8472.d: of Egyptian derivation; Tachpenes, an Egyptian woman; Tahpenes.

H8473.d: from חָרָה in the original sense of חוּר or חוּר; a linen corslet (as white or hollow); habergeon.

H8474.d: a facitious root from חָרָה through the idea of the heat of jealousy; to vie with a rival; close, contend.

H8475.d: for תַּאֲרֵעַ; Tachrea, an Israelite; Tahrea.

H8476.d: probably of foreign derivation; a (clean) animal with fur, probably a species of antelope; badger.

H8477.d: the same as תַּחַשׁ; Tachash, a relative of Abraham; Thahash.

H8478.d: from the same as תּוֹחַ; the bottom (as depressed); only adverbially, below (often with prepositional prefix underneath), in lieu of, etc.; as, beneath, [idiom] flat, in(-stead), (same) place (where...is), room, for...sake, stead of, under, [idiom] unto, [idiom] when...was mine, whereas, (where-) fore, with.

H8479.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to תַּחַת; {the bottom (as depressed); only adverbially, below (often with prepositional prefix underneath), in lieu of, etc.}; under.

H8480.d: the same as תַּחַת; Tachath, the name of a place in the Desert, also of three Israelites; Tahath.

H8481.d: or תַּחְתֹּן; from תַּחַת; bottommost; lower(-est), nether(-most).

H8482.d: from תַּחַת; lowermost; as noun (feminine plural) the depths (figuratively, a pit, the womb); low (parts, -er, -er parts, -est), nether (part).

H8483.d: apparently from the plural masculine of תַּחְתִּי or תַּחַת and חֹדֶשׁ; lower (ones) monthly; Tachtim-Chodshi, a place in Palestine; Tahtim-hodshi.

H8484.d: or תִּיכֹן; from תָּוֶךְ; central; middle(-most), midst.

H8485.d: or תֵּמָא; probably of foreign derivation; Tema, a son of Ishmael, and the region settled by him; Tema.

H8486.d: or תֵּמָן; denominative from יָמִין; the south (as being on the right hand of a person facing the east); south (side, -ward, wind).

H8487.d: or תֵּמָן; the same as תֵּימָן; Teman, the name of two Edomites, and of the region and descendant of one of them; south, Teman.

H8488.d: probably for תֵּימָנִי; Temeni, an Israelite; Temeni.

H8489.d: patronymically from תֵּימָן; a Temanite or descendant of Teman; Temani, Temanite.

H8490.d: or תִּמָרָה; from the same as תָּמָר; a column, i.e. cloud; pillar.

H8491.d: patrial or patronymically from an unused noun of uncertain meaning; a Titsite or descendant or inhabitant of an unknown Tits; Tizite.

H8492.d: or תִּירֹשׁ; from יָרַשׁ in the sense of expulsion; must or fresh grape-juice (as just squeezed out); by implication (rarely) fermented wine; (new, sweet) wine.

H8493.d: probably from יָרֵא; fearful, Tirja, an Israelite; Tiria.

H8494.d: probably of foreign derivation; Tiras, a son of Japheth; Tiras.

H8495.d: from an unused root meaning to butt; a buck or he-goat (as given to butting); he goat.

H8496.d: or תּוֹך; (Psalm 72:14), from the same base as תָּוֶךְ (in the sense of cutting to pieces); oppression; deceit, fraud.

H8497.d: a primitive root; to strew, i.e. encamp; sit down.

H8498.d: feminine passive participle of תָּכַן; adjustment, i.e. structure; by implication, equipage; fashion, store.

H8499.d: from כּוּן; or probably identical with תְּכוּנָה; something arranged or fixed, i.e. a place; seat.

H8500.d: or תּוּכִּי; probably of foreign derivation; some imported creature, probably a peacock; peacock.

H8501.d: from an unused root meaning; to dissever, i.e. crush; deceitful.

H8503.d: from כָּלָה; completion; by implication, an extremity; end, perfect(-ion).

H8504.d: probably for שְׁחֶלֶת; the cerulean mussel, i.e. the color (violet) obtained therefrom or stuff dyed therewith; blue.

H8505.d: a primitive root; to balance, i.e. measure out (by weight or dimension); figuratively, arrange, equalize, through the idea of levelling (ment. estimate, test); bear up, direct, be (un-)equal, mete, ponder, tell, weigh.

H8506.d: from תָּכַן; a fixed quantity; measure, tale.

H8507.d: the same as תֹּכֶן; Token, a place in Palestine; Tochen.

H8508.d: from תֹּכֶן; admeasurement, i.e. consummation; pattern, sum.

H8509.d: apparently from an unused root meaning to encompass; a wrapper or robe; garment.

H8510.d: by contraction from תָּלַל; a mound; heap, [idiom] strength.

H8511.d: a primitive root; to suspend; figuratively (through hesitation) to be uncertain; by implication (of mental dependence) to habituate; be bent, hang (in doubt).

H8512.d: from תֵּל and אָבִיב; mound of green growth; Tel-Abib, a place in Chaldaea; Tel-abib.

H8513.d: from לָאָה; distress; travail, travel, trouble.

H8515.d: or תְּלַשַּׂר; of foreign derivation; Telassar, a region of Assyria; Telassar.

H8518.d: a primitive root; to suspend (especially to gibbet); hang (up).

H8519.d: or תּלֻנָּה; from לוּן in the sense of obstinacy; a grumbling; murmuring.

H8520.d: probably from an unused root meaning to dissever; breach; Telach, an Israelite; Telah.

H8521.d: from תֵּל and the feminine of חֲרָשִׁים; mound of workmanship; Tel-Charsha, a place in Babylonia; Tel-haresha, Tel-harsa.

H8522.d: probably from תָּלָה; a quiver (as slung); quiver.

H8523.d: (Aramaic) or תַּלְתִּי; (Aramaic), ordinal from תְּלָת; third; third.

H8524.d: a primitive root; to pile up, i.e. elevate; eminent. Compare הָתַל.

H8525.d: from an unused root meaning to accumulate; a bank or terrace; furrow, ridge.

H8526.d: from תֶּלֶם; ridged; Talmai, the name of a Canaanite and a Syrian; Talmai.

H8528.d: from תֵּל and מֶלַח; mound of salt; Tel-Melach, a place in Babylonia; Tel-melah.

H8529.d: a denominative from תּוֹלָע; to crimson, i.e. dye that color; [idiom] scarlet.

H8530.d: feminine from an unused root meaning to tower; something tall, i.e. (plural collective) slenderness; armoury.

H8531.d: (Aramaic) from תְּלָת; a tertiary rank; third.

H8532.d: (Aramaic) masculine תְּלָתָה; (Aramaic), or תְּלָתָא; (Aramaic), corresponding to שָׁלוֹשׁ; three or third; third, three.

H8533.d: (Aramaic) multiple of תְּלָת; ten times three; thirty.

H8534.d: by reduplication, from תָּלַל through the idea of vibration; a trailing bough (as pendulous); bushy.

H8535.d: from תָּמַם; complete; usually (morally) pious; specifically, gentle, dear; coupled together, perfect, plain, undefiled, upright.

H8536.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁם; there; [idiom] thence, there, [idiom] where.

H8537.d: from תָּמַם; completeness; figuratively, prosperity; usually (morally) innocence; full, integrity, perfect(-ion), simplicity, upright(-ly, -ness), at a venture. See תֻּמִּים.

H8539.d: a primitive root; to be in consternation; be amazed, be astonished, marvel(-lously), wonder.

H8540.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to תָּמַהּ; a miracle; wonder.

H8542.d: of uncertain derivation; Tammuz, a Phoenician deity; Tammuz.

H8543.d: or תְּמֹל; probably for אֶתְמוֹל; sometimes with  שִׁלְשׁוֹם; properly, ago, i.e. a (short or long) time since; especially yesterday, or  day before yesterday; [phrase] before (-time), [phrase] these (three) days, [phrase] heretofore, [phrase] time past, yesterday.

H8544.d: or תְּמֻנָה; from מִין; something portioned (i.e. fashioned) out, as ashape, i.e. (indefinitely) phantom, or (specifically) embodiment, or (figuratively) manifestation (of favor); image, likeness, similitude.

H8545.d: from מוּר; barter, compensation; (ex-) change(-ing), recompense, restitution.

H8546.d: from מוּת; execution (as a doom); death, die.

H8547.d: of uncertain derivation; Temach, one of the Nethinim; Tamah, Thamah.

H8548.d: from an unused root meaning to stretch; properly, continuance (as indefinite extension); but used only (attributively as adjective) constant (or adverbially, constantly); ellipt. the regular (daily) sacrifice; alway(-s), continual (employment, -ly), daily, (n-)ever(-more), perpetual.

H8549.d: from תָּמַם; entire (literally, figuratively or morally); also (as noun) integrity, truth; without blemish, complete, full, perfect, sincerely (-ity), sound, without spot, undefiled, upright(-ly), whole.

H8550.d: plural of תֹּם; perfections, i.e. (techn.) one of the epithets of the objects in the high-priest's breastplate as an emblem of complete Truth; Thummim.

H8551.d: a primitive root; to sustain; by implication, to obtain, keep fast; figuratively, to help, follow close; (take, up-) hold (up), maintain, retain, stay (up).

H8552.d: a primitive root; to complete, in a good or a bad sense, literal, or figurative, transitive or intransitive; accomplish, cease, be clean (pass-) ed, consume, have done, (come to an, have an, make an) end, fail, come to the full, be all gone, [idiom] be all here, be (make) perfect, be spent, sum, be (shew self) upright, be wasted, whole.

H8553.d: from מָנָה; a portion assigned; Timnah, the name of two places in Palestine; Timnah, Timnath, Thimnathah.

H8554.d: patrial from תִּמְנָה; a Timnite or inhabitant of Timnah; Timnite.

H8555.d: from מָנַע; restraint; Timna, the name of two Edomites; Timna, Timnah.

H8556.d: or תִּמְנַת סֶרַח; from תִּמְנָה and חֶרֶס; portion of (the) sun; Timnath-Cheres, a place in Palestine; Timnath-heres, Timnath-serah.

H8557.d: from מָסָה; liquefaction, i.e. disappearance; melt.

H8558.d: from an unused root meaning to be erect; a palm tree; palm (tree).

H8559.d: the same as תָּמָר; Tamar, the name of three women and a place; Tamar.

H8560.d: from the same root as תָּמָר; a palm trunk; palm tree.

H8561.d: (plural or (feminine) תִּמֹּרָה; (singular and plural), from the same root as תָּמָר; (architectural) a palm-like pilaster (i.e. umbellate); palm tree.

H8562.d: or תַּמְרֻק; or תַּמְרִיק; from מָרַק; properly, a scouring, i.e. soap or perfumery forthe bath; figuratively, a detergent; [idiom] cleanse, (thing for) purification(-fying).

H8563.d: from מָרַר; bitterness (plural as collective); [idiom] most bitter(-ly).

H8564.d: from the same root as תָּמָר; an erection, i.e. pillar (probably for a guide-board); high heap.

H8565.d: from an unused root probably meaning to elongate; a monster (as preternaturally formed), i.e. a sea-serpent (or other huge marine animal); also a jackal (or other hideous land animal); dragon, whale. Compare תַּנִּין.

H8566.d: a primitive root; to present (a mercenary inducement), i.e. bargain with (a harlot); hire.

H8567.d: a primitive root (identical with through the idea of attributing honor); to ascribe (praise), i.e. celebrate, commemorate; lament, rehearse.

H8568.d: probably feminine of תַּן; a female jackal; dragon.

H8569.d: from נוּא; alienation; by implication, enmity; breach of promise, occasion.

H8571.d: perhaps from the same as אֲנָךְ through the idea of protraction; a pinnacle, i.e. extremity; tip.

H8572.d: from נוּם; drowsiness, i.e. sleep; slumber(-ing).

H8573.d: from נוּף; a brandishing (in threat); by implication, tumult; specifically, the official undulation of sacrificial offerings; offering, shaking, wave (offering).

H8574.d: from נִיר; a fire-pot; furnace, oven.

H8575.d: or תַּנְחֻם; and (feminine) תַּנְחוּמָה; from נָחַם; compassion, solace; comfort, consolation.

H8576.d: for תַּנְחוּם (feminine); Tanchumeth, an Israelite; Tanhumeth.

H8577.d: or תַּנִּים; (Ezekiel 29:3), intensive from the same as תַּן; a marine or land monster, i.e. sea-serpent or jackal; dragon, sea-monster, serpent, whale.

H8579.d: (Aramaic) from תִּנְיָן; a second time; again.

H8580.d: from נָשַׁם; properly, a hard breather, i.e. the name of two unclean creatures, a lizard and abird (both perhaps from changing color through their irascibility), probably the tree-toad and the water-hen; mole, swan.

H8581.d: a primitive root; to loathe, i.e. (morally) detest; (make to be) abhor(-red), (be, commit more, do) abominable(-y), [idiom] utterly.

H8582.d: a primitive root; to vacillate, i.e. reel or stray (literally or figuratively); also causative of both; (cause to) go astray, deceive, dissemble, (cause to, make to) err, pant, seduce, (make to) stagger, (cause to) wander, be out of the way.

H8583.d: or תֹּעִי; from תָּעָה; error; Tou or Toi, a Syrian king; Toi, Tou.

H8584.d: from עוּד; attestation, i.e. a precept, usage; testimony.

H8585.d: from עָלָה; a channel (into which water is raised for irrigation); also a bandage or plaster (as placed upon a wound); conduit, cured, healing, little river, trench, watercourse.

H8586.d: from עָלַל; caprice (as a fit coming on), i.e. vexation; concretely a tyrant; babe, delusion.

H8587.d: from עָלַם; a secret; thing that is hid, secret.

H8588.d: or תַּעֲנֻג; and (feminine) תַּעֲנֻגָה; from עָנַג; luxury; delicate, delight, pleasant.

H8589.d: from עָנָה; affliction (of self), i.e. fasting; heaviness.

H8590.d: or תַּעְנָךְ; of uncertain derivation; Taanak or Tanak, a place in Palestine; Taanach, Tanach.

H8591.d: a primitive root; to cheat; by analogy, to maltreat; deceive, misuse.

H8593.d: from עָרָה; a knife or razor (as making bare); also a scabbard (as being bare, i.e. empty); (pen-) knife, razor, scabbard, shave, sheath.

H8594.d: from עָרַב; suretyship, i.e. (concretely) a pledge; [phrase] hostage.

H8596.d: from תָּפַף contracted; a tambourine; tabret, timbrel.

H8597.d: or תִּפְאֶרֶת; from פָּאַר; ornament (abstractly or concretely, literally or figuratively); beauty(-iful), bravery, comely, fair, glory(-ious), honour, majesty.

H8598.d: from נָפַח; an apple (from its fragrance), i.e. the fruit or the tree (probably includ. others of the pome order, as the quince, the orange, etc.); apple (tree). See also בֵּית תַּפּוּחַ.

H8599.d: the same as תַּפּוּחַ; Tappuach, the name of two places in Palestine, also of an Israelite; Tappuah.

H8601.d: from אָפָה; cookery, i.e. (concretely) a cake; baked piece.

H8602.d: from an unused root meaning to smear; plaster (as gummy) or slime; (figuratively) frivolity; foolish things, unsavoury, untempered.

H8603.d: from the same as תָּפֵל; quagmire; Tophel, a place near the Desert; Tophel.

H8604.d: from the same as תָּפֵל; frivolity; folly, foolishly.

H8605.d: from פָּלַל; intercession, supplication; by implication, a hymn; prayer.

H8607.d: from פָּסַח; ford; Tiphsach, a place in Mesopotamia; Tipsah.

H8608.d: a primitive root; to drum, i.e. play (as) on the tambourine; taber, play with timbrels.

H8609.d: a primitive root; to sew; (women that) sew (together).

H8610.d: a primitive root; to manipulate, i.e. seize; chiefly to capture, wield, specifically, to overlay; figuratively, to use unwarrantably; catch, handle, (lay, take) hold (on, over), stop, [idiom] surely, surprise, take.

H8611.d: from the base of תָּפַף; a smiting, i.e. (figuratively) contempt; tabret.

H8612.d: the same as תֹּפֶת; Topheth, a place near Jerusalem; Tophet, Topheth.

H8613.d: probably a form of תֹּפֶת; Tophteh, a place of cremation; Tophet.

H8614.d: (Aramaic) perhaps from שָׁפַט; judicial, i.e. a lawyer; sheriff.

H8615.d: from קָוָה; (compare קָוֶה); literally a cord (as an attachment); figuratively, expectancy; expectation(-ted), hope, live, thing that I long for.

H8616.d: the same as תִּקְוָה; Tikvah, the name of two Israelites; Tikvah.

H8617.d: from קוּם; resistfulness; power to stand.

H8618.d: from קוּם; an opponent; rise up against.

H8619.d: from תָּקַע (in the musical sense); a trumpet; trumpet.

H8620.d: a form of תָּקוֹעַ; Tekoa, a place in Palestine; Tekoa, Tekoah.

H8621.d: or תְּקֹעִי; patronymically from תְּקוֹעַ; a Tekoite or inhabitant of Tekoah; Tekoite.

H8622.d: or תְּקֻפָה; from נָקַף; a revolution, i.e. (of the sun) course, (of time) lapse; circuit, come about, end.

H8625.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שָׁקַל; to balance; Tekel, be weighed.

H8626.d: a primitive root; to equalize, i.e. straighten (intransitive or transitive); figuratively, to compose; set in order, make straight.

H8627.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to תָּקַן; to straighten up, i.e. confirm; establish.

H8628.d: a primitive root; to clatter, i.e. slap (the hands together), clang (an instrument); by analogy, to drive (a nail or tent-pin, a dart, etc.); by implication, to become bondsman by handclasping); blow (a trumpet), cast, clap, fasten, pitch (tent), smite, sound, strike, [idiom] suretiship, thrust.

H8629.d: from תָּקַע; a blast of a trumpet; sound.

H8630.d: a primitive root; to overpower; prevail (against).

H8631.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to תָּקַף; to become (causatively, make) mighty or (figuratively) obstinate; make firm, harden, be(-come) strong.

H8632.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to תֹּקֶף; power; might, strength.

H8633.d: from תָּקַף; might or (figuratively) positiveness; authority, power, strength.

H8634.d: probably for תַּרְעֵלָה; a reeling; Taralah, a place in Palestine; Taralah.

H8635.d: from רָבָה; multiplication, i.e. progeny; increase.

H8636.d: from רָבָה; multiplication, i.e. percentage or bonus in addition to principal; increase, unjust gain.

H8637.d: a denominative from רָגַל; to cause to walk; teach to go.

H8638.d: a denominative from רָגַם in the sense of throwing over; to transfer, i.e. translate; interpret.

H8639.d: from רָדַם; a lethargy or (by implication) trance; deep sleep.

H8640.d: of foreign derivation; Tirhakah, a king of Kush; Tirhakah.

H8641.d: or תְּרֻמָה; (Deuteronomy 12:11), from רוּם; a present (as offered up), especially in sacrifice or as tribute; gift, heave offering (shoulder), oblation, offered(-ing).

H8642.d: formed as תְּרוּמָה; a sacrificial offering; oblation.

H8643.d: from רוּעַ; clamor, i.e. acclamation of joy or a battle-cry; especially clangorof trumpets, as an alarum; alarm, blow(-ing) (of, the) (trumpets), joy, jubile, loud noise, rejoicing, shout(-ing), (high, joyful) sound(-ing).

H8644.d: from רוּף in the sense of its congener רָפָא; a remedy; medicine.

H8645.d: probably from רָזָה; a species of tree (apparently from its slenderness), perhaps the cypress; cypress.

H8646.d: of uncertain derivation; Terach, the father of Abraham; also a place in the Desert; Tarah, Terah.

H8647.d: of uncertain derivation; Tirchanah, an Israelite; Tirhanah.

H8648.d: (Aramaic) feminine תַּרְתֵּין; corresponding to שְׁנַיִם; two; second, [phrase] twelve, two.

H8649.d: and תַּרְמוּת; or תַּרְמִית; from רָמָה; fraud; deceit(-ful), privily.

H8650.d: probably for אֹרֶן; a pole (as a mast or flagstaff); beacon, mast.

H8651.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to שַׁעַר; a door; by implication, a palace; gate mouth.

H8654.d: patrial from an unused name meaning gate; a Tirathite or inhabitant of an unknown Tirah; Tirathite.

H8655.d: plural from רָפָא; a healer; Teraphim (singular or plural) a family idol; idols(-atry), images, teraphim.

H8656.d: from רָצָה; delightsomeness; Tirtsah, a place in Palestine; also an Israelitess; Tirzah.

H8657.d: of foreign derivation; Teresh, a eunuch of Xerxes; Teresh.

H8658.d: probably of foreign derivation (compare תַּרְשִׁישׁ); a gem, perhaps the topaz; beryl.

H8659.d: probably the same as תַּרְשִׁישׁ (as the region of the stone, or the reverse); Tarshish, a place on the Mediterranean, hence, the ephithet of a merchant vessel (as if for or from that port); also the name of a Persian and of an Israelite; Tarshish, Tharshish.

H8660.d: of foreign derivation; Tirshatha, the title of a Persian deputy or governor; Tirshatha.

H8661.d: of foreign derivation; Tartan, an Assyrian; Tartan.

H8662.d: of foreign derivation; Tartak, a deity of the Avvites; Tartak.

H8663.d: from שׁוֹא; a crashing or loud clamor; crying, noise, shouting, stir.

H8664.d: patrial from an unused name meaning recourse; a Tishbite or inhabitant of Tishbeh (in Gilead); Tishbite.

H8665.d: from שָׁבַץ; checkered stuff (as reticulated); broidered.

H8666.d: or תְּשֻׁבָה; from שׁוּב; a recurrence (of time or place); a reply (as returned); answer, be expired, return.

H8667.d: from שׂוּם; a deposit, i.e. pledging; [phrase] fellowship.

H8668.d: or תְּשֻׁעָה; from שָׁוַע in the sense of יָשַׁע; rescue (literal or figurative, persons, national or spiritual); deliverance, help, safety, salvation, victory.

H8669.d: from שׁוּק in the original sense of stretching out after; a longing; desire.

H8670.d: from שׁוּר in the sense of arrival; a gift; present.

H8672.d: or (masculine) תִּשְׁעָה; perhaps from שָׁעָה through the idea of a turn to the next or full number ten; nine or (ordinal) ninth; nine ([phrase] -teen, [phrase] -teenth, -th).

H8674.d: of foreign derivation; Tattenai, a Persian; Tatnai.
